jobs.excerpt: DescriptionPrimary responsibilities for administration and development & integration support for Splunk Cloud.
jobs.description:
Description

Primary responsibilities for administration and development & integration support for Splunk Cloud. Develops, recommends, implements, and manages the technical architecture (hardware, software, database, and communications) which will be used for all or specific applications in a large, distributed cross-platform environment. Responsibilities also include the identification of relevant information and the determination of the environment, which will be used for development.

In this role the Senior SIEM Architect will:

  • Provide engineering and operational support for the Splunk Cloud Security Incident and Event Management (SIEM) platform. This includes assisting with the implementation and support of SPLUNK Cloud across multiple environments and varying OS types.
  • Provide integration support and development effort on design related changes or introduction of new business requirements to Splunk Cloud.
  • Support ongoing work efforts to develop and administer Splunk Cloud can continue as new requirements, functionality or integration is required to enable our modern enterprise security monitoring program and target state operating model within the current project timelines.

General Skills:

  • Leadership experience in the development and implementation of technical security architectures at the specified experience level
  • Extensive experience with at least two cloud service providers (i.e. AWS, Azure, GCP) , enterprise security services, Identity and database technologies, and network access protocols
  • Experience in structured methodologies for the design, development and implementation of cloud applications
  • Extensive experience in systems analysis and design in large secure solution environments
  • Knowledge and experience designing processes around ITIL and is able to guide others using this methodology
  • Experience translating business requirements into solution needs
  • Experience preparing conceptual, logical and/or physical processes and data models
  • Experience developing, recommending, implementing and managing technical security architecture
  • Awareness of emerging technologies, trends and directions
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving and decision-making skills; verbal and written communication skills; interpersonal and negotiation skills
  • A team player with a track record for meeting deadlines
  • Knowledge and understanding of Information Management security principles, concepts, policies and practices

SkillsExperience and Skill Set Requirements

Experience and Skill Set Requirements

Advanced knowledge and experience with Security Information & Event Management technology: (45%)

SIEM:

  • SPLUNK Cloud (Must)
  • Azure Sentinel

Cloud Infrastructure:

  • Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS)
  • Platform as a Service (PaaS)
  • Software as a Service (SaaS)

Agile Project Delivery (15%)

Experience working on agile project delivery teams. Working experience with:

  • Backlog
  • User stories
  • Scrum
  • Sprints

Security Operations Experience (35%)

  • SIEM use case development, rationalization and configuration.
  • SIEM dashboard creation
  • Security operational process development and documentation (playbooks/runbooks)
  • MITRE Framework

Previous Public Sector Experience (5%)

  • Previous public sector work experience is considered a positive

Must haves:

Advanced knowledge and experience with Security Information & Event Management technology

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States.
jobs.description:
Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States. LendingTree and its affiliates (“LendingTree”) will not provide or assume sponsorship for employment visas for this position, now or in the future.

The Opportunity
As a Data Engineer at LendingTree, you’ll build the pipelines, models, and data services behind reporting, analytics, and data science across our lending and insurance businesses. You’ll tackle complex integration and modeling challenges, improve reliability and cost efficiency, and apply practical AI tools to help the team deliver better data solutions faster.

How You’ll Make an Impact

  • Build and operate scalable batch and real-time streaming pipelines, ETL/ELT workflows, and database applications across multiple lines of business, with clear plans for schema changes, retries, and recovery.
  • Design dimensional models and reusable datasets for business, analytics, and data science needs. Perform complex data analysis to validate business rules, identify trends and anomalies, and uncover opportunities.
  • Own the reliability and efficiency of your data solutions: automate quality checks, monitor freshness, tune performance and compute costs, and participate in the on-call rotation to resolve incidents and prevent recurrence.
  • Create reusable frameworks and development patterns that improve delivery speed and consistency. Apply automated testing, code review, and repeatable deployments; maintain technical standards, runbooks, and learning materials.
  • Partner with business users and engineering teams to clarify requirements, resolve issues, and contribute to the data engineering roadmap, including platform capabilities, priorities, technical trade-offs, and delivery estimates.
  • Apply AI tools to development, testing, documentation, and troubleshooting. Validate generated code and results, protect sensitive data, and assess whether these tools improve quality and reduce delivery time.

Who You’ll Work With

You’ll join the Data Engineering team, working with your manager, fellow engineers, and partners in analytics, data science, product, and business operations across Lending and Insurance. You’ll also collaborate with platform and infrastructure teams to manage dependencies, support production services, and turn business priorities into practical data solutions.

What You’ll Bring

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in data engineering, including data warehousing, ETL/ELT development, and analytics, with a record of delivering and supporting production solutions.
  • Advanced SQL skills, including writing, tuning, and debugging complex queries and using data analysis to investigate problems.
  • Experience designing data lakes and warehouses on scalable, distributed platforms, with an understanding of batch and streaming integration patterns.
  • Strong dimensional modeling skills and sound data warehousing practices, including defining grain, fact and dimension tables, and how historical changes are represented.
  • Ability to deliver projects with minimal guidance in an Agile team, using testing, version control, documentation, and systematic troubleshooting to build maintainable solutions.
  • Clear written, verbal, and data presentation skills, including the ability to understand business needs and explain findings and technical decisions through documentation, presentations, or dashboards.

What Will Help You Thrive
You’re curious about the business behind the data, learn new tools thoughtfully, communicate issues early, and share both credit and lessons learned. Experience in any of the following is a plus:

  • Snowflake virtual warehouses, performance and cost tuning, Streams and Tasks, and/or SQL Server.
  • Matillion, dbt, or similar tools for data integration and transformation.
  • Python, C#, or PowerShell for integration and automation; Git/GitLab for collaboration and CI/CD workflows.
  • Power BI, Tableau, or Streamlit for dashboards, data applications, and communicating insights.
  • using AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or Maia to accelerate coding, testing, documentation, and troubleshooting while validating generated code and results.
  • S. in Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

What Success Looks Like

  • Production pipelines meet agreed freshness and reliability targets, with clear monitoring, ownership, and recovery procedures.
  • Business, analytics, and data science partners use tested models with consistent definitions and less manual reconciliation.
  • Query tuning and pipeline improvements produce measurable reductions in runtime, compute cost, or recurring incidents.
  • Reusable frameworks, useful documentation, and validated AI workflows shorten delivery time while maintaining quality.

Life at LendingTree

We’re a collaborative, entrepreneurial team that’s curious, creative, and always ready to roll up our sleeves and get things done. You’ll work alongside smart, driven people who care about doing great work — and about helping each other succeed.

We believe the best ideas come from different perspectives, and we’re committed to creating a workplace where people feel welcomed, valued, and empowered to make an impact. You’ll have the trust and flexibility to do your best work, the opportunity to take ownership and try new things, and teammates who genuinely enjoy working together.

And while we work hard, we don’t take ourselves too seriously. We celebrate wins, recognize great work (our GSD — Get Stuff Done — Award is a fan favorite), and make time to have some fun along the way.

Come grow with us, make an impact, and help us build what’s next.

What We Offer

We want you to feel supported at work and beyond. Our benefits and programs are designed to help you stay healthy, recharge, plan for the future, and bring your best to whatever matters most to you.

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401(k) matching
  • Generous time off
  • Wellness programs and resources
  • Annual performance bonus eligibility

Base Pay:

The base pay range for this position is $100,000-130,000; pay offered may vary based on location, internal factors, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

Incentive Compensation: This position is eligible for an annual performance bonus.

Work Authorization: This role is not eligible for immigration sponsorship. Please do not apply for this role if you will need employer sponsorship now or in the future to begin or continue employment.

Everyone Belongs Here

LendingTree is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion (or creed), gender, gender expression, age, national origin, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, or military status.

If you believe you need a reasonable accommodation in order to search for a job opening or to submit an application, please email us at .

jobs.description:
Company: TurFresh

Location: Remote — Pacific Time availability required

Engagement: Project-based contractor, with opportunities for ongoing assignments

About TurFresh

TurFresh specializes in professional artificial turf cleaning and maintenance across multiple U.S. markets. We help homeowners and businesses keep their turf clean, fresh, and ready to enjoy.

We’re looking for a reliable freelance designer who can turn marketing ideas, photography, and raw video footage into polished content that educates customers, builds trust, and supports sales. You’ll work with our marketing team and complement our Social & Reputation role by producing the creative assets they need.

What You’ll Create

    • Social media graphics, educational carousels, and campaign assets.

    • Short-form videos for Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts using footage provided by our team.

    • Digital advertising graphics and video variations for testing different hooks, messages, and calls to action.

    • Email graphics for promotions, customer education, and maintenance reminders.

    • Website and landing page graphics.

    • Before-and-after content, customer testimonials, and service explainers.

    • Sales materials explaining our cleaning process, maintenance plans, and service value.

    • Occasional flyers, brochures, and other print materials.

Required Skills

    • A strong portfolio of marketing design for consumer brands or service businesses.

    • Basic short-form video editing: selecting useful footage, creating engaging openings, trimming clips, adding captions, balancing audio, and formatting for each platform.

    • Strong layout, typography, and visual storytelling skills.

    • Ability to make educational content clear and engaging.

    • Ability to follow brand guidelines while contributing thoughtful creative ideas.

    • Strong English communication, attention to detail, and dependable delivery.

    • Comfort working from briefs, asking useful questions, and incorporating feedback.

    • Proficiency in relevant design and video tools, such as Adobe Creative Suite, Canva, Figma, CapCut, or comparable software.

    • Organized delivery of editable source files and finished assets.

    Experience with home services, pet-related brands, or local service marketing is a plus.

Availability & Working Together

    Consistent availability during Pacific Time business hours is required. We need someone who can collaborate while our team is working, participate in project discussions, and respond to feedback and revision requests during agreed availability windows.

    You can be located anywhere, provided your schedule offers reliable overlap with our team. Please specify your regular available hours in Pacific Time and your current capacity for new projects.

    Our marketing team will provide objectives, key messages, brand assets, photography, and raw footage—including field content captured by our team. You’ll turn those inputs into finished creative and identify anything else needed to complete the assignment.

    Each project will have an agreed scope, deliverables, deadline, fee, and revision allowance. This role focuses on creative production; our team handles marketing strategy, publishing, community engagement, and reputation management.

What Success Looks Like

    • Clear, engaging creative that helps customers understand our services and their value.

    • Effective use of real customer and field footage.

    • Consistent branding across graphics and video.

    • Reliable turnaround, proactive communication, and accurate execution.

    • Assets delivered in the right formats, ready for our team to use.

To Apply

    Please include:

    1. Your portfolio, with three relevant graphic design examples and at least two short-form video examples.

    1. A brief explanation of your contribution to those examples.

    1. Your preferred design and video editing tools.

    1. Your time zone, regular availability in Pacific Time, and weekly capacity for new assignments.

    1. Your typical turnaround for a graphic, a short-form video, and revisions.

    1. Your project pricing or estimated fees for a social carousel, a set of three ad variations, and a 15–30-second video edited from supplied footage.

    1. Your earliest available start date.

    We plan to begin with a small paid project to evaluate creative quality, communication, turnaround, and fit before assigning additional work.

TurFresh shares a Lever recruiting platform with our sister company, Express Chipping. As a result, you may see the Express Chipping name in the application URL or automated communications. This position is exclusively with TurFresh.

jobs.excerpt: Aperia is unlocking a new era of efficiency and sustainability for commercial vehicle fleets, by developing innovative hardware and data analytics solutions.
jobs.description:
Aperia is unlocking a new era of efficiency and sustainability for commercial vehicle fleets, by developing innovative hardware and data analytics solutions. Inventors of the award- winning and disruptive Halotm Automatic Tire Inflator, and the cloud delivered Halo Connect tire analytics platform. Aperia saves fleets thousands of hours of down-time every week, reduces the carbon footprint and environmental impact of the freight industry. Join us as we expand our product offering and take the next steps on our journey toward bringing the "backbone of our economy" into the automation age.

This position requires candidates to be authorized to work in the US on an ongoing basis without current or future employer sponsorship. We are unable to sponsor or transfer H-1B or other employment-based visas, and candidates currently on F-1, OPT, STEM OPT status are not eligiable for this role.

Your Role

As a Hardware Data Analyst, you will harness vast amounts of data streaming from our extensive deployment of telematics and IoT devices in the field. Your work will directly impact our hardware systems' performance, reliability, and efficiency, helping deliver exceptional customer experiences. Collaborating with engineering, product management, data science, and customer support teams, you will process and analyze sensor and analytics data to uncover insights, identify issues, and drive continuous improvement.

Your Responsibilities

  • Design and deliver dashboards, reports, and presentations using tools like QuickSight, Tableau, or Python libraries to visualize performance metrics and communicate findings effectively.
  • Continuously monitor and analyze incoming sensor and analytics data to identify trends, anomalies, and potential issues in the field.
  • Use statistical models and machine learning techniques to extract insights and generate actionable recommendations for hardware reliability and performance improvements.
  • Compare outputs from various firmware versions to validate improvements or detect unexpected regressions.
  • Collaborate with hardware engineers, product managers, and data scientists to define and execute data analysis strategies.
  • Support customer support teams by providing data-driven insights to address product performance and anomaly-related inquiries.
  • Proactively identify and propose new tools, methods, or processes to enhance data analysis capabilities and improve operational efficiency.
  • Collaborate with the engineering and data science teams to design and implement data pipelines that ensure reliable ingestion, processing, and storage of large-scale field data.
  • Act as a data advocate within the organization, ensuring teams have the necessary data access and tools to make informed decisions.
  • Collaborate with product development teams to ensure field data is incorporated into the design of future hardware and software features.

Skills/Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • 2-4 years of experience in data analysis, with exposure to hardware-related roles or IoT systems preferred.
  • Proficiency in Python, SQL, MATLAB, or Excel for data analysis and modeling.
  • Demonstrated experience with visualization tools like Quicksight, Tableau, Streamlit, or Looker.
  • Strong understanding of statistical modeling, machine learning, and time-series data analysis.
  • Experience with cloud platforms like AWS (S3, Redshift, Kinesis, IoT Core) or similar is a plus.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to translate data findings into actionable insights.
  • Excellent communication skills to present complex data in a clear, concise manner to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Pay Range: $95,000 - $123,000

*Base salary only. Salary is dependent on multiple factors including, but not limited to, experience and location.

**Additional compensation may include equity, bonuses, stipends, medical, dental, vision, 401(k), and long-term disability insurance.

About IonQ:

IonQ, Inc. [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including Amazon Web Services, and AstraZeneca achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, setting a world record in quantum computing performance.

Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.

Location: Remote, U.S.
Travel: Up to 50%, domestic and international.
Job ID: 1904

The Role:

IonQ is hiring a Channel Sales Leader to build and scale the indirect route to market for its space portfolio including Capella Data as a Service (DaaS) and satellite systems, Skyloom optical communications terminals and crosslink solutions, and the broader space solutions offering. You will recruit, enable, and grow a global ecosystem of resellers, distributors, value-added analytics providers, systems integrators, primes, and in-country partners, and carry a channel-sourced revenue number. This is a builder's role for a leader who can stand up partner programs from early stage, run long-cycle capital and program-based pursuits through partners, and grow recurring data and capacity subscriptions at the same time.

Responsibilities:

  • Own an annual channel-sourced and channel-influenced revenue quota spanning Capella DaaS subscriptions and tasking capacity, satellite systems, Skyloom optical communications products, and the wider space solutions portfolio.
  • Design and execute the global channel strategy: partner segmentation and tiering, coverage model by region and market, and the margin, discount, and deal-registration framework that governs it.
  • Recruit, onboard, and develop partners — resellers, distributors, value-added analytics and application providers, systems integrators, defense primes, and international in-country representatives.
  • Own joint business plans with each strategic partner: co-selling motions, joint pipeline generation, marketing development funds, quarterly business reviews, and accountability to committed targets.
  • Build partner enablement end to end — sales and technical training, certification paths, demo and evaluation assets, and pricing tools — in partnership with solutions engineering and product marketing.
  • Support partner-led and teamed pursuits: RFIs, RFPs, and government solicitations, prime and subcontractor teaming strategies, and international distribution structures within export-control requirements.
  • Forecast channel pipeline accurately in CRM and PRM, maintain disciplined pipeline hygiene, and administer clear rules of engagement to manage channel conflict with the direct sales team.
  • Serve as the voice of the partner ecosystem to product, engineering, and mission solutions teams, and represent IonQ at industry, defense, and geospatial conferences and partner events.

Requirements:

  • 10+ years in enterprise sales with at least 4 years building or leading channel, partner, or indirect programs in geospatial data, earth observation, satellite communications, satellite systems, defense technology, or adjacent data/SaaS markets, with a consistent record of exceeding quota.
  • Demonstrated success standing up a channel program in an early or emerging market — recruiting partners, defining program economics, and scaling partner-sourced revenue across both recurring data subscriptions and large capital or program-based hardware.
  • Experience driving partner-led sales into U.S. government, defense, and intelligence customers as well as international markets, including familiarity with procurement vehicles, teaming arrangements, and export controls (ITAR/EAR).
  • Command of a structured sales methodology (MEDDICC, Challenger, or similar) plus deal-registration, margin governance, and CRM/PRM forecast rigor.
  • Ability to engage credibly with partner technical and mission stakeholders on remote sensing, SAR, optical communications and crosslinks, tasking, and data delivery workflows.
  • Bachelor’s degree in business, engineering, or a related field; willingness to travel up to 50%, including international travel.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Direct experience building or managing a channel for SAR, optical imagery, or RF sensing data and analytics.
  • Background in satellite systems, optical communications terminals, ground segment, or space mission integration.
  • Experience in early market development or category creation for an emerging technology, including partner-led go-to-market.
  • Active U.S. security clearance, or eligibility to obtain one.
  • Established relationships across DoD, IC, allied international defense customers, and the global space and geospatial partner ecosystem.

The International Rescue Committee (IRC) responds to the world's worst humanitarian crises, helping to restore health, safety, education, economic wellbeing, and power to people devastated by conflict and disaster. Founded in 1933 at the call of Albert Einstein, the IRC is one of the world's largest international humanitarian non-governmental organizations (INGO), at work in more than 40 countries and 29 U.S. cities helping people to survive, reclaim control of their future and strengthen their communities. A force for humanity, IRC employees deliver lasting impact by restoring safety, dignity and hope to millions. If you're a solutions-driven, passionate change-maker, come join us in positively impacting the lives of millions of people world-wide for a better future.

This position is contingent on receipt of grant funding.

Job Overview:

The International Rescue Committee (IRC) is one of the leading providers of high-quality programming for refugees resettling to the United States. The IRC is committed to developing innovative programs that respond to the refugees’ unique strengths and needs, using our learning and experience to shape policy and practice, and highlighting and promoting best practices in refugee services provision.


The IRC is seeking a Program Officer for Instructional Design and Multimedia for Settle In, a program providing information and support for newcomers in multiple languages through its website (SettleInUS.org), mobile app, and social media platforms. More information on Settle In can be found on


This position designs and produces the learning experiences newcomers encounter across Settle In’s platforms. The role combines two areas of practice: instructional design—structuring multilingual, self-paced learning journeys that help newcomers build knowledge over time—and multimedia production—creating videos, graphics, and other assets that support the full range of Settle In content.

Major Responsibilities:

  • Design multilingual, self-paced learning journeys for newcomer audiences, including learning objectives, sequencing, knowledge checks, and reinforcement. Apply instructional design, adult learning principles, plain language standards, and translation-ready structure so that content is usable by newcomers with varying levels of literacy, digital literacy, and prior exposure to U.S. systems.
  • In partnership with Switchboard’s Senior Program Officer, Instructional Design, establish instructional design standards for Settle In content and review materials developed by team members, subject matter experts, and contractors against those standards.
  • Incorporating Switchboard’s established instructional design standards, recommend and implement improvements to Settle In’s instructional design practice, and update previously developed Settle In learning resources on an established review cycle.
  • Create compelling, in-language multimedia content, including short-form video, infographics, motion graphics, and social media assets.
  • Manage post-production of all finalized work, including Adobe Premiere project organization, color correction and grading, sound design, motion graphics, music editing, sequencing, export and compression for multiple platforms, and archiving.
  • Coordinate with the multilingual Digital Community team on content creation, voiceover, subtitling, and translation review, and advise colleagues on audio and video recording tools and practices.
  • Ensure final products are easy to understand, culturally appropriate, linguistically and factually accurate, accessible across web and mobile, and aligned with Settle In standards, newcomer needs, and funder requirements.
  • Ensure all learning experiences and multimedia content meet accessibility standards (e.g., captions, alt text, screen-reader compatibility)
  • Maintain visual and instructional consistency across Settle In's platforms (website, mobile app, social media)
  • Coordinate and incorporate feedback across teams and projects and participate in user testing and other methods for optimization of content.
  • Manage production timelines across concurrent projects and coordinate the work of external contractors, including videographers, designers, and translation vendors.
  • Use platform data and user insights to set measurable goals for content and assess performance, and contribute to project reports, including monthly activity updates and performance monitoring reports.

Other duties as assigned.

Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in instructional design, education, communications, or other relevant field (or equivalent experience).
  • Minimum four years of professional experience combining instructional design and multimedia production, including creating multilingual digital content for diverse populations.
  • Demonstrated experience designing self-paced learning for adult audiences, including experience with e-learning tools.
  • Excellent command of video editing (Adobe Premiere) and graphic design software (Adobe InDesign, Canva), and knowledge of social media platforms, especially Facebook.
  • Working knowledge of plain language principles and digital accessibility standards.
  • Experience contributing to project M&E (data collection, management, and reporting).
  • Ability to manage complex projects on strict timelines, with excellent written and oral communication skills and strong attention to detail.
  • Fluency in at least one of Settle In’s supported languages (Dari, Pashto, Spanish, and Haitian Creole) preferred.
  • Previous experience working with refugee resettlement or other immigration pathways, and familiarity with ORR-funded programs.
  • Ability to translate complex or technical information into clear, visual, and easy-to-understand learning content
  • Experience engaging with external subject matter experts, consultants, or production vendors.

Working Environment: This position is a remote working environment. Required domestic travel up to 20%.


Compensation: (Pay Rate: $70,000 - $85,000/yr). Ranges are based on various factors including the labor market, job type, internal equity, and budget. Exact offers are calibrated by work location, individual candidate experience and skills relative to the defined job requirements.

Professional Standards: All International Rescue Committee workers must adhere to the core values and principles outlined in IRC Way - Standards for Professional Conduct. Our Standards are Integrity, Service, Equality and Accountability. In accordance with these values, the IRC operates and enforces policies on Safeguarding, Conflicts of Interest, Fiscal Integrity, and Reporting Wrongdoing and Protection from Retaliation. IRC is committed to take all necessary preventive measures and create an environment where people feel safe, and to take all necessary actions and corrective measures when harm occurs. IRC builds teams of professionals who promote critical reflection, power sharing, debate, and objectivity to deliver the best possible services to our clients.

Role Title: Software Engineer (Open Source Contributor)

We care about your human judgment: our interview and assessment stages are designed to see how you think, so we ask that you complete them on your own, without AI assistants or help from others.

Job Description

In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters.

You'll create realistic, interesting and challenging coding tasks for AI to solve involving feature implementation and bug fixes, and implement deterministic verifiers that accept reasonable valid solutions and reject everything else.

What we're looking for

  1. Strong backend experience in Java, Node.js, Go, Rust, Typescript, Python, C++ or similar
  2. A track record building scalable services and APIs
  3. Comfort with debugging, performance work and automated testing
  4. Solid code review instincts

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Proven experience in backend development, with a track record of delivering high-quality and performant projects.
  2. Demonstrated success in identifying and resolving software bugs and system bottlenecks.
  3. Experience with codebase refactoring and implementing complex features in large-scale applications.
  4. Strong understanding of algorithms, data structures, and foundational computer science concepts.
  5. Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and technical communication skills.

Scope of Work

  1. Contribute expert-level code samples, debugging strategies, and development insights in Python3, Java, Rust, Go, C++, or TypeScript.
  2. Analyze, troubleshoot, and resolve complex software defects and performance bottlenecks in diverse codebases.
  3. Implement robust new features, ensuring scalability, maintainability, and adherence to software best practices.
  4. Refactor and optimize legacy code to improve clarity, efficiency, and long-term reliability.
  5. Document technical reasoning, solution approaches, and code decisions to enhance AI training data quality.
  6. Review and validate peer-contributed code and technical submissions for accuracy and clarity.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Significant hands-on expertise in at least one of the following: Python3, Java, Rust, Go, C++, or TypeScript.
  2. Deep understanding of algorithms, data structures, and software engineering principles.
  3. Proven ability to debug complex systems, resolve bugs, and deliver effective optimizations.
  4. Experience with large codebase refactoring and legacy system modernization.
  5. Track record of delivering high-impact features from conception through delivery within cross-functional projects.
  6. Strong documentation and communication skills to articulate technical concepts clearly.
  7. Interest in or curiosity about AI and its technical challenges (previous AI experience not required).

Process:

  1. Apply to the role, filling out the screening questions
  2. Complete AI interview (aprox. 20 minutes)
  3. Technical Assessment (if your GitHub profile doesn’t fully showcase the expertise required for this role)
  4. Hiring Manager review

Compensation Structure

Compensation is output-based; experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete work may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow. Minimum submission requirements apply. Experts must submit a minimum of tasks per week.

Start Timeline & Availability

We typically fill roles within 48 hours and are looking for experts ready to jump in right away. If selected, we expect you to start your first tasks within 24–48 hours of completing onboarding.

We are seeking an entrepreneurial executive to build and lead a clinical supply consulting and advisory practice focused on forecasting, planning, optimization, and intelligent decision support. This leader will combine deep clinical supply expertise with consulting discipline, executive presence, and commercial acumen.

The Opportunity

    This role sits at the intersection of clinical supply strategy, forecasting and optimization, RTSM/IRT, consulting services, product innovation, and commercial growth. You will serve as Endpoint's executive subject matter expert for clinical supply and help define how sponsors use data, technology, and practical expertise to improve decisions across the trial lifecycle. This is not a traditional clinical supply operations role. It is a build-and-lead opportunity for someone who can create repeatable advisory offerings, engage senior sponsor stakeholders, shape software capabilities, and establish a differentiated market position.

What you will do

    • Build and lead the consulting practice
      • Establish and scale a clinical supply consulting and advisory capability.
      • Develop repeatable offerings, methodologies, frameworks, delivery standards, and intellectual property.
      • Define an operating model that supports high-quality delivery, measurable customer outcomes, and sustainable growth.
      • Build and develop a team of clinical supply experts as the practice grows.
      • Advise sponsors on complex supply decisions
        • Partner with clinical supply, development operations, clinical operations, and cross-functional leadership teams.
        • Guide customers through forecasting, manufacturing scenarios, inventory strategy, depot planning, overage, risk mitigation, and protocol-change impacts.
        • Facilitate executive discussions that convert uncertainty and complex data into clear decisions and actions.
        • Support strategic customer engagements, governance meetings, and business reviews.
        • Connect clinical supply planning with RTSM execution
          • Help customers use planning assumptions and real-time trial information to improve supply decisions.
          • Identify opportunities to reduce waste, improve responsiveness, and protect patient service levels.
          • Bring deep practical knowledge of RTSM/IRT workflows, integrations, and clinical supply operating models.
          • Shape product strategy and innovation
            • Collaborate with Product, Technology, Commercial, and Delivery leaders to translate market needs into scalable capabilities.
            • Use consulting insights to inform product priorities, workflow design, analytics, and decision-support use cases.
            • Act as a voice of the customer in the evolution of Endpoint clinical supply intelligence solutions.
            • Driving commercial growth and industry leadership
              • Participate in strategic pursuits, executive briefings, proposals, and solution design.
              • Create consulting-led entry points and expansion opportunities within sponsor organizations.
              • Represent Endpoint at industry events and build a credible external point of view through speaking and thought leadership.

What you will bring

    • 15+ years of experience in clinical trial supply management, clinical supply strategy, supply-chain consulting, clinical operations, or a closely related discipline.
    • Deep understanding of global clinical supply planning and execution, including forecasting, packaging and labeling, manufacturing constraints, inventory, distribution, depots, comparators, returns, and supply risk.
    • Strong working knowledge of RTSM/IRT and the relationship between supply planning and live study execution.
    • Experience advising pharmaceutical or biotechnology organizations on complex operational and strategic decisions.
    • Demonstrated ability to build methodologies, offerings, teams, or new business capabilities.
    • Credibility and confidence with senior executives and cross-functional stakeholders.
    • Commercial judgment, including the ability to identify needs, shape solutions, support proposals, and create measurable value.
    • Excellent communication, facilitation, writing, and presentation skills.
    • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant experience. An advanced degree or relevant professional certification

Leadership Profile

    • Entrepreneurial and comfortable building from an early foundation.
    • Customer-centered, outcome-oriented, and practical.
    • Analytical, data-driven, and able to simplify complex decisions.
    • Collaborative across product, technology, commercial, and delivery teams.
    • Visible and credible as an industry leader, while remaining hands-on when needed.
    • Committed to quality, speed, agility, and strong customer partnerships.

What Success looks like

    • A differentiated clinical supply consulting practice is launched with clear offerings and delivery standards.
    • Sponsor executives view Endpoint as a trusted advisor on clinical supply planning, forecasting, and optimization.
    • Consulting creates measurable customer outcomes and contributes to sustainable revenue growth.
    • Customer insights directly influence product priorities and scalable clinical supply intelligence capabilities.
    • Endpoint develops a stronger market voice and network across the clinical supply community.

Why Endpoint Clinical

    At Endpoint, you will have the opportunity to build a new capability within an established clinical trial technology organization. You will work closely with executive leadership, influence company and product strategy, advise customers on high-value decisions, and help define a more connected future for clinical supply planning and trial execution. If you are passionate about clinical supply innovation and energized by the opportunity to build, lead, and create measurable customer impact, we would like to hear from you.

Equal Opportunity

Ces évaluations jouent un rôle essentiel dans la qualité et l’intégrité des résultats des essais cliniques.

  • Poste 100 % à distance
  • Horaires de travail flexibles
  • Contrat de prestation de services (freelance)

Profil recherché

Professionnels ayant une expérience dans l’administration, la cotation, la révision ou la supervision des évaluations suivantes :

  • MADRS (Montgomery-Åsberg Depression Rating Scale)
  • MINI (Mini International Neuropsychiatric Interview)

Qualifications requises

  • Diplôme de Master en psychologie, psychiatrie ou dans un domaine connexe
  • Minimum de 3 années d’expérience clinique après l’obtention du Master
  • Minimum de 3 années d’expérience dans le domaine des essais cliniques
  • Excellentes compétences en entretien clinique et en évaluation
  • Maîtrise courante de l’anglais et du français requise ; la connaissance d’autres langues constitue un atout

Rejoignez une équipe internationale qui contribue à l’avancement de traitements innovants tout en bénéficiant de la flexibilité d’un travail à distance, basé sur des projets. Cette opportunité ne donne pas droit à un parrainage pour l’obtention d’un visa ou d’une autorisation de travail.

  • Own the full CFD study lifecycle: clarify the design question, define scope and acceptance criteria, develop the methodology, build geometry, generate the mesh, establish boundary conditions, solve, verify convergence, post-process results, and issue technical reports.
  • Perform internal data hall studies addressing rack inlet temperatures, airflow distribution, hot- and cold-aisle containment, bypass and recirculation, raised-floor or slab configurations, cooling-unit placement, rack density, failure modes, and capacity-expansion scenarios.
  • Perform external studies for cooling towers, chillers, dry coolers, generator and boiler exhaust, mechanical yards, relief air, outdoor-air intakes, heat rejection, plume behavior, short-circuiting, and thermal re-entrainment.
  • Conduct steady-state and transient analyses for cooling-system outages, equipment failures, load changes, control sequences, thermal ride-through, and other operating scenarios defined by the project team.
  • Develop defensible modeling assumptions using design documents, equipment data, controls narratives, weather data, commissioning information, and field measurements; identify data gaps and document their impact on conclusions.
  • Apply sound verification and validation practices, including mesh-sensitivity checks, mass and energy balance reviews, convergence assessment, comparison with hand calculations, and correlation to measured or monitoring data when available.
  • Evaluate results against project-specific criteria and relevant guidance, including ASHRAE TC 9.9 thermal guidance and applicable client, code, and industry requirements.
  • Translate findings into prioritized, actionable recommendations for equipment selection, airflow management, containment, intake/exhaust separation, controls, phasing, redundancy, and operational resilience.
  • Prepare concise, client-ready reports and visualizations that clearly communicate methodology, assumptions, scenarios, results, risks, limitations, and recommended next steps.
  • Present findings and coordinate directly with multidisciplinary project teams to resolve issues and confirm implementation of recommendations.
  • Contribute to standardized templates, modeling procedures, quality-control checklists, libraries, and lessons learned; support technical knowledge sharing and mentoring of less-experienced staff.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a closely related engineering discipline.
  • 6+ years of hands-on CFD experience, including direct application to data centers, mission-critical facilities, or similarly complex thermal-management environments.
  • Proficiency with at least one data-center or general-purpose CFD platform, such as Cadence 6SigmaDCX, Ansys Fluent, Ansys CFX, or OpenFOAM, and the ability to learn and apply project-required tools.
  • Strong fundamentals in fluid mechanics, heat transfer, thermodynamics, turbulence modeling, and HVAC system operation.
  • Experience modeling both internal environments, such as IT spaces and containment systems, and external environments, such as mechanical yards, cooling equipment, intakes, and exhaust discharges.
  • Working knowledge of data center cooling architectures, HVAC systems, redundancy concepts, controls and failure scenarios, and common thermal performance metrics.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s in Mechanical Engineering
  • Professional Engineer (PE)
  • Experience with US codes and standards.
  • Demonstrated success independently delivering CFD studies from scoping through final report, including geometry preparation, meshing, solver setup, convergence assessment, post-processing, and engineering interpretation.
  • Ability to develop appropriate boundary conditions from design information and equipment performance data, and to explain the sensitivity of results to key assumptions.
  • Strong technical writing, visualization, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate complex results to engineering teams, project managers, and clients.

Human Interest is changing that by making it affordable and accessible for small and medium-sized businesses to offer employees a path to financial independence through retirement savings.

Reporting directly to the Senior Director of Operations, you will translate high-level organizational strategy into actionable operational plans, driving a culture of continuous improvement, strict risk mitigation, and client-centric execution.

In this role, you will serve as a critical strategic link between frontline operations and cross-functional leadership—including Product, Engineering, Data, Legal, and Sales/Onboarding. You will mentor and develop direct-report managers, scale high-volume transaction operations, and leverage data-driven insights to elevate customer experiences while maintaining a lean operational footprint.

The CS Operations organization sits at the heart of Human Interest's mission to make retirement savings accessible. Our teams ensure high-value financial transactions for thousands of participants every day are handled seamlessly—ensuring every dollar lands in the right place, on time, and in full compliance with regulatory requirements. We operate in a highly regulated environment where errors carry real and substantial financial risk, so precision is non-negotiable. We maintain data integrity through rigorous review, quality control, and escalation protocols, and we collaborate closely with Customer Success, Engineering, Product, and Compliance to optimize workflows, surface operational insights, and continuously improve the customer experience. We partner tightly with peer teams across Operations to share best practices, understand shared challenges, and strengthen Operations as a whole.

What you get to do every day

  • Coach & Develop Leaders: Directly manage, mentor, and build leadership bench strength across multiple Operations Managers. Establish high performance standards, hold leaders accountable to ambitious KPIs, and cultivate a robust pipeline of future operational talent.
  • Drive Vision & Strategic Alignment: Translate company strategy into departmental goals across multiple money movement flows. Maintain a broad business perspective, ensuring team priorities align directly with company objectives and broader operational effectiveness.
  • Operational Excellence & Performance Monitoring: Own high-level metrics for SLA adherence, quality, accuracy, and cycle times. Utilize data, capacity modeling, and optimization reports to continuously elevate throughput and set ambitious goals across teams.
  • Cross-Functional Strategic Partnership: Build collaborative relationships with leaders in CS&O, Product, Data, Legal, and Sales. Act as an operational translator, channeling frontline customer insights to shape product roadmaps while seamlessly operationalizing technical and regulatory changes.
  • Risk Management & Control Environment: Maintain a rigorous control environment across all transaction lifecycles. Proactively identify, assess, and mitigate operational risks to prevent financial loss and ensure full compliance in a highly regulated landscape.
  • Client Experience & Root Cause Analysis: Foster a client-first mindset that looks beyond vanity metrics to evaluate true customer experience. Lead deep-dive root cause analyses on operational trends and complex escalations to implement long-term structural fixes.
  • Process Optimization & Innovation: Drive a culture of innovation by identifying and scaling opportunities for workflow automation, process standardization, and system enhancements to maintain a lean operational footprint.
  • Change Leadership & Transparent Communication: Lead teams through change with clarity and empathy. Maintain clear, concise, and solution-oriented reporting cadences with executive leadership and internal stakeholders.
  • Other duties as assigned.

What you bring to the role

  • Experience: 4+ years of operational management experience in financial services, fintech, retirement services (401k), or banking, with 2+ years specifically managing other People Managers/Leaders.
  • Domain Expertise: Deep understanding of money movement processes, transaction lifecycles, and risk controls within a regulated environment.
  • Leadership Development: Proven track record of developing direct-report managers, setting clear expectations, managing performance, and building high-performing operational teams.
  • Data-Driven Decision Making: Demonstrated ability to leverage complex data reports, staffing models, and SLA metrics to drive strategy and prioritize trade-offs.
  • Cross-Functional Influence: Exceptional ability to partner with cross-functional leadership (Product, Engineering, Legal, CS) to align on shared goals and advocate for operational priorities.
  • Change & Process Management: Experience designing end-to-end operational improvements, scaling processes, and leading large teams through organizational change.
  • Communication & Integrity: High ethical standards with outstanding written and verbal communication skills tailored for executive leadership.

Nice to have

  • Direct experience with 401(k) recordkeeping systems, payroll integrations, or complex financial reconciliations.
  • Formal certification in process improvement methodologies (Lean, Six Sigma) or continuous improvement frameworks.
  • Experience in high-growth, fast-paced fintech environments.

Human Interest is tackling one of our country's biggest challenges - closing the retirement gap. The RN Clinical Consultant is responsible for oversight of Comprehensive Assessments, Care Management Plans, Transitions of Care, and clinical escalations, ensuring timely interventions and continuity of care. This role plays a critical part in improving health outcomes, reducing avoidable utilization, and supporting members through complex care journeys.

ECM services are provided to eligible Medi-Cal members enrolled in managed care plans and focus on sustained engagement, care coordination, and connection to community-based resources. Through collaboration with internal teams and external providers, the RN Clinical Consultant helps ensure members receive the right care, at the right time, in the most appropriate setting.

  • Engage members, as appropriate, using clinical expertise and motivational interviewing techniques to support health behavior change and care plan adherence
  • Provide health education within scope of practice to promote improved health outcomes
  • Coordinate care through collaboration with internal teams and external providers, ensuring seamless communication and continuity of care
  • Ensure all clinical activities are documented accurately and in accordance with organizational, regulatory, and healthcare plan requirements
  • Consult and collaborate with clinical leadership as needed for complex cases or escalations

NICE TO HAVES

You will take a team of 3 AI-driven Creative Designers and scale it to 6. The team produces static ad creatives, photorealistic AI visuals for performance campaigns across paid media channels, and source assets for our video production pipeline.

Your job is to build the company's visual creative engine. Whatever the starting point- a brief, a hypothesis, a raw idea - it leaves the team as a creative that performs.

You'll work closely with Creative Producers, Marketers, Copywriters, Media Buyers, and the Video Editing team, and partner with our Generative AI Pipeline Engineer on tooling and workflows.

What you will work on

  • Lead, mentor, and scale a team of 3 to 6 AI-driven Creative Designers - grow people, not just output;
  • Own the production flow: task distribution, capacity planning, and strict QC - production-grade, not demo-grade;
  • Drive creative direction: concepts, hooks, and visual angles that stop the scroll and convert;
  • Generate ideas yourself and push the team beyond safe iterations - informed by visual trends and competitor creatives;
  • Own the creative testing loop: build a database of winners, analyze failures, turn performance data into next iterations;
  • Track new AI models and tools; be the company's go-to expert on what's creatively possible with AI, staying hands-on in the tools;
  • Run regular R&D and build prompt and style libraries that keep quality consistent as the team grows;
  • Stay hands-on: jump into the tools (Figma, Adobe Suite, AI platforms) when needed to unblock the team, take on the most complex creatives, or test new approaches;
  • Partner with the Generative AI Pipeline Engineer to turn the team's creative needs into pipelines, presets, and automation;
  • Work tightly with Creative Producers, Marketers, Media Buyers, and Video Editors: align on strategy, negotiate deadlines, solve bottlenecks.

Requirements

Your must-haves

You don't need to meet every single requirement. If you're excellent in most of these areas and can show shipped work, we'd love to hear from you.

  • 5+ years of Leadership Experience: You have successfully managed creative/design teams in digital marketing. (This is not a role for a senior designer looking for their first management gig);
  • Mature Leader & Problem Solver: You build clear processes, guide your team, gracefully resolve conflicts, remain highly proactive, and stay completely open to new ideas and approaches;
  • Strong Project Manager: You drive every project cleanly to the finish line. You guarantee top-tier quality, maintain absolute order, and hit strict deadlines without excuses;
  • Strong Visual Craft: composition, lighting, color, typography, anatomy. You can articulate exactly why a creative works or doesn't;
  • Design Toolstack: proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite; comfortable connecting AI outputs with traditional design pipelines;
  • AI Geek: far beyond basic prompting. You track every new model release and can't wait to test how it could level up ad creatives. Hands-on with modern AI image platforms (Figma Weave, Higgsfield, Magnific, Runway, or similar), using them for creating photorealistic visuals. Able to choose the right tool for each task, as well as to catch and fix artifacts.
  • Performance Marketing DNA: solid understanding of static ad creatives (Google, Meta, and other paid channels). You know what stops the scroll, what makes a visual sell, and how creative decisions move CTR, CPA, and conversion rate;
  • Fluency in English - both spoken and written.

Nice to have

  • A strong portfolio showcasing performance marketing creatives and AI-generated photorealistic work - ideally with examples shipped under your leadership and the results they drove;
  • Experience with creatives for high-CPA verticals (home improvement, insurance, health, legal, finance, or similar);
  • Experience creating visuals for North American audiences - you know what looks native to a US consumer;
  • Understanding of how static visuals feed video production pipelines.

What we offer

  • Remote Work - we offer a truly and fully remote environment. You choose where you are the most productive and comfortable to have an impact.
  • Paid vacations - generous paid vacation policy to ensure you have time to recharge.
  • Unlimited Sick Days - we understand that being only human means getting sick or feeling under the weather from time to time, so we guarantee you time off as long as you need to recover and get back on your feet.
  • Ongoing Learning - people at CapsLock are deeply inquisitive and eager to learn new knowledge and skills, that's why we support and create learning opportunities like the Free Books program, workshops, conferences, and more.
  • Home Office - we will cover the equipment and furniture expenses to make sure you have the best work-from-home experience.
  • Physical Well-Being - we will cover costs of your medical insurance. Additionally we offer an allowance for a flexible fitness program.
  • Fun Stuff - there is never a shortage of fun stuff.

Job Title: Clinical Eligibility & Intake Nurse

Classification: Part Time/1099 Contractor

Work Structure: Fully Remote

Shift: Monday-Friday; 3-5 hours per day / 15-20 hours per week*; schedule must overlap intake hours**

Team: Clinical Operations

Reporting to: Clinical Eligibility Lead (intake coverage coordinated with Care Delivery)

Location: United States

Compensation: $27-30 per hour

*Additional hours are available on intake coverage days and as enrollment projects arise that focus on specific target populations.

**Must be available for eligibility/enrollment team meetings and able to switch to intake coverage on short notice during scheduled hours.

About Us

One in three people die of heart disease - it's time to change that. We're redesigning heart health from the ground up so that everyone can live fuller lives. Our team consists of mission-driven clinicians, engineers, and professionals attacking a problem using evidence-based research and guidelines for cardiovascular rehabilitation. We're working to deliver exercise and wellness to older adults with cardiovascular disease using telemedicine. We are dedicated to delivering exceptional services that enhance the lives of our patients.

Job Summary

The Clinical Eligibility & Intake Specialist splits time between two kinds of work. Most days, you will review the EMR records of cardiac recovery patients to determine medical eligibility for Aviary Health's virtual cardiac rehab program. When intake needs extra capacity, such as a last-minute call-out, a schedule gap, or a high-volume week, you will step in to run initial assessments with new patients over video.

This role suits a nurse who is equally comfortable working a chart review queue independently and sitting with a new patient to explain the program, review their history, and build their plan.

Responsibilities

Clinical eligibility (majority of hours)

  • Reviewing patient charts in Epic and other EMRs to determine medical eligibility/ineligibility using the inclusion/exclusion list and decision tree
  • Identifying current cardiac rehab referral orders, or creating cardiac rehab referral orders when needed
  • Communicating eligibility and ineligibility decisions to the enrollment team through concise documentation in the appropriate platforms
  • Working the eligibility queue within team turnaround targets so patients can be scheduled without delay
  • Completing eligibility rechecks and supporting special projects as needed
  • Escalating cases that fall outside the decision tree to the Clinical Eligibility Lead

Intake coverage (as needed, often same day)

  • Conducting initial assessments by video for patients enrolling in our virtual cardiac recovery program
  • Reviewing medical history, cardiac procedures, and medications before and during the visit
  • Completing individualized treatment plans that include nutrition, psychosocial, fitness, and co-morbidities assessments
  • Educating patients on program benefits and the importance of risk factor modification
  • Using goal setting and motivational interviewing to start patients off motivated and engaged
  • Documenting each visit accurately and on time per clinical documentation standards

This position requires the ability to learn and retain a broad base of clinical knowledge, switch between chart review and patient-facing work within the same shift, and make quick, independent decisions using good judgment.

Qualifications

  • Active RN or LPN license (required); multistate/compact license preferred
  • 3-5 years of clinical experience in cardiac care, cardiac rehab, or chronic disease management
  • 3 years of experience in Epic or another EMR, including chart review
  • Working knowledge of cardiac conditions, procedures, and medications, including CHF
  • Experience assessing and educating patients, ideally older adults, in a clinical or virtual care setting
  • Comfort with motivational interviewing and goal setting
  • Strong written communication, with concise and accurate clinical documentation
  • Proficient computer skills, including Zoom, Google Suite, and EMR systems
  • Fluent in English (written and verbal)

Bonus points

  • Bilingual in English and Spanish
  • Cardiac rehab experience or knowledge of cardiac rehab eligibility criteria
  • Virtual care or remote/1099 contract experience
  • Coaching experience in smoking cessation, diabetes management, or special populations

Requirements

  • Citrix
  • Epic access/RTE
  • Google Suite
  • Zoom
  • Teams (required for GHS Epic training)
  • Reliable internet connection and a quiet, private workspace suitable for live video visits with patients

SOPs

  • Clinical eligibility check process
  • Inclusion/exclusion list
  • Decision tree
  • ICD code list
  • Aviary platform macros
  • Initial assessment and treatment plan documentation

Note: This is a 1099 contractor position.

jobs.title: Vice President FP&A
jobs.excerpt: ABOUT OLIPOPAt OLIPOP, we’re on a mission to positively impact consumer health at scale.
jobs.description:
ABOUT OLIPOP

At OLIPOP, we’re on a mission to positively impact consumer health at scale. And we’re doing it through something simple: soda. But not just any soda, a new kind of soda: one that’s delicious, refreshing, and actually good for you.

This mission is deeply personal for our CEO, Co-Founder, and Formulator, Ben Goodwin. Like many of us, Ben grew up consuming the Standard American Diet: lots of soda and processed foods that prioritized convenience over nutrition. But at 14, he took his health into his own hands. After making significant changes to his nutrition and exercise, he lost 50 pounds and saw a transformation in his energy, mood, and emotional clarity.

Those changes sparked a deep curiosity about the connection between nutrition and health. Ben became a relentless student of the gut microbiome and the ways it supports overall wellness. The more he discovered, the more passionate he became about finding credible, science-backed ways to make consumer health accessible to everyone.

The mission was clear. The vehicle? Less so. After exploring the possibilities, Ben landed on an unexpected yet familiar choice: soda. It was something he loved as a kid, and he knew millions shared that same nostalgia. But this wouldn’t be just any soda. With most Americans falling short on daily fiber, Ben set out to create a version with more fiber and less sugar, one that was perfectly balanced. The result? A deliciously refreshing soda with 6 to 9 grams of fiber and 2 to 5 grams of sugar, delivering science-backed benefits without sacrificing the classic taste people crave.

In 2018, the first OLIPOP cans hit the shelves, bringing Ben’s vision to life with a functional soda that anyone could enjoy. And by reimagining soda, we’re also reshaping culture. That means creating products that support health for all and building a business grounded in humanistic values: empathy, integrity, and a belief in better for everyone. From the ingredients we source to the culture we foster, we’re committed to proving that business (and beverage!) can be a force for good, and that soda has the power to bring people together.

So join us, and let’s write a new American soda story together. One we can all feel good about. One OLIPOP at a time.

ABOUT THE ROLE

OLIPOP is seeking a strategic, commercially minded, and highly operational Vice President of FP&A to lead enterprise financial planning, performance management, and strategic decision support through the company’s next stage of scale.

As Vice President, FP&A, you will serve as a senior finance leader and trusted partner to the CFO, executive leadership team, and cross-functional business leaders. You will own the company’s long-range planning process, enterprise financial model, forecasting operating rhythm, board and executive reporting, and strategic financial analysis that informs critical investment, growth, and profitability decisions.

This role requires a leader who can translate company strategy into financial priorities, build scalable FP&A capabilities, influence senior stakeholders through data-backed recommendations, and create the systems, routines, and team structure needed to support a high-growth CPG business.

You will be expected to balance strategic vision with operational discipline, bringing strong judgment, executive presence, and a clear point of view to ambiguous and high-impact business decisions.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Enterprise Financial Strategy & Long-Range Planning

  • Lead OLIPOP’s long-range planning process, partnering with executive and functional leaders to translate company strategy into multi-year financial plans, resource allocation priorities, and measurable business outcomes.
  • Own and evolve OLIPOP’s enterprise financial model, ensuring it serves as a dynamic decision-making tool for growth planning, profitability, capital allocation, and scenario analysis.
  • Partner with senior leadership to evaluate strategic tradeoffs across revenue growth, margin expansion, operating expense investment, working capital, and organizational scale.
  • Develop financial frameworks that help the business anticipate future risks, opportunities, and investment needs as OLIPOP continues to grow.

Financial Planning, Forecasting & Performance Management

  • Own the company-wide forecasting and planning operating rhythm across gross revenue, net revenue, trade, COGS, gross margin, operating expenses, EBITDA, cash flow, balance sheet, and key business drivers.
  • Lead the annual budget, reforecasting, and monthly performance management processes, ensuring cross-functional leaders have clear visibility into financial expectations, tradeoffs, and accountability.
  • Establish clear financial governance, timelines, tools, and reporting standards that improve forecast accuracy, business ownership, and decision quality.
  • Compare monthly operating results against budget and forecast, identify key variances, and partner with business owners to understand drivers, risks, and corrective actions.

Executive, Board & Investor Readiness

  • Lead preparation of board, executive, and corporate reporting materials, ensuring financial narratives are clear, accurate, actionable, and tied to enterprise priorities.
  • Translate complex financial and operational insights into executive-ready recommendations that support high-quality decisions.
  • Support equity raise, debt, or capital markets initiatives as needed, including materials preparation, diligence support, quality of earnings support, cost of capital analysis, scenario modeling, and investor-facing financial narratives.
  • Serve as a senior finance partner in high-stakes discussions, bringing strong judgment, business context, and a clear articulation of financial implications.

Strategic Finance & Decision Support

  • Lead financial modeling and analysis for strategic decisions, including growth investments, new products, channel expansion, pricing strategy, margin optimization, tradeoffs, and process improvements.
  • Evaluate profitability by product, channel, customer, SKU, region, and other relevant dimensions to guide investment decisions and commercial strategy.
  • Partner with Sales, Revenue Growth Management, Marketing, Operations, Supply Chain, and Accounting to evaluate business performance and identify opportunities to improve profitable growth.
  • Develop and improve pricing, margin, and investment models for existing products, new products, channels, and customer opportunities.
  • Partner with revenue and commercial teams on deal pricing, trade investment reviews, commission structures, and customer-level financial decision support.

Finance Operating Model, Systems & Scale

  • Design and implement scalable FP&A processes, tools, reporting infrastructure, and operating rhythms that improve business visibility, speed, accuracy, and decision-making.
  • Identify opportunities to strengthen financial systems, planning tools, data quality, and reporting automation to support company growth.
  • Build repeatable workflows that enable disciplined business reviews, faster insight generation, and stronger accountability across functions.
  • Lead ad hoc strategic analyses and special projects that support enterprise priorities and evolving business needs.

Team Leadership & Capability Building

  • Build, structure, and develop a high-performing FP&A team aligned to OLIPOP’s strategy, business complexity, and future scale.
  • Establish clear roles, expectations, development plans, and operating cadences that strengthen team effectiveness and business partnership.
  • Coach and develop finance talent, creating a culture of accountability, curiosity, analytical rigor, continuous improvement, and strong stakeholder partnership.
  • Model OLIPOP’s leadership expectations by leading with clarity, trust, inclusion, sound judgment, and a strong ownership mindset.

Cross-Functional Influence & Executive Partnership

  • Serve as a senior connector across Finance, Sales, Marketing, Operations, Supply Chain, People, and Executive Leadership, ensuring financial insights are embedded into business planning and decision-making.
  • Influence senior leaders through clear financial storytelling, data-backed recommendations, and balanced assessment of risk, opportunity, and long-term impact.
  • Navigate ambiguity and competing priorities with maturity, transparency, and a company-first mindset.
  • Champion OLIPOP’s culture and values by creating clarity, raising the bar for financial discipline, and helping teams connect day-to-day decisions to company goals.

REQUIREMENTS:

  • 12–15+ years of progressive finance experience, including significant leadership experience in FP&A, strategic finance, corporate finance, or related functions.
  • Experience leading FP&A in a high-growth CPG, food & beverage, consumer products, retail, marketplace, or similarly complex operating environment strongly preferred.
  • Proven ability to own enterprise planning, forecasting, financial modeling, budget management, and executive-level business performance reporting.
  • Strong commercial and operational finance acumen, including experience with revenue planning, margin analysis, pricing, tradeoffs, customer/channel profitability, working capital, and investment decision support.
  • Demonstrated experience preparing executive, board, investor, or lender-facing financial materials with clear narratives and actionable recommendations.
  • Strong understanding of accounting, budgeting, cost control, and finance principles, including GAAP.
  • Track record of building scalable FP&A processes, tools, systems, reporting routines, and financial governance in a growing organization.
  • Experience building, leading, and developing high-performing teams; able to create clarity, accountability, and development pathways during periods of change and scale.
  • Strategic and effective communication skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders, simplify complex financial concepts, and drive alignment across diverse stakeholders.
  • Strong judgment and decision quality; able to evaluate complex tradeoffs, assess risk, and recommend practical paths forward in ambiguous situations.
  • High emotional intelligence and cultural competency, with the ability to build trust, resolve tension productively, and partner effectively across functions.
  • Strategic and hands-on: comfortable shaping enterprise-level finance strategy while also diving into models, details, and operating mechanics when needed.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, or related field preferred; MBA and/or CPA a plus.
  • Comfortable operating in a remote-first, fast-paced, highly collaborative environment using tools such as Microsoft Suite, Google Suite, Slack, Zoom, NetSuite, Claude AI (other exposure to AI tools) and financial planning/reporting platforms.
  • Flexibility to travel as needed for company meetings, team offsites, board preparation, and cross-functional planning sessions. Estimated Travel:10-15%

REPORTS TO:

CFO

COMPENSATION:

$220,000-$260,000 base salary + bonus

HOW WE WORK

We may be fully remote, but we’re anything but disconnected. OLIPOP has grown from a few passionate people around a table to a nationwide team, and we’ve done it without losing our collaborative spirit or sense of purpose.

Connection here is intentional. From cross-functional projects and IRL offsites to thoughtful Slack threads and spontaneous gifs, we make the effort to stay close, even across time zones. Sure, we move quickly, but we lead with trust, transparency, and a shared commitment to doing work that matters.

We value thoughtful debate. We give feedback with care and receive it with curiosity, knowing that real growth, both personal and collective, comes from listening as much as leading. Because at OLIPOP, it’s not just about getting things done. It’s about growing together, staying true to what matters, and building something with lasting impact.

WHAT WE VALUE

At OLIPOP, our values aren’t just posters on a wall. They shape how we show up: for each other, for our customers, and for the mission we’re chasing together.

  • Mission Connectivity: Everything we do ladders up to our shared goal: supporting human health. Whether launching a new flavor or conducting clinical research, the mission stays front and center.
  • Indomitable Spirit: When things get messy, we get inventive. We stay curious, adapt quickly, and find the path forward, most likely with a dedicated Slack thread and a beautifully overbuilt deck.
  • Lead at Every Level: Leadership isn’t about titles, it’s about ownership. We speak up, follow through, and lift each other up. If you’ve got ideas and initiative, you’ve got influence.
  • Courageous Humility: We’re confident in what we bring and curious about what we don’t know (yet). We give feedback with care, take it with grace, and know that real growth takes both.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

Success at OLIPOP doesn’t come from checking boxes; it comes from living our values, staying curious, and finding energy in both the pace and the purpose. We’re building something big, and we’re looking for people who:

  • Think big, move fast, and take thoughtful risks
  • Thrive in a high-performance, feedback-rich environment
  • Value real human connection and honest collaboration
  • Are fired up by building something new, and making it better every day

Startup life at OLIPOP is equally fun and fast-paced. If you’re energized by a dynamic environment, eager to grow, and excited to help shape something meaningful from the inside out, OLIPOP is a one-of-a-kind ride.
