  • Test relevant functionality on real devices and resolve problems that automated tests alone may not reveal.
  • Mentor our junior team member through practical demonstrations, pair programming, and understandable explanations.
  • Document important technical decisions and share reusable knowledge with the internal team.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated senior-level experience delivering and maintaining production Android applications with Kotlin.
  • Strong practical experience with Kotlin Multiplatform, including shared code, platform-specific integrations, and the boundaries between them.
  • Solid understanding of Android architecture, Jetpack Compose, coroutines, Flow, application lifecycle, and state management.
  • Strong debugging skills and the ability to investigate problems across application code, APIs, and device behavior.
  • Substantial hands-on experience using AI coding tools to deliver working software.
  • A strong interest in agentic coding and the ability to establish effective development workflows around coding agents.
  • The ability to assess AI-generated solutions critically and explain why an implementation is appropriate.
  • Willingness and ability to teach less experienced team members patiently and clearly.
  • The ability to work independently, communicate progress clearly, and take ownership of results in a remote team.
  • Interest in a long-term, full-time position and availability to start promptly after an agreement is reached.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • GPS positioning, location accuracy, sensor data, and proximity detection.
  • BLE discovery, advertising, connections, and signal-strength limitations.
  • UWB ranging, distance measurement, direction estimation, and hardware compatibility.
  • NFC and other device-to-device interactions.
  • Building automated development and testing workflows that combine human oversight with coding agents.

What We Offer

  • A fully remote, full-time role with a long-term perspective.
  • Compensation based on your experience, expertise, and responsibilities.
  • Ownership of meaningful mobile development work.
  • The opportunity to shape how our team uses AI and coding agents.
  • Close collaboration with an internal team that wants to learn from your experience.

Remote Working Arrangement

Our remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots of the screen. This monitoring is part of the working arrangement and will be explained during the recruitment process.

Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup.

jobs.description:
Senior Infrastructure & Network Engineer (L3) (Part-time)

Architecture, Security & Compliance

Position Summary

We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Infrastructure & Network Engineer (Level 3) to provide senior-level technical oversight, architecture review, configuration validation, project assurance, and infrastructure compliance support across our enterprise technology environment.

This is not a traditional network administration or deployment-focused position.

The primary purpose of this role is to serve as a senior technical reviewer and trusted second set of eyes for infrastructure and network projects. The engineer will review proposed architectures and implementations, identify technical or security weaknesses, recommend improvements, assist with complex configuration adjustments when necessary, and independently verify that systems have been implemented correctly.

The engineer will work closely with IT leadership, infrastructure teams, vendors, MSPs, and the cybersecurity team to ensure that technology implementations are reliable, scalable, secure, properly documented, and aligned with established cybersecurity and compliance requirements.

The role will also participate in the development of automation and AI-assisted compliance validation, including an AI CISO platform designed to continuously review technical controls, configurations, asset coverage, and compliance evidence.

Core Responsibilities

  • Review network and infrastructure architectures before implementation.
  • Review configurations implemented by internal teams, vendors, MSPs, and other technical resources.
  • Validate that infrastructure projects follow technical, security, and vendor best practices.
  • Identify design weaknesses, configuration problems, unnecessary exposure, and operational risks.
  • Provide recommendations for improving architecture, reliability, performance, security, and maintainability.
  • Perform post-implementation reviews to verify systems were configured as designed.
  • Assist engineers with complex configuration changes and troubleshooting when senior-level expertise is required.
  • Independently validate remediation after identified issues have been corrected.
  • Participate in technical design and architecture discussions for new projects.
  • Review implementation plans, change plans, testing procedures, and rollback strategies.
  • Maintain and improve technical standards, configuration baselines, and review checklists.

Advanced Network Engineering Skills

The successful candidate should possess advanced Level 3 knowledge of:

  • TCP/IP and advanced network troubleshooting.
  • IPv4 addressing and subnetting.
  • Layer 2 and Layer 3 switching.
  • VLANs and network segmentation.
  • STP/RSTP.
  • LACP and link aggregation.
  • ACLs.
  • NAT.
  • DHCP and DNS.
  • OSPF and BGP.
  • VPN technologies.
  • Firewall concepts and policy design.
  • Multi-site networking.
  • Network redundancy and high availability.
  • Enterprise Wi-Fi.
  • Network performance analysis.
  • Packet-level troubleshooting using Wireshark or equivalent tools.

The engineer should be capable of reviewing an unfamiliar network environment and identifying architectural, configuration, performance, reliability, and security concerns.

Infrastructure Architecture & Technical Assurance

Strong experience reviewing:

  • Network diagrams and architecture.
  • Switch and router configurations.
  • Firewall rules and ACLs.
  • VLAN and segmentation strategies.
  • Management networks.
  • Wireless architecture.
  • VPN and remote-access configurations.
  • High-availability designs.
  • Internet and WAN connectivity.
  • Authentication and administrative access.
  • Logging and monitoring configurations.
  • Infrastructure firmware and software standards.
  • Backup and recovery architecture.
  • Vendor-proposed technical solutions.

Security & Compliance Engineering

This position is not part of the cybersecurity/SOC function, but the engineer must have a strong understanding of cybersecurity architecture and compliance requirements.

Required knowledge includes:

  • Network segmentation.
  • Zero Trust principles.
  • Least privilege.
  • Secure administrative access.
  • MFA and SSO.
  • Privileged-access concepts.
  • Endpoint protection architecture.
  • EDR/XDR architecture.
  • Secure Internet access.
  • Encryption requirements.
  • Logging and telemetry.
  • Vulnerability-remediation requirements.
  • Infrastructure hardening.
  • Secure configuration baselines.
  • Defense-in-depth principles.

The engineer should have working knowledge of frameworks such as:

  • NIST Cybersecurity Framework.
  • CIS Critical Security Controls.
  • Cyber-insurance technical requirements.
  • Common enterprise security-control requirements.

Configuration & Compliance Validation

A major responsibility of this position is independently validating technical controls.

Examples include reviewing whether:

  • Management interfaces are properly isolated.
  • Administrative access is appropriately restricted.
  • Network segmentation is implemented correctly.
  • Firewall and ACL rules match the intended design.
  • Required MFA controls are properly configured.
  • Endpoint-management platforms cover the intended systems.
  • Security agents are correctly deployed and communicating.
  • Required logs are being generated and forwarded.
  • Network equipment is running approved configurations and firmware.
  • Encryption requirements are implemented.
  • Infrastructure configurations follow approved security baselines.

Identity & Endpoint Architecture

Strong understanding of:

  • Microsoft Entra ID.
  • Duo MFA and SSO.
  • SAML.
  • OAuth/OIDC concepts.
  • Conditional Access concepts.
  • RBAC.
  • Privileged-access concepts.
  • Service accounts.
  • Windows enterprise management.
  • macOS enterprise management concepts.
  • RMM and endpoint-management architecture.
  • Patch-management architecture.
  • Endpoint security architecture.

Preferred Technology Experience

Experience with the following technologies is highly desirable:

  • Cisco networking and security technologies.
  • Cisco Secure Endpoint.
  • Cisco Secure Access.
  • Cisco Umbrella.
  • Cisco XDR.
  • Duo.
  • Extreme Networks.
  • ExtremeCloud IQ.
  • Microsoft Entra ID.
  • NinjaOne.
  • Microsoft 365.
  • Enterprise MDM platforms.

Automation & API Engineering

This role will help develop automated technical validation and compliance-assurance capabilities.

Desired skills include:

  • Advanced PowerShell.
  • Python.
  • REST APIs.
  • JSON.
  • OAuth and API authentication.
  • Webhooks.
  • SQL/data-query concepts.
  • Git/version control.
  • Data normalization.
  • Cross-system data reconciliation.
  • Secure API credential and secrets management.
  • Automated configuration validation.
  • Automated compliance checks.
  • Automated evidence collection.

Professional Skills

The ideal candidate should:

  • Be highly analytical.
  • Be naturally skeptical of unverified technical assumptions.
  • Have exceptional troubleshooting skills.
  • Be comfortable reviewing another engineer's work constructively.
  • Be capable of identifying subtle configuration and architectural problems.
  • Communicate technical findings clearly.
  • Explain risks without unnecessarily exaggerating them.
  • Provide practical remediation recommendations.
  • Work effectively with internal teams, vendors, MSPs, and cybersecurity personnel.

  • Know when additional specialist expertise is required.

Experience

  • 7+ years of progressive network/infrastructure engineering experience.
  • Significant Level 3 or senior engineering experience.

jobs.description:
Job Overview:

The Sr. Demand Planner will be responsible for creating, maintaining, and continuously improving a rolling 12-month forecast for all items. In this role, they will combine historical demand, customer forecasts, sales input, product activity, and other available information to develop an actionable demand plan. They will coordinate the Sales and Operations Planning meeting and work closely with Sales, Marketing, Supply Chain, and other groups to develop the forecast. The role requires the ability to work effectively with varied and incomplete data sets from both internal systems and customers.

RectorSeal is part of the Industrial Products division of CSWI, a publicly traded U.S. company. RectorSeal has an 80+ year track record of growth and success providing unique products to HVAC, Plumbing, and Electrical contractors as well as the commercial construction industry across North America. RectorSeal currently operates from five manufacturing locations in the United States and maintains strong third-party manufacturing and distribution relationships across the world.

The ideal candidate will possess strong quantitative and analytical skills, experience developing item-level forecasts, and the judgment to make sound recommendations when data is incomplete or inconsistent. They will be comfortable coordinating cross-functional discussions, challenging assumptions constructively, and engaging tactically in data preparation, forecast maintenance, and process improvement activities.

Key Responsibilities:

Operations

  • Create and maintain a rolling 12-month item-level forecast for the full product portfolio, including new, mature, seasonal, promotional, and discontinued items.
  • Analyze historical sales, orders, customer forecasts, market inputs, promotions, pricing activity, product lifecycle changes, and other demand drivers.
  • Combine, clean, validate, and reconcile incomplete, inconsistent, or differently structured data sets from internal systems and customers; document assumptions and identify material gaps.
  • Monitor forecast accuracy and bias, investigate variances, identify root causes, and implement corrective actions with commercial and operational partners.
  • Prepare for and coordinate the Sales and Operations Planning meeting, including, data preparation, presentation materials, decision tracking, and follow-up.
  • Maintain forecasting parameters, product hierarchies, customer mappings, and forecast inputs while improving data quality, and planning processes.
  • Support inventory and supply planning decisions by providing timely, accurate, and clearly documented demand assumptions.
  • Have a general understand of the products, markets, and customers to be able to make more informed decisions regarding the forecast.

Communication

  • Present forecast changes, assumptions, performance metrics, risks, and recommended actions.
  • Maintain effective communication with key internal stakeholders.
  • Identify process problems and data-quality concerns and implement improvements and solutions.

Required Experience:

  • Minimum of five years of experience in demand planning, forecasting, supply chain analytics, business analytics, or a similar role.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Data Science, Economics, Operations Research, Supply Chain, or a related field.
  • High-level Excel skills and proficiency with relevant business systems and Microsoft applications.

Skills/Competencies:

  • Strong quantitative, analytical, and problem-solving skills, including the ability to form defensible conclusions from incomplete or imperfect data.
  • Ability to combine, clean, validate, and interpret data from multiple internal and customer sources.
  • Ability to work independently and as a member of a team.
  • Excellent interpersonal, presentation, and communication skills.

Preferred Requirements:

  • Experience with demand planning, ERP, business intelligence, or statistical forecasting systems.
  • Working knowledge of time-series forecasting, seasonality, trend analysis, forecast value added, segmentation, and exception-based planning.
  • Experience using customer-provided forecasts, point-of-sale data, order history, or other external demand signals.
  • Familiarity with inventory management, supply planning, service-level tradeoffs, and Sales and Operations Planning or integrated business planning processes.
  • Experience in a manufacturing or distribution environment.

Benefits:At RectorSeal, our employees enjoy the following benefits to support their physical, financial, and emotional wellness. These benefits include comprehensive medical, dental and vision plans, 401(k), pension, life insurance, paid time off program with paid holidays, and various wellness programs.

About RectorSeal

Based in Houston, Texas, RectorSeal, LLC, is a wholly owned subsidiary of CSW Industrials, Inc. [NYSE: CSW] and is a leading provider of quality solutions for the professional trades serving heating, ventilation, and air conditioning (HVAC/R), plumbing, electrical, and construction markets. For more information about RectorSeal’s innovative products and brands that increase efficiency and improve reliability, please visit www.RectorSeal.com.

About CSW Industrials
CSW Industrials is a diversified industrial growth company with industry-leading operations in three segments: Contractor Solutions, Specialized Reliability Solutions, and Engineered Building Solutions. CSW provides niche, value-added products with two essential commonalities: performance and reliability. The primary end markets we serve with our well-known brands include HVAC/R, plumbing, electrical, general industrial, architecturally-specified building products, energy, mining, and rail transportation.

jobs.description:
Job Summary:

The Manager, Member Intake is a hands-on virtual leader responsible for the day-to-day performance, quality, and development of a team of Intake CSRs supporting LegalShield members across all states. This role owns real-time queue management, call quality oversight, coaching, and the professional growth of team members, while driving the team toward defined efficiency, proficiency, and productivity targets.

The Manager is a working leader actively engaged with the live queue, visible and accessible to the team throughout the shift, and directly accountable for delivering a consistent, seamless, and cohesive member experience aligned to the intake framework, disposition standards, and call-flow methodology (Connect → Understand → Assess → Resolve → Close).

Responsibilities:

Performance Outcomes

Real-Time Queue & Contact Center Operations

  • Monitor live queue activity throughout the shift service level, average speed of answer, calls in queue, agent availability, adherence, and abandoned rate and take immediate action to balance staffing and workload.
  • Manage agent status and scheduling exceptions in Workday (WD), including log-in/log-out compliance, breaks, and after-call work.
  • Identify and resolve real-time bottlenecks (e.g., callback backlog, referral handling delays, unusually high abandoned rates) before they impact the member experience.
  • Escalate systemic issues (telephony, tooling, staffing gaps) with clear data and recommended actions.

Call Listening, QA & Coaching

  • Conduct scheduled and ad-hoc live-call monitoring and recorded-call reviews for every direct report on a defined cadence.
  • Evaluate calls against the intake call-flow standard (Connect / Understand / Assess / Resolve / Close), verification protocol, OPP procedures, disposition accuracy, and member-experience benchmarks.
  • Deliver timely, specific coaching after each observation reinforcing what worked and providing concrete, actionable guidance where the agent can grow.
  • Partner with the QA/Trainer to calibrate scoring, close skill gaps identified in QA trends, and ensure coaching is consistent across the team.
  • Coach agents on correct use of the Primary + Secondary disposition framework so call data remains reporting-ready for QA, trend analysis, and firm-level insights.

Professional & Personal Development

  • Maintain an individual development plan (IDP) for every direct report, updated quarterly, covering role proficiency, career aspirations, and personal growth goals.
  • Hold consistent 1:1s that go beyond metrics focusing on the whole person, their engagement, career trajectory, and any barriers to success at work or otherwise.
  • Identify high-potential team members and create stretch opportunities (e.g., peer mentorship for new hires, SME ownership of a disposition category, project participation).
  • Onboard new hires coming off the training cohort, pairing them with veteran agents and providing intensified coaching support during their first 30/60/90 days.
  • Recognize and celebrate wins publicly call saves, member-experience moments, KPI milestones to reinforce a culture of pride and ownership.

KPI Tracking & Performance Management

  • Track, analyze, and act on team and individual KPIs, including but not limited to:
  • Efficiency: average handle time (AHT), after-call work (ACW), adherence, occupancy, log-in/log-out compliance
  • Proficiency: QA score, first-contact resolution, disposition accuracy, verification compliance, adherence to script and call-flow standards
  • Productivity: calls handled per shift, intakes opened, callbacks completed, transfer accuracy, referral-handling accuracy
  • Member Experience: CSAT / member feedback, escalation rate, complaint rate, save rate on at-risk members
  • Build and deliver weekly individual and team performance summaries; identify trends and translate them into targeted coaching actions.
  • Own performance management for direct reports from positive recognition through structured improvement plans and, when necessary, formal corrective action in partnership with HR.
  • Coach agents to efficiency, proficiency, and productivity targets simultaneously, ensuring speed never comes at the cost of quality or the member experience.

Team Communication & Culture

  • Lead daily huddles and use the Member Intake Connection Hub to reinforce daily announcements, disposition updates, and resource visibility.
  • Serve as the primary real-time escalation point for complex calls, hostile callers, OPP inquiries, and complaint / escalation dispositions.
  • Foster a collaborative, feedback-driven culture where agents help each other, share wins, and surface issues without hesitation.
  • Represent the front-line perspective in cross-functional discussions, especially where firm-level decisions, process changes, or new tooling will impact the CSR experience.

Process & Continuous Improvement

  • Identify recurring member pain points, workflow gaps, and disposition trends; partner with the Manager and QA/Trainer to translate these into process improvements and coaching content.
  • Provide input into training material updates, ensuring content reflects the actual work happening on live calls.
  • Contribute to the Intake team’s role in operationalizing a tailored, seamless, cohesive member experience across all states.

Education, Knowledge, and Experience

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years in a contact center / member services environment, with at least 1 year in a supervisory, team lead, or senior QA role.
  • Demonstrated experience with real-time queue management, live-call monitoring, and coaching to KPIs.
  • Working knowledge of contact center telephony, workforce management platforms (Workday or equivalent), CRM systems, and QA tooling.
  • Strong understanding of call quality frameworks and structured call-flow methodologies.
  • Proven ability to deliver direct, respectful, growth-oriented feedback and to hold performance conversations with empathy and accountability.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; comfortable presenting data, trends, and recommendations to leadership.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience supporting a legal services, insurance, or member-benefits contact center.
  • Familiarity with LegalShield membership, intake workflows, or comparable member-benefit programs.
  • Experience implementing or refining disposition frameworks and reporting structures.
  • Experience onboarding and ramping new-hire cohorts.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.

Core Competencies

  • Leadership — leads from alongside the team, not above it
  • Coaching Mindset — meets agents where they are and grows them from there
  • Data Fluency — comfortable turning KPI data into concrete coaching actions
  • Composure Under Pressure — steady during volume spikes, escalations, and system issues
  • Member-First Thinking — every decision routes back to the member experience
  • Ownership & Follow-Through — commitments made are commitments kept
  • Adaptability — thrives amid change, and helps the team do the same

Success in the First 90 Days

  • Fully onboarded to WD, the disposition framework, the Connection Hub, and all monitoring tools.
  • Established a consistent 1:1 and coaching cadence with every direct report.
  • Delivered a first pass of individual QA calibration and identified the top three team-level coaching themes.
  • Built early trust with the team through visibility, follow-through, and clear communication.
  • Delivered at least one process or coaching insight to the Manager grounded in real call data.

The Manager, Field Planning & Execution is a senior individual contributor responsible for running the day-to-day operating cadence for integrated field planning and assigned commercial pilots across U.S. Field and Inside Sales. Reporting to the Senior Manager, Field Innovation & Pilot Execution, this role translates approved priorities into executable plans, coordinates cross functional workstreams, maintains roadmap and governance discipline, and turns field and performance insights into practical recommendations.

The role owns planning, coordination, issue resolution, reporting, and follow through for assigned work while influencing partners without formal authority. The Senior Manager retains accountability for portfolio direction, prioritization, executive alignment, and final recommendations.

Integrated Field Planning and Roadmap Management

Measurement, Reporting and Recommendations

  • Synthesize results, field feedback, customer experience, and commercial outcomes into clear recommendations to scale, adapt, combine, or stop an approach.
  • Build readouts and decision materials for cross-functional partners and leadership.

Cross-Functional Ways of Working

  • Lead day-to-day coordination across Field Marketing, HCP Marketing, Consumer Marketing, Sales Leadership, Training & Clinical Business, Global Sales & Clinical Training, Medical, Data Science and Insights, Sales Effectiveness, and Sales Operations teams.

jobs.description:
Location: 100% Remote

Employment: Full-time, long-term position
Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement
Salary: Based on experience, technical expertise, and level of responsibility

About Us

We are developing a mobile application that combines real-world interactions with location and proximity technologies. Our team uses AI coding tools and autonomous coding agents to accelerate development, improve engineering workflows, and share practical knowledge.

We are looking for a senior engineer who can connect mobile development, backend services, databases, and infrastructure into a reliable development and delivery process.

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Senior Mobile & Platform Engineer who can work across Android and iOS, contribute to our Kotlin Multiplatform architecture, and support our dedicated developers on both platforms.

Your main focus will be enabling the team to deliver effectively: resolving technical challenges, maintaining shared components, improving development workflows, and managing the backend and infrastructure that support the application.

You will also contribute directly to implementation where needed. Depending on your experience and suitability, the role may include technical team leadership for our Android and iOS developers.

Strong GitHub, GitHub Actions, and runner-management experience is essential. Practical experience with AI-assisted and agentic development is equally important.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support our Android and iOS developers with technical decisions, debugging, code reviews, and integration challenges.
  • Develop and maintain shared application logic using Kotlin Multiplatform.
  • Contribute to native Android and iOS development where platform-specific work is required.
  • Maintain a clear architecture across mobile applications, backend services, APIs, and databases.
  • Develop and maintain backend functionality and server-side integrations.
  • Manage database changes, investigate data-related issues, and maintain reliable migration, backup, and recovery processes.
  • Build and improve CI/CD workflows using GitHub Actions.
  • Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot GitHub runners, including self-hosted runners.
  • Improve build reliability, automated testing, deployment processes, and development environments.
  • Manage server-side application deployments, configuration, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
  • Establish effective AI-assisted and agentic coding workflows across the team.
  • Review AI-generated code and ensure that changes are tested, understandable, secure, and maintainable.
  • Help developers and junior team members use AI tools effectively through practical demonstrations and knowledge sharing.
  • Where appropriate, act as technical team lead: coordinate dependencies, guide implementation, review technical decisions, and help the team resolve blockers.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated senior-level experience in mobile software development.
  • Strong Kotlin and Android development experience, together with practical Swift and iOS development experience.
  • Solid hands-on experience with Kotlin Multiplatform and integrating shared code into both mobile platforms.
  • The ability to investigate problems across mobile clients, APIs, backend services, databases, and infrastructure.
  • Practical backend development experience and a sound understanding of API design, authentication, and application security.
  • Strong SQL and relational database experience, including schema changes, migrations, and performance troubleshooting.
  • Hands-on DevOps experience with Linux servers, application deployment, configuration, and operational troubleshooting.
  • Excellent Git and GitHub knowledge, including pull requests, code reviews, branch workflows, and repository configuration.
  • Strong experience with GitHub Actions and configuring and maintaining GitHub runners.
  • Substantial experience using AI coding assistants and coding agents to deliver working software.
  • The ability to establish development workflows that combine coding agents, automated checks, and human review.
  • Clear communication, practical documentation skills, and a willingness to share knowledge.
  • The ability to work independently while supporting other developers constructively.
  • Interest in a long-term, full-time position and availability to start promptly after an agreement is reached.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • Previous experience as a technical lead or senior engineer supporting a mobile development team.
  • GPS, BLE, UWB, NFC, or other location and proximity technologies.
  • Testing mobile applications on real devices and investigating platform-specific behavior.
  • Container-based application deployment and reproducible development environments.
  • Monitoring, incident diagnosis, and maintaining reliable backend services.
  • Coordinating changes that affect mobile applications, backend APIs, and database structures together.

Potential Technical Team Lead Responsibilities

For a suitable candidate, the role can include technical leadership of our Android and iOS developers.

This would involve helping the team make consistent technical decisions, breaking down implementation work, coordinating shared dependencies, and maintaining the quality of delivered changes. You should be comfortable mentoring developers and taking responsibility for the technical direction while remaining actively involved in engineering.

What We Offer

  • A fully remote, full-time role with a long-term perspective.
  • Compensation based on your experience, expertise, and responsibilities.
  • A central role supporting our mobile development team.
  • The opportunity to shape our architecture, infrastructure, and agentic development workflows.
  • Potential technical teamlead responsibility, depending on suitability.
  • Close collaboration with a team that values practical knowledge sharing.

Remote Working Arrangement

Our remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots of the screen. This monitoring is part of the working arrangement and will be explained during the recruitment process.

Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup.

How to Apply

Please submit your CV and a short overview of relevant projects.

Include:

  • Your experience developing for both Android and iOS, including Kotlin Multiplatform.
  • Your backend, database, and server infrastructure responsibilities.
  • Examples of GitHub Actions workflows and runner environments you have configured or maintained.
  • The AI coding tools and agentic workflows you use, with examples of delivered results.
  • Your experience supporting developers, mentoring colleagues, or leading a technical team.
  • Your earliest start date and salary expectations.

Public portfolio links, GitHub repositories, and released application references are welcome where available.

jobs.description:
Job Description

We are seeking a Growth and Improvement minded Regional Medical Scientific Director (AKA Medical Science Liaison, MSL) | in Inflammatory Bowel Disease Immunology that can help drive our Strategic Operating Priorities.

Summary, Focus and Purpose

The Regional Medical Scientific Director (Medical Science Liaison) is a credentialed (i.e., PhD, PharmD, DNP, MD) Director Level Medical Affairs position and therapeutic and disease expert who engages in bidirectional exchange of scientific or medical information with Scientific Leaders (SLs). The role provides balanced, factual, scientific information about non-product areas of interest to the Company and replies to scientific questions from SLs, including questions about Company products. The work is aligned to Scientific Exchange, Research, Scientific Congress Support, and Scientific Insights.

You will liaise between the scientific community and the Company to enhance the comprehension of scientific foundations and goals for approved, in-development, and active Company-sponsored trials and/or investigator-sponsored research studies and serve as a role model for other field medical team members in ways that include on-boarding and/or sharing of therapeutic expertise.

Consistent adherence to field and corporate policies and Global Medical Scientific Affairs (GMSA) strategy, including field standard operating procedures (SOPs), Good Clinical Practice (GCP) guidelines, and administrative/operational responsibilities.

Responsibilities and Primary Activities

Scientific Exchange

  • Develops professional relationships and engages with national and regional SLs to ensure access to company-approved medical and scientific information on areas of therapeutic interest and Company products

  • Conducts peer-to-peer scientific discussions and maintains a reliable presence with those SLs to ensure they have a medical contact within the company

  • Addresses scientific questions and directs SL inquiries on issues outside of scope (e.g., grants) to appropriate company resources consistent with applicable policies

  • Maintains current knowledge and comprehension of dynamic scientific and clinical environment in the Company's Areas of Interest (AOI) for your specific therapeutic area

Research

  • Upon Request from Global Center for Scientific Affairs (GCSA)

    • Initiates discussions with SLs and/or potential investigators that include scientific/data exchange within our AOI to determine the alignment with our research strategies, studies concepts, scientific merit, and qualifications for a specific compound or trial

    • Enhances the comprehension of the scientific foundations and goals of investigator-sponsored research

    • Identifies barriers to patient enrollment and retention efforts to achieve study milestones

  • Upon Request from Global Clinical Trial Operations (GCTO)

    • Recommends study sites and identifies potential investigators to participate in phase II-IV clinical development programs, conducts Site Initiation Visits (SIVs), and detects barriers to patient enrollment and retention efforts to achieve study milestones

    • Protocol lead responsibilities in collaboration with GCTO

    • Addresses questions from investigators and provides information regarding participation in Company-sponsored clinical studies

Scientific Congress Support

  • Engages in scientific congresses and medical meetings, facilitates scientific and data exchange for both Company and competitor data

Scientific Insights

  • Gathers feedback, data, or information during routine activities that can help the company better comprehend medical or scientific needs, priorities, or concerns of SLs and/or patients

Inclusive Mindset and Behavior

  • Work Independently and as a Team member with Integrity | Precision | Accomplishment | Motivational Ambition | Respect | Inclusion

  • Demonstrates eagerness to contribute to an environment of belonging, and empowerment

  • Leads by example and serves as a role model for creating, leading, and retaining a workforce

  • Motivation to contribute to an environment of belonging, engagement, and empowerment

    • Working to transform the environment, culture, and business landscape

    • Leveraging to ensure business value, per global and inclusion strategy

    • Ensuring accountability to drive an inclusive culture

    • Strengthening the foundational elements

Required Location:

  • This role covers northern Texas (Dallas).

  • Candidates must reside within the territory.

  • Ability for travel up to 50% within the territory

Required Education

  • PhD, PharmD, DNP, DO, or MD

Required Experience | Skills | Knowledge

  • Proven competence and three years of relevant Immunology (Inflammatory Bowel Disease) experience beyond that obtained in the terminal degree program

  • Principled verbal and written communications

  • Ability to conduct doctoral-level discussions with key external stakeholders

  • Dedication to scientific excellence with a strong focus on scientific education and dialogue

  • Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and networking skills

  • Thorough comprehension of FDA, OIG, HIPAA, and other ethical guidelines, laws, and regulations relevant to the pharmaceutical industry and its customers

  • Ability to organize, prioritize, and work effectively in a constantly changing environment

  • Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite (Word, PowerPoint, Excel, Teams, OneNote)

  • Familiarity with virtual meeting platforms

Preferred Experience | Skills | Knowledge

  • Additional experience in Immunology Rheumatology and/or Dermatology

  • Field-based medical experience

  • Research Experienced

  • Demonstrated record of scientific/medical publication

This is a remote position.

Drishti Clarity LabJob Opening — Growth Marketing Manager

QUICK FACTS

  • Position: Growth Marketing Manager
  • Company: MaxFate Pvt Ltd — Drishti Clarity Lab
  • Location: Mathura, UP / Remote
  • Experience: 2–4 years (D2C / E-commerce / Agency, Meta Ads)
  • Salary: ₹40,000 – ₹50,000/month + performance bonus
  • Reporting: Founder (CEO) — weekly 30-minute data review

WHERE WE ARE GOING (Our 3-Year Vivid Vision) We are already at 1 lakh customers today — and by 2029, Drishti Clarity Lab will serve 10 lakh paying customers: people who do NOT believe in magic. They understand accountability, and they come to us for clarity and a real action plan that helps them move forward — not vague predictions. We are the most trusted name where Vedic wisdom meets behavioral science, profitable and growing without burning money on ads. And just as our customers believe in action over magic, we need team members who are action-oriented and believe in action, not magic.

If that future excites you, read on. If it does not, this role is not for you — and that is okay.

ABOUT US Our goal is to guide people who are under mental stress because they cannot make the right decisions. These life confusions directly hurt their health, wealth and relationships. We pull them out of that confusion and give them complete clarity — along with a clear, action-oriented blueprint — so their stalled growth and happiness can return.

Drishti Clarity Lab (DCL) blends 20 years of Vedic astrology expertise with modern behavioral science. We deliver personalized clarity blueprints to an Indian audience, primarily through Meta Ads. We are a small, self-funded team that has reached profitability — now we need one sharp owner to take us from steady to scaled.

HOW WE WORK (Our Values) We live by Satya (truth). We only sell what we genuinely believe in. If you are someone who will sell anything to anyone, we are not the right fit. We want an honest operator who builds long-term trust.

THE ROLE (Read This Carefully) This is NOT a "just run ads" job. You will OWN revenue, not just channel metrics. Like a second-in-command, you take our growth engine end-to-end: bring new customers in efficiently, fix where they drop off, and — most importantly — get more value from the 1 lakh+ customers who already trust us.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE IN YOUR FIRST 90 DAYS We believe in clear targets, decided by data and gut together. By day 90, you will have:

  • Re-activated our existing customer base — generated measurable repeat revenue from the 1 lakh+ past buyers (your #1 mission).
  • Moved CPA closer to our ₹200 target, with stable, profitable campaigns.
  • Reduced our Add-to-Cart to Checkout drop-off (currently ~23%) through tested funnel fixes.
  • Set up a clean weekly reporting rhythm so the whole team sees the numbers honestly.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN (Ongoing)

  • Meta Ads: daily optimization, preventing learning-phase resets, killing underperformers fast.
  • Funnel: landing-page and retargeting experiments to plug leaks.
  • Repeat Revenue: email, WhatsApp and retargeting to existing customers; revive high-value offers that worked before.
  • Copywriting: write high-converting ad scripts (Hindi/Hinglish) and landing-page copy that speaks to our audience and drives action.
  • Data analysis: read the numbers across Meta Ads, CRM and analytics — spot what's working and what's not, and make decisions from data, not guesses.
  • Data discipline: track everything in our Zoho ecosystem; report honestly, no guesswork.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

  • 2–4 years running Meta Ads for a D2C / e-commerce brand or agency.
  • Proven ability to tie your work to revenue, not just clicks/impressions.
  • Comfortable with numbers — basic Excel/analytics, funnel thinking.
  • Bonus: Hindi-speaking / Tier 2-3 audience experience, and retention/upsell experience.
  • Strong copywriting — can write ad scripts and landing-page copy in Hindi/Hinglish that actually converts (please share samples).
  • Solid data analysis — comfortable reading dashboards, finding patterns, and drawing conclusions from numbers.
  • Owner mindset — you want to grow into a second-in-command, not just clock hours.

PROOF OF DELIVERY — This Is Non-Negotiable We do not hire on talk. We hire on evidence. In your interview you must be ready to SHOW, not just tell:

  • Screen-share a real account, dashboard, or report you personally built or ran (Meta Ads Manager, a tracking sheet, an analytics dashboard, a campaign result).
  • Bring at least one written record / screenshot / short screen-recording (even a 5-minute video) that proves a result you delivered — with before and after numbers.
  • Every achievement you claim must come with specific numbers and dates. "I increased sales" is rejected. "Jan to Jun 2024, I grew revenue 47%, from ₹2cr to ₹2.94cr" is what we want.

If you cannot show proof of what you have done, please do not apply.

TWO QUESTIONS THAT WILL DECIDE YOUR APPLICATION Answer both in 4–5 lines each, with numbers:

  • Q1: Describe one time you generated revenue from an EXISTING customer base (not new acquisition). What did you do, and what was the measurable result?
  • Q2: Tell us about one project or campaign that completely FAILED. What happened, what was your part in it, and what did you learn?

(There is no right answer to Q2. Saying nothing ever failed is itself a red flag.)

OUR HIRING PROCESS (Please Read) We follow hire slow, fire fast. Our process has clear stages:

  1. You read our Vivid Vision (sent with this), and reply with "Please interview me" if the future excites you.
  2. Interview rounds where you show proof of your work (see above).
  3. Reference checks: before the final round, we WILL call your past managers. Please keep their names and contacts ready. (A-players are happy about this; it is a chance to shine.)
  4. After joining, the first 90 days decide long-term fit, measured against the clear targets above.

HOW TO APPLY Send the following to :

  1. Your CV / portfolio.
  2. Your written answers to Q1 and Q2 above.
  3. At least one proof (screenshot / dashboard link / short video) of a result you personally delivered.
  4. One line: best CPA you personally achieved, for what product, at what monthly ad spend.
  5. One writing sample: an ad script or landing-page copy you wrote (Hindi/Hinglish preferred).

jobs.description:
Our client, a leading Software, Information and Communication Technologies company, operates internationally (Athens, Brussels, Luxembourg, Copenhagen, Stockholm, London, Nicosia, Hong-Kong, Valetta, etc). Our client is a renowned supplier of IT services to government institutions, multinational corporations, public administrations and multinational companies, research and academic institutes.

Role Overview

Our client currently has a vacancy for a Scrum Master to offer his/her services as an expert remotely within the EU. In the context of the first assignment, the successful candidate will be integrated in the team of the company that will closely cooperate with a major client’s IT team on site.

Job Type: B2B Contract

Location: Netherlands

Workplace: Remote

Requirements

  • University Degree and at least 8 years of IT professional experience;
  • Minimum of 3 of dedicated experience working as a Scrum Master at SM2 level or above;
  • Led at least 2 production teams through full sprint cycles (planning, review, retrospective, and refinement);
  • Implemented data-driven continuous improvement initiatives, such as increasing team velocity or reducing lead time;
  • Experience coordinating cross-team work via Scrum-of-Scrums or PI Planning events;
  • Deep knowledge of the Scrum Guide and Agile Manifesto principles and values;
  • Good knowledge of facilitation techniques (e.g., Fist of Five, participatory decision-making, Liberating Structures);
  • Good knowledge of systems-thinking and process tailoring to fit complex or evolving environments;
  • Good knowledge of team motivation and stakeholder engagement techniques (e.g., information radiators, team empowerment models);
  • Good knowledge of Agile metrics (velocity, cycle time, burn-up/down charts, cumulative flow diagrams) and the ability to build and interpret dashboards to support team performance and forecasting;
  • Tool proficiency in Azure DevOps (preferred) or Jira, particularly in backlog management, dashboards, and workflow configuration;
  • Possession of Scrum Master certifications: PSM II (or higher) and SAFe 5/6 Agilist;
  • Experience with one or more scaled Agile frameworks (SAFe, Nexus, LeSS, etc.) is considered as an asset;
  • Knowledge of integrating SAFe and Kanban approaches to optimize flow and delivery predictability is considered as an asset;
  • Excellent command of the English language.

Responsibilities

  • Organize and facilitate agile activities and ceremonies including daily stand-up meetings, sprint reviews, retrospectives, sprint and release planning, and product backlog refinement sessions;
  • Ensure that all meetings are positive, productive, stay on topic, and are kept within the timebox;
  • Collaborate closely with the product owner to manage the backlog;
  • Coach team and Product Owner on empiricism, value‑based backlog slicing, and incremental delivery;
  • Track and radiate flow metrics (velocity, sprint burndown, iteration burn rate) and guide the team in data‑driven improvement;
  • Champion and facilitate adoption of agile standards, tools, and best practices;
  • Proactively identify and resolve impediments to team progress;
  • Promote empowered, self‑organising teams, shared vision, psychological safety, collaborative decisions (e.g., Fist‑of‑Five);
  • Uphold Definition of Done, quality gates, and compliance with organisational standards;
  • Communicate with other SCRUM masters and product owners across the organization to ensure transparency into delivery progress, challenges, and risks;
  • Utilize team feedback and metrics (e.g., quality, delivery, cadence, etc.) to identify areas of opportunity and work with team to continuously improve;
  • Support the team in using agile planning and development tools (e.g. Azure DevOps, Confluence);
  • Experiment with new practices and frameworks to improve team outcomes;
  • Actively participate in learning opportunities such as communities of practice or conferences to improve skills and better support the team;
  • Contribute to the advancement and improvement of agile practices within the organization.

jobs.excerpt: DescriptionDescription Section for Assignment in VMS (Flextrack): The MTO COMPASS Advanced Traffic Management System (ATMS) allows Traffic Operation Centres to monitor the traffic and road conditions of selected provincially maintained highways; as well as control in real time all the field traffic control assets through MTOs private COMPASS fibre network.
jobs.description:
Description

Description Section for Assignment in VMS (Flextrack):

The MTO COMPASS Advanced Traffic Management System (ATMS) allows Traffic Operation Centres to monitor the traffic and road conditions of selected provincially maintained highways; as well as control in real time all the field traffic control assets through MTOs private COMPASS fibre network. Oracle Database Appliance (ODA) with Virtual Machine (VM) provisioning and Oracle Weblogic Application Server are two key components within the COMPASS ATMS environment.

Two (2) ODA-X9 are currently in operation in the COMPASS ATMS environment since 2023 and have been running Oracle 19C database with two-node RAC configuration, Fusion Middleware (Weblogic) VMs and also hosted other COMPASS application VMs. The ODA development environment has been set up to mirror the production environment. Oracle Dataguard is deployed for the 19C database and Oracle Cloud Control software is used as grid management tools, supporting

the 24x7 operation of the province-wide COMPASS ATMS system.

As the existing service provided by the Data Architect/Modeller through IT source is ending on March 31, 2025, the new service contract is required to maintain the COMPASS systems production and backup Oracle Database Appliances and to provide preventive maintenance support to COMPASS operations in order to continue support of the 24x7 COMPASS operations and applications as well as ongoing system migration activities.

ITS Office oversees the COMPASS ATMS environment and performs all required testing on the development environment prior to the production rollout. Under this contract, all the Oracle components on both production and development environment shall be maintained regularly and upgraded to conform with Oracle support level and certification requirements.

Responsibilities/Assignment Deliverables

This project involves the following tasks to ensure the 24x7 operation of the province-wide COMPASS systems production and backup Oracle Database Appliance (ODA).

1. Provide technical support in COMPASS production database and application update and migration activities. Services include but not limited to the following:

  • Upgrade the Oracle Cloud Control infrastructure to latest version

- Update/reconfigure ODA infrastructure

  • Update IP addresses of ODA infrastructure to the latest COMPASS VLAN topology

- Relocate and/or backup existing VMs

  • Re-create database and restore necessary VMs

- Create new VMs and/or databases

- Failover database to another ODA

2. Provide preventive maintenance works. Key tasks involve but not limited to the following:

  • Monitor and review Oracle Enterprise Manager Cloud Control alerts

- Perform regular ODA health checks

- Conduct space analysis and checks

  • Install the latest patches (including latest released Oracle security patches), in the ODA database and Weblogic in both production and backup environment

- Maintain the Cloud Control platform

  • Maintain the Production and Standby Emergency Backup environment and user access control
  • Provide system support to resolve issue related to Oracle database, Fusion Middleware (Weblogic), Cloud Control and JEOS VMs.

3. Interface with Oracle on behalf of the Client on the following:

  • Manage ODA related incidents and Service Requests (SR)
  • Coordinate hardware repair/replacement of the ODAs

The consultant must work closely with the client and will undertake and manage the tasks in close collaboration with the Client. The successful consultant shall meet with the Clients team on a frequent basis as deemed required by each task.

The consultant must have practical experience in:

  • ODA migration in complex production system environment
  • Deploying and maintaining ODA X9-2HA and X9-2L
  • Installing, deploying, upgrading and maintaining ODA VM provisioning including the latest versions of Oracle database, Weblogic, Oracle Fusion Middleware, and Linux Just Enough Operation System (JEOS) VMs.

Current COMPASS ODA Configurations:

ODA-X9 (to operate in production environment, pending completion of migration activities):

One ODA X9-2HA with VM Provisioning (not bare-metal) base configuration

One ODA X9-2L with VM Provisioning (not bare-metal) base configuration

Oracle 19C Enterprise Edition (subject to change)

Weblogic with Fusion Middleware (Forms/Reports) are running as VMs on the same ODA

Weblogic Managed Server are running as VMs on the same ODA

Oracle Cloud Control is running on all ODAs and its VMs

COMPASS ATMS Distributed Functions java programs are running as standalone JEOS VM on ODA DOMx (DOM1, DOM2, etc) [NK1]

Experience and Skill Set Requirements for Assignment in VMS (Flextrack):

Skill Set Requirements

One (1) Specialized IT Consultant

  • Practical experience in installing, deploying and provisioning Oracle DB Systems, Oracle 19C Database, VMs and Oracle Weblogic.
  • Practical expertise in Oracle Database Appliance (ODA) X9 Model Family
  • Practical expertise in Oracle Standby Database Architecture
  • Practical expertise in building Oracle Virtual Machine (VM) and VM Template
  • Practical expertise in applying patches in ODA X9 Model Family
  • Practical expertise in Oracle Weblogic with Form and Report Services
  • Practical expertise in working with JEOS Linux
  • Project management competencies such as planning and organizational skills to be able to complete the deliverables in timeframe provided culminating with high quality results
  • Previous experience and performance of other similar projects
  • Demonstrated ability to build effective working relationship with clients
  • Written and spoken communication skills with respect to both formal presentations, reports and correspondence
  • Practical experience in Oracle Cloud Control
  • Practical experience in integrating WLS, JEOS and Cloud Control in ODA-X9 environment

Maintenance and Support Requirements

1. Oracle Certified Professional / Database Administrator

2. Oracle Implementation Certification in Oracle Database Appliance

3. Oracle Implementation Certification in Oracle Virtual Machine

4. Oracle Implementation Certification in Oracle Real Application Clusters

5. Oracle Implementation Certification in Oracle Database

6. Oracle Implementation Certification in Oracle Performance Tuning

7. Oracle Implementation Certification in Oracle Enterprise Manager Oracle Linux

Note: Please be advised that this is an in-demand Role, and the contractor will be contacted on a need-basis.

SkillsExperience and Skill Set Requirements

Evaluation Criteria

Technical Experience and Qualifications - 30%

  • Demonstrated practical experience in Oracle single-node DB systems and 2-node RAC DB systems on virtual machines within the last 5 years
  • Demonstrated practical experience in Oracle Standby Database Architecture and Oracle Data Guard within the last 5 years
  • Demonstrated practical experience in building Oracle Virtual Machine (VM) and VM Template
  • Demonstrated practical experience in Oracle Weblogic with Form and Report Service (WLS)
  • Demonstrated practical experience in Oracle Cloud Control

Project Management Skills - 20%

  • Demonstrated experience with project management and in completing deliverables in timeframe provided culminating with a high quality results
  • Proven experience deploying, installing, and managing other similar projects
  • Strong experience with building effective working relationship with clients
  • Strong written and spoken communication skills with respect to both formal presentations, reports and correspondence

ODA Experience - 50%

  • Demonstrated experience in Oracle Database Appliance (ODA) X9 Model Family
  • Demonstrated practical experience in applying patches in ODA X9 Model Family
  • Demonstrated practical experience in deploying, upgrading and managing Oracle Real
  • Application Cluster database (including backup/standby) in Oracle Database Appliance (ODA) Virtual Machine (VM) provisioning.
  • Demonstrated practical experience in deploying, upgrading and managing Oracle Fusion Middleware Weblogic (WLS) in ODA VM provisioning.
  • Demonstrated practical experience in deploying, upgrading and managing Just Enough OS (JEOS) Linux VM in ODA.
  • Demonstrated practical experience in deploying, upgrading and managing Oracle Cloud Control in ODA VM provisioning.
  • Demonstrated practical experience in integrating the WLS, JEOS and Cloud Control in the ODA VM provisioning.

Must haves:ODA X9-2HA and X9-2L

jobs.description:
About Doppel

Doppel is building the future of social engineering defense. Our AI-native platform uses agentic AI to protect executives, employees, customers, and brands from phishing, impersonation, fraud, and other AI-powered threats across digital channels. Backed by leading investors including Andreessen Horowitz and Bessemer Venture Partners, Doppel is a rapidly growing Series C company helping customers stay ahead of modern digital threats.

The Role

We are hiring our first dedicated Renewals Manager to build and run the renewals function at Doppel.

This is a builder role and a hands-on commercial role. You will not inherit a finished renewals organization or simply administer contracts. You will design the operating model while personally owning renewal execution across our customer base.

You will establish the systems, processes, forecasting discipline, commercial guardrails, segmentation, and cross-functional handoffs required to make renewals predictable and scalable. At the same time, you will be directly responsible for moving renewals from early planning through commercial negotiation, procurement, signature, and close.

You will partner closely with Customer Success Managers, Account Executives, CS Operations / RevOps, Deal Desk, Finance, Legal, and channel partners. Customer Success will continue to own customer value, adoption, health, and risk-recovery plans. You will own the commercial renewal motion and renewable ARR.

This is initially an individual-contributor role, with the opportunity to help define how the renewals organization should evolve as Doppel scales.

What You Will Do

Build the Renewals Function

  • Design and implement Doppel's scalable renewals operating model, including lifecycle stages, ownership, exit criteria, escalation paths, and rules of engagement.
  • Establish renewal motions for strategic, core, scaled, direct, channel, and auto-renewal customers.
  • Build a forward-looking renewal forecasting and inspection cadence that gives leadership reliable visibility into renewable ARR, expected renewals, churn, contraction, timing risk, and commercial blockers.
  • Define clear renewal stages, forecast categories, risk definitions, and Salesforce data requirements so the renewal book can be inspected consistently.
  • Develop playbooks, templates, customer and partner cadences, dashboards, reporting, and repeatable commercial workflows.
  • Partner with Deal Desk, Finance, Legal, Sales, and CS leadership to define commercial guardrails for standard uplifts, multi-year agreements, co-terming, concessions, downsells, payment terms, and non-standard exceptions.
  • Establish consistent churn and contraction reason codes and use renewal data to identify systemic retention risks and improvement opportunities.
  • Identify opportunities to automate renewal opportunity creation, reminders, quoting, risk detection, reporting, and administrative work using Salesforce, customer-success tooling, and AI.
  • Continuously refine the model as renewal volume and complexity grow, including recommending when additional renewal capacity or specialized coverage is required.

Run the Renewal Business

  • Personally own the end-to-end commercial renewal lifecycle across Doppel's customer base, from early planning through quote, negotiation, procurement, signature, and close.
  • Maintain a forward-looking view of the renewal book and ensure upcoming renewals are identified, validated, and actively managed well in advance of expiration.
  • Lead customer-facing renewal conversations covering pricing, uplift, term, multi-year options, scope changes, downsell, procurement, and contract execution.
  • Own standard renewal quotes and commercial execution, routing non-standard pricing or terms through DealHub and the appropriate approval process.
  • Maintain an accurate renewal forecast and provide evidence-based visibility into expected outcomes, churn and contraction exposure, timing risk, and blockers.
  • Partner with CSMs to translate account health, adoption, business outcomes, support history, stakeholder changes, and competitive signals into the renewal strategy.
  • Identify renewal risk early and drive the commercial components of mitigation plans alongside the CSM, AE, leadership, and executive sponsor.
  • Coordinate partner-led renewals and ensure Doppel, the partner, CSM, and AE are aligned on timing, pricing, scope, customer communication, and remaining steps to close.
  • Partner with AEs on combined renewal-and-expansion motions. Renewals remains accountable for the existing renewable ARR and renewal execution; the AE owns incremental expansion ARR. Together, you will create one coordinated customer-facing commercial strategy.
  • Manage complex renewal structures including multi-year terms, co-terming, product changes, pricing adjustments, and approved commercial exceptions.
  • Keep Salesforce accurate and current as the single source of truth for renewal amount, forecast category, risks, next steps, owners, commercial status, and expected close timing.
  • Ensure signed renewals become clean, billable transactions by coordinating PO requirements, billing contacts, subscription dates, payment terms, invoice schedules, and other required information with Finance.
  • Analyze churn, contraction, uplift realization, multi-year adoption, late renewals, forecast variance, and other renewal patterns and turn those insights into improvements to the operating model.

What We Are Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience in SaaS renewals, account management, customer success, or another commercial post-sale role, with meaningful direct ownership of renewals.
  • Demonstrated experience owning a renewal target or book of business and delivering strong retention outcomes with disciplined forecasting.
  • Experience building or materially improving a renewals process, operating model, playbook, forecast methodology, or commercial cadence—not simply operating within an established one.
  • Experience in cybersecurity or another complex B2B SaaS environment involving enterprise customers, channel partners, procurement, and legal stakeholders.
  • Strong commercial judgment and negotiation skills across pricing, term, uplift, concessions, multi-year agreements, procurement, and contract execution.
  • Ability to operate both strategically and tactically: you can design the process, build the dashboard, negotiate with a customer, inspect a forecast, and chase a signature when needed.
  • Ability to distinguish customer-value risk from commercial or transaction risk and mobilize the right cross-functional team for each.
  • Strong executive communication skills: concise, credible, comfortable with senior customer stakeholders, and effective in high-pressure commercial situations.
  • Strong analytical skills and operational rigor, with the ability to manage a large number of concurrent renewal dates without losing the strategic context of the account.
  • Strong Salesforce fluency; experience with CPQ / DealHub-style quoting, forecasting tools, customer-success platforms, and contract workflows is highly valuable.
  • Comfort operating in a fast-growing environment where roles and processes are evolving and you are expected to create structure rather than wait for it.

Why Join Doppel

  • Competitive compensation and meaningful equity; $120,000 - $130,000 OTE
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Comprehensive health benefits, PTO, and parental leave.
  • Opportunity to build a critical recurring-revenue function from the ground up and have a direct impact on how Doppel scales.

Success Measures

  • Strong Gross Revenue Retention and achievement of Doppel's renewable ARR target.
  • High percentage of renewals completed on or before the contractual renewal date.
  • Reliable renewal forecast accuracy with risks identified early enough for the business to act.
  • Consistent realization of approved renewal uplifts and increased adoption of multi-year agreements where appropriate.
  • Reduced late-stage surprises, emergency extensions, and renewals entering the final 30 days without a clear path to close.
  • Clear visibility into churn and contraction drivers with measurable improvements based on those insights.
  • Consistent execution of direct, channel, and auto-renewal motions with clean ownership and handoffs.
  • A scalable, documented renewals operating model that reduces administrative burden on CSMs and allows them to spend more time driving customer value.
  • Clean handoffs from signed renewal to Finance, with accurate contracts, dates, PO information, billing contacts, and payment terms.
  • A clear recommendation for how the Renewals function should scale as Doppel's customer base and renewable ARR grow.
Salary Range
$120,000—$130,000 USD

Gegründet in 2019 durch Arend Liese, zuvor Rechtsanwalt bei Freshfields Bruckhaus Deringer, denkt Hopkins das Prinzip Kanzlei und Rechtsdurchsetzung täglich neu - mit großem Fokus auf moderne Technologie und interdisziplinäre Zusammenarbeit. Mit einem Team von mehr als 150 Personen berät und vertritt Hopkins Privatpersonen deutschlandweit in allen rechtlichen Belangen.

Aufgaben

  • Sie sind Teil der Mission die Zukunft der Rechtsberatung für Verbraucher neu zu formen
  • Mithilfe von Hopkins bereitgestellter moderner Technologien betreuen Sie Ihre Mandanten eigenständig, digital und deutschlandweit

Qualifikation

Als praxiserfahrene/r Anwalt/-ältin bringen Sie Neugier und Offenheit für Technologien und die Digitalisierung mit. Sie haben eine gültige Zulassung zur Rechtsanwaltschaft bei einer deutschen Rechtsanwaltskammer und suchen einen unkomplizierten Weg Mandate und damit verbundenes zusätzliches Einkommen zu generieren, ohne Kostenrisiko und ohne die Mühen der eigenen Mandatsakquise.

Benefits

  • Infrastruktur: Nutzen Sie unsere professionelle Kanzleiumgebung für eine effiziente Mandatsbearbeitung auf Augenhöhe sowie moderne digitale Schnittstellen für eine reibungslose, standortunabhängige Zusammenarbeit und den sicheren Datenaustausch.
  • Vergütung: Dank bereits akquirierter und aufbereiteter Mandate können Sie sofort loslegen und für jeden bearbeiteten Fall zusätzliches Einkommen generieren. Die konkrete Vergütung richtet sich je nach Rechtsgebiet und Falltyp.
  • Selbstständigkeit: Als freie/r Mitarbeiter/in von Hopkins entscheiden Sie selbst, in einem gemeinsam erarbeiteten Rahmen, wie viele Mandate Sie aktiv betreuen möchten.
  • Flexibilität: Sie genießen die Flexibilität einer vollständig digitalen Kanzlei und können aus Ihrer Kanzlei, Ihrem Home-Office oder an einem anderen Ort Ihrer Wahl arbeiten.

Wir freuen uns sehr auf ein Kennenlernen, wenn Sie diese Herausforderung anspricht.

Floowi connects top LATAM professionals with leading U.S. companies through remote talent solutions. Our mission is to make LATAM the world’s premier hub for growth and excellence.

Our client is a performance-based marketing company that helps businesses generate recurring revenue from existing customer databases through consent-based SMS, email, and paid media campaigns. ✍ Short Description:

We are looking for an Accounting Assistant to support the tracking and reconciliation of payments generated through digital marketing campaigns. This role will focus on reviewing weekly and monthly campaign data, determining the amounts owed based on campaign performance, and reconciling those amounts against actual payments received. The position combines accounting and reconciliation work with basic use of campaign tracking platforms. Advanced technical knowledge is not required, but the ability to comfortably navigate online platforms and learn new tools is important.

  • Review weekly and monthly campaign performance data to determine amounts owed.

  • Access campaign tracking platforms to retrieve performance and payment information.

  • Reconcile expected payments against actual deposits and payments received.

  • Identify discrepancies between amounts owed and amounts paid and track outstanding payments.

  • Maintain accurate records of payments, campaign data, and reconciliations.

  • Prepare recurring reports and summaries using financial and campaign data.

  • Work with spreadsheets to organize, analyze, and track payment information.

jobs.description:
About Avalere Health

United by one profound purpose: to reach EVERY PATIENT POSSIBLE. At Avalere Health, we ensure every patient is identified, treated, supported, and cared for. Equally. Our Advisory, Medical, and Marketing teams come together – powerfully and intentionally – to forge unconventional connections, building a future where healthcare is not a barrier and no patient is left behind.
Achieving our mission starts with providing enriching, purpose-driven careers for our team that empower them to make a tangible impact on patient lives. We are committed to creating a culture where our employees are empowered to bring their whole selves to work and tap into the power of diverse backgrounds and skillsets to play a part in making a difference for every patient, everywhere.
Our flexible approach to working allows our global teams to decide where they want to work, whether in-office or at home based on team and client need. Major city hubs in London, Manchester, Washington, D.C., and New York, and smaller offices globally, serve as collaboration hubs allowing our teams to come together when it matters. Homeworkers are equally supported, with dedicated social opportunities and resources.
Our inclusive culture is at the heart of everything we do. We proudly support our employees in bringing their whole selves to work with our six Employee Network Groups – Diverse Ability, Family, Gender, LGBTQ+, Mental Health, and Race/Ethnicity. These groups provide opportunities to promote diversity, equity, and inclusion and to connect, learn, and socialise through regular meetings and programs of activity. We are an accredited Fertility Friendly employer with our Fertility Policy, enhanced parental leave, and culture of flexibility ensuring every employee feels supported across their family planning journey and can work in a way that suits their family’s needs.
We are deeply invested in supporting professional growth for our employees through day-to-day career experiences, access to thousands of on-demand training sessions, regular career conversations, and the opportunity for global, cross-capability career moves.
We take pride in being part of the Disability Confident Scheme. This helps make sure you can be interviewed fairly if you have a disability, long term health condition, or are neurodiverse. If you'd like to apply and need adjustments made, you can let us know in your application.

About the role

The Project Manager leads the execution of projects. This individual is responsible for the creation of the project plan based on information provided in the strategy and the determination of job level. He or she owns the process inception to completion, including participation in budget determination, creation of project schedule, managing resources for deliverables, raising red flags as issues arise and ensuring adherence to the approval process.

What you'll do:

  • Responsible for the creation of Scope of Work (“SOW”)
  • Collaborates with all agency teams to establish effective project plans, staff plans, forecast upcoming work and allocate resources
  • Manages effective, efficient workflow of all projects on assigned accounts
  • Develops timelines and advises on estimates; manages projects to remain on time and budget; flags timing and budget concerns to course correct
  • Schedule and lead project kick-off meeting (as it relates to schedule, job level, folder structure and location, SOW, creative assets, etc.)
  • Work with internal team to define program requirements and system specifications. Work with client on as-needed basis
  • Initiate and conduct formal internal review meetings to secure creative approvals
  • Initiate and conduct formal team status meetings, document risks and issues for internal purposes
  • Maintain daily communications with team members on all projects
  • Work closely with the team to determine and understand daily project status
  • Ensure that issues and risks are anticipated, identified and properly escalated and resolved. Seek final resolution on all issues so projects do not stall or fall out of scope without warning
  • Conduct internal copy/layout reviews with core team and ensure all assets are routed internally, with specific attention to required creative and proofreading approvals
  • Ensure adequate amount of time, whenever possible, for the routing and review of materials
  • Facilitate presentations and review of final asset with client and provide recommendations pertaining to budget, timing, production, etc.
  • Identify out-of-scope activities
  • Manage the financial tracking process for the project (create job status report, attend accounting meetings, maintain the estimate by reallocating hours as necessary, flag overages, identify delays that may affect budget, etc.)
  • Takes ownership of and enforces agency processes by providing meaningful feedback to all teams
  • Analyzes and recommends process improvements to enhance efficiency, including systems and/or software recommendations
  • Tactful, yet assertive communication style; able to foster positive relationships with agency teams
  • Provides meaningful performance input for other employees in all departments
  • Maintains a high level attention to detail
  • Maintains a professional and positive attitude
  • Seeks out additional opportunities to expand experience and cultivate expertise
  • Performs other duties as assigned

About you:

  • Bachelor’s Degree required
  • 2-5 years project or account management experience in Pharma agency environment
  • Experience with timeline development and budget management required
  • Ability to establish and build productive relationships with diverse personalities
  • Must be self-motivated, professional, detail-oriented and possess excellent communication skills
  • Comfortable working under pressure within tight deadlines while maintaining a positive attitude
  • Must have an enthusiastic desire to continuously learn, evolve and innovate
  • PC, MS Office Suite software experience required
  • Workfront and Jira experience required

What we can offer

You will receive a 401K plan with an employer match contribution up to 4% (immediately vested), as well as life insurance, disability coverage, and medical, dental, and vision plans for peace of mind. Enjoy flexible working arrangements, including hybrid and remote work, along with the option to work from anywhere across the globe two weeks each year. We provide 20 vacation days plus one personal well-being day, recognise 9 public holidays, along with gifted end-of-year holidays and an early Summer Friday finish in June, July, and August.
Access free counselling through our employee assistance program and personalized health support. Our enhanced maternity, paternity, family leave, and fertility policies provide support across every stage of your family-planning journey. You can also benefit from continuous opportunities to professionally develop with on-demand training, support, and global mobility opportunities across the business.
