jobs.description:
Job Title: Partnership Development Executive – DeVoe School of Business (B2B & B2G)

Reporting Relationship:Executive Director, Strategic Partnership Expansion

Unit: National & Global

Department: Strategic Partnerships - IWU National & Global

Campus Location: Online/Remote within the United States

Summary of Position:The Partnership Development Executive – DeVoe School of Business represents IWU–National & Global and the DeVoe School of Business in developing B2B and B2G organizational partnerships that create sustainable enrollment pipelines for working professionals and adult learners.

This role focuses on employer-driven talent development by connecting organizations with IWU’s business degree portfolio, including traditional business programs, leadership and management pathways, graduate business programs, MBA-related offerings, and emerging AI-focused business programs and certificates. The position helps employers address workforce needs by developing talent pipelines, career ladders, upskilling pathways, and retention solutions.

The Partnership Development Executive serves as a consultative relationship builder with Human Resources leaders, Chief People Officers, Talent Development Directors, Learning and Development leaders, workforce development organizations, chambers of commerce, municipal and government HR divisions, and other employer decision makers.

This position is designed for a high-potential, relationship-driven professional with non-negotiable excellence in written and verbal communication, professional polish, business acumen, strategic curiosity, and disciplined follow-through. A background in human resources, talent development, workforce development, organizational development, or employer relations is strongly preferred. The successful candidate will identify prospective partners, initiate outreach, conduct professional discovery meetings, present tailored business and AI education solutions, manage pipeline milestones in Salesforce, collaborate with DeVoe faculty and academic leaders, and advance opportunities toward signed partnership agreements.


Duties and Responsibilities

  • B2B and B2G Partnership Development, Discovery, and Advancement
    • Identifies and initiates outreach to prospective employer partners across private-sector, nonprofit, workforce, municipal, and government/public-sector organizations
    • Prepares for and leads professional, agenda-driven discovery meetings with HR executives, Chief People Officers, Talent Development Directors, Learning and Development leaders, City/County HR Directors, state agency HR leaders, workforce leaders, and other organizational decision-makers
    • Positions IWU DeVoe School of Business programs, including traditional business degrees and AI-focused business programs and certificates, as strategic solutions for employer talent pipelines, career ladders, employee upskilling, succession planning, leadership development, and retention
    • Writes clear, polished prospecting emails, executive summaries, meeting recaps, and tailored proposals linking organizational workforce goals to IWU degree and certificate pathways
    • Presents IWU educational solutions, tuition discount benefits, cohort opportunities, and Prior Learning Assessment options clearly and persuasively
    • Works collaboratively with leadership to navigate decision-making pathways, address objections, establish clear next steps, and secure formal partnership agreements using institutional legal templates
    • Develops consultative relationships that move beyond general awareness or event attendance and toward measurable partnership, enrollment, and workforce outcomes
  • Targeted Market Outreach, Strategic Events, & Lead Generation
    • Develops and executes targeted regional outreach plans for priority employers, workforce development boards, chambers of commerce, professional associations, HR networks, and business organizations
    • Builds strategic presence within key professional organizations and employer networks, including SHRM, workforce development organizations, chambers of commerce, talent development groups, industry associations, municipal HR networks, and business leadership forums
    • Partners with DeVoe School of Business faculty by coordinating and exhibiting at events where DeVoe faculty are speaking, presenting, facilitating workshops, or representing the university as thought leaders
    • Leverages faculty expertise and public speaking engagements to generate qualified employer conversations, strengthen DeVoe’s market visibility, and connect organizational needs to IWU programs
    • Uses selective event attendance strategically by conducting pre-event outreach, securing scheduled one-on-one meetings, engaging decision makers during the event, and completing disciplined post-event follow-up
    • Employs market research and AI-enabled prospecting tools to identify workforce trends, talent shortages, skill gaps, AI adoption needs, leadership development opportunities, and high-yield employer targets
    • Represents IWU and the DeVoe School of Business with professionalism at employer meetings, association events, conferences, workforce forums, and community-based business events
  • CRM Pipeline Discipline, Follow-Through, & AI Workflow Utilization
    • Maintains uncompromising daily discipline in Salesforce as the system of record for all accounts, contacts, meeting notes, pipeline stages, and follow-up tasks
    • Demonstrates meticulous follow-through by executing committed action items promptly and maintaining momentum across all active partner relationships
    • Utilizes CRM performance metrics and pipeline management tools to prioritize outreach, track conversion rates, and meet weekly/monthly activity benchmarks
    • Leverages artificial intelligence (AI) tools and technologies to support market research, prospect identification, workflow optimization, strategic planning, communication drafting, and data analysis
    • Ensures that all partner activity is documented accurately, timely, and completely to support team visibility, leadership reporting, and effective handoff
  • Internal Collaboration & Academic Pathway Alignment
    • Collaborates closely with the DeVoe School of Business Dean, faculty, program directors, and academic leaders to understand program offerings, emerging AI curriculum, business programs, custom cohort opportunities, and employer education capabilities
    • Coordinates with DeVoe faculty to support speaking engagements, professional organization involvement, employer-facing workshops, and thought leadership opportunities that can generate partnership conversations
    • Partners with Enrollment Counselors, Marketing, Legal, Operations, and Student Success teams to ensure responsive communication, smooth handoffs, and tailored recruitment campaigns for partner employees
    • Communicates employer feedback, workforce trends, market intelligence, and partnership barriers to academic and enrollment leaders to support continuous improvement and program alignment
    • Helps translate academic offerings into employer-relevant language focused on workforce outcomes, employee development, retention, promotion pathways, and organizational performance
    • Supports internal planning for co-branded employer materials, landing pages, employee communication plans, webinars, information sessions, and partnership launch activities
  • Partner Onboarding, Activation, & Relationship Transition
    • Coordinates the initial onboarding process for newly signed partners, including launch communications, co-branded landing pages, employee announcements, webinars, lunch-and-learns, and discovery sessions
    • Ensures early partner engagement and qualified student interest before transitioning mature accounts to designated long-term account nurture managers or appropriate internal owners
    • Documents onboarding steps, communication commitments, stakeholder contacts, and future engagement opportunities in Salesforce
    • Supports a smooth transition from signed agreement to active enrollment pipeline by coordinating internal teams and ensuring timely follow-up with partner contacts
    • Monitors early partner activity to identify additional opportunities for employee engagement, cohort development, program alignment, and future growth

Qualifications:According to Indiana Wesleyan University employment policy all employees must possess a strong Christian commitment and adhere to the standards outlined in the IWU Community Lifestyle Statement.

Education

  • Required: Minimum of a bachelor's degree from an accredited institution
  • Preferred: Master's degree in business, Human Resources, Management, Leadership, Communication, Higher Education, or equivalent experience

Experience

  • Required:
    Minimum of two to four (2-4) years of successful professional experience in human resources, talent development, learning and development, workforce development, organizational development, B2B sales, B2G sales, business development, partnership development, account management, employer relations, higher education recruitment, corporate recruitment, or a related externally facing role
  • Preferred:
    Experience working with employers, HR leaders, workforce organizations, business associations, chambers of commerce, professional associations, government agencies, or talent development networks
  • Ideal Background:
    A candidate with a talent development, workforce development, organizational development, or employer relations background is strongly preferred because this role requires understanding of workforce planning, employee development, career ladders, retention, talent pipelines, and organizational learning needs
  • IWU is willing to consider candidates with less direct partnership development experience if they demonstrate exceptional communication skills, strong business acumen, professional presence, coachability, initiative, and disciplined follow-through

Required Skills

  • Exceptional Written Communication:
    Proven ability to write clear, polished, persuasive, and error-free business correspondence, prospecting emails, meeting recaps, executive summaries, and proposals. A writing assessment may be part of the interview process
  • Professional Presentation and Executive Polish:
    Confidence, poise, and clarity when presenting to HR executives, C-suite leaders, workforce leaders, faculty, internal stakeholders, and professional business audiences
  • Business Acumen:
    Understanding of employer needs related to workforce planning, talent pipelines, career ladders, employee retention, leadership development, upskilling, succession planning, and organizational performance
  • Consultative Relationship Building:
    Ability to ask strong discovery questions, listen carefully, identify organizational needs, summarize opportunities accurately, and connect employer challenges to relevant IWU academic solutions
  • Strategic Thinking:
    Ability to evaluate partner fit, prioritize high-potential opportunities, plan outreach intentionally, and use events and professional networks to generate qualified partnership conversations
  • Disciplined Follow-Through and Organization:
    Strong time management, attention to detail, personal accountability, and proactive follow-through. Ability to set next steps, document commitments, and keep opportunities moving through the pipeline
  • Technology, CRM, and AI Acumen:
    Experience using CRM systems, pipeline management tools, and performance analytics. Proficiency with artificial intelligence tools and technologies to support market research, prospect identification, workflow optimization, strategic planning, communication, and data analysis. Salesforce experience strongly preferred
  • Collaboration:
    Ability to work effectively with academic leaders, faculty, enrollment teams, marketing, legal, operations, and external partners to advance shared goals
  • Mission Fit:
    Personal ability to articulate and support the Christ-centered mission, values, and educational philosophy of Indiana Wesleyan University
  • Mobility:
    Valid driver’s license with an excellent driving record. Willing and able to travel approximately 50% across Central Indiana and surrounding regions, with occasional evening, weekend, and overnight travel. Able to lift 50lbs

IWU Kingdom Diversity Statement

IWU, in covenant with God's reconciling work and in accordance with the Biblical principles of our historic Wesleyan tradition, commits to build a community that reflects Kingdom diversity. We will foster an intentional environment for living, teaching and learning, which exhibits honor, respect, and dignity. Acknowledging visible or invisible differences, our community authentically values each member's earthly and eternal worth. We refute ignorance and isolation and embrace deliberate and courageous engagement that exhibits Christ's commandment to love all humankind.

LIMITATIONS AND DISCLAIMER

As a religious educational institution operating under the auspices of The Wesleyan Church, Indiana Wesleyan University is permitted and reserves the right to prefer employees on the basis of religion (42 U.S.C., Sections 2000e-1 and 2000e-2).

The above job description is meant to describe the general nature and level of work being performed; it is not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required for the position. Employees will be required to follow other job-related instructions and to perform other job-related duties requested by their supervisor in compliance with Federal and State Laws.

jobs.excerpt: There’s a moment when growth becomes personal.  Someone discovers a product because of an idea you believed in.
jobs.description:
There’s a moment when growth becomes personal. Someone discovers a product because of an idea you believed in. They return because it earned their trust. You helped make that connection happen. At Mercola, you’ll bring supplements and at-home lab tests to more people—and feel the pride of turning a bold idea into a relationship that lasts. Imagine watching a partnership you built open doors that once seemed out of reach. Feel the exhilaration of backing your judgment, finding what connects, and seeing customers choose you again. Experience the satisfaction of building a business whose success carries your fingerprints. Your ambition will have room to breathe. Your decisions will matter. And your proudest achievement can be what keeps growing after that first breakthrough: customers who stay, partners who believe, and a team inspired by what you made possible. Build something you’ll be proud to look back on—and excited to wake up to.

ROLE SNAPSHOT —

  • Pay: Base salary plus performance pay tied directly to new customers, active buyers, monthly product revenue and customer acquisition cost.
  • Location/Schedule: Remote/ Full-Time
  • Purpose: Grow revenue from Mercola’s existing supplements, new supplement launches and at-home lab tests through profitable customer acquisition, repeat purchasing and partnerships.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES —

  • Own revenue outcomes for the existing supplement line and at-home lab tests.
  • Lead new supplement launches from go-to-market planning through sustained sales.
  • Increase new customers, active buyers, repeat purchases and reorder rates.
  • Run paid acquisition through Hawke Media, setting targets, reviewing results weekly and holding the agency accountable for customer acquisition cost and revenue.
  • Reallocate channel spend based on measured return and growth efficiency.
  • Turn the Florida practitioner-clinic and UK gym bone-screening partnerships into measurable sources of customers and product revenue.
  • Monitor commercial performance and improve acquisition cost while scaling volume profitably.
  • Operate directly across acquisition, agencies and partnerships before building a team.

MUST-HAVE QUALIFICATIONS

  • Proven experience growing a direct-to-consumer health or supplement business.
  • A demonstrated record of reducing customer acquisition cost while scaling customer volume.
  • Experience managing performance agencies against business results.
  • Direct accountability for acquisition and revenue outcomes.
  • Documented results with specific numbers, including customers acquired, revenue growth, acquisition cost and repeat purchase performance.
  • A hands-on commercial approach, sound economic judgment and willingness to take direction and adjust quickly.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Leadership experience at a direct-to-consumer health, wellness or subscription brand, or a supplement brand that scaled online.
  • Experience launching supplements into an existing customer base.
  • Experience selling diagnostics or at-home lab tests directly to consumers.
  • Revenue generation through practitioner, clinic or fitness-facility partnerships.
  • Experience operating in both US and UK markets.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Direct ownership of physical product and partnership revenue.
  • A hands-on mandate across acquisition, repeat purchasing, launches and partnerships.
  • Base salary plus performance pay linked to defined commercial outcomes.
  • An opportunity to build a team after establishing direct operating results.

Honest Challenge You will run acquisition, manage agency performance and drive partnership revenue directly before building a team. Success requires specific, measurable results and profitable growth. This role will challenge candidates whose experience centers on brand, content or product creation without direct acquisition and revenue accountability. PLEASE NOTE: While we appreciate candidates who reach out directly, given the volume, we are unable to respond to each inquiry individually. The pay range for this position is base salary plus performance pay tied directly to new customers, active buyers, monthly product revenue and customer acquisition cost. Please note that the quoted pay range for this job is a general guideline only and not a guarantee of compensation or salary. Additional factors considered in extending an offer include (but are not limited to) experience, including industry or specific experience, education, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity, alignment with market data, and/or other applicable laws. This position is benefits-eligible. Mercola provides competitive, affordable, and diverse benefit programs that support your total health – from a healthy body to a healthy mind. These benefits support you and your family in all aspects of life:

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage
  • Optional Accident, Hospital Indemnity, and Critical Illness
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Employer-paid Life and AD&D Insurance
  • Optional Supplemental Life and AD&D Insurance
  • Short- and Long-Term Disability Insurance
  • Flexible Spending Accounts
  • Health Savings Accounts
  • Dayforce Wallet – get paid as you earn
  • Employee Discount
  • Retirement Planning (401k with matching contribution)
  • Pet Insurance
  • Wellness Program Offerings
  • Paid Time Off, accrued per pay period based on years of service, starting at 15 days annually.
  • 9 Paid Holidays per year, including 1 floating holiday.

The Company reserves the right to modify this information at any time, with or without notice, subject to applicable law. About Inspira Education

Inspira Education Group is one of the fastest-growing edtech startups in the US. We started with a simple mission to democratize access to high-quality coaching so that every student in the world has an equal opportunity to access the best opportunities.

As the world’s leading network of top admissions coaches in medical, legal, business, and college studies, we’re building software and services in one place—disrupting long-entrenched application processes with products and experiences that strive to provide an equal platform for candidates from diverse backgrounds worldwide.

As one of the fastest-growing edtech firms in the world, we are backed by some of the leading venture capital firms and investors in the world, including Zeev Ventures, Quiet Capital, Craft Ventures and Jeff Fluhr (Founder of Stubhub).

The Role

We’re looking for a Junior Content Editor to help keep everything we publish accurate, clear, and polished. You’ll work alongside our senior editors, SEO team, writers, and subject-matter experts to take drafts from rough to publish-ready across our blogs, guides, and marketing content.

This is a great fit if you have a sharp eye for detail, love making sentences better, and want to grow into a more strategic editorial role. You’ll learn how content gets found and cited by search engines and AI tools, and you’ll build real skills in editorial process, style, and feedback.

Please note: This role is open to candidates based remotely in Canada.

What You’ll Do

Edit for quality

  • Catch spelling, grammar, factual, and formatting errors before content goes live.
  • Rewrite passive constructions into active voice and replace jargon with plain language.
  • Tighten wordy sentences without losing the point.
  • Check that headings are logical and accurately reflect the content beneath them.
  • Verify stats, claims, and quotes against primary sources, and flag anything unverified.

Apply our style guide

  • Apply Inspira’s house style consistently across punctuation, capitalization, formatting, and tone.
  • Flag style deviations for writers rather than silently fixing them, so they learn the rules over time.
  • Suggest updates to the style guide as you spot patterns or gaps.

Edit for search and AI discoverability

  • Make sure each section leads with its main point rather than burying the answer.
  • Help break content into clear, self-contained sections that answer a specific question.
  • Spot forced keywords or unnatural phrasing, and make the writing read naturally for people first.
  • Check that link text is descriptive and specific (no “click here”).
  • Follow our SEO and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) guidelines as you edit.

Support the editorial workflow

  • Keep multiple pieces moving through briefs, review stages, and approvals on deadline.
  • Give writers clear, constructive feedback that explains the reason behind each change.
  • Work with coaches and subject-matter experts to clarify and strengthen their drafts.
  • Help document and improve our editorial processes as we scale.

What We’re Looking For

Required

  • 2–3 years of professional editing or copyediting experience (digital publishing, content marketing, agency, or similar).
  • Excellent command of grammar, punctuation, and style, plus the judgment to know when a rule should flex.
  • A sharp eye for detail and a commitment to catching errors before they ship.
  • Ability to give kind, specific, actionable feedback to writers.
  • Comfort working with subject-matter experts and non-professional writers.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to juggle multiple projects and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Familiarity with SEO fundamentals (search intent, on-page best practices) and curiosity about how AI-driven search is changing content.
  • A portfolio or a few before/after editing samples you can walk us through.
  • Based remotely in Canada

Nice to have

  • Experience with style guides, whether using or contributing to one.
  • Experience editing for admissions, higher education, or other high-stakes audiences.
  • Familiarity with a CMS (WordPress, Webflow, or similar) and tools like Google Docs, Notion, or Asana.
  • Basic understanding of Generative Engine Optimization (GEO).

Why you'll love Inspira

  • Amazing people with a great vision and values
  • Mission-driven team culture focused on student success
  • Your work directly impacts the lives and careers of students across the globe
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance, base plans 100% employer paid
  • Pre-tax benefits (HSA, FSA, DCFSA, Commuter)
  • Flexible paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays
  • 401(k) with company match

The pay ratio between base pay and target incentive will be finalized at the offer. The pay range is subject to the discretion of the Company.

The salary range for this role is $5,000 - $9,500 per month (Gross in USD)

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

Compensation:

For this principal development role, with 6+ years of experience, the compensation range is $5,000 - $9,500 USD per month, based on experience level and gross amount. This range acknowledges the extensive expertise, leadership capabilities, and significant contributions expected at this level, offering a competitive salary to reflect the value of advanced skills and experience

About the Role:

We are seeking a hands-on, high-impact Senior Security Engineer, Detection & Response, to strengthen security operations at Sezzle: detection, incident response, and vulnerability management across our cloud infrastructure and applications.

You will join the team that runs our SIEM and detection capability — from log ingestion and audit coverage to detection rules, alert tuning, and investigation workflows — so that access to sensitive systems is attributable and suspicious activity is caught and attributed by our own detections. You will operate the vulnerability-management loop end-to-end, and when incidents happen, you will lead the investigation and see the long-term fix through. You should consider yourself a DOer - someone who is comfortable diving into logs, analyzing systems, validating findings, and working end-to-end to get issues resolved.

You will report to the Director of Information Security and work alongside the engineers who own the security platform and network and zero trust — your detection and response work is what proves their controls hold. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment and wants to work on real-world security problems at scale. At Sezzle, AI-assisted engineering is a standard part of how we work. In this role you will use and build agentic workflows for alert triage, investigation, and threat hunting that multiply what the team can cover.

What You’ll Do:

  • Build, operate, and mature SIEM/XDR capabilities, including log ingestion, detection rule development, alert tuning, and investigation workflows
  • Design and implement detection strategies for suspicious activity, including data exfiltration patterns using application and database telemetry
  • Extend audit and attribution coverage across the estate — Kubernetes audit logs, database audit logging, SSO and access-path telemetry — so access to sensitive data is attributable to a person or workload, with retention aligned to compliance requirements
  • Investigate and respond to security incidents across cloud infrastructure and applications, performing root cause analysis and driving long-term fixes
  • Run proactive threat hunts across cloud and identity planes, building agentic hunting workflows that make hunts repeatable
  • Operate vulnerability management across infrastructure, platforms, and applications - including internal scans, dependency analysis, and external findings, validating true positives and driving remediation with engineering teams
  • Triage and validate external security findings (including bug bounty reports), distinguishing true positives and coordinating remediation
  • Contribute to threat modeling and security design reviews for the detection, logging, and incident-response implications of new systems
  • Apply strong AWS and Kubernetes judgment to secure the systems you operate and advise owning teams on remediation
  • Support and implement security controls aligned with PCI DSS, SOC 2, and other compliance requirements — with your logging and detection work producing the audit evidence as a by-product
  • Develop and implement automation (including AI) to improve efficiency in security operations, detection, and response
  • Participate in the on-call rotation for detection and response and the services you own

What We Look For:

  • 6+ years of experience in security, software, or infrastructure engineering, with hands-on experience securing cloud-based production systems and working with real-world security challenges
  • Experience working with SIEM platforms (e.g., Wazuh, Splunk, ELK) for detection engineering, monitoring, and incident response
  • Experience designing and tuning detection rules, reducing alert noise, and improving investigation workflows
  • Strong hands-on experience in vulnerability management — scanning, triage and validation of scanner and bug-bounty findings, remediation coordination, and verification
  • Strong knowledge of AWS, Linux, and Kubernetes infrastructure, including security architecture and operational best practices
  • Ability to investigate issues directly using logs, cloud tooling, and system-level data
  • Experience assessing the detection and logging implications of new systems in design reviews
  • Knowledge of common security vulnerabilities and mitigation strategies (OWASP, SANS, etc.)
  • Working knowledge of compliance frameworks such as PCI DSS and SOC 2, particularly logging, monitoring, and evidence expectations
  • Demonstrated AI-forward engineering: you actively use AI tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or custom LLM integrations) in your work today, and have opinions grounded in practice about where it helps and where it doesn't

Preferred Knowledge and Skills:

  • You have built AI-assisted workflows that others adopted — triage, enrichment, or hunting
  • Familiarity with log-based detection, telemetry pipelines, and security analytics use cases
  • Experience with internal penetration testing or adversarial exercises, and translating results into detection and remediation work
  • Strong understanding of cloud-native security controls, including IAM, network segmentation, and container security
  • Experience with container and dependency security tools (e.g., Snyk, Trivy, Grype) as an operator of their findings
  • Experience aligning technical security work with regulatory and compliance expectations
  • Experience in fintech, payments, or other regulated environments

About You:

  • You think like an investigator - you turn telemetry into detections and detections into answers, and you are not done until the root cause is fixed.
  • You treat attribution as an engineering deliverable - every access to sensitive data has a name on it, and every finding has an owner and a date.
  • You are excited to use automation and emerging technologies (including AI) to take repetitive security work off the team's plate
  • You balance strong security standards with business needs and can support privacy and compliance requirements in a practical, scalable way
  • You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  • You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
  • You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  • You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
  • You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
  • You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

Sezzle’s Technology Stack:

  • Languages: Golang, Typescript, Python
  • Frontend: Typescript - React and React Native
  • Backend: Golang
  • Database: MySQL, Postgres, Elasticsearch
  • DevOps & Cloud: AWS, Kubernetes
  • Version Control: Git
  • CI/CD: Gitlab
  • Testing: Developer and AI-driven, focus on automated end-to-end, integration, and unit tests
  • Open Source: Sezzle is focused on using open source, and we build what we can before buying!

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome?

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators; we are skilled musicians, yogis, cyclists, chefs, golfers, dog-lovers, and rock-climbers. We believe in surrounding ourselves with not only the best and the brightest individuals, but those that are unique and purpose-driven in all that they do. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

Overview

Are you a seasoned leader passionate about building a sustainable future? We’re looking for a Construction Project Manager to lead utility-scale solar projects across the U.S. In this role, you’ll not only manage complex construction efforts but also mentor and empower project teams, fostering a culture of excellence, safety, and innovation.

As a key leader in our growing renewables division, you’ll partner with energy clients nationwide to deliver high-impact storage solutions that support grid resilience and decarbonization. Your ability to lead multiple concurrent projects, develop talent, and drive results will be instrumental in shaping the future of clean energy infrastructure.

Location & Travel: This is a remote position and may be based anywhere within the United States. The role supports projects nationwide and requires regular travel to project sites, with an expected baseline of approximately 50% travel. Additional onsite presence will be required during project start-up, critical execution phases, and when project performance medtrics, operational objectives, or business needs are not being achieved. Employees in this role are expected to maintain the flexibility necessary to provide increased field support as required to ensure successful project outcomes. This position is eligible for a vehicle allowance and a company credit card to cover approved business-related travel expenses.

Company Overview

MasTec Renewables, comprised of Wanzek Construction, IEA Constructors, and White Construction, combines over 20 years of experience in renewable energy construction. Depending on your position and project, you may work for one or more of our companies over your career with us. Join one of the largest construction firms in the country (Engineering News-Record [ENR]: #1 in Power, #17 Top 50 Domestic Heavy Contractors, #20 Transportation Contractor).

We embrace diverse perspectives among our employees and across all levels of our business, including our suppliers, community partners, and clients. We have built a multidimensional workforce that brings valuable differences in perspectives, work ethics, and approaches to our organization. By collaborating across departments, we foster innovation and encourage everyone—from interns to executives—to share their ideas and make an impact. Our goal is to create a respectful work environment where all employees feel valued, included, and empowered to become innovative leaders in our industry.

The MasTec Renewables market sector is part of the MasTec Clean Energy & Infrastructure business segment. MasTec’s Clean Energy & Infrastructure (CE&I) segment generates over $4 billion in annual revenue, providing construction services across industrial, renewables and infrastructure sectors. Our renewables sector focuses on solar, wind and battery storage. Sustainability and safety are foundational to our culture and influence everything we do.

MasTec, a minority-owned Fortune 500 company, has shaped the construction industry for more than 90 years. With over 35,000 employees and 400 offices nationwide, we provide flexibility and career growth in dynamic work environments.

Responsibilities

Essential Job Functions:

  • Assure project abides by all environmental safety awareness and compliance
  • Support and further the company culture, values, Key Results and quality management
  • Document and communicate project progress, performance, and issues to all stakeholders
  • Provide day to day direction and oversight of project resources (staff, equipment, subcontractors) and materials
  • Successfully integrate resources, activities, and deliverables as outlined in the Project Execution Plan
  • Own the project budget, cost, forecast, and schedule
  • Provide successful management of all contract documents, risks and changes throughout the project
  • Project Integration Management: manage the processes and activities needed to identify, define, combine, unify, and coordinate the various processes and project management activities within the project
  • Project Scope management: Responsible for the processes required to ensure that the project includes all the work required, and only the work required, to complete the project successfully
  • Project Time Management: track and monitor the processes required to manage the timely completion of the project
  • Project Cost Management: work collaboratively with support and operations teams to successfully manage the planning, estimating, budgeting, financing, funding, managing, and cost controls so that the project can be completed within the approved budget
  • Project Quality Management: establish and support the processes and activities of the performing organization that determine quality policies, objectives, and responsibilities so that the project will satisfy the needs for which it was undertaken
  • Project Human Resource Management: organize, manage, and lead the project team
  • Project Communications Management: ensure timely and appropriate planning, collection, creation, distribution, storage, retrieval, management, control, monitoring, and the ultimate disposition of project information
  • Project Risk Management: Conduct risk management planning, identification, analysis, response planning, and controlling risk on project
  • Project Procurement Management: purchase or acquire products, services, or results needed from outside the project team. Processes in this area include Procurement Planning, Solicitation Planning, Solicitation, Source Selection, Contract Administration, and Contract Closeout
  • Project Stakeholder Management: identify all people or organizations impacted by the project, analyzing stakeholder expectations and impact on the project, and developing appropriate management strategies for effectively engaging stakeholders in project decisions and execution
  • Invest time and effort in enhancing apprentices’ skills and knowledge – champion the process
  • Provide positive environment to support coaching and mentoring of apprentices
  • Commit to accurate classification to ensure PWA (Prevailing Wage & Apprenticeship) compliance when applicable
  • Commit to involving PWA (Prevailing Wage & Apprenticeship) team prior to subcontract negotiations
  • Ensure documents in regards to discipline for apprentices gets completely filled out and submitted to HR and PWA team for DOL purposes
  • Issue PWA non-compliance notices following alerts from PWA (Prevailing Wage & Apprenticeship) team
  • Full responsibility of PWA compliance execution through partnering with PWA (Prevailing Wage & Apprenticeship) team
  • Ensure the CMIII keeps the Apprentice/Journeyman pairings updated and sent to Apprenticeship team weekly
  • Submit PWA deliverables to the Owner

  • Bachelor's degree from four-year college or university in Construction Management, Engineering, or equivalent combination of education and experience
  • Minimum of five years of construction Industry experience/knowledge of construction techniques, estimating and construction management

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Required:

  • Take reasonable care of your own and others’ health and safety and of those who may be affected by the day-to-day delivery of this role by taking personal responsibility for working toward Wanzek’s Zero Injury principles
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office, Excel, Primavera, Timberline, and Construction Software
  • Ability to read, analyze and interpret blueprints, professional journals, technical procedures, contracts or governmental regulations
  • Write reports, business correspondence and document project activities
  • Effectively present information and respond to questions from project managers, superintendents, clients, customers and the general public
  • Effectively present information to top management, public groups, and/or boards of directors
  • Calculate figures and amounts such as discounts, interest, proportions, percentages, area, circumference and volume
  • Ability to apply concepts of basic algebra and geometry
  • Solve practical problems and deal with a variety of concrete variables in standardized situations

Lead Solutions Engineer, Strategic

AcuityMD is the AI platform for MedTech trusted by over 500 MedTech companies – including 16 of the top 20. Commercial leaders use AcuityMD to identify target markets, surface top opportunities, and grow their business. By combining real-world healthcare data with AI-powered insights, AcuityMD enables companies from pre-commercial to enterprise to understand where and how to sell faster to accelerate the adoption of medical technology. AcuityMD ranked No. 316 on the 2026 Inc. 5000 list of the fastest-growing private companies in America and was named to Forbes' 2025 "Next Billion-Dollar Startups" list – an elite group of 25 venture-backed U.S. companies identified as most likely to reach a $1 billion valuation. AcuityMD is backed by Stepstone Group, Benchmark, Redpoint Ventures, ICONIQ, and Atreides Management.

As a Solution Engineer at AcuityMD, you will be crucial in driving the sales process by providing technical product expertise, presenting tailored solutions, and ensuring customer success. You will work closely with the Sales team to understand customer requirements and deliver compelling demonstrations of AcuityMD's products. The Solution Engineer will use a consultative approach to understand business and technical requirements and recommend effective strategies for implementing AcuityMD solutions.

Team Mission

At AcuityMD, we aim to empower our solution engineers to be strategic partners to our customers and prospects. Our team is committed to developing and maintaining a deep understanding of AcuityMD's products and services while staying current with the latest medical device industry trends. We strive to build and nurture long-term customer relationships by understanding their unique needs. Working closely with cross-functional teams, we collaborate to identify new opportunities, streamline processes, and enhance product offerings. We advocate for the value of data-driven insights, educating customers and prospects on how AcuityMD's platform can transform their businesses. We embody the highest professional, ethical, and integrity standards in all interactions.

Responsibilities

  • Discovery: Engage with customers to understand their business challenges, technical landscape, and requirements.
  • Solution Design: Develop and present tailored AcuityMD solutions that address customer needs and demonstrate the value of the company’s products and services.
  • Sales Partnership: Collaborate with the Sales team to develop account strategies and drive the sales process.
  • Technical Architecture: Translate customer technical requirements into future-state system designs that show how our solutions integrate into the customer’s existing tech stack.
  • Demos & POCs: Deliver compelling product demonstrations, proofs of concept, and presentations to showcase the value of AcuityMD solutions.
  • RFI/RFP Response: Respond to technical inquiries, RFIs, and RFPs with functional and technical solutions.
  • Cross-Functional Feedback: Provide feedback to the Product, Engineering, and Marketing teams on customer needs, industry trends, and competitive landscape to drive product innovation and improvements.
  • Brand & Industry Presence: Participate in industry events, webinars, and conferences to build brand awareness and showcase AcuityMD’s capabilities.
  • Team Collaboration: Work as a team player by contributing, learning, and sharing new knowledge.
  • Travel: Up to 30%-40% domestic travel required.

Your Profile

  • 5+ years of experience in the IT industry, with a focus on pre-sales or technical sales roles, ideally including experience at a vertical AI company. MedTech/healthcare IT background is not required; experience across multiple verticals is valued over tenure in a single one. This is a senior-level hire (high P4/low P5).
  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with a focus on needs analysis, positioning, business justification, and closing techniques.
  • Superior presentation and demonstration skills, with the ability to engage with both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience working with CRM platforms, AI/ML-driven products, or other relevant enterprise SaaS applications.
  • Prior experience collaborating with cross-functional teams, including sales, marketing, product management, engineering, and customer success.
  • Self-motivated, flexible, and able to take initiative in a dynamic environment.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to think creatively to develop innovative solutions for customer needs.
  • Demonstrated fluency with AI-driven products and the ability to quickly learn and adapt as our AI capabilities evolve.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience working in the MedTech or healthcare industry (not required, experience across multiple verticals, especially other AI-focused companies, is equally valued).
  • Familiarity with data analytics, business intelligence tools, and data visualization techniques.
  • Knowledge of industry common data sources such as NPI, Medicare claims, PubMed, and ICD/CPT/HCPCS codes.

You must have an eligible work permit in the USA or Canada to be considered for this position.

AcuityMD is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role's scope and complexity, and the candidate's experience and expertise, market data and may vary from the range provided.

Base salary range: $140,000-$170,000

We Offer:

  • Ground floor opportunity: Join a high-growth startup, backed by world-class investors across Enterprise SaaS and Medical Devices (Benchmark, Redpoint Ventures, and Ajax Health).
  • Learning Budget: Reimbursements for relevant learning and up-skilling opportunities.
  • Remote work: AcuityMD is committed to supporting full-remote flexibility for employees in the US. We provide a work-from-home stipend for all employees.
  • Flexible PTO: Generous time off and flexible hours give you the freedom to do your best work.
  • Paid Health, Dental, and Vision Plans: We offer 100% paid health, dental, and vision plans for all employees and 75% paid for our employees' dependents.
  • Home Office Stipend: $1,000 to invest in remote office equipment and WiFi reimbursement.
  • Optional Team Retreats: We meet in-person multiple times per year for co-working and social gatherings.
  • Parental Leave: 8-16 weeks of fully-paid, flexible parental leave.

Who We Are:

The Company: We are builders, who are inspired by our mission to expand patient access to cutting-edge medical technologies. We value working collaboratively to solve hard problems for our customers with simple, innovative solutions. We push ourselves to learn with empathy. We foster an active culture of mentorship and inclusion, and we welcome new team members that share our values.

We're backed by Benchmark, Redpoint Ventures, Ajax Health, ICONIQ Growth and several other leading software and medical device investors. Since Acuity launched in 2020, we've brought on customers ranging from publicly traded Fortune 500 companies to innovative growth-stage companies and regional medical device distributors.

The Product: AcuityMD uses data and software to help teams collaborate around the complex relationships they have with the users of medical technologies: doctors. Our platform empowers medical technology companies to see how their products are used, understand why outcomes vary, and identify opportunities where physicians or sites of care can better serve their patients.

How We Work:

AcuityMD is a remote-first company. We believe the best talent isn't confined to one zip code, so our team works from wherever they do their best work, across the U.S.

We also believe some of our best work happens face-to-face. Critical projects move faster, our products get better, and our community gets stronger when we're in the same room, so we bring the team together throughout the year for company-wide and team on-sites built around that work.

In practice: expect 4-5 in-person opportunities a year through company/team on-sites and in-person collaboration for critical projects. If you're based near our Boston hub, there's no set requirement for how often you come into the office, that's your call, based on what works best for you and your team.

AcuityMD is an Equal Opportunity Employer

AcuityMD is seeking to create a diverse work environment because all teams are stronger with different perspectives and life experiences. We strongly encourage people of all backgrounds to apply. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, religion, color, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. All employees and contractors of AcuityMD are responsible for maintaining a work culture free from discrimination and harassment by treating others with kindness and respect.

Chief of Staff

JENREG1EA

Full Time

Role overview

About the client

The client is a dynamic multi-entity family office and serial entrepreneur operating across four distinct market sectors:

  1. Real Estate Investment & Development: A portfolio of cash-investment residential properties across multiple regions, managed under individual entity structures alongside property management for outside owners.
  2. Boutique Interior Design & Contracting: A boutique interior design practice specializing in high-end residential projects, turnkey furnishing, and property contracting.
  3. Boutique Fitness & Wellness: A fast-growing infrared fitness studio brand with locations across key markets undergoing strategic expansion, corporate structuring, and location rollouts.
  4. Personal & Family Office: Family office administration, executive scheduling, and personal household logistics.

The business operates with a small, high-touch core team—including licensed brokers, property accountants, bookkeepers, and studio managers. The Managing Partner requires a central partner to maintain cross-business oversight, streamline administrative follow-through, and bridge operational gaps across all four sectors.

About the role

As the Chief of Staff, you will serve as the primary point of organizational accountability and central connective tissue across all four business entities and personal operations.

You are the "layer above and between" the Managing Partner, external accountants, bookkeepers, studio managers, contractors, and clients—ensuring information is gathered, organized, updated, and dispatches to the right people on time. You will manage executive priorities, oversee property management logistics, support back-office design procurement, monitor fitness expansion deliverables, and handle high-level executive and personal administration.

As you demonstrate capability, the role will expand to include light marketing, client outreach, and broader operational management to drive business growth and client retention.



BUSINESS AREA

HOURS ALLOCATION

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES & SCOPE

1. Real Estate & Property

Baseline: 10 hrs/wk

Swing: 6–16 hrs

  • Master Property Registry maintenance
  • Monthly utility close & statement reviews
  • Tenant/vendor communications & access
  • Turnover SOPs & lease renewals

2. Design & Contracting

Baseline: 10 hrs/wk

Swing: 6–14 hrs

  • Project back-office & budget tracking
  • Purchasing, orders & trade logistics
  • Client invoicing & vendor matching
  • CRM marketing & portfolio updates

3. Fitness Brand

Baseline: 10 hrs/wk

Swing: 6–14 hrs

  • Investment & reimbursement tracking
  • Corporate entity & lease compliance
  • Build-out & expansion tracking
  • Agency & marketing follow-through

4. Executive & Family Admin

Baseline: 10 hrs/wk

Swing: 6–12 hrs

  • Calendar triage & focus protection
  • Family appointments & logistics
  • Travel itineraries & household admin

Key responsibilities

1. Real Estate Investment & Property Management Coordination

  • Master Property Registry: Maintain a current master database across all properties (holding entities, tenant details, rent schedules, security deposit holdings, lease expiration alerts at 120/90/60 days, insurance policies, tax appeal timelines, and utility logins).
  • Monthly Utility Close: Download, review, flag variance (>20% spikes), and reconcile monthly statements across all owner-paid utilities by the 7th of every month for the bookkeeper.
  • Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs): Write and execute SOPs for acquisitions, tenant move-in/move-out workflows, utility transfers, lease renewals, and maintenance requests.
  • Property Administration: Field tenant and vendor requests, coordinate property access, manage insurance/permit renewals, and log property maintenance/markup fees.

2. Boutique Interior Design Practice Support

  • Project Back-Office: Set up and maintain project files, scope sheets, vendor contracts, and decision logs for all active interior design jobs.
  • Purchasing & Logistics Tracker: Track all orders from procurement to delivery (SKUs, deposits, delivery dates, damage reports, and storage logistics).
  • Budget & Invoicing Control: Perform weekly updates on budget vs. committed spend; draft client invoices, reconcile vendor receipts, and pass coded records to the financial team.
  • Marketing & Client Outreach: Compile project photos, maintain the CRM database, draft client check-ins, coordinate project photography, and manage digital portfolio updates during lull periods.

3. Fitness & Wellness Business Operations Support

  • Investment & Capital Tracking: Maintain a clear ledger of capital contributions, member loans, and business expenses; ensure all brand-related spend is executed on dedicated business cards.
  • Corporate & Compliance Records: Track studio LLC entities, lease terms/options, insurance renewals, and legal agreements.
  • Expansion & Build-Out Logistics: Maintain project timelines, site evaluation files, contractor schedules, and grand-opening checklists for new studio locations.
  • Agency & Marketing Follow-Up: Monitor external marketing, PR, and ad agencies against agreed deliverables, timelines, and scope.

4. Executive & Personal Administration

  • Calendar Management: Triage, structure, and protect the Managing Partner’s calendar; confirm daily appointments, resolve conflicts proactive of client meetings, and block focus time.
  • Family Logistics & Personal Admin: Coordinate recurring family appointments, school calendars, travel itineraries, household vendors, and personal renewals with absolute discretion.
  • Inbox & Triage Management: Monitor primary inboxes, flag priority action items, and draft responses to maintain timely follow-up.

Operating Cadence & AI Tooling

  • Daily Morning Brief: Deliver a daily summary detailing priorities, required approvals, and daily schedules before Eastern business hours begin.
  • Daily Close-Out Note: Provide an end-of-shift update on completed tasks and pending items.
  • Weekly Syncs: Conduct a weekly strategy review with the Managing Partner and structured handoffs with the financial team.
  • AI-Enabled Execution: Utilize modern AI productivity tools (such as Claude/Claude Design) to quickly generate project spec sheets, floor plans, draft communications, summarize documents, and prepare client-facing materials.

Qualifications & skills (Non-Negotiable)

  • 5+ Years Experience: Proven track record in a high-level support role—such as Chief of Staff, Operations Manager, or Senior Executive Assistant—directly supporting a Founder or Senior Executive across multiple business entities.
  • Real Estate / Property Management Background: Direct experience handling property back-office operations, leases, utility setups, tenant transitions, and vendor coordination.
  • Financial & Numerical Aptitude: Proficient in spreadsheet management, budget tracking, invoice reconciliation, and preparing clean reporting packages for bookkeepers/accountants.
  • Systems Builder Mindset: Proven ability to create, implement, and maintain SOPs, CRM databases, project trackers, and checklists independently.
  • AI & Tech Proficiency: Comfortable utilizing modern software and AI tools (Claude/Claude Design, CRM platforms, project management tools, shared password managers) to drive operational efficiency.
  • Communication Skills: Flawless written and verbal English communication skills with a professional, warm, and collaborative tone suitable for high-touch clients and external partners.
  • Proven Tenure: Demonstrated history of long-term reliability and stability in previous positions.
  • Availability & Reliability: Available full-time (40 hours/week) during US Eastern business hours, with a reliable remote work setup (including backup power/internet solutions where applicable).

Qualifications & skills (Non-Negotiable)

  • Spanish language proficiency is a plus.
  • Prior familiarity with property tracking tools, password manager security vaults, and modern financial reporting tools (e.g., Ramp, QuickBooks read-access).

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • 100% On-Time Monthly Financial Packages: Utility closes, invoices, and expense logs delivered cleanly to the financial team by designated monthly deadlines.
  • Zero Lapsed Obligations: Zero missed lease renewal deadlines, insurance renewals, or permit expirations.
  • Seamless Transitions: Zero gaps in utility service during property turnover events.
  • Budget Accuracy: Design and expansion budgets updated weekly with proactive flags on budget variances.
  • Operational Autonomy: Founder’s direct administrative workload demonstrably reduced within the first 90 days.

Collage Group is seeking a Research Manager / Senior Research Manager to join our Custom Insights market research team in our mission to uncover hidden truths and immersive human insights that propel brands forward.

In this role, you will lead full service custom market research engagements across both Quantitative and Qualitative methodologies. You will serve as a strategic thought partner to major brand clients, synthesizing insights from primary data and Collage’s proprietary cultural intelligence assets to deliver actionable, high-impact stories that drive confidence in decision-making.

Note: This is a consumer market research position and not a business analyst, UX research, or evaluation research role.

Responsibilities

  • Full Service Research Execution: Manage and execute custom quantitative and qualitative research studies from kickoff to presentation, championing research quality at every stage of the process. This includes ownership of tasks such as questionnaire and discussion guide design, field management, survey and data QC, data analysis, and reporting (quant and qual data visualization in PowerPoint).
  • Insight Generation & Storytelling: Synthesize both qualitative and quantitative data into strategic research reports with compelling narratives to inspire clients to action. Serve as the representative of the consumer voice, delivering culturally fluent insights on under-represented audiences and an empathetic perspective on consumer tensions.
  • Project Management: Oversee project timelines and task execution to ensure projects are completed on time, meet research objectives, and drive client delight and loyalty.
  • Team Collaboration: Partner closely with project team members and vendors to ensure alignment on task division, timelines, and project objectives. Help the team proactively problem-solve by flagging any capacity, quality, or timing issues early. Provide direction and mentorship to junior analysts on project teams (e.g., slide building best practices). Note: This role does not have direct reports/management responsibilities.
  • Client Servicing: Serve as the client contact on key projects or support project lead on client management and communication. Lead project kick off calls and presentations, ensuring research objectives and core business questions are addressed with meaningful insights and brand-specific recommendations.

Experience

  • 5-8+ years demonstrated experience in consumer market research (agency, supplier, or consultancy side preferred)

  • Experience directly working with clients (e.g., presenting research findings to key client stakeholders)
  • Intellectually curious, with a passion for consumer culture, human behavior, and brainstorming insights and creative research design
  • Highly organized, able to manage multiple tasks or projects concurrently, strong follow-through on deadlines, and a passion for high-quality research
  • Equally comfortable in a collaborative, co-creative team environment and with self-directed responsibilities
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel & PowerPoint

We believe in a life outside of work, supported by a generous PTO program that includes 12 company holidays, a floating holiday, and a dedicated day for you to give back to a cause you love. We’re also proud to support growing families with 8 weeks of fully paid parental leave for all parents, regardless of path to parenthood. Finally, we help you build for tomorrow with a competitive 401(k) match—because your future is just as important as your present.


Details regarding our Benefits can be found on our Careers Page.

Position Summary

The Sales, Marketing & Business Solutions product team owns the product stack that Natera's Sales and Marketing organizations rely on daily. That includes the tools for generating demand, managing accounts and pipeline, and running campaigns. Salesforce is the center of this portfolio today, and the scope is growing to include marketing automation and other commercial tools around it.

In this role, you will own the roadmap, KPIs, and strategy, while partnering with engineering for delivery, for these platforms. The portfolio has a lot of requests from commercial stakeholders, and part of the job is helping the business choose what matters most, in what order, and how to demonstrate quantifiable success. You will work closely with engineering, architecture, and commercial stakeholders to turn a long list of initiatives into a clear plan with measurable outcomes. You will also help us decide what to build, what to buy, what to configure, and what to retire.

If you like bringing clarity to a high-visibility platform and seeing the business benefit directly, you will enjoy this role.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Own the strategy, roadmap, and backlog for Sales and Marketing platforms, with Salesforce as the system of record and primary user-facing interaction mode for commercial workflows
  • Partner with Sales & Marketing to turn business needs into clear requirements (PRDs, user stories, user flows) and prioritize them by value, effort, and platform impact
  • Manage the integration points between CRM and marketing automation, including lead lifecycle, scoring, routing, and attribution
  • Lead quarterly and annual planning (intake, prioritization, and governance processes) with technical and cross-functional stakeholders so every initiative is visible, sequenced, and tied to an outcome
  • Work with engineering and architecture on data model, integration, and build vs. buy vs. configure decisions
  • Plan releases and manage dependencies across platforms, making sure changes are tested, communicated, and adopted
  • Define and track KPIs such as adoption, data quality, funnel efficiency, and delivery predictability, and use them to guide investment
  • Evaluate new tools and capabilities, including AI-enabled features, and recommend where to consolidate or retire overlapping systems
  • Communicate status, risks, and tradeoffs clearly to stakeholders, including senior leadership

Qualifications

  • Experience partnering directly with Sales & Marketing stakeholders to turn business goals into product roadmaps, features, and defined impact.
  • A track record of delivering enterprise Sales or Marketing technology (CRM, sales engagement, CPQ, lead routing, analytics) with quantifiable results.
  • Hands-on Salesforce product experience (required). You have owned or managed product delivery on the Salesforce platform, for example Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, or Health Cloud. You are comfortable with objects and data model, flows and automation, security and permissions, sandboxes and release management, and org governance.
  • Experience with marketing automation and campaign platforms such as Eloqua, Marketo, Account Engagement, or HubSpot. Eloqua experience is a plus.
  • Experience working alongside Salesforce engineers, admins, and architects. You can weigh integration approaches (APIs, middleware, data pipelines) and know when configuration is enough and when custom development is worth it.

  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills. Strong analytical skills, with the ability to use data to make product decisions.
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, business, or a related field, plus 5+ years of experience in software development, digital product management, or commercial and CRM systems.

Preferred

  • Experience in healthcare, life sciences, or diagnostics commercial environments
  • Familiarity with data platforms such as Snowflake

jobs.description:
Data Scientist, AI/ML

Job Description:

Today’s complex, fast-paced systems have become a minefield of reliability risks, any of which could cause an outage that costs millions and destroys customer confidence. That’s why high-availability teams use Gremlin to find and fix reliability risks before they become incidents.

Gremlin Reliability Platform helps software teams proactively monitor and test their systems for common reliability risks, build and enforce reliability standards, and automate their reliability practices organization-wide. As the industry leader in Chaos Engineering and reliability testing, we work with hundreds of the world’s largest organizations where high availability is non-negotiable.

About the Role of the Data Scientist, AI/ML

As a Data Scientist, AI/ML at Gremlin, you will have the opportunity to improve the reliability of the internet at large by turning millions of chaos engineering experiments into automated failure analysis and remediation. You will be able to leverage your applied machine learning experience to inform product direction as well as solve complex technical problems that directly impact our customers (which range from the Fortune 500 to smaller organizations). You will work closely with a small, talented engineering team focused on quality, delivery, and predictability with an emphasis on providing our customers a great user experience.

In this role, you’ll get to:

  • Analyze Gremlin’s proprietary dataset of millions of chaos engineering experiments to identify failure patterns, root causes, and resilience signals across complex distributed systems
  • Pretraining and fine-tuning machine learning models that automatically detect, classify, and explain failures observed during chaos experiments
  • Build intelligent systems that deliver automated remediation recommendations, and eventually orchestration, by learning from historical experiment outcomes and system behavior
  • Develop scalable data pipelines and feature stores to process, enrich, and serve large volumes of experiment data for both model training and real-time inference
  • Collaborate closely with platform engineers and SREs to integrate AI-driven failure analysis and remediation capabilities directly into Gremlin’s core product
  • Apply advanced techniques, including causal inference, graph ML, time-series modeling, and reinforcement learning, to continuously improve the accuracy and actionability of automated failure analysis
  • Translate insights from millions of chaos experiments into AI-powered features that help customers automatically understand blast radius, pinpoint root causes, and accelerate recovery
  • Research and productionize novel ML approaches, including causal AI and agentic systems, that turn raw chaos experiment data into automated, reliable remediation strategies

We’ll expect you to have:

  • Experience as a self-driven and collaborative problem solver with strong communication skills
  • 5+ years professional experience building and productionizing machine learning, ideally for distributed systems, infrastructure, or DevOps and SRE use cases with more overall years of experience in software development.
  • Hands-on experience with techniques such as causal inference, graph ML, time-series modeling, or reinforcement learning
  • Experience building data pipelines and feature stores that support both offline training and real-time inference
  • Experience with agile development environments and practices
  • Strong advocate and practitioner of rigorous experimentation, model evaluation, and engineering best practices
  • Comfort partnering with platform engineers and SREs to turn research into shipped product features
  • Strong at breaking down ambiguous problems into concrete actions and milestones

Bonus Experience:

  • Experience with chaos engineering, site reliability engineering, or distributed systems
  • Background in agentic AI systems or large-scale causal inference in production
  • Experience standing up MLOps tooling such as model serving, monitoring, or feature store infrastructure
  • Working in Remote first environments
  • Has been on-call and participated in an incident management program

*The role does not offer sponsorship employment benefits.

**If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria above but still are interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box, we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

Compensation

We expect the salary range for this role to be $220,000 - $290,000. We recognize that salary varies from person to person depending on level of experience and we welcome direct conversations about it. The final offer will vary based on assessment of a candidate's skills and ability and our budget and market data.

Gremlin offers competitive total compensation packages including 401k Matching, Equity and other benefits such as flexible time off and paid company holidays.

About Gremlin:

Gremlin is a team of industry veterans and people eager to learn from one another. We set the standard for reliability and equip leading organizations with the mindset and expertise needed to drive reliability improvements that move the world forward. We’re backed by top-tier investors Index Ventures, Amplify Partners, and Redpoint Ventures. Our customers love us, and we’re thrilled to be a partner in their success.

What Do We Care About:

We Care about our People

People are our critical differentiators. The company strives to treat our people with respect, empathy, and dignity. We expect that our people will treat each other similarly. In both cases, we will assume good intent. All are welcome at Gremlin. We know our differences make us stronger and that our best ideas and contributions can come from anyone at any level.

We Care about Collaboration

Gremlin is strongest when we come together as one team with shared goals. Be the glue, not the glitter. But as a remote company, teamwork and collaboration won’t happen by accident. We approach every challenge as a shared challenge. We rely on each other for diverse perspectives and creative ideas. We celebrate our wins as a team.

We Care about Results

Be high productivity, low drama. Results matter. To keep our pace, everyone owns the outcomes of their actions and takes action when needed. We reward speed over perfection. We empower each other to iterate and experiment. You are welcome at Gremlin for who you are. The more voices and ideas we have represented in our business, the more we will all flourish, contribute, and build a more reliable internet.

Gremlin is a place where everyone can grow and is encouraged. However you identify and whatever background you bring with you, please apply if this sounds like a role that would make you excited to come into work everyday. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep building a more reliable internet by building and designing tools used by the best companies in the world.

Visit our website to learn more -

Your team: Collaborators in change

This is a key role in ensuring that the fair treatment of customers is embedded within the Operations team whilst ensuring that fair customer outcomes are consistently delivered. The purpose of the role is to support the Operations Leaders by supporting customers in financial difficulty and arrears whilst achieving departmental service levels. Upholding company standards and complying with all relevant Company and regulatory obligations (including adherence to FCA rules (including FCA MCOB and CONC rules).   

Led by our Operations Director, our Operations teams are responsible for all customer contact.  The teams are the primary points of contact for customers including responding to their inbound queries during the lifetime of their mortgage or loan as well as supporting customers that are in financial difficulty and/or arrears. Our aim is to provide an exceptional service to our customers by ensuring that we have knowledgeable, well training operational colleagues to deliver the service that our customers expect of us.   

Your Impact: Building a sustainable tomorrow

As an Arrears Executive at Tandem your focus will be on:

  • Proactively service requests from our customers efficiently and professionally ensuring at you provide the customer with the information that they require. 
  • Proactively manage all customer service-related inbound communication (via telephone, correspondence, email, portal) from customers and third parties as part of the servicing and arrears management of a range of mortgage and loan products.
  • Ensure regulatory transactional documentation is issued accurately and correctly in accordance with regulatory requirements (including regulatory arrears correspondence). 
  • Identify situations that may require specialist handling (e.g. complaints, vulnerability, fraud) and refer these where appropriate.

  • Knowledge and practical application of dealing with vulnerable customers at first point of contact to ensure their specific needs are understood and they are treated with care and consideration. 
  • Proactively manage accounts in arrears by completing outbound contact to establish the root cause of the customers payment difficulties and identify options to assist the customer in rehabilitating their mortgage or loan arrears.

  • Knowledge and practical application of completing Income and Expenditure assessments and deciding suitable forbearance options for the customer.  
  • Knowledge and practical application of late arrears and litigation practices.

  • Proactively challenge existing processes and take ownership for implementing positive changes which are within own span of control. 
  • Keep up to date with all Company/regulatory changes particularly those which affect own business area. 
  • Actively contribute to the achievement of the Company Balance Scorecard objectives and demonstrating Company values in everything you do. 
  • Adherence to and promotion of a culture of treating our customers fairly to deliver fair outcomes.   

We’d love to hear from you if you have:

  • Previous experience in financial services (with relevant regulatory appreciation) with demonstrable success in customer service and arrears within a regulated lending environment. 
  • Demonstrable experience of working accounts in arrears including applying arrears forbearance options and identification of customers that are vulnerable.
