jobs.excerpt: Job SummaryThe Forward Deployment Engineer, HL7 Integration helps customers adopt DeepHealth’s Diagnostic Suite correctly by owning how it integrates with their clinical systems.
jobs.description:
Job Summary

The Forward Deployment Engineer, HL7 Integration helps customers adopt DeepHealth’s Diagnostic Suite correctly by owning how it integrates with their clinical systems. The role combines HL7 and DICOM engineering depth, radiology workflow knowledge and customer communication to design customer integrations, coach implementation teams, resolve complex interface issues, and turn recurring integration needs into standard, configurable product capabilities.

The Forward Deployment Engineering (FDE) function, whose purpose is to help customers adopt DeepHealth products correctly sits at the intersection of the Technical Delivery Manager (TDM), Product, Service and Solution Delivery teams to ensure smooth customer adoption. It transitions best practices to the Service and Solution Delivery teams and plans upcoming product changes with them to ensure commercial readiness.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Own integration solution design for assigned customers, mapping the radiology order-to-result workflow (RIS/EHR, worklists, PACS, Viewer, reporting, results) to HL7 and DICOM interface configuration.

  • Lead integration technical discovery with customers and implementation teams, covering interfaces, message types, code sets, migration data and cutover requirements.

  • Build, configure and validate interfaces in the integration engine (Mirth Connect / NextGen Connect), including mappings, transformers, routing and test message sets.

  • Partner with the assigned implementation counterpart for this workstream to adopt learnings and best practices into customer configuration and implementations; train and coach implementation teams and customer interface analysts on the standard interface specification and correct configuration; publish integration playbooks and baselines.

  • Serve as customer-facing technical lead for integration during go-lives, hypercare and escalations.

  • Provide implementation support as the escalation point for HL7 and integration issues during implementation, including root cause analysis and resolution with engineering (approximately 20–30% of time).

  • Establish change control for site-specific interface customizations, including documentation, versioning and rollback plans aligned to product releases.

  • Convert recurring interface needs into standard, configurable product capabilities and requirements, reducing one-off custom integrations.

  • Own the AI adoption strategy for clinical data integration: define requirements, expected customer impact and success criteria, and feed them back to Product and Engineering.

  • Configure and support adoption of AI-enabled workflows that depend on clinical data integration (e.g., AI report drafting using prior and clinical data), coordinating rollout, site readiness and customer adoption with the Technical Delivery Manager and Product Manager.

  • Own escalation of engineering issues from assigned accounts: triage, document reproducible defects, track status with engineering and close the loop with customers.

  • Support site reliability (SRE) for HL7 in assigned accounts: monitor service health with observability tools, participate in incident response and drive reliability improvements with engineering.

PLEASE NOTE: This is not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities and requirements of the position described above. Other functions may be assigned and management retains the right to add or change duties at any time.

Requirements

Minimum Qualifications, Education and Experience

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Biomedical Engineering, Health Informatics, Information Systems or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience (required).

  • Experience: 8+ years of overall experience in healthcare IT integration or clinical systems (required).

  • Experience: 5+ years of hands-on HL7 v2.x interface design and support in a customer-facing or implementation role, ideally in radiology or imaging (required).

  • Expert-level experience with at least one integration engine; Mirth Connect / NextGen Connect strongly preferred (Rhapsody, Cloverleaf or Corepoint acceptable) (required).

  • Strong understanding of radiology order-to-result workflow across RIS, PACS, modality worklist, reporting and EHR (required).

  • Working knowledge of DICOM, including how HL7 order data maps to DICOM attributes and modality worklist (required).

  • Proficiency in JavaScript (for interface transformers), SQL and message/log analysis (required).

  • Demonstrated ability to work directly with customer IT, interface analysts and clinical stakeholders, including in escalated situations (required).

  • Experience with FHIR R4 and IHE profiles (SWF, PIR, XDS) (preferred).

  • Imaging informatics credential such as CIIP or PARCA (preferred).

  • Experience in a regulated medical device environment (FDA 21 CFR 820, ISO 13485) and with ITIL practices (preferred).

  • Microsoft Office experience required.

Quality Standards

  • Communicates, cooperates, and consistently functions professionally and harmoniously with all levels of supervision, co-workers, visitors, and vendors.

  • Demonstrates initiative, personal awareness, professionalism and integrity, and exercises confidentiality in all areas of performance.

  • Follows all local, regional and country laws concerning employment.

  • Reports to work regularly as scheduled; consistently punctual with respect to working hours, meal and rest breaks, and maintains satisfactory personal attendance in accordance with DeepHealth guidelines.

  • Completes job responsibilities in a quality and timely manner.

What We Do

Our Security Operations Center (SOC) protects the enterprise by detecting, investigating, and responding to cybersecurity threats.  

As a member of our Threat Detection Engineering team operating within our SOC, you will build governed agent capabilities to support data onboarding, detection engineering, threat hunting, investigation, response, automation, and platform operations. Our goal is to expand threat visibility, accelerate security outcomes, reduce repetitive work, and improve operational consistency and resilience without compromising sound security judgment, human accountability, or control. 

The Principal Engineer provides hands-on technical leadership to turn this strategy into secure, reliable, and supportable production capabilities across the SOC.

 

*We are open to remote candidates for this role

What You’ll Do

  • Lead the architecture and hands-on implementation of Agentic Security Operations capabilities across the SOC.
  • Define and evolve the reference architecture for governed data services, agent capabilities, workload routing, execution environments, and deterministic orchestration.
  • Build reusable capabilities that translate operational intent into tested, reviewable, and auditable security outcomes.
  • Establish engineering standards for creating, testing, registering, approving, releasing, monitoring, and retiring agents and their capabilities.
  • Advance detection-as-code practices, including versioning, simulation, deployment, tuning, migration, and rollback.
  • Build governed knowledge and context services that provide authoritative documentation, policies, operational history, citations, freshness information, and permission-aware retrieval.
  • Design workload identity, least-privilege access, short-lived authorization, spend controls, approval gates, audit trails, rollback, and emergency shutdown mechanisms.
  • Define autonomy levels that determine which activities may execute automatically, require human approval, or remain analyst led.
  • Establish agent evaluation and observability through historical replay, synthetic scenarios, expected-versus-actual comparisons, policy tests, traces, outcome verification, and regression testing.

jobs.description:
Senior Construction Contracts and Claims Specialist

U.S. Heavy Civil and Infrastructure Projects

Remote | Part-time independent contractor
Initial engagement: 3-4 months, with potential extension

About The Client

U.S.-based civil engineering and construction management firm providing engineering, surveying, project management, and construction support services for major infrastructure projects.

The Role

We are seeking an experienced, hands-on specialist to own the preparation and coordination of construction claims, change-order packages, and contract reviews. You will turn project records into substantiated submissions, develop proposed contract revisions, and drive assigned matters through management and legal review. Success requires independent analysis, clear writing, and persistent follow-through with project teams.

The initial focus is on outstanding changes and payment-related disputes, together with new contracts and amendments requiring review. You work directly with project managers, finance, administrative support, and external legal counsel.

Claims and Change Management

  • Develop claim packages covering changed scope, additional costs, disruption, delay, remobilization, and other documented project impacts. Build an event chronology and connect the contractual basis, cause, impact, and requested relief.
  • Review contracts, amendments, directives, correspondence, daily reports, schedules, quantities, and cost records. Distinguish supported facts from assumptions, identify weaknesses, and obtain missing evidence directly from the responsible team members.
  • Prepare claim narratives, calculations, indexed exhibits, change-order requests, draft notices, and responses. Reconcile amounts with finance and identify prior payments, credits, overlapping claims, and unsupported costs.
  • Assess schedule impacts using available records and identify when specialist delay analysis is needed. Evaluate both supporting and adverse evidence, including potential responsibility shared by multiple parties.

Contract Review and Administration

  • Compare original and revised agreements, subcontracts, and amendments. Produce a prioritized issues matrix and proposed revisions addressing scope, exclusions, survey responsibility, access, schedule, compensation, payment, insurance, indemnity, liability, termination, and dispute provisions.
  • Identify incorporated documents, ambiguous obligations, notice requirements, submission deadlines, and documentation gaps. Coordinate unresolved legal questions with counsel and insurance requirements with the authorized broker.
  • Maintain a live contract and claims register showing amounts, status, deadlines, evidence gaps, owners, next actions, and decisions required. Track approved submissions, delivery records, acknowledgments, and responses.
  • Prepare concise recommendations and negotiation briefs for management. Follow up on missing inputs and overdue responses, escalate time-sensitive issues promptly, and develop reusable checklists and templates.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated, hands-on experience preparing claims and administering U.S. construction contracts for heavy civil, transportation, transit, or public infrastructure projects.
  • Experience supporting project owners or contractors through change-order preparation, disputed payment issues, and claim review or negotiation. Clearly describe your personal contribution to prior assignments.
  • Ability to interpret contract requirements, analyze project records and schedule impacts, and reconcile claim calculations to source cost records.
  • Strong technical writing, analytical, spreadsheet, and document-control skills, with the ability to produce clear, traceable, review-ready work.
  • Ability to work independently, obtain information across a distributed team, manage concurrent deadlines, and coordinate during agreed U.S. Eastern Time hours.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with rail or transit work, professional service agreements, delay and disruption analysis, and public-sector contracting. Familiarity with Critical Path method (CPM) Scheduling, Procore, Primavera P6, Microsoft Project, Bluebeam, Excel, and Google Workspace are helpful. Practical capability and relevant work samples carry more weight than software familiarity alone.

Coordination and Authority

The specialist owns package preparation and follow-through. Project staff validate technical facts and field records; finance validates costs, billing, and payment history; administrative support coordinates access and approvals. Legal advice and representation remain with appropriately licensed counsel.

The specialist may request records and coordinate reviews but may not accept contractual terms, certify insurance compliance, waive rights, settle claims, commit company funds, or authorize execution. External submissions and negotiations require designated management approval and legal review where appropriate.

Engagement and Application

The engagement is remote and initially part-time for approximately 3-4 months. Weekly hours, response expectations, hourly rate, and a spending limit will be agreed before work begins. Please provide your earliest start date, weekly availability, Eastern Time overlap, and proposed hourly rate.

Submit a resume or professional profile, two relevant project examples describing your role and outcomes, and a redacted claim narrative or contract-review sample that you are authorized to share. Shortlisted candidates may complete a short paid assessment using sanitized project records. Do not submit confidential client information.

jobs.description:
SOLV Energy is a leading provider of infrastructure services to the power industry, designing, building and maintaining utility scale solar, battery storage and high voltage substation projects nationwide.

Job Description Summary:

The Director of Project Development and Strategy leads all preconstruction activities for SOLV Energy's High Voltage Infrastructure business unit, from early-stage opportunity identification through estimate finalization, proposal submission, and handoff to project execution. This role owns the accuracy, consistency, and competitiveness of HV bids and budgets — including transmission, substation, and switchyard scope — and works closely with Business Development, Engineering, Procurement, and Operations leadership to convert pipeline opportunities into well-scoped, biddable, and constructible projects. The Director builds and standardizes preconstruction process across a growing HV portfolio, including the integration of recently acquired self-perform capability, and is a key contributor to win-strategy and pricing decisions presented to executive leadership.

This role is fully remote. Specific location details and expectations will be discussed during the interview process.

Job Description:

*This job description reflects management's assignment of essential functions; it does not prescribe or restrict the tasks that may be assigned

Position Responsibilities and Duties:

  • Lead the HV preconstruction team through all phases of estimating and proposal development — conceptual/budgetary pricing, competitive hard-bid estimates, negotiated pricing, and change order/scope development for existing projects.
  • Own the preconstruction stage-gate process for the HV business unit, ensuring consistent scope definition, take-off methodology, risk review, and estimate quality across all opportunities and estimators.
  • Partner with Business Development to evaluate incoming opportunities, support go/no-go decisions, and shape win strategy, pricing philosophy, and differentiation for client proposals and RFP responses.
  • Direct quantity take-offs, unit pricing, and labor productivity assumptions for HV scope, including substations, switchyards, transmission lines, and BOP tie-in work, using both self-perform and subcontracted delivery models.
  • Lead constructability reviews with Engineering and Operations to identify schedule, sequencing, and cost risk during design development, and to ensure estimates reflect buildable, field-validated approaches.
  • Manage subcontractor and major equipment vendor bid solicitation, leveling, and qualification (transformers, switchgear, structures, conductor, and specialty subcontract scopes), working closely with Procurement and Supply Chain.
  • Develop and present cost estimates, risk registers, and pricing recommendations to executive leadership and ownership (American Securities) as part of proposal and award approval processes.
  • Ensure a clean, well-documented handoff of awarded projects from preconstruction to project execution teams, including budget basis of estimate, key assumptions, and identified risk/contingency items.
  • Track win rates, estimate-to-actual performance, and productivity/pricing benchmarks across the HV portfolio; use this data to refine future estimating assumptions and unit costs.
  • Standardize estimating tools, templates, and historical cost databases across HV, incorporating lessons learned from ongoing process improvement work and integration of Spartan Infrastructure and Roberson Waite Electric.
  • Build and develop the preconstruction team's bench strength, including hiring, mentoring, and succession planning for estimators and preconstruction managers as the HV pipeline grows.
  • Support long-lead item identification and early procurement (LNTP) coordination with Operations and Supply Chain to reduce transformer, switchgear, and structure lead-time schedule risk.

Minimum Skills or Experience Requirements:

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in preconstruction, estimating, or engineering roles within high voltage transmission, substation, or heavy electrical/industrial construction; 3+ years in a preconstruction leadership role.
  • Demonstrated experience leading competitive and negotiated pricing efforts for HV/substation EPC or self-perform projects, including hard-bid, design-build, and progressive design-build delivery models.
  • Strong command of substation and transmission scope, major equipment (power transformers, GIS/AIS switchgear, structures, protection & control), and associated cost drivers.
  • Experience building and leading an estimating team, including process standardization across multiple concurrent pursuits.
  • Working knowledge of construction project controls, scheduling, and constructability principles, and how they inform estimate accuracy and risk.
  • Strong executive communication and presentation skills, with experience presenting pricing and risk recommendations to senior leadership.
  • Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Electrical Engineering, Civil Engineering, or related field, or equivalent industry experience.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience estimating for both utility-scale solar/BESS interconnection substations and standalone transmission/substation projects.
  • Familiarity with estimating and take-off platforms (e.g., Accubid or comparable tools) and evaluation of estimating technology upgrades.
  • Experience integrating preconstruction processes following an M&A transaction or multi-entity combination.
  • Existing relationships with major HV equipment manufacturers and specialty subcontractors.

THE JOB

The Senior Client Marketing Manager is responsible for providing exceptional client and account management support for one of Ticketmaster’s largest clients in the Sports and Venues vertical. Additional responsibilities include offering strategic guidance and recommendations across all offered solutions with an emphasis on paid media, coordinating the execution of marketing campaigns and supporting revenue growth targets.

The ideal candidate excels at building deep relationships while effectively managing both client expectations and internal teams supporting client deliverables. The successful Client Marketing Manager marries knowledge of the client’s business objectives with a deep understanding of Ticketmaster’s products and services while also ensuring flawless execution of the client’s campaigns including recommendations for optimizations, reporting and data insights.

Key requirements include: a proven track record of success in an account management role serving top tier clients, the ability to manage many complex projects across multiple clients simultaneously, and a deep understanding of digital marketing channels and strategies including on-site advertising, programmatic display, paid social and SEM.


WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING


  • Ensure retention of performance media spend within your client portfolio
  • Quarterback flawless execution of complex digital marketing campaigns, analytics projects and other initiatives
  • Serve as the internal “expert” on your clients: understand their business challenges/opportunities, how to navigate their organizations and what solutions Ticketmaster can offer
  • Support growth targets by recommending cross-channel marketing solutions that deliver against client objectives

  • 5-7 years’ experience in similar role within the digital marketing industry
  • Digital media agency experience a plus
  • Strong quantitative skills including analytical abilities

  • Strong written and verbal communication and comprehension skills, and the ability to adjust style to different audiences
  • Understanding and interest in the business side of sports
  • Very strong competence in Microsoft Office products and knowledge of AI tools

YOU (BEHAVIORAL SKILLS)

  • Ability to effectively interact with clients and colleagues across the executive, mid-manager and day-to-day operations levels in a professional, service-oriented manner
  • Creative problem-solver
  • Exceptional organizational skills
  • Ability to work effectively under pressure and tight deadlines

BENEFITS & PERKS

Through our ‘Taking Care of Our Own’ program, we provide benefits across six key pillars:

  • HEALTH: Medical, vision, dental and mental health benefits for you and your family, with access to a health care concierge, and Flexible or Health Savings Accounts (FSA or HSA)
  • YOURSELF: Free concert tickets, generous paid time off including paid holidays, sick time, and personal days

jobs.description:
About Portless

Portless helps fast-growing direct-to-consumer brands ship orders from our fulfillment centers in China straight to their customers in North America, the UK and beyond. Brands no longer have to import and warehouse inventory in every market, which frees up cash and cuts costs.

We run the whole chain: fulfillment, freight, customs clearance and last-mile delivery, tied together by our own software and AI. Our merchants are mid-market brands in apparel, beauty, electronics and home goods.

We are venture-backed and on track to double revenue in 2026. Our team works across North America, China and beyond.

You will own Portless's books end to end: the monthly close across our entities in North America and Asia, merchant billing and collections, cash, and our first external audit. You will lead our accounting team, most of whom are based in China, and build the processes and controls that let us keep growing fast.

This is a hands-on role. You will be in the reconciliations yourself before you hand them off, and you will have real ownership from day one.

What you'll own

Month-end close. Own the close calendar across all entities, including consolidation, intercompany and FX, and get it done faster each month.

Billing and order-to-cash. Make sure every merchant is billed correctly and on time. That includes rate-card changes, credit notes and waivers with clear approvals, duties, VAT and tariffs billed back accurately, and cash applied across Stripe and our other payment channels.

AR and collections. Keep AR reconciled to the bank and payment processors, set our bad-debt reserve policy, and run collections with our billing team.

Cash. Own the daily cash position and a 13-week forecast tied to the bank, plus payment runs and approvals.

Audit and diligence. Select and lead our first external audit, prepare the books for investor and lender diligence, and own monthly lender reporting.

Tax and compliance. Coordinate outside advisors on Canadian, US and Chinese filings, sales tax and VAT, and transfer pricing.

Systems and controls. Tighten our stack (QuickBooks Online, Stripe, Bill.com, Ramp), document how things get done, and decide when we need an ERP.

Team. Lead and develop the accounting team, give every process a clear owner, and work closely with our data and engineering teams on billing data.

What success looks like in your first year

Outcome

By

90 days

You own the daily cash position and monthly lender reporting, and the whole team works from one close calendar.

6 months

Every entity closes by business day 10, and every rate-card change, credit note and waiver has an approval trail.

12 months

Our first external audit is complete. AR ties to the bank and payment processors every month, and duties and VAT billed match what we paid. The team runs on documented processes.

What you bring

CPA, CA or an equivalent designation.

8+ years in accounting, including at least 3 as a controller or assistant controller who owned the close.

A start in audit at a Big 4 or mid-tier public accounting firm.

You have owned a multi-entity, multi-currency close, including consolidation and intercompany.

You have run billing and collections at a high-volume business that bills per order, per transaction or on usage.

You have taken a company through a first audit or an audit-readiness cleanup, working directly with the auditors.

You have led a team, including people in another country.
You are comfortable with a lean stack and AI tools, and you keep your work auditable. Clear, direct written English.

Nice to have

Mandarin. Most of our accounting team is in China, so this is a big plus.

Experience in logistics, 3PL, freight forwarding, customs brokerage or cross-border e- commerce.

Accounting for duties, VAT and tariffs paid on behalf of customers, and for transfer pricing.

Financial due diligence or transaction services experience. An ERP implementation or migration, such as NetSuite.

How you work

You can't let a number go until it ties.

You stay calm and factual when things move fast.

You hold the line on controls, even when someone senior is asking for an exception.

You fix the biggest problems first instead of redesigning everything at once.

You are hands-on and low ego, and you'll do the reconciliations yourself until the team can.

You raise bad news early and say "I don't know" when you don't.

You manage across time zones and cultures with patience and clear writing.

Location and hours

This role is global and remote. What matters is overlap, not where you live: part of your working day must overlap with Eastern Time, where our merchants, auditors and lenders are, and part with China time, where most of the accounting team works.

For example, someone in Europe or the Middle East covers both in a normal day. Someone in Toronto or New York would add a short evening call with the China team, and someone in Asia an evening call with North America. Expect occasional travel to meet the team in person.

What we offer

A senior role with real ownership, reporting directly to a co-founder.
The chance to build the finance function of a company that is doubling revenue. Competitive base salary, performance bonus and equity.
Remote work on a global team, with flexible hours around the overlap windows.

Portless is an equal opportunity employer.

Job Description:


The Senior Manager, Technology Enablement is a senior business-facing technology leader responsible for helping Consulting and Managed Services use technology effectively to improve growth, scalability, efficiency, client delivery, and business performance. This role develops a deep understanding of the businesses supported and translates business needs into clear technology recommendations and roadmaps, with a core focus on using existing enterprise capabilities, third-party platforms, and commercial software effectively and ensuring technology investments deliver meaningful value.\


Essential Job Functions, Responsibilities & Duties:

1. Serve as a strategic technology advisor

  • Build trusted relationships with business and practice leaders and understand their strategies, operating models, workflows, economics, and technology needs.
  • Identify opportunities where technology can improve business performance, scalability, quality, client experience, or risk management.
  • Distinguish problems requiring technology investment from those better addressed through process, adoption, operating-model, or organizational changes.
  • Turn complex business and technology considerations into clear options, recommendations, and actions; challenge assumptions and recommend a path forward.
  • Partner across Product, Engineering, Architecture, Data, AI, Security, Operations, Procurement, Finance, Risk, and business leadership to establish ownership and decision rights and drive work to outcomes.

40%

2. Lead and develop the Technology Enablement team

  • Lead and develop a team of 3-5 direct reports, setting clear expectations for business understanding, analytical rigor, judgment, communication, and accountability.
  • Build independent, high-performing team members who bring recommendations and ownership rather than simply coordinating activity or reporting information.
  • Create clear accountability, delegate effectively, coach decision-making, and address performance or ownership gaps promptly.

30%

3. Lead third-party technology and application portfolio strategy

  • Own visibility into and stewardship of material third-party applications used across the supported service lines.
  • Evaluate whether business needs should be addressed through existing enterprise capabilities, improved adoption or configuration, commercial software, or an internally developed solution.
  • Evaluate software vendors and platforms based on business fit, capabilities, cost, risk, architecture, and strategic alignment.
  • Drive recommendations regarding investment, expansion, consolidation, rationalization, replacement, and retirement, while improving value realization and reducing unnecessary cost and complexity.

15%

4. Shape technology roadmaps and investment priorities

  • Develop service-line technology roadmaps aligned to business strategy and enterprise technology direction.
  • Help leaders prioritize investments based on value, strategic alignment, cost, risk, complexity, readiness, and capacity.
  • Connect initiatives across the portfolio to reduce duplication and fragmented technology decisions.
  • Surface risks, dependencies, ownership gaps, and decisions early and drive them toward resolution.

15%


Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree required; degree in technology, business, accounting, or a related field preferred. MBA preferred.
  • 8 years of progressive experience in business technology, technology strategy, technology consulting, application portfolio management, enterprise/business applications, digital transformation, product management, or a related field required
  • Experience translating business strategies and complex business problems into technology recommendations and actionable roadmaps; evaluating commercial software and vendors; and managing or advising on an application or technology portfolio, including investment and lifecycle decisions. Experience in professional services, financial services, healthcare, or similarly complex industries preferred.
    • Strong business and financial judgment with the ability to evaluate value, cost, risk, tradeoffs, and strategic alignment; understanding of complex, technology-dependent business environments.
  • Strong executive communication and stakeholder leadership; demonstrated ability to translate business strategies into technology recommendations and actionable roadmaps; meaningful experience evaluating commercial software, technology vendors, and alternative solution approaches.
  • Enough technical depth to engage credibly with architecture and engineering teams without needing to be the engineering owner; ability to influence across organizational boundaries, lead and develop high-performing team members, make recommendations, and drive decisions in ambiguous environments.

jobs.title: Founding Computer Vision Engineer — Teach AI to See Ocean Plastic
jobs.excerpt: Remote Worldwide | Flexible Commitment (Part-time to Full-time) | Equity | Frequent International Field Work About RetideEvery minute, the equivalent of a garbage truck of plastic enters the ocean.
jobs.description:
Remote Worldwide | Flexible Commitment (Part-time to Full-time) | Equity | Frequent International Field Work

About Retide

Every minute, the equivalent of a garbage truck of plastic enters the ocean.

And yet, our ability to see where that plastic is, understand how it moves, and measure the impact of removing it is still surprisingly limited.

Retide is building the intelligence infrastructure to change that.

We use AI, robotics and environmental data to help organizations better understand plastic pollution, improve recovery efforts, and create stronger evidence of environmental impact.

Our long-term vision is a world where we can understand how plastic moves through the environment, identify where intervention matters most, and measure what happens when we act.

We're a Canadian ocean-tech startup working alongside cleanup organizations and environmental partners to build and test our technology in the real world.

We're now expanding our work into autonomous aerial systems and looking for a founding engineer to help build this next part of Retide.

Where We Are Today

Retide was founded in early 2025 and is currently at the pre-seed stage.

Since then, we've moved from concept development into field testing and validation, while building the partnerships and market access needed to bring our technology into the real world.

Today:

  • We're part of Canada's leading AI, climate-tech and ocean innovation ecosystems, including NextAI, Foresight Canada and the Ocean Startup Project
  • We've established partnerships with key stakeholders across the plastic recovery and plastic credit ecosystem globaly.
  • We've built relationships and early distribution channels that give us access to cleanup operators, field environments and potential users of our technology
  • We're working with environmental, research and industry partners across Canada, Germany, Brazil and Southeast Asia
  • We've begun collecting real-world beach and drone data alongside cleanup organizations
  • Retide was recognized among Scale AI's 2025 Top 100 AI Startups in Canada

We have the partnerships, field access and early market pathways. Now we're building the technology and technical team to turn that into something real.

The Role

We're looking for a 'Founding Computer Vision & Perception Engineer' to lead the development of Retide's aerial perception capabilities.

You'll work at the intersection of computer vision, machine learning, robotics and environmental sensing to explore how AI can transform aerial data into useful intelligence about plastic pollution.

You'll take ownership of Retide's computer vision and perception work, building on what we've developed so far and helping shape where it goes next. You'll work with real-world data, develop and test models, and take them into the field to understand how they perform outside the lab.

You'll have significant influence over Retide's AI architecture, datasets and technical direction.

What You'll Work On

In the first few months, you'll likely be:

  • Building initial detection and segmentation models from our existing drone and beach imagery datasets
  • Traveling to Brazil, west-coast Canada or Southeast Asia for at least one field deployment, working directly alongside cleanup partners
  • Helping us decide where to build custom architectures versus adapt existing ones — especially for small-object detection in complex, cluttered environments

Beyond that, the role spans the full perception stack: multimodal sensor fusion, real-time and edge AI, model uncertainty and human-in-the-loop systems, and active learning as our datasets grow. You'll work closely with our robotics and software team to treat perception as part of an entire sensing system, not just a model trained on a static dataset.

We're Looking for Someone Who

  • Has strong experience in computer vision, machine learning, robotics perception or a closely related field
  • Has built and evaluated real-world perception systems
  • Has experience with object detection, segmentation and modern deep learning approaches
  • Is comfortable working with imperfect and evolving datasets
  • Can move from research to prototype to experiment to iteration quickly
  • Takes ownership rather than waiting for detailed requirements
  • Is excited to spend time in the field, not just behind a computer

Experience with PyTorch, aerial imagery, small-object detection, edge AI, active learning, uncertainty estimation, sensor fusion, remote sensing, multimodal imaging or robotics is valuable. But we're more interested in what you can build and how quickly you can learn than whether you check every box.

Commitment & Compensation

We're flexible on commitment level. This role can start at 20 hours per week or move to full-time immediately for the right person — we'd rather structure around what works for you than force a fixed schedule this early.

At our current pre-seed stage, this is an equity-based role, with the intention of transitioning to salary + equity following our next funding round, currently targeted for Q2 2027.

Location & Field Work

Retide is remote worldwide — you can be based anywhere. Our founder is a digital nomad.

This role involves frequent international travel for field testing and deployments, concentrated across Canada, Brazil and Southeast Asia.

Field work logistics: Core travel costs for scheduled field deployments are covered by Retide.

This isn't a purely remote AI role. We want someone excited to take models into the field, work alongside our partners, see where they fail, and use that to make them better.

What It's Like to Build at Retide

We're small, ambitious and still early. That means everyone has a voice in what Retide becomes.

We value curiosity over ego, ownership over titles, and progress over perfection. We care about rigorous science and thoughtful engineering, but we also believe technology only matters if it works outside the lab — which means learning alongside the communities and organizations already doing this work on the ground.

You should be excited by ambiguity, comfortable challenging assumptions, and willing to get your hands dirty — sometimes literally.

Why Join Now

You'll join Retide at a point where many of our most important technical decisions have yet to be made. You'll have the opportunity to shape our perception architecture, datasets, research direction and engineering culture from the beginning — working directly with the founder and a small technical team, with significant ownership over what you build.

The models you develop won't live only in a benchmark or research paper. They'll go into the field and help us build a better way to understand plastic pollution in the environments where it actually exists.

If you're excited about computer vision, robotics, oceans and applying AI to one of the world's most visible environmental problems, we'd love to hear from you.

Founded in 2011, AlphaSense is headquartered in New York City with more than 2,000 employees across the globe and offices in the U.S., U.K., Finland, India, Singapore, Canada, and Ireland. Come join us!

About the Role

We are building an AI Security and Governance capability and need an AI Security Analyst to be the front line for detecting, investigating, and containing risk across every AI tool, agent, and model touching AlphaSense's environment.

You will monitor enterprise AI usage end to end, hunt for unauthorized ("shadow") AI and rogue agent activity, and turn raw AI telemetry into triaged findings the security and governance team can act on. Working alongside the Automation Engineer, Data Analyst, and Director, you will be a primary contributor to the evidence base underpinning our ISO 42001 certification and our broader AI risk posture.

Key Responsibilities

AI Tool Discovery & Shadow AI Monitoring

Continuously monitor CASB/SWG, OAuth, and endpoint telemetry to discover unsanctioned AI tools, browser extensions, and API-level agents in use across the business. Classify findings by risk tier and escalate unauthorized deployments for containment.

Rogue Agent Detection & Investigation

Investigate alerts related to autonomous agents and AI-powered workflows (e.g., anomalous tool chains, unexpected data access, credential misuse) including threats such as OpenClaw and similar agent-based attack patterns. Document findings and drive remediation with the Automation Engineer and Identity teams.

AI Data Exfiltration Detection & DLP

Monitor DLP and AI usage logs for signs of sensitive data leaving the environment through AI tools (prompts, uploads, plugins, MCP connectors). Tune detection rules and validate that AI-specific DLP controls are operating as designed.

Developer AI Tool Governance

Monitor usage of developer-facing AI tools (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Codex, and similar) for policy compliance, credential exposure, and non-human identity risk. Partner with Engineering to ensure code-assist and agentic dev tools operate within approved guardrails.

AI Logging, Retention & Audit Support

Maintain and validate AI activity logging and data retention controls to ensure auditability. Assemble and organize evidence supporting ISO 42001 audits, EU AI Act readiness, and internal AI impact assessments.

Detection Tuning & Continuous Improvement

Analyze false positive/negative trends across AI security detections and recommend threshold and logic adjustments. Feed recurring patterns into the Automation Engineer's playbook backlog.

Cross-functional Collaboration

Partner with Security Operations, Identity, Legal, and AI/ML Engineering to align findings with existing incident response processes, and support the Director in preparing risk findings for governance council and executive reporting.

Who You Are

Basic Requirements

  • 3-5+ years in security analysis, SOC, or GRC analyst roles
  • Working knowledge of SIEM platforms (Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, Google Chronicle) and DLP/CASB tooling
  • Understanding of AI/LLM risk concepts: prompt injection, data exfiltration via AI tools, model/agent misuse, shadow AI
  • Familiarity with non-human identity concepts (service accounts, API keys, OAuth tokens) and their security challenges
  • Understanding of threat detection logic (MITRE ATT exposure to MITRE ATLAS or OWASP LLM Top 10 a plus)
  • Comfortable reading and interpreting logs, API telemetry, and structured/unstructured investigation data Basic scripting or query proficiency (Python, SQL, or SPL/KQL) for investigation and reporting
  • Strong written documentation habits
  • Ability to translate technical findings into clear, risk-based narratives Familiarity with cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP)

Required AI Security Depth (must demonstrate genuine, applied experience in at least one of the following — not coursework, certifications, or familiarity alone)

  • Hands-on AI/LLM risk testing or investigation: prompt injection testing, model/agent misuse investigation, or AI-specific data exfiltration analysis
  • CASB/SWG-based application discovery: unsanctioned SaaS, browser extension, or shadow IT/shadow AI detection using tools such as Netskope, Zscaler, Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps, Wiz, or similar
  • Non-human identity investigation: API key, OAuth token, or service account misuse investigation and risk assessment (administration alone does not qualify — we're looking for investigative/risk experience)
  • Agentic AI or MCP-based architecture exposure: from either the security or engineering side — e.g., securing, testing, or building agent tool-use pipelines (LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, MCP servers)

Candidates should be prepared to describe a specific example — what they found, how they investigated it, and what the outcome was — rather than listing this as a resume skill.

Threat Detection Logic

  • Understanding of MITRE ATT exposure to MITRE ATLAS or OWASP LLM Top 10 strongly preferred

Nice to Have

  • Hands-on (not just conceptual) exposure to AI governance frameworks — ISO 42001, NIST AI RMF, EU AI Act risk tiers — ideally through audit evidence collection or control testing (SOC 2, ISO, or similar)
  • Direct experience with any of: Netskope, Zscaler, Wiz, Orca Security, Microsoft Purview, Abnormal Security, Bolster AI, or comparable AI-aware security platforms
  • Exposure to ML-based anomaly detection or NLP-driven log analysis
  • Certifications: Security+, CISSP (Associate), or AI-specific credentials (e.g., AI/ML security, OWASP AI, GIAC)

Your goal as an Account Manager is to assist your clients in meeting their revenue goals using the products and services of our company.

The Account Manager will report directly to the Head of Account Managers, the Account Managers’ Leads, and the Service Director while working collaboratively with other departments.

About the Role:

Mission statement:

The primary mission of our Account Manager is to be in charge of maintaining a good relationship with your assigned clients while ensuring that our products and services are bringing results for our clients. This will include coming up with innovative ideas for clients’ marketing campaigns, monitoring the performance of such marketing campaigns, and keeping an open channel of productive and fruitful communication with our clients.

You will also be responsible for leading teams consisting of professional Copywriters, Designers, and Account Managers’ Associates to ensure that your assigned clients’ marketing campaigns are executed smoothly. This involves activities such as outlining the client's campaign calendar, briefing new campaigns, delegating creative work, and ultimately overseeing the timely delivery of marketing campaigns.

  • Building and maintaining a strong relationship with your assigned clients to ensure peak productivity, open communication, and establishing trust between our clients and Hustler Marketing
  • Being in charge of the planning, development, and execution of marketing strategies (consisting of email campaigns, SMS campaigns, pop-ups, and flows) for your assigned clients (meaning that you’ll be managing about 40 unique marketing campaigns per month)

  • Working to improve the results from email marketing for your assigned clients
  • Collaborating with team members to respond to client requests promptly
  • Working alongside a team of experienced marketing professionals productively and harmoniously to ensure that the highest quality marketing campaigns are delivered to our clients
  • Continuously staying in contact with your assigned clients, including leading and attending regular meetings with your clients
  • Collecting and analyzing data to understand the consumers’ demographics and trends to forward the clients' marketing agenda and drive better results, setting new goals weekly
  • Regularly reporting on the performance of the email marketing campaigns for your assigned clients, including reporting on aspects like revenue from email marketing, best-performing campaigns, results from A/B testing, and the measures taken to improve and optimize client revenue
  • Working with the Service Department to maintain high work standards and ensuring that the set targets for your assigned clients are met in terms of Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
  • Keeping a tight grip on client churn (especially for your assigned clients), and implementing strategies to prevent clients from leaving the company, with the assistance of the Service Director
  • Troubleshooting and assisting with any issues related to clients’ satisfaction and the performance of marketing campaigns as developed and executed by our team
  • Being able to effectively and productively work with any type of client with minimal supervision
  • Working on various tasks as part of the team of Account Managers
  • Participating in the Account Managers’ group calls
  • Participating in the training and skill-building sessions for Account Managers within the Service Department to improve their skills, performance, and overall expertise
  • Acting as a liaison between clients and cross-functional teams to ensure the successful implementation of new services and products offered by Hustler Marketing
  • Continuously working to identify new opportunities to expand services offered to clients through regular communication and relationship building
  • Using data analysis techniques to create targeted campaigns for upselling our services to our client segments, and to present these service offers to clients in a compelling manner
  • Continuously working to discover industry-wide best practices and standards and present your findings to the Account Managers’ Lead, the Head of Account Managers, and the Service Director
  • Being available to assist with all internal service-related needs from other departments
  • Directly reporting to the Account Managers’ Leads, the Head of Account Managers, and the Service Director (in that structural order)

Positions Specs:

  • Full-time commitment while meeting our general availability for office hours
  • An average of 140 tracked hours per month consistently
  • Fixed-rate monthly salary paid in USD
  • Receive contractor status after signing our non-disclosure agreement
  • Exclusivity agreement (nullifying the possibility to work in a position of a similar nature while working for Hustler Marketing)

  • Regular performance reviews every 9-12 months, with the first one being after 3-6 months
  • Re-evaluation of the role and workload after 6-12 months

Requirements

Profile:

The ideal candidate must be someone with extensive working experience in managing client accounts effectively, as well as experience in email marketing. Such experience should include managing a team consisting of marketing professionals (such as Account Managers’ Associates, Designers, Copywriters, and other team members) to deliver marketing campaigns that are focused on driving sales.

The Account Manager must be able to act swiftly upon receiving urgent requests from clients and must be able to work consistently with high levels of accountability.

The right person will be professional and also have considerable leadership and managerial experience, as well as strong communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills to effectively communicate with clients and internal teams. Familiarity with various tools such as Slack, Hubstaff, Asana, Klaviyo, and Google Workspace Suite is a must for this role. The candidate should also feel comfortable working in a remote environment. Availability, accountability, professionalism, responsiveness, and consistency are highly important factors for us, so the Account Manager should display these qualities when it comes to workload commitments and general availability during office hours.

Key Requirements:

  • At least 12 months of experience working in a digital marketing role, together with at least 6 months of working experience in an email marketing field (Preference will be given to candidates who have worked with remote teams and team members from different countries or have any account management or agency experience)
  • A proven track record of achieving success in a leadership role is a must, especially leading a team of creatives to deliver quality work that meets the needs of clients
  • Must have the ability to work independently without compromising on work standards
  • Must be highly accountable, responsive, and have an excellent ability to meet deadlines
  • Great aptitude for working with people, problem-solving, and thinking critically / analytically, as these skills are essential for meeting the needs of our clients and resolving any issues or queries
  • Possesses a growth and results-driven mindset, and can handle and implement constructive criticism
  • Any remote work experience is a major advantage
  • Excellent interpersonal skills to clearly and effectively communicate with clients as well as marketing professionals in our Service Department
  • Must possess great problem-solving skills as it is essential for working with clients and resolving any queries, complaints, or issues

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English. You must be fluent in English, although English doesn't have to be your native language

Architecture & Systems Design

Coding

About Ethos

Ethos (Nasdaq: $LIFE) is a leading life insurance technology company on a mission to protect families by democratizing access to life insurance and empowering agents at scale. With its robust three-sided technology platform, Ethos is transforming the life insurance experience for consumers, agents, and carriers alike. Ethos offers instant, accessible products and a seamless online process that requires no medical exams and just a few health questions; it eliminates traditional barriers, making it easier than ever for everyone to protect their families. Ethos is redefining how life insurance is bought, sold, and underwritten.

About Ethos

Ethos makes life insurance simple to buy, through our own platform and through agent and partner channels. Salesforce supports our sales, customer experience, and partnership teams as they grow. We are looking for a Salesforce Developer to build and support the custom applications and integrations these teams depend on, from design through deployment.

About the Role

You will design, build, and support applications and integrations on Salesforce. This is full-lifecycle work: requirements, design, build, test, deploy, and support. We work source-driven and Git-based, and we release through automated pipelines instead of large quarterly releases.

You'll work with Salesforce Administrators, business analysts, data engineers, and product engineering teams, as part of the Enterprise Systems team.

What you'll work on

  • Event integrations. Customer and policy events from our product platform update Salesforce in near real time and sync out to our sales and marketing systems.
  • Partner APIs. APIs that partners and internal services use to manage agent and partner data in Salesforce.
  • Consent and compliance. Contact preferences and Do-Not-Contact requests that must stay consistent across our communication systems.
  • Sales and service tooling. Apps, automation, and routing for our sales agents and service teams.

Responsibilities:

  • Build reliable event-driven integrations. Handle duplicate and late events, recover from failures, and give support teams clear diagnostics.
  • Build and maintain inbound REST APIs and outbound callouts to external systems.
  • Build and improve Apex, LWC, and Flow solutions. Maintain existing automation, and move logic to Apex when scale, control, or testing needs require it.
  • Write Apex that works at volume. Bulkify every path and design around governor limits, record locks, and async job limits.
  • Protect personal and health data. Enforce appropriate sharing, object and field access, and least privilege. Choose execution context explicitly, document privileged integration operations, and keep sensitive data out of logs.
  • Build integrations with Named and External Credentials, OAuth 2.0, Platform Events, Change Data Capture, and Apex REST. Design for retries, idempotency, and partial failure.
  • Write tests that check behavior and failure cases. Use mocks where appropriate, address static-analysis findings, and review code from teammates, contractors, and AI tools.
  • Deploy through Git-based CI/CD. Manage sandboxes, destructive changes, rollback plans, and the three annual Salesforce releases. Keep Git and production in sync.
  • Support what we've shipped. Triage production issues, debug across integration boundaries, and fix root causes instead of symptoms.

Qualifications and Skills:

  • Typically 5+ years of Salesforce development experience, not admin and config work alone, or equivalent evidence of delivering and supporting production systems.
  • Strong Apex, SOQL, bulk processing, asynchronous processing, and automated testing skills.
  • Experience building REST or event-driven integrations that handle duplicate messages, retries, and partial failures.
  • Ability to build and debug Flow and LWC (modern JavaScript, ES6+) solutions, and explain when Apex is the better choice.
  • Experience with Salesforce data models, sharing, object and field access, Salesforce CLI, Git, and automated deployments.
  • Ability to investigate production failures, review code, and explain technical decisions to business teams.
  • You use the team's AI coding tools and check their output for correctness, security, and maintainability.

Nice to have

  • Experience with trigger frameworks and layered Apex design (domain, selector, and service classes), dependency injection, and mocking libraries.
  • Experience integrating Salesforce with customer data platforms, contact-center systems, marketing tools, or identity providers.
  • Insurance or financial services experience, especially with agent or partner distribution.
  • Consent and privacy compliance (TCPA, CCPA).
  • Salesforce Platform Developer II certification.

Our stack

Salesforce Sales Cloud and Service Cloud, Apex, LWC, Flow, Platform Events, and Change Data Capture. Integrations with customer data, contact-center, marketing, and identity platforms. GitHub with automated CI/CD. Snowflake as our warehouse. Slack for collaboration and alerting. Jira for tracking.

jobs.description:
Senior Major Gifts Officer
Reports to: Director, Global Business Development
Location: Remote (East Coast)

Help Transform Community Health for 25 Million People
Living Goods is at an inflection point.

For more than 15 years, we have partnered with governments across Africa to strengthen community health systems and ensure that families can access quality healthcare where they live. Our work has helped demonstrate that when community health workers are equipped with the right tools, training, supervision, and data, governments can deliver lifesaving care at scale.

Today, the global health landscape is changing. Traditional funding models are shifting, governments are demanding greater impact and efficiency, and new technologies, including artificial intelligence, are creating unprecedented opportunities to improve frontline healthcare delivery.

Living Goods is meeting this moment with a bold new strategy.

By 2030, we aim to support governments in enabling 50,000 community health workers to reach 25 million people across our core countries, contributing to a measurable reduction in maternal and child mortality. Achieving this vision will require transformational partnerships with philanthropists and family foundations who believe that lasting change happens when governments are equipped to deliver for their people.

That's where you come in.

The Opportunity:
This is not a traditional major gifts role.

We are seeking an entrepreneurial and relationship-driven fundraising leader who wants to help build and scale a major gifts program capable of generating more than $5 million annually in philanthropic support.
You will partner closely with the Director of Global Business Development, executive leadership, and program leaders to identify, cultivate, solicit, and steward philanthropists and family foundations capable of making six- and seven-figure investments in Living Goods' mission.

This role offers a rare opportunity to help shape strategy, influence organizational growth, and build meaningful partnerships with some of the most sophisticated philanthropists in the United States.

The ideal candidate is energized by building something ambitious, enjoys creating opportunities where none previously existed, and thrives in an environment that values initiative, creativity, collaboration, and results.

What You'll Do:
Build and Scale a Transformational Major Gifts Program
  • Partner with the Director of Global Business Development to develop and execute a comprehensive major gifts strategy focused on securing six- and seven-figure philanthropic investments.
  • Help shape the future growth of Living Goods' individual and family foundation fundraising program.
  • Identify new opportunities, emerging trends, and innovative approaches to engage major donors.
  • Develop and implement donor engagement strategies that align donor interests with Living Goods' highest-impact priorities.
  • Serve as an internal thought partner on major donor strategy, philanthropic trends, and relationship management.
Cultivate and Secure Major Gifts
  • Build and manage a portfolio of high-capacity donors and prospects capable of making gifts of $100,000+ annually.
  • Create and execute individualized cultivation, solicitation, and stewardship plans.
  • Personally solicit and close six- and seven-figure gifts.
  • Leverage existing donor relationships to expand Living Goods' philanthropic network.
  • Develop and maintain a robust pipeline of qualified prospects and strategic opportunities.
  • Collaborate with organizational leadership to advance donor conversations and secure transformational investments.
Deliver Exceptional Donor Experiences
  • Design meaningful engagement opportunities that deepen donor understanding of Living Goods' impact.
  • Coordinate donor meetings, events, learning opportunities, and site visits.
  • Ensure donors receive thoughtful stewardship and reporting that demonstrates the value and impact of their investment.
  • Represent Living Goods with professionalism, authenticity, and enthusiasm in external settings.

Who You Are:
  • Proven Major Gifts Fundraiser
You bring at least 10 years of experience securing major gifts from high-net-worth individuals and family foundations, with a demonstrated record of closing six- and seven-figure gifts. Experience in global health, international development, systems change, or related sectors is highly desirable.
  • Builder and Strategist
You are energized by building programs, creating strategy, and turning ambitious goals into measurable results. You can see both the big picture and the tactical steps required to get there.
  • Exceptional Relationship Manager
You naturally build trust and credibility with sophisticated donors and advisors. You understand how to navigate complex donor relationships and create authentic connections that lead to long-term partnership.
  • Outstanding Communicator
You are an excellent writer, storyteller, and presenter. You can translate complex ideas into compelling narratives that inspire action and investment.
  • Collaborative and Culturally Intelligent
You enjoy working across teams, functions, and geographies. You bring humility, curiosity, and cultural sensitivity to your work and are comfortable engaging with colleagues and partners from diverse backgrounds.
  • Entrepreneurial and Resourceful
You are self-directed, resilient, and solutions-oriented. You thrive in fast-moving environments and are comfortable operating with both autonomy and accountability.

Why Join Living Goods?
  • Build Something Meaningful
Help shape and grow a major gifts program at a pivotal moment in the organization's history.
  • Drive Transformational Impact
Your work will directly contribute to strengthening government health systems and improving access to healthcare for millions of people.
  • Partner with Exceptional Leaders
Work alongside a passionate global team committed to innovation, impact, and equity.
  • Grow Your Career
This role offers significant opportunity for professional growth, leadership, and influence within a globally respected organization.
  • Experience the Mission Firsthand
Travel opportunities may include donor engagement throughout the United States and visits to Living Goods' programs in Africa.
  • Travel
Up to 25%, primarily within the United States, with occasional international travel.

Compensation
Salary range: $105,000–$120,000, commensurate with experience, plus competitive benefits and performance-based incentive opportunity.
Living Goods is an equal opportunity employer and will consider every qualified applicant for employment. Living Goods does not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, national origin, ancestry, religion, gender, sexual orientation or disability.

Our current job openings are displayed on our website, where you can search for open positions and apply directly. Living Goods does not offer any positions without an interview and never asks candidates for money. If you are asked for money, we strongly recommend that you do not respond and do not send money or personal information.

About Legence Legence (Nasdaq: LGN) is a leading provider of engineering, consulting, installation, and maintenance services for mission-critical systems in buildings. The company specializes in designing, fabricating, and installing complex HVAC, process piping, and other mechanical, electrical, and plumbing (MEP) systems—enhancing energy efficiency, reliability, and sustainability in new and existing facilities. Legence also delivers long-term performance through strategic upgrades and holistic solutions. Serving some of the world’s most technically demanding sectors, Legence counts over 60% of the Nasdaq-100 Index among its clients.

Location: Remote, United States. Near Legence office preferred. The Lead Cybersecurity Specialist within the Legence IT Security organization will be responsible for helping advance the company’s overall security posture. This role goes beyond operational support to include architecture, risk strategy, and cross-functional leadership. This role will work with other IT pillars and team members to implement, and continuously improve security controls that protect enterprise systems, cloud environments, and data against evolving threats while aligning with business objectives and regulatory requirements. This role will provide team leadership to junior staff members About the Role We are seeking a highly skilled Lead Cybersecurity Specialist to lead a team of cyber analysts tasked with advancing Legence’s security posture and reducing risk. This role is critical to ensuring the integrity, reliability, and security of our IT systems and processes. The ideal candidate will bring deep cyber experience, the ability to develop team members, the ability to communicate with business and IT partners, and a focus in ITGC audits, tool selection, continuous improvement, and cross-functional project management. Key Responsibilities

  • Cloud Security & Architecture

◦ Ensure the implementation and governance of secure cloud architectures across platforms. ◦ Continue development, enforcement, and governance of cyber security controls (including identity, access management, and workload protection). ◦ Partner with engineering teams to embed security into cloud-native development and DevOps processes (DevSecOps).

  • Enterprise Risk Management

◦ Evolve the organization’s security risk management program. ◦ Conduct risk assessments, threat modeling, and control evaluations. ◦ Translate technical risks into business impact and present recommendations to senior leadership.

  • Security Engineering & Automation

◦ Develop and maintain advanced automation frameworks and scripts to improve detection, response, and compliance capabilities. ◦ Lead efforts to integrate security tooling (SIEM, EDR, CSPM, etc.) into a cohesive security ecosystem.

  • Threat Detection & Incident Response

◦ Oversee monitoring and detection strategies across networks, endpoints, and cloud environments. ◦ Lead incident response efforts, including triage, containment, root cause analysis, and post-incident improvements. ◦ Drive continuous improvement of detection use cases and response playbooks.

  • Vulnerability Management & Offensive Security

◦ Lead vulnerability management lifecycle, including scanning, prioritization, and remediation strategies. ◦ Coordinate perform penetration testing and adversary simulations. ◦ Provide expert guidance on remediation and risk prioritization.

  • Governance, Compliance & Security Strategy

◦ Support and help shape governance, risk, and compliance initiatives (e.g., NIST, ISO, SOC 2). ◦ Lead security assessments, audits, and third-party risk reviews. ◦ Contribute to long-term cybersecurity strategy, roadmap planning, and security metrics reporting.

  • Leadership & Collaboration

◦ Act as a technical mentor and escalation point for junior analysts and engineers. ◦ Oversee the career development of security team members ◦ Collaborate with IT, engineering, and business stakeholders to align security initiatives with organizational goals. ◦ Stay ahead of emerging threats, technologies, and industry trends, bringing proactive recommendations to leadership. Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 5–10+ years of experience in cybersecurity, with demonstrated progression into senior or lead responsibilities.
  • Deep expertise in cloud security, network security, and enterprise security architecture.
  • Strong experience with security technologies such as SIEM, EDR, IDS/IPS, firewalls, and encryption.
  • Proven experience in risk management, incident response, and vulnerability management.
  • Proficiency in scripting or programming (e.g., Python, PowerShell, Bash) for automation and security engineering.
  • Experience with security frameworks and compliance standards (e.g., NIST, ISO 27001, CIS).
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to influence technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Industry certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CCSP, or GIAC.
  • Experience leading security initiatives or small teams.

jobs.excerpt: über uns „Grenzen verschieben, disruptiv denken, die Zukunft gestalten - sei dabei, wenn wir die Talente von morgen formen.
jobs.description:
über uns

„Grenzen verschieben, disruptiv denken, die Zukunft gestalten - sei dabei, wenn wir die Talente von morgen formen.“
Das Franklin Institute steht für Disruption und Innovation in der sonst so staubigen Bildungsbranche. Unser Antrieb ist es, die Online-Bildungslandschaft stetig neu zu definieren und zu gestalten. Inspiriert von visionären Unternehmen, kombinieren wir Leistung, Innovation und unternehmerischen Geist, um der Bildungsbranche immer einen Schritt voraus zu sein. Mit unserem Wachstum als Bildungsträger wächst auch unser Lehrbetrieb - deshalb schaffen wir mit dem Head of Teaching (m/w/d) eine neue übergreifende Führungsrolle, die diesen Bereich ganzheitlich verantwortet und gemeinsam mit uns weiterentwickelt.

deine rolle & aufgaben

Als Head of Teaching verantwortest du unseren gesamten Lehrbetrieb und führst ein deutschlandweit verteiltes Remote-Team über mehrere Bildungsprogramme hinweg. Dabei geht es um mehr als einen reibungslosen Unterricht: Du gestaltest mit uns, wie Weiterbildung in einer von KI geprägten Arbeitswelt aussehen muss, welche Skills Menschen für den Arbeitsmarkt der Zukunft brauchen und wie wir diese wirksam vermitteln. Damit hast du direkten Einfluss darauf, dass unsere Teilnehmenden neue Perspektiven entwickeln, relevante Kompetenzen aufbauen und erfolgreich zurück in den Arbeitsmarkt finden.

  • Führung & Gesamtsteuerung: Du führst Team Leads und Mitarbeiter unserer Weiterbildungsmaßnahmen und entwickelst gemeinsam mit ihnen einen starken, maßnahmenübergreifenden Lehrbetrieb - mit gemeinsamen Standards, Formaten, Tools und einem kontinuierlichen Austausch zwischen den Teams.

  • Qualität, Didaktik & Zertifizierung: Du verantwortest die Qualität unseres Lehrbetriebs über alle Maßnahmen hinweg, setzt didaktische Standards und stellst sicher, dass unsere Teilnehmenden eine konstant hochwertige Lernerfahrung erhalten. Gleichzeitig sorgst du dafür, dass unsere QM- und Zertifizierungsanforderungen fest im Lehralltag verankert sind, eingehalten und kontinuierlich gepflegt werden.

  • Weiterentwicklung & Skalierung des Lehrbetriebs: Du entwickelst bestehende und neue Lehrangebote auf Basis von Teilnehmerfeedback, Markt- und Wettbewerbsentwicklungen und erkennst, welche Möglichkeiten KI und neue Technologien für die Bildung von morgen schaffen. Dabei entwickelst du Ideen, wie wir Lernen zukünftig noch besser gestalten und gleichzeitig wachsende Teilnehmerzahlen mit gleichbleibend hoher Qualität abbilden können.

  • Prozesse, Kennzahlen & Automatisierung: Du schaffst skalierbare Prozesse für Planung, Dokumentation und Qualitätssicherung, definierst und analysierst relevante Kennzahlen und sorgst dafür, dass die gesetzten Ziele erreicht werden. Zusätzlich identifizierst du gemeinsam mit unseren Prozess- und Automatisierungsteams sinnvolle Einsatzmöglichkeiten für Automatisierungen und KI.

  • Planung & Ressourcen: Du behältst Kursstarts, Kapazitäten, Auslastung und Laufzeiten über alle Maßnahmen hinweg im Blick, erkennst Engpässe und Effizienzverluste frühzeitig und stellst gemeinsam mit den Team Leads sicher, dass unsere Kurse personell zuverlässig besetzt sind.

  • Schnittstelle zu Sales & Marketing: Du vertrittst unser gesamtes Lehrangebot gegenüber Sales und Marketing, stimmst neue Kursstarts eng mit den Teams ab und stellst sicher, dass Inhalte, Playbooks und Kommunikationsmaterialien aktuell sind und unsere Maßnahmen nach außen genauso dargestellt werden, wie sie tatsächlich stattfinden.

dein profil

  • Führung & Kommunikation: Du hast mehrere Jahre disziplinarisch größere Teams geführt - idealerweise remote und mit Team Leads in deinem Team. Du schaffst Orientierung, gibst Verantwortung ab und kommunizierst sicher mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern.

  • Prozess- & Strukturdenken: Du baust Strukturen auf, statt nur bestehende zu verwalten, denkst in klaren Prozessen und Kennzahlen und behältst auch bei vielen parallelen Themen den Überblick. Gerade bei Dokumentations- und Nachweispflichten arbeitest du genau und verlässlich.

  • KI & digitale Prozesse: KI ist selbstverständlicher Teil deines Arbeitsalltags. Du verstehst, wo KI und Automatisierung echten Mehrwert schaffen, und bringst Erfahrung mit digitalen Workflows und CRM-Systemen wie HubSpot mit.

  • Regulatorisches Verständnis: Du kennst dich mit Datenschutz im digitalen und KI-Umfeld aus und hast ein gutes Verständnis für relevante Anforderungen wie DSGVO und EU AI Act.

  • Scale-up-Mindset: Du hast bereits in einem Startup, Scale-up oder einer ähnlich dynamischen Organisation gearbeitet und fühlst dich wohl in einem Umfeld, in dem Strukturen neu entstehen, sich Verantwortlichkeiten verändern und nicht für alles bereits ein fertiger Prozess existiert.

  • Sprache: Du sprichst Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem oder sehr sicherem Niveau und verfügst über sehr gute Englischkenntnisse.

  • Ein großes Plus: Du kennst die Bildungswelt bereits - zum Beispiel durch eigene Lehrerfahrung, die Konzeption von Lehrinhalten oder Bildungsmaßnahmen oder die Arbeit in einem AZAV-zertifizierten Umfeld. Besonders wertvoll sind Erfahrungen mit Bildungsgutscheinen, fachkundigen Stellen und der Bundesagentur für Arbeit.

was macht uns aus?

Bei uns verantwortest du den gesamten Lehrbetrieb - mit echtem Gestaltungsspielraum und in direkter Zusammenarbeit mit unserer COO und Geschäftsführung. Gemeinsam gestalten wir Bildung, die Menschen nicht nur fachlich qualifiziert, sondern ihnen die Skills für einen sich wandelnden Arbeitsmarkt vermittelt.

Denn Lehre ist für uns mehr als Wissensvermittlung. Lernen bedeutet bei uns Coaching, Empowerment und Leadership. Unsere Dozierenden sind keine Folien-Vortragenden, sondern Lernbegleiter:innen, die Selbstwirksamkeit, kritisches Denken und berufliche Handlungsfähigkeit fördern. Als Head of Teaching (m/w/d) schaffst du die Strukturen und Standards, damit dieser Anspruch über alle Maßnahmen hinweg gelebt und weiterentwickelt wird.

Die Wirkung deiner Arbeit ist dabei greifbar: Menschen entwickeln sich fachlich und persönlich weiter, bauen zukunftsrelevante Kompetenzen auf und schaffen neue berufliche Perspektiven. Und das in einem remote aufgestellten Arbeitsumfeld, das auf Vertrauen, Eigenverantwortung und echte Zusammenarbeit setzt.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!

As Digital Campaign Manager, you’ll lead integrated marketing efforts that build awareness of FICO Scores among audiences in the mortgage ecosystem and in federal, state, and local government. This role is ideal for a strong project manager with deep expertise in digital marketing, budget management, and stakeholder coordination. You will execute and optimize multi-channel campaigns across paid media, out-of-home, TV, podcasts, newsletters, and niche placements.


You’ll collaborate closely with Government Relations, Scores Field Marketing, Product Marketing, Content, Design, Communications, Ops, and external agencies to ensure consistent messaging and seamless execution across every touchpoint.

What We’re Seeking

Category: Technology

The ServiceNow OperationalTechnology Solution Engineer supports the design, configuration,implementation, and optimization of ServiceNow Operational TechnologyManagement solutions for enterprise clients. This is a hands-on,client-facing technical delivery role. The Solution Engineer owns assignedtechnical workstreams, supports Architects and Managers, and contributes tosuccessful client outcomes through high-quality configuration, development,testing, and operational support.


Requirements

OT SolutionDelivery and Asset Onboarding

  • Configure and implementServiceNow Operational Technology Management and related ServiceNow platformcapabilities under the direction of the assigned Architect.

CMDB CSDM andOT Discovery

DevelopmentIntegration Reporting and Automation

  • Configure and develop scalableServiceNow solutions using out-of-the-box capabilities, configuration,integrations, automation, and controlled customization.

TestingDeployment and Technical Governance

ClientCollaboration and Professional Development

  • Participate in stakeholderworkshops, requirements gathering, process analysis, design reviews, solutiondemonstrations, sprint reviews, client training, and feedback sessions.
  • Communicate technical concepts,implementation decisions, issues, risks, and recommendations to technical andnon-technical stakeholders.

TheSolution Engineer supports Templar Shield’s Practice Leads and Architects bycontributing technical expertise to business-development activities andpractice growth.

Technical Knowledge and Skills

  • Strong working knowledge ofServiceNow Operational Technology Management, CMDB, CSDM, Service GraphConnectors, OT Discovery, Industrial Workspace, and related ServiceNowcapabilities.

Preferred Qualifications
