jobs.description:
Position: Credit Analyst (NZ)

Working Hours & Conditions: New Zealand business hours

Work Type: Independent Contractor

ABOUT THE COMPANY:

The company a premier New Zealand mortgage advisory business dedicated to supporting first-home buyers, existing homeowners, and property investors. The business provides tailored advice and assistance across home purchases, pre-approvals, refinancing, restructuring, top-ups, and investment-property lending. The company focuses on guiding clients seamlessly through the lending journey and structuring mortgages that align with their specific financial circumstances and long-term goals.

ROLE OVERVIEW:

The client is seeking an experienced and detail-oriented Credit Analyst with practical, recent experience in the New Zealand residential mortgage market to strengthen its application assessment, lender research, and submission capabilities.

In this analytical support role, you will analyze clients’ financial positions, assess borrowing capacity, complete complex serviceability calculations, and identify suitable bank and non-bank lender options based on current credit policies. Working closely with the Company Director and Mortgage Advisers, you will develop lending scenarios, prepare accurate mortgage applications, and identify credit risks or missing information prior to submission.

Note: This is an analytical support role. All final lending strategies, regulated financial advice, and recommendations to clients remain subject to review and approval by the authorized Mortgage Adviser.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Credit Assessment & Financial Analysis

  • Review client applications and supporting documentation (payslips, bank statements, loan statements, tax returns, and financial accounts).
  • Analyze income, expenses, assets, liabilities, credit commitments, and deposit positions across salaried, self-employed, and investment-property clients.
  • Calculate borrowing capacity, assess affordability, and identify unusual transactions, undisclosed liabilities, or income inconsistencies.
  • Document assumptions, calculations, credit risks, and outstanding requirements clearly, escalating complex or higher-risk files as appropriate.

Serviceability & Lending Scenarios

  • Accurately complete lender serviceability calculators and model various loan amounts, structures, terms, and repayment scenarios.
  • Compare servicing outcomes across New Zealand lenders, taking into account debt, credit limits, rental income, and specific servicing rules.
  • Review proposed lending structures for compliance with lender policy and prepare scenario summaries for the Mortgage Adviser.
  • Recalculate serviceability upon changes in interest rates, lending requirements, or client circumstances while maintaining meticulous records of calculations.

Lender Policy Research

  • Research and interpret current New Zealand bank and non-bank lender policies, comparing criteria across income treatment, deposit requirements, LVR restrictions, and acceptable securities.
  • Maintain internal policy reference notes, matrices, and reference materials.
  • Direct inquiries to lender representatives when authorized and communicate relevant policy changes to the advisory team.

Application Preparation & Submission Support

  • Ensure applications and supporting documents are complete, current, accurate, and ready for submission.
  • Draft comprehensive application summaries and supporting credit notes to clearly present client financial positions.
  • Assist with submitting applications via approved lender platforms, monitoring progress, and managing outstanding conditions, valuations, pricing requests, and approvals.
  • Support all transaction types including purchases, pre-approvals, refinancing, restructuring, top-ups, and refixes.

Compliance, File Quality & CRM Management

  • Ensure complete, compliant, and well-organized digital records in MYCRM and NZFSG.
  • Record detailed file notes on all client, adviser, lender, and third-party interactions.
  • Support the preparation of suitability and compliance documentation under adviser direction while safeguarding client confidentiality.
  • Flag missing approvals or potential compliance concerns and support internal file reviews or audits.

Stakeholder Communication & Process Improvement

  • Contact clients to request documents and clarify information clearly without providing unauthorized financial advice.
  • Liaise professionally with lenders, bank assessors, valuers, conveyancers, and accountants.
  • Help improve credit assessment templates, calculators, and internal checklists to minimize processing delays and rework.

Requirements

  • Industry Experience: Demonstrated recent experience as a Credit Analyst, Mortgage Adviser Assistant, Loan Processor, or Parabroker within the New Zealand mortgage industry.
  • Mortgage Knowledge: Strong practical understanding of New Zealand residential lending, lender policies, and required application documentation.
  • Systems Proficiency: Hands-on experience using MYCRM and NZFSG is required.
  • Technical & Analytical Skills: Proven capability to complete and interpret lender serviceability calculators, analyze complex income structures (salaried, self-employed, investors), and evaluate credit risks.
  • Communication & Detail: Excellent written and spoken English, high numerical accuracy, strong problem-solving skills, and the ability to explain complex requirements clearly.
  • Workplace Setup: A reliable internet connection, a quiet home-office setup, and availability to work during agreed New Zealand business hours.
  • Education: A relevant qualification in finance, banking, accounting, business, or financial services is advantageous. A New Zealand Certificate in Financial Services (or equivalent) is beneficial but not essential. Equivalent practical experience will be considered.

Preferred

  • Experience assessing complex applications for first-home buyers, existing homeowners, and property investors across both bank and non-bank lenders.
  • Hands-on experience evaluating self-employed borrowers and reviewing financial statements/tax returns.
  • Knowledge of current New Zealand mortgage industry compliance expectations and standards.
  • Experience collaborating directly with Mortgage Advisers or business principals.
  • Track record of creating lender matrices, credit assessment templates, or internal processing workflow improvements.

What You’ll Bring

  • Analytical Rigor: An eagle eye for detail with an innate ability to spot inconsistencies, unstated liabilities, and hidden risks in financial documents.
  • Proactive Ownership: Strong self-management skills to run multiple files simultaneously while keeping deadlines, tasks, and follow-ups strictly organized.
  • Clear Communication: Professionalism and clarity when liaising with internal team members, clients, and external stakeholders.
  • Adaptability: Up-to-date knowledge of evolving credit criteria and a continuous-improvement mindset toward internal templates and workflows.

jobs.description:
Namecheap is in the business of opening doors to online success. We make it easy for anyone to build a winning web presence — with simple domain registration, affordable hosting, trusted security and privacy products, and an award-winning customer service team available 24/7. As proud advocates for online privacy and net neutrality, we put clients first — which is why we're one of the web's largest registrars, with millions of happy customers and over 32 million domains under management (and counting).

About the role

Now, as we enter an ambitious new stage of growth, we're looking for a Financial Controller to own the integrity of our financial reporting and transform how it's produced. This is a hands-on build-and-lead role: modernizing our systems, bringing the accounting function to full US GAAP rigor, and building a leaner, more automated finance organization, reporting directly to the CFO.

Why this role

Most Controller roles are about keeping the financial engine running. This one is about rebuilding and fine-tuning that engine so we're ready to scale commercially.

You will rebuild our accounting function from first principles, with the resources of a profitable, PE-backed company behind you. For a finance leader who would rather design the system than inherit it, that combination is rare:

  • A genuine greenfield build: Rebuild the accounting function from the chart of accounts up — systems, close, controls, and reporting — and bring it to full US GAAP rigor as we scale.

  • Own the technology: Move us off legacy tooling onto a modern, AI-native ERP, and design an operating model built around automation from day one.

  • AI-native by design. Build a lean, senior team modeled on the most automated finance orgs in tech — where expert people focus on judgment and impact, and AI handles manual work.

  • Real ownership, and a career-defining role: Own the accounting function end to end, lead an established team, and partner with the CFO as they focus on strategic finance and treasury—building the experience that prepares you for your next leadership role.

  • Startup-like canvas, scale-up rewards: The build-from-scratch experience of an early-stage company, with compensation set well above typical early-stage benchmarks, plus potential equity in a business entering its next growth phase.

What you’ll own

Accounting & Close

  • Own the monthly, quarterly, and annual close, delivering accurate, timely consolidated financials.

  • Own the general ledger, technical accounting, and financial reporting — including revenue recognition across domains, renewals, hosting subscriptions, and marketplace/auction transactions; deferred revenue; and multi-currency and intercompany accounting.

  • Oversee accounting across diverse payment rails (cards, PayPal, crypto, bank transfer) and reconcile high-volume, low-value transaction flows.

  • Design and run an internal controls framework across multiple entities, currencies, and jurisdictions — right-sized to our stage.

  • Prepare board- and sponsor-ready reporting, partner with FP&A on variance analysis, and manage relationships with external auditors, tax advisors, and banking partners.

Rebuild & Transformation

  • Re-architect the accounting foundations from first principles and bring the function to full US GAAP rigor.

  • Partner with the CFO to select a modern, AI-native ERP, then lead the end-to-end implementation — design, data migration, testing, and go-live — moving us off legacy tooling.

  • Re-engineer close, reporting, and controls to be scalable, automated, and audit-ready as the business grows.

  • Lead change management across finance and adjacent functions (revenue operations, billing, product) and manage the transformation to measurable outcomes.

An AI-First Operating Model

  • Build accounting operations around automation from the ground up — close automation, reconciliation, anomaly detection, and AI-assisted reporting and analysis.

  • Design a lean, high-seniority team where experts focus on judgment and impact while AI handles the manual work, moving beyond a traditional monthly-close cadence.

  • Evaluate and adopt emerging finance-AI tooling, consistent with the AI-embedded philosophy already built into our own products.

Team Leadership

  • Lead and develop an established accounting team, reshaping structure and ownership as the operating model evolves.

  • Set the standard for a build-first culture — clear processes, strong documentation, and continuous improvement over legacy manual habits.

What you’ll bring

  • Big Four foundations: You trained at a top-tier global accounting firm, ideally with multi-entity consolidations and multi-currency environments and US GAAP exposure.

  • CPA, or an equivalent international qualification (e.g., ACCA, CA).

  • 8+ years of progressive accounting experience, including time as a Controller or Assistant Controller.

  • Deep technical accounting expertise: ASC 606 (multi-element, marketplace, and subscription revenue), ASC 350 (goodwill, intangibles, and capitalized software), ASC 830 (multi-currency operations), and ASC 805 (business combinations) — with the judgment to handle what's not in the textbook (e.g., crypto payment accounting under ASU 2023-08).

  • Hands-on ERP implementation experience: You’ve led or heavily contributed to a major ERP rollout, not just operated within one.

  • Experience in high-volume, low-ACV transaction flows (e-commerce, subscription, SaaS, or marketplace) is a strong plus.

  • A first-principles builder: You’d rather design systems than maintain them, and you’re energized by ambiguity and a blank canvas.

  • A proven transformation and change leader with specific processes you’ve rebuilt, systems you’ve implemented, and teams you’ve upskilled.

  • A genuine AI-native mindset: Real experience automating finance workflows, and a clear point of view on where AI creates leverage in close, reporting, and controls.

  • Comfort with the control and audit rigor of a larger or public company — and the judgment to right-size it for our stage.

What success looks like in year one

  • A new or significantly re-architected ERP live and stable, with the accounting team fully transitioned onto it

  • A documented finance transformation roadmap with clear milestones beyond year one

  • Close is faster and materially less manual, with automation embedded across reconciliation and reporting.

  • A strengthened internal controls framework appropriate to our scale and transaction complexity

  • The accounting foundations are rebuilt to full US GAAP rigor, from the chart of accounts up.

  • The team is reshaped into a leaner, more senior structure with clear ownership.

  • You’ve built a trusted partnership with the CFO, executive leadership, and CVC.

Highlights

100% remote Financial Controller modernizing systems, strengthening US GAAP rigor, and reporting to the CFO. Working hours: overlap between US Eastern Time and EU business hours.

Currently in the testing phase and approaching its soft launch, the platform features an AI-powered coaching assistant that uses Large Language Models (LLMs) to deliver structured, personalised coaching conversations.

The AI Coach operates within a clinically guided framework, incorporating structured coaching pathways, a toolkit of resources, conversational guidelines, and built-in safety mechanisms that can intervene when necessary.

Requirements

  • Proven experience shipping LLM-based products to production: prompt architecture, conversation state machines, RAG/retrieval, evals, moderation and safety handling - not just API calls
  • Strong backend engineering: Python, FastAPI (or similar), SQL/PostgreSQL, AWS; comfortable owning infrastructure, CI/CD and production operations solo

Nice to have:

You report directly to the founder, who is not technical. The Account Executive – MI Clarity is responsible for driving awareness, adoption, and utilization of MI Clarity, an AI-powered prognostic assay designed to assess both early and late distant recurrence risk in postmenopausal patients with HR-positive/HER2-negative, node-negative early-stage breast cancer.

The Account Executive will partner with oncologists, breast surgeons, pathologists, nurse navigators, and healthcare systems to educate stakeholders on the clinical value of the test, integrate the assay into clinical workflows, and increase appropriate utilization.

  • Position MI Clarity as a clinical decision-support tool that optimizes patient care, addressing questions related to assay performance, patient selection, workflow integration, turnaround time, and clinical interpretation.

jobs.description:
The Health Consortium of Greater San Gabriel Valley (Health Consortium) is a collaborative network of healthcare organizations, providers, and community agencies dedicated to improving health equity and access to integrated, quality, and culturally responsive services. Established in 2000, the Health Consortium supports vulnerable and diverse populations throughout Greater San Gabriel Valley by strengthening partnerships, facilitating information sharing, increasing access to resources, and enhancing the visibility of participating organizations.

The Health Consortium serves communities within Los Angeles County Service Planning Area 3 (SPA 3), spanning the foothill communities from Pasadena to Pomona and areas north and immediately to the south of the 10 Freeway. Employees contribute to building strong community partnerships and supporting initiatives that connect physical health, behavioral health, and social services to better meet the needs of individuals and families in the region.

The Health Consortium is seeking an experienced individual to serve as its Executive Director. The Executive Director provides strategic leadership, operational management, and administrative oversight to advance the Health Consortium's mission of improving health outcomes through cross-sector collaboration, systems integration, and community partnerships. The Health Consortium is fiscally sponsored by Heluna Health and the position will be hired as an employee of Heluna Health.

Working in close partnership with the Health Consortium's Co-Chairs, Steering Committee, fiscal sponsor, and community partners, the Executive Director is responsible for coalition coordination, resource and grant development and management, financial oversight, organizational operations, committee facilitation, stakeholder engagement, planning the Health Consortium's Annual Summit, and managing the Food for All San Gabriel Valley Program along with other organizational initiatives.

This position requires a high degree of independence, initiative, sound judgment, and the ability to manage multiple priorities while building and maintaining collaborative relationships across healthcare, public health, behavioral health, community-based organizations, government agencies, and philanthropic partners.

This is a full time, benefitted exempt position starting at $96,000.00 annually

This position will be remote but will require some local travel in the San Gabriel Valley area of Los Angeles County.

Employment is provided by Heluna Health.

Essential Functions

  • Coordinate and process financial approvals, invoices, vendor payments, and related organizational expenses in accordance with established protocols.
  • Monitor monthly financial reports, budgets, and grant expenditures to ensure accurate tracking and compliance with funding requirements.

Resource Development & Fundraising

  • Identify funding opportunities and develop competitive grant proposals.
  • Coordinate proposal narrative and budget development with partners and Heluna Health.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with current and prospective funders, public and private.
  • Prepare and submit timely, accurate, and comprehensive reports to funders.
  • Solicit contributions and sponsorships from Health Consortium partners and stakeholders.

Program Implementation Oversight and Management

  • Manage grant implementation timelines, compliance, monitoring, and reporting requirements
  • Oversee all aspects of program implementation to ensure activities remain aligned with approved goals, timelines, and deliverables.
  • Collect, analyze, and compile program data and support documentation for grant reporting.

Committee Leadership & Management

  • Provide leadership and administrative support for Health Consortium committees and workgroups.
  • Collaboratively develop community workplans and meeting agendas.
  • Facilitate and support meetings.
  • Conduct committee member outreach, engagement, and communications.
  • Conduct follow-up activities, research, outreach, and presenter coordination.
  • Collaborate with administrative support staff to prepare meeting materials, presentation, and follow-up notes.

Organizational Development

  • Support governance activities, including periodic review of bylaws and organizational polices.
  • Maintain Steering Committee membership and leadership succession planning.
  • Coordinate Co-Chair nomination and election processes.
  • Facilitate strategic planning and organizational evaluation activities.
  • Develop and strengthen internship and workforce development partnerships.

Summit Planning & Event Management

  • Lead planning and implementation of the Health Consortium's Annual Summit by:
    • Collaborating with planning committees to establish event priorities and objectives.
    • Developing event budgets and timelines.
    • Coordinating event logistics, venues, registration, speakers, sponsorships, vendors, and promotional activities.
    • Recruiting presenters and sponsors.
    • Managing communications with elected officials and community leaders.
    • Overseeing marketing materials and event communications.
    • Coordinating evaluations and post-event reporting.

Company Overview

Bloomlife is redesigning maternal care to improve the health of moms and babies. We partner with healthcare providers to enable high-quality patient-centered care to improve access and enable more efficient screening and management of maternal and fetal health. Our remote care platform combines connected devices, data analytics, and clinical services. At the center of our platform is a proprietary maternal-fetal monitor designed to remotely assess fetal health. By addressing modifiable risk factors, quickly detecting abnormalities, and predicting adverse events, Bloomlife aims to ensure every family gets a healthy start.

With a proprietary FDA-cleared fetal monitoring solution, proven reimbursement pathways, and commercial traction with leading healthcare organizations nationally, we’re ready to scale. Join us in building the market defining remote maternal care platform.

The Opportunity

We have signed some of the largest OB/GYN care delivery organizations in the country, practices are going live, and we're about to launch our home fetal NST offering. Now we need a proven seller to turn that momentum into scale.

As our Account Executive, you'll own deals end to end, from first conversation to signed contract. Your primary focus is OB/GYN and maternal-fetal medicine practices, with health systems as a secondary focus. You won't start cold: you'll begin with a ready-to-work list of practices inside regional and national contracts that are already signed with Bloomlife, then build a pipeline from there. Once a deal closes, our clinical implementation and operations teams take it to go-live.

This is a field role for a builder. As one of the first members of our commercial team, you'll shape our sales playbook, our messaging, and the launch of a new product line. You will report to the Chief Commercial Officer and work closely with the CEO to scale our commercial reach.

You must possess a proven track record of meeting and exceeding sales goals selling into women’s health organizations. You have deep, existing relationships with medical directors, clinical and quality leaders, and C-suite executives at MSOs, health systems, and large private practices.

You will handle the entire sales lifecycle—from initial lead generation to qualification, clinical workflow analysis and agreement —ensuring a seamless handoff to the implementation team for a successful launch.

Your Responsibilities and Impact will include:

Build and work the pipeline

  • Convert active leads: Turn prospects into active clinic deployments.
  • Expand the pipeline: Generate new leads within practices and health systems in your region, prioritizing favorable payer coverage for RPM.
  • CRM Discipline: Execute pipeline funnel management and prioritization, including lead tracking and stage assignment and progression, to drive increased velocity of closed deals.
  • Relationship Management: Leverage your existing networks of medical directors, clinical and quality leaders, and C-suite executives at MSOs, health systems, and large private practices to secure initial meetings and buy-in.
  • Be in the field: Meet clinicians, practice administrators, and nurse leaders in person, and represent Bloomlife at regional and national conferences and events such as ACOG, SMFM, and AWHONN.

Own the full sales cycle

  • Lead Generation: Proactively identify and penetrate new business opportunities within target health systems and practices across your assigned region.
  • Lead Qualification: Assess practice size, birth volume, high-risk patient mix, payer mix, EMR, and current standard of care.
  • Volume Forecasting: Provide accurate sales, revenue, and volume forecasting for pipeline accounts, giving leadership a reliable view of revenue opportunity.

  • Win Clinical Committee Approval: Present the clinical and financial case to decision makers, handle objections and competitive questions, and negotiate the contract to close.
  • Develop Practices Champions: Develop strong clinical, product and operations champions to drive deal closure and implementation planning.
  • Shape the Implementation Plan: Conduct detailed in-department workflow interviews with clinical staff to identify operational bottlenecks and draft the plan to integrate Bloomlife Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM) protocols smoothly into existing clinical workflows.
  • Implementation Handoff: Ensure a comprehensive, well-documented handoff to the clinical implementation and customer success teams so go-live is fast and the customer's first experience is strong to drive long-term adoption.

Sell on value

  • Build the Business Case: Use our ROI tools to show customers the revenue and capacity they gain by integrating Bloomlife Connects remote care programs
  • Introduce the Business Model: Speak confidently about pricing, reimbursement and billing workflows, documentation requirements, payer coverage, and EMR integration; bring in internal experts when needed.

  • Closing: Consistently meet or exceed quarterly and annual sales targets.

Responsibilities

Empower AI is seeking a Senior VoIP Engineer to own the architecture, engineering, and sustainment of enterprise Voice over IP infrastructure for a Department of War agency across NIPRNet, SIPRNet, and JWICS enclaves. The engineer manages Cisco Unified Communications Manager clusters, Unity Connection voicemail, Expressway and session border controllers, voice gateways, dial plans, and softphone (Jabber) services; serves as the Tier III/IV authority for the most complex voice incidents and PL1/PL2 outages; leads voice installation and modernization projects and site surveys; and ensures the voice infrastructure achieves and maintains STIG compliance and Authorization to Operate. The role mentors VoIP technicians and supports the Customer Communications Support Manager. This is a salaried, FLSA-exempt position in which you will independently analyze situations, determine the appropriate course of action, and exercise discretion and independent judgment on matters of significance to the program and its customers.

THIS IS AN REMOTE ROLE IN WITH UP TO 25% OF TRAVEL INVOLVED.

JOB DUTIES:

  • Own the design, engineering, and lifecycle of the enterprise VoIP architecture: CUCM clusters, Unity Connection, IM&P, Expressway/SBCs, voice gateways and trunks (DISN/DSN, SIP), dial plans, class of service, E911, and softphone (Jabber) services across enclaves.
  • Serve as the Tier III/IV escalation authority for complex voice incidents and PL1/PL2 outages, analyzing call detail records, traces, SIP/MGCP signaling, and QoS to root cause, engineering permanent fixes, and liaising with Cisco and carriers.

  • Own the design, engineering, and lifecycle of the enterprise unified communications architecture including CUCM clusters, Unity Connection, Expressway/SBCs, voice gateways, dial plans, VTC bridges and management, and integrations with collaboration platforms across multiple security enclaves.

As one of the leading writers of Federal Crop Insurance, AgriSompo North America combines industry experience, resources, capital and talent to deliver both traditional and innovative crop insurance and productivity tools to farmers, ranchers, insurers and agribusinesses in the United States. Through operating subsidiaries, Sompo International writes agriculture, casualty and other specialty, professional lines, property, marine/energy and aviation lines of insurance and catastrophe, property, casualty, professional lines and specialty lines of reinsurance.

As a leading provider of crop insurance and other agricultural risk management tools, we recognize that our success is derived directly from those whose contributions matter most: our people. AgriSompo North America has major offices in Lenexa, Kansas and Des Moines, Iowa as well as regional offices around the country. Python Software Architect- Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Python Software Architect
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
PositionType: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000–$150,000 Annually
ExperienceRequired: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Python Software Architect to design, build, and continuously enhance complex enterprise-grade applications, data-intensive services, and automation platforms. This is a hands-on engineering role focused on delivering robust, secure, and high-performance Python systems that operate reliably within distributed and mission-critical production environments. The ideal candidate will bring deep Python expertise combined with strong fundamentals in software architecture, data engineering, and operational support, and will partner closely with product, data, and infrastructure teams to translate ambiguous business problems into well-engineered technical solutions. You will be expected to think beyond surface-level fixes, identify root causes of complex issues, and proactively raise the engineering bar across the team.

Key Responsibilities
  • Provide end-to-end design, development, and advanced technical troubleshooting for complex enterprise-grade Python applications, reaching beyond routine approaches to solve novel and non-trivial technical problems.
  • Develop secure, high-quality, production-ready Python code and implement algorithms that perform reliably within distributed systems, with thoughtful consideration of concurrency, fault-tolerance, and observability.
  • Produce architecture and design artifacts for complex applications, ensuring that day-to-day development adheres to defined design constraints, performance requirements, and enterprise standards.
  • Develop and optimize data processing logic for large-scale datasets, including extraction, transformation, validation, deduplication, enrichment, and performance tuning to support both batch and near-real-time workloads.
  • Gather, analyze, and synthesize large and diverse datasets to support continuous improvement of applications and business processes, surfacing insights that lead to measurable improvements in product, reliability, or cost.
  • Develop reporting mechanisms, dashboards, and data visualizations where required to support operational insights, leveraging libraries and tools appropriate to the stakeholder audience.
  • Identify hidden defects, performance bottlenecks, and architectural weaknesses, and proactively implement improvements to coding standards, system reliability, and overall maintainability.
  • Contribute substantively to engineering best practices, conduct thorough peer code reviews, and participate constructively in architectural design discussions, mentoring less-senior engineers along the way.
  • Participate fully in Agile development cycles and CI/CD processes, ensuring consistent, stable, and frequent deployments with appropriate testing, rollback, and monitoring strategies in place.
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional stakeholders — product managers, data scientists, operations engineers, and business analysts — to clarify requirements and translate them into scalable technical solutions.
  • Support operational stability through structured incident response, debugging, log analysis, and post-incident reviews in enterprise environments, contributing actionable preventative measures.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Five or more years of applied Python development experience in enterprise-grade environments.
  • Strong experience building and maintaining large-scale production applications with significant uptime and reliability requirements.
  • Hands-on experience with relational database systems such as Oracle, MS SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or Sybase, including query tuning and schema design.
  • Strong understanding of the full software development lifecycle (SDLC), including requirements, design, build, test, release, and ongoing support.
  • Proven hands-on experience across system design, application development, automated testing, and operational support.
  • Strong working knowledge of data structures, algorithms, and computational efficiency, with the ability to make sound design trade-offs.
  • Demonstrated experience debugging and maintaining complex, enterprise-level applications in production.
  • Solid understanding of Agile methodologies, CI/CD practices, application resiliency patterns, and secure coding standards.
  • Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects in dynamic, fast-changing environments while keeping stakeholders well informed.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with experience collaborating with both technical and business teams.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Strong shell scripting skills in UNIX/Linux environments and comfort working with command-line tooling.
  • Solid grounding in mathematical and statistical concepts and the ability to translate them into code.
  • Hands-on experience with the Python data and ML ecosystem, including NumPy, Pandas, SciPy, Scikit-Learn, TensorFlow, and PyTorch.
  • Working exposure to AWS cloud services and cloud-native storage technologies such as S3, RDS, DynamoDB, and Glue.

jobs.description:
À propos d’Apertera

Apertera collabore avec les principaux cabinets d’avocats, institutions financières et organismes de réglementation du Canada afin d’offrir des services linguistiques juridiques et réglementaires de calibre supérieur. Nous combinons une expertise linguistique approfondie avec la technologie et l’innovation afin d’améliorer continuellement la façon dont nous accompagnons nos clients.

Le rôle

Votre mission consiste à assurer une qualité linguistique exceptionnelle pour nos clients. Vous traduirez et réviserez des documents juridiques et réglementaires hautement complexes, en veillant au respect des plus hauts standards d’exactitude, de cohérence et de jugement professionnel.

Chez Apertera, nous attendons de nos linguistes principaux qu’ils fassent plus que produire d’excellentes traductions. Nous recherchons des professionnels capables de bien comprendre nos clients, de prendre en charge leur approche linguistique, de cerner les occasions d’améliorer notre façon de les servir et de contribuer activement à l’évolution de nos services. Nous valorisons les personnes qui remettent en question les méthodes existantes, proposent de meilleures approches et assurent la mise en œuvre de ces améliorations.

Responsabilités

jobs.description:
This position may be filled prior to the posted deadline. Interested candidates are encouraged to apply as soon as possible.

Koniag Emerging Technologies is looking for a highly qualified, experienced and self-motivated individual to perform the duties of a Senior Databricks Engineer to support our client located in Washington, DC. This position requires an Active Secret clearance. This is a remote position.

Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) retirement plan, paid time off, paid parental leave, life and disability insurance, flexible spending accounts, commuter benefits and tuition reimbursement.

POSITION DESCRIPTION:

The Senior Databricks Engineer will be responsible for designing, developing, and deploying scalable data infrastructure while driving key data engineering initiatives. By leveraging the Databricks platform and deep expertise in modern data warehousing and the Medallion Architecture, the engineer will build data pipelines supporting the Department of State’s “4Ps” data lake. The ideal candidate will be able to support the following functions:

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with project managers, team members, and business owners to gather requirements, communicate progress, and ensure data meets customer needs.
  • Architecture & Design: Should be capable of architecting and implementing scalable, highly available data pipelines using Databricks, adhering strictly to the Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold layers) to ensure data quality, consistency, and optimized reporting.
  • Data Quality Governance & Monitoring: Establish comprehensive data quality standards and implement monitoring dashboards to enable business owners and responsible parties to track and proactively address data issues.
  • Pipeline Development: Write clean, efficient, and production-ready code using PySpark and SQL for complex data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL/ELT) processes. Expertise in DLT and structured streaming pipelines.
  • API Integration: Design and build robust data ingestion pipelines to reliably pull from various third-party external systems using RESTful API integrations.
  • Automated Deployments (CI/CD): Implement infrastructure and pipelines as code. Utilize Databricks Asset Bundles (DABs) integrated with Azure DevOps to manage and automate deployments across Development, Staging, and Production environments safely and reliably.
  • Code Reusability: Develop, package, and maintain custom Python libraries and modules to establish common frameworks used across multiple data projects and teams.
  • Data Warehousing: Apply foundational and advanced data warehousing concepts (e.g., dimensional modeling, slowly changing dimensions) to optimize data storage and retrieval for downstream analytics and business intelligence.
  • Performance Tuning: Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize Databricks clusters and Spark jobs to ensure maximum efficiency and cost-effectiveness.
  • External BI & Native Dashboarding: Securely sharing data with external BI tools (such as PowerBI or SAP BusinessObjects) and developing dashboards and capabilities natively within the Databricks environment.
  • Mentorship & Leadership: Serve as a technical SME for the data engineering team, conducting code reviews, establishing best practices, and mentoring other staff members.

Required Skills:

  • Active SECRET clearance
  • Knowledge of Object Oriented Programming (OOP) concepts and proficiency in one or more programming or scripting languages (Java, C#, Python, JavaScript, PowerShell)
  • Experience: 8+ years of dedicated Data Engineering experience, with at least 3+ years functioning in a senior capacity focused on the Databricks ecosystem.
  • Core Languages: Expert-level proficiency in PySpark and complex SQL.
  • Python Library Management: Proven ability to create, package, and manage custom Python libraries (e.g., building Wheel files) for scalable reuse across multiple data pipelines and projects.
  • API Data Ingestion: Deep understanding of HTTP REST methods (GET, POST, PUT, etc.) with hands-on experience extracting, paginating, and processing data from external API sources.
  • Frameworks & Methodology: Deep theoretical and practical understanding of modern Data Warehousing concepts and hands-on experience building out the Medallion Architecture.
  • DevOps & CI/CD: Proven experience automating Databricks deployments. You must have hands-on experience configuring and deploying Databricks Asset Bundles (DABs) using Azure DevOps (creating YAML pipelines, managing service principals, and handling multi-workspace deployments).
  • Cloud Platforms: Strong familiarity with the broader cloud ecosystem surrounding Databricks (e.g., Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2, Azure Key Vault).
  • Version Control: Proficiency with Git-based version control workflows.
  • Concise and comprehensive written and oral communication skills for both technically understanding and customer usage support.

Desired Skills:

  • Experience with a wide range of data products, BI tools, and visualization libraries such as Tableau, PowerBI, Jupyter Notebooks, d3js, and Analytics Search Tools such as Elasticsearch, SOLR, Lucene
  • Experience working with HR application (PeopleSoft) data for reporting purposes.
  • 3+ year(s) .NET, Java or similar OOP experience
  • Experience writing Oracle PL/SQL queries, packages, and procedures.
  • Experience architecting Data Vault 2.0 solutions.

If you require an accommodation to navigate or apply for a position on our website, please get in touch with Heaven Wood via e-mail at or by calling 703-488-9377 to request accommodations. jobs.description:
Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.

.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.

.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Software Engineer L2 (Messaging Channels).

About the job

This position is needed to power the future of communications by developing the connectivity, compliance and rich messaging features required to enable adoption of new messaging channels and drive continued growth of existing channels such as WhatsApp, RCS and Facebook Messenger. Our team navigates the complexities of requirements across many channels to enable Twilio customers to have a unified and seamless experience. We enable startups, non-profits and Fortune 500 companies to send billions of messages a year on our platform. We are looking for candidates passionate about designing, developing, deploying and operating software solutions at scale to help Twilio deliver the best user experience for modern, rich messaging.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Build High-Scale APIs: Design, develop, and maintain high-performance REST APIs and backend microservices using Java and Go.
  • Power Rich Messaging: Build and enhance rich messaging features, managing high-throughput message routing and delivery pipelines.
  • Operate Cloud Systems: Deploy and support backend services in AWS (open to Azure/GCP experience), prioritizing system reliability, low latency, and fault tolerance.
  • Leverage Modern AI Tools: Actively integrate AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude, Copilot) into your daily workflow to accelerate output and elevate code quality.
  • Own System Reliability: Support team on-call rotations to maintain high availability and operational excellence for critical communications services.
  • Collaborate Remotely: Partner asynchronously across distributed engineering teams using clear technical written and verbal communication.

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

Required:

  • 3+ years of hands-on software development experience building backend services in Java or Go
  • Experience designing and building production RESTful APIs as a core part of your day-to-day role
  • Experience operating distributed systems on top of cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred, or equivalent experience with Azure/GCP)
  • Hands-on use of AI development tools (e.g. Claude, Copilot) to streamline coding, debugging or documentation
  • Strong written and verbal technical communication skills
  • Ability to participate in on-call rotation (includes weekends and holidays)

Desired:

  • Experience with NoSQL datastores (e.g. DynamoDB)
  • Experience with message queuing (e.g. Simple Queue Service)
  • Experience deploying and supporting containerized applications in Kubernetes
  • Prior experience with telecom or rich messaging platforms (RCS, SMS/MMS, OTT messaging)

Location

This role will be remote and based in the USA

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Compensation

[OPTION A: NON OTE ROLES]

*Please note the salary range information provided applies only to candidates residing in California, Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York, Vermont, Washington D.C., and Washington State due to local requirements. Compensation for candidates in other locations will be discussed during the hiring process. Please note that hiring for this role is not restricted to the locations listed above.

The estimated pay ranges for this role are as follows:

The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location.

Application deadline information (required for ALL US jobs)

Applications for this role are intended to be accepted until 12/15/2026, but may change based on business needs.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

.

Stay alert to recruitment fraud

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @ email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.

.

Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. jobs.title: Director, Sales & Customer Success
jobs.excerpt: About Empower Community Care Empower Community Care is a family of mission-driven organizations delivering evidence-based behavioral health, child welfare, and community care programs and services.
jobs.description:
About Empower Community Care

Empower Community Care is a family of mission-driven organizations delivering evidence-based behavioral health, child welfare, and community care programs and services. Our portfolio includes BSFT, Carey Group, Evidence-Based Associates (EBA), FFT LLC, MST Services, Orbis, and The Incredible Years — each advancing outcomes for children, families, and the communities we serve.

Why Empower Community Care, and Why Now

Empower's mission is to develop, deliver, and sustain evidence-based behavioral health programs, combining clinical excellence with the workforce, data, and technology infrastructure that make lasting system change possible. Our vision is to be the system support partner that states and communities turn to when they need evidence-based care to take hold and hold, not just get piloted and reported on. At the center of that work is a simple belief: families do better when care meets them where they are. Everyone on our team, including the people representing our work in the field, gets to see that belief turn into real families staying together and thriving.
Today, Empower serves more than 3,000,000 families through 2,000-plus customers across all 50 states and 35 countries. We work across the five systems where families need us most: youth justice, child welfare, behavioral health, adult justice and corrections, and early childhood and schools. Joining our sales team means representing evidence-based programs, including MST, FFT, BSFT, and Incredible Years, alongside the assessments, professional development, implementation support, and technology that make those programs work in practice, not just on paper.
Empower is entering a defining, exciting period of growth. We are bringing seven subsidiary brands together into one connected platform, deepening relationships with state governments and Medicaid systems, and building the infrastructure, including a coordinated regional pod model, needed to support that growth. This Sales Director role sits at the center of that transformation: the chance to lead our Specialty Sales Reps through the transition from individual, program-aligned roles into a coordinated regional pod model, help shape how Empower shows up in the market, and define what it means to sell a unified system rather than a single program. Few sales leaders get to join an organization at this exact inflection point, where the platform, the market demand, and the mission are all coming together at once. For a builder who wants real ownership over both strategy and execution, there may not be a better moment to join.

Position Summary

Empower Community Care is seeking an experienced, hands-on Director, Sales & Customer Success to build and lead our specialty sales and customer success teams. Today, our Specialty Sales Reps function as independent contributors aligned to individual programs. This is a foundational leadership role: the Director, Sales & Customer Success will bring structure, coaching, and consistency to this team as it exists today, while helping architect and lead the transition toward a regional pod model over time.
Reporting to the Chief Growth Officer, this role will manage and coach the Specialty Sales Reps aligned to our community-based clinical programs (MST, FFT, BSFT), early childhood and prevention programming (Incredible Years), and assessment and behavior-change tools (Orbis/Carey Group), along with the Customer Success function. Enterprise Sales Reps report directly to the CGO; the Director, Sales & Customer Success will work in close, daily partnership with Enterprise reps to ensure tight collaboration, consistent hand-offs, and a coordinated customer experience across Empower's capabilities: evidence-based programs (MST, FFT, BSFT, and Incredible Years), Assessment & Behavioral Change Solutions, and Organizational Strategy and Advisory.
The ideal candidate is a builder who brings rigor and consistency to pipeline and forecasting discipline, is energized by turning a high-level structure into clear process and team habits, and is genuinely excited to use AI and modern sales tools to remove friction from the sales process. This person will propose the hiring plan for the sales team — identifying, interviewing, and recommending candidates, with final signoff from the CGO — and will be a key architect of Empower's move from independent sales roles toward a coordinated pod model. This role will also help shape how sales and business development represent Empower in the market as the organization evolves from a house of brands to a branded, unified platform, including representing Empower at key industry conferences. Empower moves quickly to adopt AI and expects this leader to actively identify where automation and AI-enabled workflows can improve rep productivity, forecasting accuracy, and customer responsiveness.

Key Responsibilities

  • Team leadership: Lead, coach, and develop the Specialty Sales Reps and Customer Success team members, driving a consistent standard for pipeline discipline, activity, and quota attainment across today's independent role structure.
  • Hiring plan: Propose the hiring plan for the sales organization — headcount, sequencing, and role design — and lead sourcing and interviewing for open and new roles, with final signoff from the Chief Growth Officer on all hires.
  • Enterprise/Specialty coordination: Partner closely with the Chief Growth Officer and Enterprise Sales Reps to operationalize the Enterprise/Specialty commercial model, including clear collaboration rules, deal routing, and account hand-offs so opportunities move smoothly between system-level and program-level conversations.
  • Sales management: Own day-to-day sales management: pipeline reviews, forecasting, deal coaching, territory and account assignment, and performance management across the sales team.
  • RevOps partnership: Partner closely with the Sales/RevOps Manager, who owns HubSpot CRM administration, on pipeline stages, forecasting logic, activity tracking, and reporting needs for the sales organization, ensuring the system reflects how the team actually sells and stays aligned with NetSuite for revenue and contract data.
  • AI & automation: Actively identify and implement AI-enabled workflows and automation across the sales process — prospecting, call preparation, proposal generation, CRM hygiene, and reporting — to reduce manual work and increase rep capacity for client-facing time.
  • Pod model transition: Partner with the CGO and RevOps to design and lead the organization's transition from today's independent-role structure toward a regional pod model, including defining what a fully functioning pod looks like, sequencing the rollout, and building the commission, territory, and process infrastructure to support it.
  • Brand evolution: Support Empower's evolution from a house of brands to a branded house — helping shape how sales and business development represent “One Empower” in the market, and ensuring reps can speak to the platform as well as their individual program or brand.
  • Cross-sell strategy: Drive cross-sell and expansion motion across Empower's seven subsidiary brands, ensuring Specialty Reps understand the full portfolio and know when to pull in an Enterprise Rep or a peer Specialty Rep on a joint opportunity.
  • Market presence: Attend key industry conferences and events to build brand awareness, represent Empower's platform in the market, and develop networking and collaboration opportunities that support pipeline and partnership development.
  • Onboarding & ramp: Build and execute onboarding and ramp plans for new and existing sales hires, defining clear milestones for productivity and quota readiness.
  • Implementation hand-off: Partner with Implementation Success under operations and the Program Delivery team to ensure a clean hand-off process from sale to implementation, with clear accountability for adoption and renewal signals feeding back into the sales process.
  • Executive reporting: Provide regular, decision-oriented pipeline, forecast, and team-performance updates to the CGO and executive leadership, including clear visibility into hiring progress and the pod-model transition.
  • Voice of the field: Represent the voice of the field sales team in shaping go-to-market strategy, marketing plans, and product/program feedback loops.

Required Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in business, healthcare administration, or a related field; equivalent experience considered.
  • Sales leadership experience: 7+ years of progressive sales experience, including 3+ years directly managing and coaching a field or specialty sales team, ideally in a healthcare, behavioral health, human services, or public-sector-adjacent environment.
  • Builder track record: Demonstrated success building or scaling a sales function, with a track record of turning a high-level structure into working process, tools, and team habits.
  • Pipeline & CRM discipline: Strong pipeline management and forecasting discipline, with hands-on CRM fluency; direct experience with HubSpot strongly preferred.
  • RevOps/ERP comfort: Comfort partnering with finance/RevOps on data that lives in an ERP system; familiarity with NetSuite a plus.
  • Multi-buyer coaching: Proven ability to coach a team selling complex, consultative offerings to multiple buyer types (e.g., government/system-level buyers and program-level clinical or operational buyers), and to instill judgment about how and when to route opportunities between them.
  • Cross-functional collaboration: Excellent coaching, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills; able to work effectively with sales reps, marketing, RevOps, Customer Success, and program delivery leadership.
  • Hiring experience: Direct hiring experience — sourcing, interviewing, and building a business case for candidates — and comfort proposing a hiring plan to an executive stakeholder for final approval.
  • Customer Success:Experience leading or managing a customer success, account management, or renewal function.
  • RevOps partnership model: Experience partnering with a RevOps, sales operations, or CRM administrator function rather than owning the system directly — comfortable influencing CRM process and data standards through collaboration.
  • AI enthusiasm: Genuine enthusiasm for using AI and modern sales tools to improve team productivity, with a track record of introducing new tools or workflows that reps actually adopt.

Preferred Skills & Experience

  • Sector experience: Experience in behavioral health, evidence-based programs, child and family services, human services, education, or criminal justice/juvenile justice markets.
  • Government/MCO selling: Experience selling or managing sales into government and managed care organization (MCO) buyers, including familiarity with multi-year, multi-program contract vehicles.
  • Comp design: Experience designing or refining commission plans and territory structures alongside RevOps or sales operations.
  • Structural transitions: Experience leading a sales team through a structural transition — such as moving from individual contributor roles to a pod, squad, or territory-team model.
  • Brand consolidation: Experience supporting a brand or portfolio consolidation — e.g., helping a multi-brand organization move toward a single, unified market-facing identity or platform story.
  • Conference representation: Comfortable and effective representing an organization at industry conferences and events, with a track record of turning conference presence into pipeline, partnerships, or brand visibility.
  • AI tools: Hands-on experience with AI-enabled sales tools (e.g., AI note-taking, call intelligence, prospecting or proposal automation) and a point of view on responsible, effective adoption — including sound judgment around data privacy, accuracy, and appropriate human review.
  • Lean/fast-moving orgs: Experience working in a lean, fast-moving commercial organization where the leader is expected to be both strategic and hands-on.

Additional Requirements

  • Background Check: Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check, consistent with applicable law and Empower's standard hiring practices.
  • Confidentiality: This role may involve exposure to confidential organizational, financial, and/or clinical program information. The employee must maintain strict confidentiality and comply with Empower's internal data governance and confidentiality policies.
  • Work Environment: This is a remote, computer-based position requiring prolonged periods of sitting and extended use of a computer, keyboard, and video-conferencing tools, along with travel of approximately 25–35% of the time for in-person meetings, client engagements, and industry conferences. Reasonable accommodations will be made for qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with the ADA.
  • Other Duties: This job description reflects the general nature and level of work performed and is not intended to be a comprehensive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Benefits

Programme Manager - Migration & Integrations

About OrderYOYO

We help takeaways and restaurants succeed online by providing them with personalised branded mobile apps, websites and personalised marketing. We are here to ensure that small to medium-sized restaurants and small chains are not subjected to high commissions, and giving the restaurant the ownership of their success!

We serve restaurants across multiple markets, including the UK, Ireland, DACH, the Netherlands and the Nordics, and acquisitions are one part of how we grow. Each business we acquire brings its own platform, data and restaurant partners, and bringing them onto OrderYOYO safely is how we protect and build on that value.

Purpose of the role

You will lead the technology integration and migration of businesses that join OrderYOYO, from technical due diligence and integration planning through migration, stabilisation and the retirement of legacy platforms.

You will own the integrated programme plan across engineering, product, data and customer-facing teams, protecting restaurant continuity and tracking delivery costs and agreed benefits.

You will coordinate dependencies with Finance, People, Commercial and other functional owners, rather than owning every aspect of corporate integration.

Key responsibilities

Programme leadership

  • Own end-to-end programme plans and a consolidated view of scope, timelines, dependencies, budget forecasts and risks.
  • Lead workstream owners, agree priorities and capacity with functional leads, and run governance, escalating unresolved trade-offs to the CTPO.
  • Embed lessons learned into a repeatable migration and integration approach.

Pre-completion and Day 1

  • Inform due diligence with assessments of migration complexity, product gaps, dependencies, effort, costs and delivery risks.
  • Prepare integration plans before completion and coordinate Day 1 access, environments, tooling and working practices with incoming teams, engineering, IT and security.
  • Coordinate early technical and compliance assessments with specialists and track follow-up actions.

Data and systems

  • Coordinate data migration and integration into our data platform and business systems with data and engineering teams, agreeing mappings, quality checks and reporting requirements.

Customer migration

  • Segment customers by size, value, product usage and complexity; lead platform gap analysis and scope decisions.
  • Recommend migration waves and sequencing based on customer impact, technical readiness and capacity, adapting plans as capabilities mature and lessons emerge.
  • Agree product, data, operational and customer-readiness criteria; coordinate testing and reconciliation of order flows, payments and key integrations, securing accountable-owner sign-off.
  • Coordinate wave runbooks covering preparation, cutover, validation, rollback and support; lead go/no-go recommendations for approval by accountable business and technical owners.
  • Own operational handover, including named support owners, stabilisation exit criteria and business acceptance; plan controlled legacy retirement after migration.

Stakeholders

  • Align engineering, product, customer-facing and finance teams around one plan and timeline, working with customer-facing teams to keep restaurant partners informed and supported.

Commercial outcomes and reporting

  • Partner with Finance to establish and track business cases, covering migration and parallel-running costs, revenue at risk, legacy-retirement savings and forecast cost to complete.
  • Verify realised benefits with business owners and report progress, customer experience and value delivered to the CTPO and leadership team.

Skills and experience required

  • 5+ years of programme management experience in a technology organisation, including at least 3 years leading platform migrations, customer migrations or post-acquisition integrations.
  • Demonstrated ownership of complex, customer-facing platform migrations, including readiness assessment, cutover, post-migration stabilisation and transition into normal operations.
  • Strong technical literacy: comfortable discussing APIs, data pipelines, CRM migrations, cutover plans and infrastructure decommissioning with engineers.
  • Experience segmenting large customer bases into migration waves, with detailed run books, rollback, hypercare and clear go or no-go criteria.
  • Commercial judgement: you can weigh the cost of a feature gap against the revenue at risk and drive a decision.
  • Excellent stakeholder management across engineering, product, commercial and executive audiences, with a proven ability to secure commitments, resolve competing priorities and lead delivery without relying on direct line-management authority.
  • Clear, concise written and verbal communication, including executive-level reporting.
  • Comfortable working across countries, cultures and time zones.

Nice to have

  • Experience in SaaS, restaurant technology, food ordering, payments or marketplaces.
  • Experience with data platform and CRM migrations.
  • Direct post-acquisition integration experience, and running a repeatable migration approach across multiple programmes.
  • A recognised programme management qualification such as MSP, PRINCE2 or PgMP.

What we offer

  • A senior role with direct visibility to the executive team and real influence on how OrderYOYO grows.
  • Ownership of our migration and integration capability from day one, with the autonomy to shape how it works.
  • Room to grow: as the portfolio expands, the opportunity to build this capability into a dedicated function and lead it.
  • Work across nine European markets alongside engineering, product, data and commercial teams.

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated IT Network Administrator / Operation Technology (OT) to join our team. As an IT / OT Network Administrator, you will be responsible for implementing, managing, and maintaining the network infrastructure used in our operation technology and information technology systems. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop and implement robust, reliable, and secure IT/OT network solutions that align with business goals and industry best practices. This role requires a deep understanding of networking principles, network security measures, IT/OT systems, cybersecurity, and the ability to maintain and administrate scalable and resilient network architectures.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Deploy, and manage the operation technology (OT) / IT network infrastructure, including switches, routers, firewalls, and other network devices.
  • Maintain and manage the operation technology (OT) / IT network architecture based on business requirements and industry best practices.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to understand their needs and translate them into technical requirements and network design specifications.
  • Implement secure and resilient network solutions for OT / IT systems, considering factors such as availability, performance, scalability, and redundancy.
  • Monitor and maintain the performance, availability, and security of the OT / IT network.
  • Implement and enforce network security measures, such as access controls, firewall rules, intrusion detection systems, and data encryption.
  • Ensure compliance with relevant standards, regulations, and cybersecurity requirements in the design and implementation of the OT network.
  • Participate in incident response activities, including investigating security incidents and implementing corrective actions.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless integration of OT systems with other IT infrastructure components.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve network-related issues, including network outages, connectivity problems, and performance bottlenecks.
  • Monitor network traffic and analyze network data to identify patterns and anomalies.
  • Create and maintain network documentation, including network diagrams, configurations, and standard operating procedures.
  • Stay current with industry trends, best practices, and emerging technologies related to OT networking and cybersecurity, and network architecture.
  • Provide training and guidance to end-users on network usage, security protocols, and best practices.
  • Collaborate with vendors and service providers to ensure the successful implementation and ongoing support of the OT / IT network infrastructure.
  • Collaborate with IT and OT teams to integrate the OT network with other IT infrastructure components, such as enterprise networks and data centers.
  • Work closely with cybersecurity teams to implement network security controls, such as firewalls, intrusion detection systems, and access controls, to protect the OT network.
  • Provide guidance and mentorship to network administrators and other IT personnel on OT network architecture, best practices, and emerging technologies.
  • Conduct proof-of-concept and pilot projects to evaluate new network technologies and assess their feasibility and suitability for the OT environment.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, or a related field (or equivalent work experience).
  • Proven experience as a network administrator, preferably in an operation technology (OT) / IT environment.
  • Proven experience as a network Engineer or a similar role, with a focus on operation technology (OT) networks.
  • Strong knowledge of networking principles, protocols, routing, switching, and subnetting.
  • Proficiency in network design and architecture principles, including network segmentation, redundancy, and high availability.
  • Strong knowledge of networking protocols, routing, switching, and subnetting.
  • Understanding of IT cybersecurity principles and best practices, particularly in the context as it relates to OT networks.

You'll figure out what will generate pipeline for each one, make the case for it, and then build it and run it.

Managing a set caseload of mixed acuity members, reviewing and/or obtaining member data and entry in HealthMap’s Care Management documentation system (Compass), completing member health and social determinants of health screenings, medication reconciliation, creation and maintaining member-centric care plans, updates of identified problems, barriers, interventions, and goals and assistance with ongoing case management. The Care Navigator will collaborate with internal and external (physicians, nurses, and other healthcare personnel) to assure positive patient outcomes and care coordination.

Responsibilities

  • Handle in and outbound calls delivering world-class service to our members
  • Educate kidney health and related co-morbid conditions as well as optimizing renal replacement therapy by educating members on the types of dialysis and transplant options
  • Engage members into HealthMap’s Kidney Health Program
  • Follow up with members based on complexity and cadence by policy
  • Serve as patient advocate for responding and working to resolve concerns or barriers
  • Utilize community resources and programs in care planning
  • Serve as liaison between the patient, the patient’s support network, treating physician, and other ancillary providers as a member of an interdisciplinary care team to coordinate care, resolve nursing problems and assist patients in meeting individualized goals
  • Notify providers of identified patient needs based on policy
  • Comply with HIPAA privacy laws and all other federal, state, and local regulations
  • Comply with company-defined operational policies and procedures
  • Comply with company security policies
  • Accountable for individual metrics and key performance indicators and identified by the organization
  • Navigate technical applications - Excel, OneNote, Outlook, and Word
  • Support after hours and various time zones based on business need

Requirements

  • CCM preferred

jobs.description:
At PrimeVigilance, PV Officers are independent case processing team members who are expected to manage a variety of case processing services with full accountability.

If you join PrimeVigilance, you can expect to work with teams of different sizes, from small clinical trial, to large, generic post-marketing teams. We are always looking for proactive, capable and motivated individuals who aim to surpass any target set in front of them.

The PV Officer should be a Life science / bio medical background graduate or have other healthcare related degree qualification (chemistry, biology, biotechnology, veterinary science etc.) and have demonstrated experience with several years in case processing. The PV Officer will be working as part of a project team, performing, and supporting contracted pharmacovigilance activities on behalf of PrimeVigilance.

Responsibilities include:

  • Processing of Individual Case Safety Reports from all sources (post-marketing and clinical trials, including device and combination products) in compliance with applicable regulations, PrimeVigilance procedures and in accordance with client specific requirements and timelines. As a key member there is an expectation to effectively cover all steps of a workflow cycle, except Medical Review.
  • Independent SAE/SUSAR Management (submissions, unblinding, clinical trial reconciliations)
  • Preparation of database outputs for periodic reporting (PBRER, DSUR, PADER, etc.)
  • Mentoring and training of new and more junior employees within the department, including procedure optimization and development
  • Life science / bio medical background – healthcare related degree (chemistry, biology, biotechnology, veterinary science) and demonstrated experience in Pharmacovigilance case processing
  • Demonstrated case processing experience
  • Time and issue management, delegation, organization and multitasking skills with good attention to detail
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills
  • Advanced English skills, both verbal and written, at least C1

When you join Ergomed Group, you make a difference by helping to bring safe and effective pharmaceutical treatment to patients around the world. You’ll join a passionate and collaborative team of experts in clinical research, pharmacovigilance, and quality consulting.

  • Integrity and trust: we do the right thing, especially when it is hard.

  • Drive and passion: we care about the outcome, because someone is waiting on it.

  • Agility and responsiveness: we move quickly, because patients cannot wait.

  • Belonging: everyone is welcome, and every voice counts.

  • Collaborative partnerships: we go further by going together.

We look forward to welcoming your application.

Medicine moves forward here. So will you.

At PrimeVigilance, patient safety is not one part of the job. It is why we exist.

Our teams help clients navigate complex regulations while keeping patient safety at the center of every decision, from early development through to post-marketing surveillance. Increasingly, the value we create is not only in processing safety data but in interpreting it: spotting the signal that matters early and turning it into insight our clients can act on.

That work takes curious minds, problem-solvers and experts who care about getting it right. It also takes a culture worth staying for. Across Europe, North America, South America, Asia and Australia, we work in an environment built on kindness, flexibility, growth and belonging, where colleagues support one another and good ideas are heard wherever they come from.

If you want a role with real purpose, global reach and the chance to keep growing while you help protect patients, you will feel at home here. We would love to hear from you.
