    1. Your California Privacy Rights

    2. Right to Know

    As a California consumer, you have the right to request that we disclose certain information to you about our collection, use, disclosure, or sale of your personal information over the past 12 months. Once we receive and confirm your verifiable consumer request, and subject to certain limitations that we describe below, we will disclose such information. You have the right to request any or all of the following:

  • The categories of Personal Information that we have collected about you.

  • The categories of sources from which the Personal Information is collected.

  • Our business or commercial purpose for collection, use, or disclosure of that Personal Information.

  • The categories of third parties with whom we sell or share that personal information.

    1. Right to Data Portability

    You have the right to request a copy of Personal Information we have collected and maintained about you in the past 12 months. The CCPA allows you to request this information from us up to twice during a 12-month period. We will provide our response in a readily usable (in most cases, electronic) format.

    1. Right to Delete

    You have the right to request that we delete any of your Personal Information that we collected from you and retained, subject to certain exceptions. Once we receive and confirm your verifiable consumer request, we will delete (and direct our service providers to delete) your Personal Information from our records unless an exception applies. For example, we may deny your deletion request if retention of the Personal Information is:

  • Necessary to detect security incidents, protect against malicious, deceptive, fraudulent, or illegal activity; or prosecute those responsible for that activity;

  • Reasonably anticipated within the context of your employment or engagement, or application for employment, with us;

  • For solely internal uses that are reasonably aligned with your expectations based on your relationship with us;

  • Necessary to comply with a legal obligation; or

  • Otherwise necessary for internal use in a lawful manner that is compatible with the context in which you provided the Personal Information.

    1. Right to Correct

    You have the right to request the correction of any Personal Information we maintain about you.

    1. Right to Limit the Use or Disclosure of Sensitive Personal Information

    You have the right to limit the use or disclosure of your Sensitive Personal Information (“SPI”) if we are using your SPI beyond what is reasonable and proportionate within the context of your relationship with us as an employee or job applicant. You can make a request for us to limit the use or disclosure of your SPI by emailing us at .

    1. Right to Nondiscrimination

    You have the right not to receive discriminatory treatment by us for the exercise of your CCPA privacy rights.

    1. Exercising Your California Privacy Rights

    To exercise the rights described above, please submit a request to us by contacting us at .

    After submitting a request, we will take steps to verify your identity in order for us to properly respond and/or confirm that it is not a fraudulent request. In order to verify your identity, we will request, at a minimum, that you provide your name, email address, phone number, address, and relationship to us, so that we can seek to match this information with the information existing in our systems. When providing us this information, you represent and affirm that all information provided is true and accurate. If we are unable to verify that the consumer submitting the request is the same individual about whom we have collected personal information, we may contact you for more information, or we may not be able to meet your request.

    Only you, or an agent legally authorized to act on your behalf, may make a verifiable request related to your Personal Information. If you are making a request as the authorized agent of a California consumer, we will ask you also submit reliable proof that you have been authorized in writing by the consumer to act on such consumer’s behalf.

    We will make every effort to respond to your request within 45 days from when you contacted us. If you have a complex request, the CCPA allows us up to 90 days to respond. We may contact you within 45 days from the date you contacted us to inform you if we need more time to respond.

    1. Data Retention Periods

    Personal Information will be stored in accordance with applicable laws and kept as long as Company has an ongoing legitimate business need to carry out the purposes described in this Notice or as otherwise required by applicable law. Generally this means your Personal Information will be retained until the end or your employment, employment application, or work relationship with us plus a reasonable period of time thereafter to respond to employment or work-related inquiries, comply with regulatory obligations, or to deal with any legal matters (e.g. judicial or disciplinary actions), document the proper deductions during and on termination of your employment or work relationship (e.g. to tax authorities), or to provide you with ongoing pensions or other benefits.

    1. Updates to this Notice

In such cases, we will indicate at the top of the Notice when it was most recently updated, and if we make a material change, we will inform you, for example, on our intranet or by company-wide email. jobs.excerpt: About AlphaSense: The world’s most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision-making.
jobs.description:
About AlphaSense:

The world’s most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision-making. With market intelligence and search built on proven AI, AlphaSense delivers insights that matter from content you can trust. Our universe of public and private content includes equity research, company filings, event transcripts, expert calls, news, trade journals, and clients’ own research content.

The acquisition of Tegus by AlphaSense in 2024 advances our shared mission to empower professionals to make smarter decisions through AI-driven market intelligence. Together, AlphaSense and Tegus will accelerate growth, innovation, and content expansion, with complementary product and content capabilities that enable users to unearth even more comprehensive insights from thousands of content sets. Our platform is trusted by over 6,000 enterprise customers, including a majority of the S&P 500. Founded in 2011, AlphaSense is headquartered in New York City with more than 2,000 employees across the globe and offices in the U.S., U.K., Finland, India, Singapore, Canada, and Ireland. Come join us!

About the Role:

As a Senior Engineer, QE, you own test strategy and coverage for your team's features and act as a strategic quality partner to the engineers who build them. You design test plans, build and evolve automation frameworks, and embed quality-by-design.You partner closely with developers, product managers, and platform teams to define test requirements, guide teams toward sustainable quality practices, and help us ship with confidence at velocity.

You will:

Define and execute test strategies across UI, API, and service layers to ensure comprehensive coverage.Develop and maintain reliable automation frameworks and performance testing suites.Utilize AI-assisted tools and agentic workflows to accelerate testing and debugging cycles.Lead risk assessments, release validations, and root-cause analyses for critical issues.Implement shift-left practices and enforce quality gates within development teams.

Desired Skills:

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in software quality engineering roles
  • Deep proficiency in testing TypeScript/JavaScript and modern frontend ecosystems (React, Webpack, or similar).
  • Expert-level experience with Playwright or comparable browser automation frameworks (Cypress, Selenium WebDriver) for end-to-end testing.
  • Strong experience with unit and component testing frameworks such as Vitest, Jest, or React Testing Library.
  • Proven track record of designing and building test automation frameworks from scratch or significantly evolving existing ones at scale.
  • Solid understanding of CI/CD systems (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Buildkite, Gitlab or similar) and how to integrate and optimize test suites within them.
  • Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or Claude for accelerating test authoring, code review, and debugging.
  • Hands-on experience with Allure or similar test reporting/analytics platforms.
  • Understanding of AI/ML-powered products and the unique testing challenges they present (non-deterministic outputs, data quality, model evaluation).
  • Experience in SaaS, fintech, or market intelligence domains.
  • Familiarity with performance and load testing tools (k6, Lighthouse, Artillery).
  • Familiarity with visual regression testing (Percy, Chromatic, Playwright visual comparisons).
  • Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP).

AlphaSense is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals. All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling AlphaSense’s commitment to equal employment opportunity. AlphaSense does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, religion, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, military or veteran status, disability, or any other non-merit factor. This policy applies to every aspect of employment at AlphaSense, including recruitment, hiring, training, advancement, and termination.

In addition, it is the policy of AlphaSense to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees who have protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances where a particular employee works.

Recruiting Scams and Fraud

We at AlphaSense have been made aware of fraudulent job postings and individuals impersonating AlphaSense recruiters. These scams may involve fake job offers, requests for sensitive personal information, or demands for payment. Please note:

  • AlphaSense never asks candidates to pay for job applications, equipment, or training.
  • All official communications will come from an @ email address.
  • If you’re unsure about a job posting or recruiter, verify it on our Careers page.

If you believe you’ve been targeted by a scam or have any doubts regarding the authenticity of any job listing purportedly from or on behalf of AlphaSense please contact us. Your security and trust matter to us.

jobs.description:
The Work

ICF is seeking a Senior Databricks Platform Engineer to support an independent US Government Agency where you will design, build, secure, and operate governed Azure Databricks Lakehouse capabilities supporting a cloud-based analytics platform, enterprise AI operations, and emerging data initiatives.

You will develop reliable batch and streaming pipelines, administer Databricks workspaces and access, implement governance, and automate delivery through infrastructure as code and CI/CD. Working with cloud architects, AI engineers, security analysts, Business Analysts, and mission owners, you will help move data products from ingestion through validated, analysis-ready datasets and production operations.


Job Location: Remote


What You Will Do

  • Design, configure, and operate Azure Databricks workspaces, clusters, jobs, workflows, catalogs, storage credentials, external locations, and service principals for enterprise initiatives.
  • Build and optimize batch and real-time ingestion and transformation pipelines using Python, PySpark, SQL, Delta Lake, Delta Live Tables, Auto Loader, and Apache Spark.
  • Implement medallion architecture, dimensional models, change data capture, schema evolution, data quality checks, retry and rollback mechanisms, and reproducible processing patterns.
  • Configure Unity Catalog governance, including role-based access, lineage, retention, catalog and schema provisioning, and secure integration with ADLS Gen2 and other approved storage.
  • Develop frameworks and interfaces that enable AI and analytics teams to access governed training, inference, and reporting data across CDMA, AlphaRex, and future DMS initiatives.
  • Automate Databricks deployments and environment configuration using Terraform, Databricks Asset Bundles, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or comparable tools.
  • Integrate Databricks with Azure Data Factory, Kafka, Airflow, APIs, Snowflake, Synapse, and other enterprise data services as required by the solution architecture.
  • Monitor pipeline, cluster, and workspace health; diagnose performance and data issues; and use Azure Monitor, Databricks logs, Splunk, or comparable tools to support root cause analysis and operational reliability.
  • Support security, ATO, vulnerability remediation, business continuity, disaster recovery, and operational readiness activities for Databricks environments and data products.
  • Participate in Agile planning, code reviews, demos, and retrospectives; document architecture, runbooks, data models, governance decisions, and deployment procedures in version-controlled repositories.

What You Will Bring With You

  • BA/BS/MS in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or equivalent experience, with more than 5 years of data engineering experience and at least 3 years specifically supporting Azure Databricks and related Azure data services.
  • Expertise in Apache Spark, Delta Lake, Python, SQL, and Scala, with hands-on experience designing and optimizing large-scale ETL/ELT pipelines.
  • Experience with Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake Storage, Azure Synapse Analytics, Databricks workflows, data modeling, and big data technologies.
  • Experience configuring and managing Databricks workspaces, clusters, compute resources, security controls, access management, and cost optimization.
  • Experience implementing CI/CD or infrastructure as code for data platforms using Git and tools such as Terraform, Databricks Asset Bundles, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or comparable technologies.
  • Experience with Agile delivery, data governance, data security, performance troubleshooting, and clear communication with technical and business stakeholders.
  • Ability to satisfy FDIC personnel eligibility and background-investigation requirements
  • U.S. Citizenship required due to federal contract requirements.
  • Candidate must reside in the U.S., be authorized to work in the U.S., and all work must be performed in the U.S.

What We Would Like You To Bring With You

  • Experience with Azure Databricks, ADLS Gen2, Unity Catalog, Delta Live Tables, Auto Loader, Azure Data Factory, and Azure Synapse.
  • Databricks Certified Data Engineer Associate or Professional certification, Databricks Generative AI Engineer certification, or comparable demonstrated experience.
  • Experience with streaming and real-time data using Kafka, Confluent, Structured Streaming, or similar technologies.
  • Experience with medallion architecture, CDC, dimensional modeling, Apache Iceberg, Snowflake, Oracle, SQL Server, or other enterprise data platforms.
  • Experience supporting Generative AI, NLP, RAG applications, vector stores, agents, or Databricks AI/ML workloads.
  • Experience with MLflow, model deployment pipelines, AWS SageMaker, AWS Bedrock, or cross-cloud data and AI architectures.
  • Experience implementing BCDR, high availability, disaster recovery, data retention, and enterprise security controls for cloud data platforms.
  • Experience supporting ATO processes, NIST or federal compliance controls, vulnerability remediation, SonarQube, Checkmarx, or Zero Trust implementation.
  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, REST APIs, FastAPI, Node.js, or cloud-native application integration.
  • Experience supporting federal data modernization programs and communicating technical decisions to agency stakeholders.

Professional Skills

  • Explain data platform architecture, trade-offs, risks, and operational impacts to technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
  • Work effectively across data engineering, AI, cloud, security, application, and operations teams.
  • Use structured problem solving to diagnose pipeline, performance, access, and deployment issues.
  • Organize work across concurrent Agile priorities and maintain clear technical documentation and status communication.

Get to Know Rivia Mind

jobs.excerpt: WHO WE AREWe’re not in the wing business.  We’re in the flavor business.
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

We’re not in the wing business. We’re in the flavor business. It’s been our mission to Serve the World Flavor since we first opened in 1994, and we’re just getting started. 1997 saw the opening of our first brand partner operated Wingstop location, and by 2002 we had served the world one billion wings. It’s flavor that defines us and has made Wingstop one of the fastest growing brands in the restaurant industry.

Above all else – our success is largely due to our people and our core values, or what we call The Wingstop Way of being entrepreneurial, service-minded, fun, and authentic. We believe having a strong people foundation centered on these collective values creates a crave-worthy culture and talented team, as well as ensures our brand is poised for accelerated growth. We all win together.

WHAT WE’LL NEED

As the Field Marketing Manager for the Mountain-West, you are the regional marketing strategist and subject-matter expert responsible for translating enterprise priorities, market dynamics, and Restaurant-level opportunities into focused plans that build brand awareness, increase customer engagement, and drive sales and transaction growth.

You will work at the intersection of Marketing, Operations, Restaurants, Brand Partners, and local communities. You are accountable for both the quality of the strategy and the effectiveness of its in-market execution, helping transform local marketing into a market-facing growth engine with measurable business impact.

• Own and deliver annual market and Restaurant-level marketing plans for the Mountain-West, including objectives, audiences, strategies, tactics, investment recommendations, performance measures, and clear roles for execution; re-evaluate priorities quarterly.
• Act as the market expert by maintaining a current understanding of demographics, Restaurant trade areas, traffic drivers, competition, cultural dynamics, community needs, and other factors that may affect Restaurant performance.
• Use sales, transactions, channel, media, consumer, competitive, and Restaurant-level insights to diagnose business challenges, identify growth opportunities, and translate findings into actionable recommendations.
• Partner with Operations leadership and Brand Partners to establish market-level goals and integrated action plans that improve comparable sales, transactions, frequency, brand relevance, and Restaurant performance.
• Prioritize resources and marketing investments based on business opportunity, expected impact, operational readiness, and alignment with the broader brand strategy.
• Lead regional execution of national campaigns, ensuring plans are locally relevant, operationally achievable, on brand, and supported by clear communication and implementation tools.
• Develop high-impact local programs that may include media, community engagement, cultural moments, partnerships, influencers, catering, promotions, and Local Store Marketing initiatives.
• Collaborate with Media and Brand Partners to implement local media support for existing Restaurants and New Restaurant Openings, evaluate results, and optimize investment to drive positive transaction growth.
• Serve as a strategic marketing advisor to Brand Partners, guiding market strategy, local investment decisions, and long-term growth planning while maintaining appropriate decision rights and brand standards.
• Build trusted relationships with Brand Partners and field Operations leaders through business reviews, market visits, planning sessions, and clear follow-through on agreed actions.
• Serve as a brand ambassador and primary marketing contact for community partners, building relationships that keep Wingstop top of mind and strengthen relevance within priority trade areas.
• Source, evaluate, negotiate, and manage local partnerships and sponsorships in accordance with approved processes, contractual requirements, brand standards, and expected business value.
• Manage, support, and track all New Restaurant Openings in Mountain-West, including market-entry strategy, media plans, Local Store Marketing initiatives, Grand Openings, pre-opening awareness, on-site opening support, and post-opening sustainment.
• Identify underperforming markets and priority Restaurants, then develop focused recovery strategies with Operations and Brand Partners; monitor progress and adjust plans as conditions change.
• Collaborate with Operations, Media, Delivery, Consumer Insights, Development, FP&A, Digital, CRM, Brand, Communications, and Restaurant Technology to support the strategic vision and drive regional growth.
• Prepare regular communications, business reviews, and presentations for Brand Partners and Operations leadership, including Period and Quarterly Sales Performance, marketing activity, business impact, key learnings, risks, and recommended actions.
• Lead test-and-learn initiatives, document outcomes, and use findings to optimize current plans, inform future investment decisions, and scale successful local programs.
• Spend meaningful time in markets and Restaurants to observe execution, understand Restaurant realities, connect with communities, strengthen partner relationships, and uncover opportunities not visible in reporting alone.
• Champion Wingstop brand standards and marketing philosophies while adapting strategy appropriately to local market needs.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED

• A bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and directly relevant experience
• Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills, with the ability to support Brand Partners, Operations leaders, and cross-functional teams
• Five or more years of progressive experience in Marketing, Field Marketing, or a directly relevant field
• Quick Service Restaurant marketing experience; restaurant, retail, or Brand Partner-operated system experience is preferred
• A self-starter mindset and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment
• Strong analytical skills and experience interpreting business performance, consumer insights, media results, and market-level data
• Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint and experience with Power BI or comparable reporting and data-visualization tools
• Strong presentation, facilitation, negotiation, and written communication skills
• Experience planning and negotiating sponsorships, including agreements, activation, relationship management, and impact assessment

So, what does ‘all in a day’s work’ look like to a Wing Expert in this role? Your day could shape up somewhat like this:
• Ability to travel up to 60% within the Mountain-West, including overnight travel, based on business needs.
• Ability to work occasional nonstandard hours, including nights and weekends, in support of openings, events, activations, and urgent Restaurant needs.
• Frequent use of a computer and other technology is essential to completing everyday responsibilities while working remotely, in an office, in Restaurants, or on the go.
• Frequent use of mental energy while gathering, documenting, analyzing, and communicating information with Brand Partners, cross-functional colleagues, vendors, and the extended Wingstop team.
• Ability to work in fast-paced Restaurant and kitchen environments and perform necessary on-site activities that may include extended periods of walking, standing, lifting, and bending, with reasonable accommodation where applicable.
• Ability to work indoors and outdoors in varied temperatures and around food products, common allergens, industrial equipment, and commercial cleaning products, using required personal protective equipment where applicable.
• Must reside within, or be willing to relocate to, the assigned Mountain-West market.

WHO YOU ARE

No job is too small. You recognize that the real work happens in the restaurants, and everything we do should support their success. You stay humble, roll up your sleeves, and always look for ways to help. You learn from others and contribute wherever you can.

You care deeply about doing great work and driving results. You’re curious, ask questions, and seek out opportunities to improve. You don’t just point out problems—you bring solutions, ideas, and perspectives that move the team forward.

You take full responsibility for your work and see things through to completion. You aren’t afraid to fail because you know that failure is a part of learning and growth. You take action, move fast, and keep pushing forward.

You lead with empathy, respect, and emotional intelligence. You collaborate effectively, fostering a culture of trust and constructive feedback. You understand the importance of teamwork and ensure that your actions build others up rather than break them down.

You push yourself and others to be better. You embrace healthy conflict, knowing that great ideas and strong teams emerge from honest, constructive conversations. You believe that leaders create leaders and are committed to fostering a culture of growth, challenge, and continuous improvement.

BENEFITS

FLAVOR PERKS:

  • Unlimited paid time off for exempt employees

  • One paid volunteer day of your choice

  • Competitive bonus structure for eligible roles

  • Team member stock purchase plan

  • Health savings or flexible spending account options

  • 401k – (dollar for dollar on the first 3% and then 50 cents on the dollar for the next 2% for team member contributions up to 5% of eligible compensation)

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits

  • Basic life and AD&D insurance provided

  • Paid maternity and paternity leave

FUN IS THE BEST FLAVOR:

  • Lunch provided every Tuesday and Thursday in office

  • Discount on Wingstop gift cards

  • Onsite game room

Content Development & Instructional Design

Job Title: Researcher, North Africa

Department: Middle East & North Africa (MENA)

Job Band: Researchers & Associates Level I

Salary Range: Commeasurate with skills and experience and in line with typical local market pay. See below for more information.

Location: North Africa, Middle East regions or a similar time-zone

Workspace Designation: Remote

Reports to Title: Regional Director, MENA

Union Represented: No

Closing Date: October 23, 2026

Organization Overview:

Founded in 1981, the Committee to Protect Journalists (“CPJ”) is an independent, non-profit organization defending journalists worldwide without regard to their political ideology. Through its work to safeguard journalists, CPJ protects the rights of all people to have access to diverse and independent sources of information. For over four decades, CPJ has helped win the early release of imprisoned journalists, secure convictions in journalist murders, and enable legal reform in countries where free expression has deteriorated. CPJ’s widely cited database and reports have raised global awareness of attacks on press freedom. Learn more about CPJ’s fight to defend freedom of the press here

At CPJ, we are dedicated to upholding values of equity and free expression in both our internal operations and external endeavors. As a global organization headquartered in the United States, we aspire to build a diverse workplace and foster an inclusive and welcoming environment. We strive for our people to be representative of the global community on which we report and to equip them with the opportunities and resources they need to learn and succeed.

Job Summary:

The North Africa Researcher will document, investigate, and report on press freedom violations and threats to journalists in North Africa. The role includes research and writing for CPJ’s editorial and advocacy output, maintaining up-to-date data on press freedom violations, and translating reports between Arabic and English.

Monitoring & Documentation

  • Track and document press freedom violations, including arrests, censorship, attacks, legal harassment, and other threats to journalists and media outlets across the MENA region, with focus on North Africa.
  • Maintain accurate, timely updates to CPJ’s databases of imprisoned, missing, or killed journalists.
  • Build/maintain databases for local and regional media, government & civil society contacts.

Research & Writing

  • Draft letters of appeal, statements, and news alerts on tight deadlines
  • Review relevant news websites and publications
  • Research and write reports on press freedom issues in the region
  • Produce timely news alerts, statements, and features on press freedom issues in the assigned region.
  • Prepare research notes, background materials, and verification summaries in accordance with CPJ standards.
  • Contribute to advocacy materials and other editorial outputs as requested.

Engagement & Coordination

  • Communicate regularly with journalists & human rights activists across North Africa and with human rights groups
  • Liaise with journalists, media workers, civil society partners, and human rights organizations for interviews, case updates, and verification.
  • Participate in regular check‑ins and team meetings with CPJ program staff.
  • Maintain and expand a network of regional contacts relevant to CPJ’s work.
  • Collaborate with the Advocacy and Communications department as needed.
  • Conduct direct advocacy with relevant actors to advance CPJ’s mission.

Journalist Assistance (JA) Support

  • Conduct research, assessment, and verification for Journalist Assistance (JA) requests in the MENA region.
  • Submit JA documentation in line with CPJ’s framework and internal systems.
  • Assist journalists, vet cases, and coordinate with the Emergencies team and journalists receiving support.

Additional Support

  • Create and share engaging content for social media.
  • Perform all other duties as assigned
  • Devise and generate engaging content for social media

Physical Demands:

The physical demands described here represent those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this classification and are reflective of work in a typical office setting. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions of the job, absent undue hardship.

Work Location:

This position is located in the Middle East / North Africa region or a country within a similar time-zone (such as those in Europe), and is classified as fully remote. Availability to work and attend meetings on the US Eastern time zone as needed is required.

Compensation and Hiring Mechanism:

As CPJ is a US-based organization, the hiring for this position will ultimately be managed by an Employer of Record (EOR) firm that is engaged by CPJ for the purpose of employing international staff. Benefits will be consistent with those typically offered by the EOR firm in the country of hire.

Salary will be determined based on skills and experience and adjusted for local market rates depending upon the country of hire. Employment agreements through the EOR are written in equivalent local currency. As examples, the annual USD pay range for this position if hired in Morocco would be $24,135 - $31,237; Tunisia $22,548 - $30,643; Spain $46,890 - $53,570.

Equal Employment Opportunity:

CPJ provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type based on race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), parental status, national origin, age, disability, genetic information (including family medical history), political affiliation, military service, or other non-merit-based factors.

jobs.excerpt: The RoleIntellect delivers a clinically governed mental health programme to enterprise clients in the mining and resources sector, supporting remote and expatriate workforces.
jobs.description:
The Role

Intellect delivers a clinically governed mental health programme to enterprise clients in the mining and resources sector, supporting remote and expatriate workforces. This is not a standard EAP. Cases begin with acute risk assessment on remote sites and run through structured treatment, fitness-for-work assessment and return-to-work clearance, in direct coordination with the client's chaplaincy, medical and people teams.

This role covers the client's United Kingdom operations and a West African project site where the working language is French. It is a combined clinical delivery and case management role: the postholder conducts the assessments, delivers the therapy, writes the reports and owns the case, rather than coordinating a provider network. That design reflects the absence of an established provider network in the West African market at launch, and gives the client a single clinician who knows each case end to end.

Full professional fluency in French and English is a non-negotiable requirement. Welfare calls, clinical assessment, case documentation and client communication in the West African market are conducted in French.

Responsibilities

Clinical assessment and delivery

  • Conduct acute risk and welfare assessments for employees referred through the client's escalation pathway, in French or English as required.
  • Deliver individual counselling and psychotherapy across the supported caseload, virtually.
  • Conduct fitness-for-work assessments and produce the associated clinical documentation.
  • Write risk assessments, session documentation, return-to-work memoranda and fitness-for-work reports to a standard that stands up to client and regulatory scrutiny, in the language the case requires.
  • Delivery is capped so that case management availability is protected. Session load is agreed with the Head of Clinical Operations and reviewed as volume changes.

Case management and coordination

  • Own each case end to end, from referral through assessment, treatment, fitness-for-work and reintegration to closure.
  • Align the initial support plan with the client's on-site teams, including session volume and cadence, and manage adjustments where clinically indicated.
  • Coordinate with internal helpline, care excellence and network partnership teams on anything that cannot be delivered directly.
  • Review the open case list for stalled items and follow up to keep cases moving.

Clinical risk oversight and governance

  • Confirm risk tiering against the client's framework and set review cadence and monitoring requirements.
  • Make the clinical decisions the pathway requires, including disputed risk ratings and medical evaluation pathways where an employee declines therapy.
  • Escalate to the Head of Clinical Operations where a case exceeds the scope of remote delivery or requires in-person intervention.
  • Work within the differing regulatory, medical and emergency-escalation environments of each market, and flag where local pathways do not support the agreed protocol.

Clinical protocols and client enablement

  • Co-develop and maintain the clinical protocols, risk frameworks and SOPs the client's on-site teams operate to, including French-language versions.
  • Design and deliver clinical training and framework guidance to client-side staff who are not clinicians, in French and English.
  • Build out the in-market provider network alongside Network Partnerships, so that in-person and overflow capacity exists as the programme scales.

Client relationship, insights and reporting

  • Act as the named clinical contact for the client's chaplaincy, medical and health and safety leads in both markets, responding within the core window to queries that are frequently unscheduled and time-critical.
  • Produce the case tracker and monthly clinical reporting, moving beyond utilisation to presenting issues, risk patterns, outcomes and service-level themes.
  • Present clinical insight at client review meetings and translate it into recommendations the client's health and safety and people teams can act on.

Requirements

  • Full professional fluency in French and English, to the standard required for clinical assessment, therapy delivery and client-facing documentation in both languages.
  • Registered clinical psychologist or qualified counsellor, with current registration in your jurisdiction and the right to practise remotely.
  • Master's degree in clinical psychology, counselling or a related field.
  • Minimum three years in clinical practice, including direct delivery of assessment and therapy to adults.
  • Demonstrable experience managing acute risk, including suicidality, in a setting where you held the decision rather than advised on it.
  • Experience of structured return-to-work, fitness-for-work or occupational mental health pathways.
  • Able to work four hours a day, Monday to Friday, within the 08:00 to 17:00 UK and West Africa window.

Desirable

  • Experience working across multiple jurisdictions or with expatriate, rotational or multinational workforces.
  • Understanding of remote industrial, mining, resources or energy operating environments.
  • Additional language capability, particularly Mandarin.
  • Experience contributing to clinical protocols, risk frameworks or SOPs.
  • Prior case management or clinical account experience in a commercial setting.

jobs.description:
Location: 100% Remote

Employment: Full-time, long-term position
Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement
Salary: Based on experience, technical expertise, and level of responsibility

About Us

We are developing a mobile application that combines real-world interactions with location and proximity technologies. Our team uses AI coding tools and autonomous coding agents to accelerate development, improve engineering workflows, and share practical knowledge.

We are looking for a senior engineer who can connect mobile development, backend services, databases, and infrastructure into a reliable development and delivery process.

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Senior Mobile & Platform Engineer who can work across Android and iOS, contribute to our Kotlin Multiplatform architecture, and support our dedicated developers on both platforms.

Your main focus will be enabling the team to deliver effectively: resolving technical challenges, maintaining shared components, improving development workflows, and managing the backend and infrastructure that support the application.

You will also contribute directly to implementation where needed. Depending on your experience and suitability, the role may include technical team leadership for our Android and iOS developers.

Strong GitHub, GitHub Actions, and runner-management experience is essential. Practical experience with AI-assisted and agentic development is equally important.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support our Android and iOS developers with technical decisions, debugging, code reviews, and integration challenges.
  • Develop and maintain shared application logic using Kotlin Multiplatform.
  • Contribute to native Android and iOS development where platform-specific work is required.
  • Maintain a clear architecture across mobile applications, backend services, APIs, and databases.
  • Develop and maintain backend functionality and server-side integrations.
  • Manage database changes, investigate data-related issues, and maintain reliable migration, backup, and recovery processes.
  • Build and improve CI/CD workflows using GitHub Actions.
  • Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot GitHub runners, including self-hosted runners.
  • Improve build reliability, automated testing, deployment processes, and development environments.
  • Manage server-side application deployments, configuration, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
  • Establish effective AI-assisted and agentic coding workflows across the team.
  • Review AI-generated code and ensure that changes are tested, understandable, secure, and maintainable.
  • Help developers and junior team members use AI tools effectively through practical demonstrations and knowledge sharing.
  • Where appropriate, act as technical team lead: coordinate dependencies, guide implementation, review technical decisions, and help the team resolve blockers.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated senior-level experience in mobile software development.
  • Strong Kotlin and Android development experience, together with practical Swift and iOS development experience.
  • Solid hands-on experience with Kotlin Multiplatform and integrating shared code into both mobile platforms.
  • The ability to investigate problems across mobile clients, APIs, backend services, databases, and infrastructure.
  • Practical backend development experience and a sound understanding of API design, authentication, and application security.
  • Strong SQL and relational database experience, including schema changes, migrations, and performance troubleshooting.
  • Hands-on DevOps experience with Linux servers, application deployment, configuration, and operational troubleshooting.
  • Excellent Git and GitHub knowledge, including pull requests, code reviews, branch workflows, and repository configuration.
  • Strong experience with GitHub Actions and configuring and maintaining GitHub runners.
  • Substantial experience using AI coding assistants and coding agents to deliver working software.
  • The ability to establish development workflows that combine coding agents, automated checks, and human review.
  • Clear communication, practical documentation skills, and a willingness to share knowledge.
  • The ability to work independently while supporting other developers constructively.
  • Interest in a long-term, full-time position and availability to start promptly after an agreement is reached.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • Previous experience as a technical lead or senior engineer supporting a mobile development team.
  • GPS, BLE, UWB, NFC, or other location and proximity technologies.
  • Testing mobile applications on real devices and investigating platform-specific behavior.
  • Container-based application deployment and reproducible development environments.
  • Monitoring, incident diagnosis, and maintaining reliable backend services.
  • Coordinating changes that affect mobile applications, backend APIs, and database structures together.

Potential Technical Team Lead Responsibilities

For a suitable candidate, the role can include technical leadership of our Android and iOS developers.

This would involve helping the team make consistent technical decisions, breaking down implementation work, coordinating shared dependencies, and maintaining the quality of delivered changes. You should be comfortable mentoring developers and taking responsibility for the technical direction while remaining actively involved in engineering.

What We Offer

  • A fully remote, full-time role with a long-term perspective.
  • Compensation based on your experience, expertise, and responsibilities.
  • A central role supporting our mobile development team.
  • The opportunity to shape our architecture, infrastructure, and agentic development workflows.
  • Potential technical teamlead responsibility, depending on suitability.
  • Close collaboration with a team that values practical knowledge sharing.

Remote Working Arrangement

Our remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots of the screen. This monitoring is part of the working arrangement and will be explained during the recruitment process.

Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup.

How to Apply

Please submit your CV and a short overview of relevant projects.

Include:

  • Your experience developing for both Android and iOS, including Kotlin Multiplatform.
  • Your backend, database, and server infrastructure responsibilities.
  • Examples of GitHub Actions workflows and runner environments you have configured or maintained.
  • The AI coding tools and agentic workflows you use, with examples of delivered results.
  • Your experience supporting developers, mentoring colleagues, or leading a technical team.
  • Your earliest start date and salary expectations.

Public portfolio links, GitHub repositories, and released application references are welcome where available.

Payments Optimization Product Manager

PLEASE NOTE THIS ROLE IS FOR OVERSEAS APPLICATION, NON -U.S. ONLY. NO DOMESTIC (U.S.) APPLICATIONS WILL BE CONSIDERED.

The Payments Optimization Manager is both the subscription and payments platform lead and the operator who is responsible for optimizing that platform. This is an analysis-led, hands-on role. You will own platform migrations, retry and dunning strategy, decline and authorization rate performance, gateway routing and failover, chargeback systems, and the revenue we recover from involuntary churn. You find the problem in the data, hypothesize changes, and write the requirements for engineering to execute. Our payments and billing platform is evolving, and you will be the internal voice defining what it has to do. This role requires real payments and subscription depth, strong analytical ability, and the judgment to know which decline pattern is worth chasing and which is noise.

What You’ll Be Responsible For:

  • Own retry and dunning strategy end to end, including retry cadence, the recovery lifecycle, hard versus soft decline handling, and the full failed-payment cycle, across the Scentbird family of businesses.
  • Own decline and authorization rate performance at the processor, gateway, region, and BIN level, and convert what you find into routing, retry, or fraud rule changes.
  • Create rock solid processes for execution which maximize safety but enables rapid change, logging, analysis, and management.
  • Run the payments operating cadence: failed-payment queues, decline and authorization rate monitoring, and gateway health. You are the first responder when payment performance degrades.
  • Own the recovery metric set and the baselines we manage against: dunning recovery rate, authorization rate, chargeback rate, and payment cost as a percentage of processed volume.
  • Own the authorization rate levers, including account updater and network token coverage, retry timing, and extending failover coverage to customer-initiated transactions rather than background renewals alone.
  • Partner with Financial Systems, CX, CRM, and Retention so dunning messaging works through our lifecycle channels and billing waves align with fulfillment and CX capacity.
  • Report payment performance on a regular cadence to Product, Finance, and leadership: what you changed, what it moved, and what you are going after next.

What You’ll Need to Have:

  • 7+ years in payments, billing, or subscription operations at a recurring revenue business, with direct ownership of dunning, retry, or authorization rate outcomes.
  • Real domain fluency: decline codes and issuer behavior, BIN-level analysis, MIT versus CIT and stored credential mandates, exemption handling, network tokens and account updater, interchange, and the chargeback lifecycle.
  • Hands-on configuration experience in a subscription billing platform and in a gateway or PSP
  • Comfort in a BI tools, generating the reporting you need to uncover the gems and the problems. You build your own analysis and form your own view of where the money is leaking.
  • The ability to write requirements an engineer can build from, including success metrics and acceptance criteria, and to defend the prioritization behind them.
  • Measurement rigor. You know how to prove a retry or routing change worked, and how to tell the difference between a real lift and seasonality, mix shift, or a good month.
  • Multi-brand, multi-currency, and multi-country exposure.
  • AI-Augmented Working Style: We don't just "use" AI; it is increasingly integrated into our workflow. You should be proficient at using AI agents and LLMs for synthesis, pattern discovery, red teaming, and automation of rote tasks, with the judgment to keep cardholder data inside our compliance boundary.
  • Margin awareness. You understand that a recovered payment, a fraud rule, and a false decline all land on the same P&L, and you can size the trade-off rather than optimize one number in isolation.
  • Comfort operating with ambiguity and influencing without authority across Engineering, Financial Systems, CX, and CRM.
  • Experience operating inside a PCI-DSS Level 1 environment is a plus.
  • Exposure to reconciliation, settlement, or ERP-side finance work is a plus.
  • Experience with subscription businesses that include physical goods, logistics, or inventory constraints is a plus.

What You’ll Love About Us:

  • Competitive base compensation
  • Bonus program
  • Paid Time Off and Work From Home
  • A fun, creative and energetic work environment

  • Deck of Scarlet: Deck of Scarlet is on a mission to break the clean category, redefining what clean fragrances should smell like. Composed entirely of vegan, cruelty-free ingredients, our fragrances bridge the gap between the clean and luxury categories, using the highest eau de parfum concentrations housed in sculptural, eye-catching bottles. You shouldn’t have to choose between being luxe and refined, or clean and vegan—now, you don’t have to.

In truth, we are complex in ways that cannot be contained in the traditional heteronormative stereotypes, existing beyond the binary with raw, unfiltered voices that deserve to be heard.

Description

CapsLock is a global IT marketing company that pioneers unique, scalable customer acquisition solutions for B2C clients. We solve complex sales challenges across a wide range of industries, primarily for large North American partners. By integrating our expertise in Digital Marketing, IT, Design, AI-driven analytics, proprietary MarTech, and sales consulting, we deliver powerful, data-informed customer acquisition solutions.

At CapsLock, people, technology, and forward-thinking innovation lie at the heart of everything we do. Our diverse, global team, fluent in over 10 languages, thrives on open collaboration and the exchange of new ideas, pushing boundaries to ensure our clients' success.

Role overview

We're looking for a Marketing Design Team Lead who is equal parts creative leader, marketer, and AI geek, someone who knows how to achieve business goals through visuals that actually sell.

You will take a team of 3 AI-driven Creative Designers and scale it to 6. The team produces static ad creatives, photorealistic AI visuals for performance campaigns across paid media channels, and source assets for our video production pipeline.

Your job is to build the company's visual creative engine. Whatever the starting point- a brief, a hypothesis, a raw idea - it leaves the team as a creative that performs.

You'll work closely with Creative Producers, Marketers, Copywriters, Media Buyers, and the Video Editing team, and partner with our Generative AI Pipeline Engineer on tooling and workflows.

What you will work on

  • Lead, mentor, and scale a team of 3 to 6 AI-driven Creative Designers - grow people, not just output;
  • Own the production flow: task distribution, capacity planning, and strict QC - production-grade, not demo-grade;
  • Drive creative direction: concepts, hooks, and visual angles that stop the scroll and convert;
  • Generate ideas yourself and push the team beyond safe iterations - informed by visual trends and competitor creatives;
  • Own the creative testing loop: build a database of winners, analyze failures, turn performance data into next iterations;
  • Track new AI models and tools; be the company's go-to expert on what's creatively possible with AI, staying hands-on in the tools;
  • Run regular R&D and build prompt and style libraries that keep quality consistent as the team grows;
  • Stay hands-on: jump into the tools (Figma, Adobe Suite, AI platforms) when needed to unblock the team, take on the most complex creatives, or test new approaches;
  • Partner with the Generative AI Pipeline Engineer to turn the team's creative needs into pipelines, presets, and automation;
  • Work tightly with Creative Producers, Marketers, Media Buyers, and Video Editors: align on strategy, negotiate deadlines, solve bottlenecks.

Requirements

Your must-haves

You don't need to meet every single requirement. If you're excellent in most of these areas and can show shipped work, we'd love to hear from you.

  • 5+ years of Leadership Experience: You have successfully managed creative/design teams in digital marketing. (This is not a role for a senior designer looking for their first management gig);
  • Mature Leader & Problem Solver: You build clear processes, guide your team, gracefully resolve conflicts, remain highly proactive, and stay completely open to new ideas and approaches;
  • Strong Project Manager: You drive every project cleanly to the finish line. You guarantee top-tier quality, maintain absolute order, and hit strict deadlines without excuses;
  • Strong Visual Craft: composition, lighting, color, typography, anatomy. You can articulate exactly why a creative works or doesn't;
  • Design Toolstack: proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite; comfortable connecting AI outputs with traditional design pipelines;
  • AI Geek: far beyond basic prompting. You track every new model release and can't wait to test how it could level up ad creatives. Hands-on with modern AI image platforms (Figma Weave, Higgsfield, Magnific, Runway, or similar), using them for creating photorealistic visuals. Able to choose the right tool for each task, as well as to catch and fix artifacts.
  • Performance Marketing DNA: solid understanding of static ad creatives (Google, Meta, and other paid channels). You know what stops the scroll, what makes a visual sell, and how creative decisions move CTR, CPA, and conversion rate;
  • Fluency in English - both spoken and written.

Nice to have

  • A strong portfolio showcasing performance marketing creatives and AI-generated photorealistic work - ideally with examples shipped under your leadership and the results they drove;
  • Experience with creatives for high-CPA verticals (home improvement, insurance, health, legal, finance, or similar);
  • Experience creating visuals for North American audiences - you know what looks native to a US consumer;
  • Understanding of how static visuals feed video production pipelines.

What we offer

  • Remote Work - we offer a truly and fully remote environment. You choose where you are the most productive and comfortable to have an impact.
  • Paid vacations - generous paid vacation policy to ensure you have time to recharge.
  • Unlimited Sick Days - we understand that being only human means getting sick or feeling under the weather from time to time, so we guarantee you time off as long as you need to recover and get back on your feet.
  • Ongoing Learning - people at CapsLock are deeply inquisitive and eager to learn new knowledge and skills, that's why we support and create learning opportunities like the Free Books program, workshops, conferences, and more.
  • Home Office - we will cover the equipment and furniture expenses to make sure you have the best work-from-home experience.
  • Physical Well-Being - we will cover costs of your medical insurance. Additionally we offer an allowance for a flexible fitness program.
  • Fun Stuff - there is never a shortage of fun stuff.

Sprinklr is the definitive, AI-native platform for Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM), empowering brands to deliver extraordinary experiences at scale — across every customer touchpoint.

Sprinklr’s unified platform provides powerful solutions for every customer-facing team — spanning social media management, marketing, advertising, customer feedback, and omnichannel contact center management — enabling enterprises to unify data, break down silos, and act on real-time insights.

Today, 1,900+ enterprises and 60% of the Fortune 100 rely on Sprinklr to help them deliver consistent, trusted customer experiences worldwide.

Job Description

Sprinklr is seeking a Sr. Solutions Consultant to partner with our Sales and Customer Success teams in driving strategic engagements with enterprise clients. This role is ideal for a consultative, outcome-driven professional with deep expertise in marketing technology, customer experience, and digital transformation.

As a Sr. Solutions Consultant at Sprinklr, you will be a trusted advisor to our clients, helping them create and implement solutions that leverage Sprinklr’s Unified-CXM platform to deliver measurable business outcomes across marketing, social, and customer experience functions.

At Sprinklr, Solution Consultants have the technical knowledge and business consulting acumen to uncover a customer’s current and future state needs and their goals to best position Sprinklr’s platform. They speak from a position of confidence and credibility with their product and industry knowledge and can provide insights and build rapport easily while being a trusted advisor.


What You’ll Do

  • Act as a key member of the account team for your territory, working directly with prospects and customers during sales cycles as a trusted advisor to build confidence and excitement around Sprinklr’s suite of products and integrations with customer systems
  • Lead discovery sessions to understand client goals, challenges, and desired outcomes across marketing, social media, customer care and CX.
  • Understand potential business opportunities at customer prospects. This includes researching and understanding prospects' go-to-market strategies and identifying potential solution hypotheses and value drivers of customer experience programs at the prospect’s organization.
  • Design and present tailored solutions using Sprinklr’s platform, showcasing how our technology drives value across the marketing tech stack.
  • Facilitate workshops, whiteboarding sessions, and proof-of-concept engagements to demonstrate solution fit and strategic impact.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and Marketing) to deliver compelling demos, create solution architectures and align to positive business outcomes and go-to-market strategy.
  • Translate complex platform capabilities into business value for executive and practitioner audiences.
  • Stay current on industry trends in mar-tech, social media, contact center, and customer experience to inform solution strategy and client conversations.
  • Work collaboratively with your peers and seek opportunities to grow through mentorship and peer learning across the global presales team.

Who You Are

  • Experience Solutions Consultant/Sales Engineer with experience in a role at a SaaS company working with Enterprise clients
  • A strategic thinker with experience in marketing technology, customer experience, or digital transformation consulting.
  • Experience guiding prospects and customers through structured problem solving and value realization frameworks and helping clients innovate and transform their customer experiences.
  • Familiar with platforms such as CRM, Marketing Automation, Social Media Management, Business Intelligence and CCaaS, as well as integrations between systems.
  • Comfortable engaging with stakeholders from C-suite to practitioner, with strong storytelling and presentation skills.
  • Thought leader with a track record of publishing, speaking, or contributing to industry conversations.
  • Open to feedback and committed to continuous learning
  • Demonstrates empathy and builds trust quickly
  • Willingness for up to 40% travel, largely within the US

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field
  • 5+ years' experience in a solutions consulting/sales engineering role
  • Experience with Sprinklr or similar Unified-CXM platforms a plus
  • Understanding of AI and automation as applied to marketing and CX use cases.
  • Familiarity with data integration, API connectivity, and scalable solution design in mar-tech environments.
  • Excellent business and technical presentation skills (remote and in-person), communication (oral & written), and relationship building skills, across all levels of management
  • Proficient technical aptitude including at a conceptual and practitioner level, and ability to become a subject matter expert with new technology applications

Please note: We are unable to consider applicants who require visa sponsorship or work authorization support for this role. Candidates must have current and unrestricted work authorization in the country where the role is based.

We focus on our mission: Sprinklr was founded in 2009 to solve a big problem: growing enterprise complexity that separated brands from their customers. Our vision was clear: to unify fragmented teams, tools and data — helping large organizations build deeper, more meaningful connections with the people they serve. Today, Sprinklr has a unified, AI-native platform for four product suites: Sprinklr Service, Sprinklr Social, Sprinklr Marketing, and Sprinklr Insights. Sprinklr is here to do three things:

  • Lead a new category of enterprise software that we call Unified-CXM.

  • Empower companies to deliver next generation, unified engagement journeys that reimagine the customer experience.

  • Create a culture of customer obsession, with trust, teamwork, and accountability.

We believe in our product: Customers who value exceptional customer experiences have what they need on our single unified platform, built with an operating system approach on a single codebase. That means that everything — and everyone — can work together to service, respond, sell, and market to customers on the channels they prefer. While Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM) as a category is just getting started, we are well on our way to creating a no-compromise, unified approach to better customer experiences for the world’s leading enterprise brands.

We invest in our people: We offer a comprehensive suite of benefits designed to help each member of our team thrive. jobs.title: Kostprijsdeskundige bovenleiding en draagconstructies railinfra
jobs.excerpt: Jouw ambitieKrijg jij energie van indrukwekkende railprojecten zoals de uitbreiding van het spoor en station in Nijmegen of de vernieuwing van het spooremplacement in hartje Amsterdam?
jobs.description:
Jouw ambitie

Krijg jij energie van indrukwekkende railprojecten zoals de uitbreiding van het spoor en station in Nijmegen of de vernieuwing van het spooremplacement in hartje Amsterdam? Wil je bijdragen aan een duurzamer Nederland met de aanleg van de Merwedelingelijn bij Dordrecht? En lijkt het je interessant om mee te werken aan de verbetering van de internationale IC-verbinding tussen Düsseldorf en Eindhoven? Dan is de rol van kostprijsdeskundige bij Dura Vermeer Railinfra echt iets voor jou! In deze functie ben jij de verbindende schakel bij het opstellen van winnende aanbiedingen voor grootschalige, multidisciplinaire railprojecten.

Dit wordt jouw baan

Als ervaren kostprijsdeskundige bovenleiding en draagconstructies ben jij verantwoordelijk voor het volledige prijsvormingsproces. Je stelt zelfstandig ramingen en kostprijsbegrotingen op en geeft stevig, onderbouwd prijstechnisch advies. Je begeleidt en coacht junior collega’s en neemt hen mee in het vak. Dit doe je zowel in de tenderfase als tijdens de realisatie. Je adviseert over contract- en scope-interpretatie, de prijsvormingsstrategie en de benodigde ontwerp- en realisatie-uitwerking. Je weegt varianten af en neemt duurzaamheid, veiligheid, innovatie, kansen en risico’s mee in je aanpak. Met jouw overzicht en diepgang zorg je voor een scherpe en concurrerende aanbieding. Je durft vragen te stellen, keuzes ter discussie te stellen en voorstellen te doen die het verschil maken. Zie jij het anders dan anderen, dan pak je die rol en voer je het gesprek. Je bent een vaste sparringpartner binnen het tenderteam en werkt nauw samen met collega’s uit de realisatie. Aan het eind van het traject sta jij achter de kostprijs en kun je die ook overtuigend toelichten. Wat deze rol sterk maakt? Je bent een echte specialist met verantwoordelijkheid en mandaat. Je hebt invloed op het plan, het contract en de aanbieding en bent van begin tot eind betrokken. Heb je ideeën om het slimmer, beter of anders te doen, dan verwacht men juist dat je die inbrengt. Hier krijg je ruimte om je expertise verder uit te bouwen en richting te geven aan het vakgebied.

Requirements

Meer bij Dura Vermeer
Dura Vermeer is een onafhankelijk familiebedrijf. En dat merk je. In hoe we samenwerken, naar elkaar omkijken en bouwen met oog voor de volgende generaties. Al sinds 1855 bouwen we aan Nederland, in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek. Onze onafhankelijkheid en langetermijnvisievormen daarbij de basis. Met een omzet van € 2,6 miljard en ruim 3.700 collega’s behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Maar uiteindelijk draait het bij ons niet om die cijfers. Het draait om mensen. Om collega’s die samen werken aan projecten waar je trots op bent – iconisch én dichtbij – en bijdragen aan oplossingen voor maatschappelijke vraagstukken. Onze ambities zijn groot. En die maken we alleen waar met betrokken mensen. Daarom investeren we in goed werkgeverschap en een werkomgeving waarin jij je thuis voelt. Waar je jezelf kunt zijn, je veilig voelt en je uitspreekt. Zodat jij het beste uit jezelf haalt en samen met ons meer maakt.

Hier zit jij op je plekJe maakt onderdeel uit van de vakgroep Bovenleiding en Energievoorziening. De verschillende vakgroepen kenmerken zich door de drive om succes te hebben en gezamenlijk de projecten tot een goed einde te brengen. Wanneer je vragen hebt of tegen problemen aanloopt, dan staan je collega's klaar om je te helpen. Samen wordt er gekeken naar een ideale oplossing. Samenwerking en collegialiteit kenmerken de sfeer binnen Dura Vermeer Railinfra.

Dit breng jij mee

Jij bent een kostprijsdeskundige, kostendeskundige, cost engineer, calculator met minimaal zo’n 1 jaar ervaring in het vak of een werkvoorbereider met een commerciële en financiële interesse die een volgende stap wil zetten. En verder:

  • Je bent bekend met Metacom of een soortgelijk systeem;

  • Je bent een positieve teamplayer;

  • Je bent van nature energiek en komt graag met nieuwe ideeën, jij daagt mensen uit verder te denken om tot het optimale plan te komen.

Dit bieden wij jou

Dura Vermeer is een grote organisatie waarin je veel kunt leren en waarin je kansen hebt om je ambities vorm te geven. Daarbij hechten we veel waarde aan opleiding, ontwikkeling en eigen initiatief. We hebben goede arbeidsvoorwaarden conform cao Railinfrastructuur (RIS). Dus bieden we je onder meer:

  • Een goed salaris afhankelijk van de meegebrachte kennis, niveau en werkervaring beginnend bij € 3.961,- tot € 5.694,- bruto per 4 weken;

  • 25 vakantiedagen + 18 ADV dagen (beide op fulltime basis)

  • Uitstekende secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden, zoals een standaard verzekering van alle werknemersrisico’s, pensioenregelingen, een extra aanvulling bij arbeidsongeschiktheid en een bijdrage voor het vakbondslidmaatschap.

  • Een goede werk-privébalans dankzij soepele regelingen voor arbeidsduur, werktijden en thuiswerken en moderne verlofvormen voor onder meer ouderschap, calamiteiten, mantelzorg of een sabbatical.

  • Voor verse vaders: 100% doorbetaling van je salaris tijdens je (aanvullende) geboorteverlof.

  • Veel aandacht voor jouw groei, met onze eigen Dura Vermeer academie en een vergoeding in tijd en geld voor zowel vak- als loopbaangerichte opleidingen.

  • Een NS Businesscard, smartphone en een laptop of tablet van de zaak.

  • En last but not least: fijne collega’s die in een professionele omgeving zorgen voor een ongekend goede werksfeer

Heb jij ook hart voor het spoor en wil jij ook meer uit je werk halen?
Bel of mail onze recruiter Jeffrey Smit via op
eisen geven een richting van het profiel dat wij zoeken voor deze functie. Voldoe jij niet aan alle eisen maar denk je wel dat dit de functie voor jou is? Dan nodigen wij je graag uit om te solliciteren. Dura Vermeer: maak meer mogelijk! Bij Dura Vermeer werven en selecteren we onze kandidaten graag zonder de goedbedoelde hulp van onderaannemers. Bij acquisitie door detacheringsbureaus of andere partijen behouden we ons het recht voor om meerwerk in rekening te brengen.

Highlights

Krijg jij energie van indrukwekkende railprojecten zoals de uitbreiding van het spoor en station in Nijmegen of de vernieuwing van het spooremplacement in hartje Amsterdam? Lees dan snel verder

jobs.excerpt: About the RoleWe are building a multi-tenant, hardware-agnostic IoT platform from the ground up.
jobs.description:
About the Role

We are building a multi-tenant, hardware-agnostic IoT platform from the ground up. We need a senior engineer who can design the system architecture in the morning and write production backend code in the afternoon. This is not an architecture-only role and not a coding-only role — it is both, simultaneously, in a fast-moving early-stage environment. You will also own cloud infrastructure as interim DevOps until we scale.

The Ideal Candidate

You have built IoT backend platforms before — not just used them. You understand the hard problems: device auth at scale, MQTT broker design, time-series ingestion performance, multi-tenant data isolation, and real-time delivery to web clients. You are comfortable making architectural decisions autonomously, documenting them clearly, and standing by them. You work remotely with discipline — you flag risks before they become problems.

Key Responsibilities

Platform Architecture

  1. Design the full end-to-end IoT platform architecture: device connectivity layer → MQTT/protocol ingestion → stream processing → time-series storage → REST/GraphQL API layer → real-time WebSocket delivery
  2. Define the multi-tenant data model: strict data isolation between customers, tenant-scoped API tokens, row-level security
  3. Design the device lifecycle system: provisioning, X.509/JWT authentication, device registry, status tracking, decommissioning
  4. Architect the protocol abstraction layer so MQTT, Modbus, OPC-UA, CoAP, and HTTP devices all normalise to the same internal data model
  5. Design a configurable rule engine: event-condition-action rules for alerts, automations, and integrations — no code required from customers
  6. Plan OTA firmware update management: secure delivery, versioning, rollback, fleet orchestration
  7. Write Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) for every major technical choice — nothing undocumented
  8. Design the scaling path from 100 devices (pilot) to 500,000+ (production) without structural rework

Backend Development

  1. Build core platform services from scratch: device management, telemetry ingestion, rule engine, notification/alerting, OTA update, multi-tenant API gateway
  2. Develop REST and GraphQL APIs with full OpenAPI specification — version-controlled from Day 1
  3. Implement WebSocket and SSE endpoints for real-time telemetry delivery to web and mobile clients
  4. Build device command-and-control with acknowledgement, retry logic, and timeout handling
  5. Implement device shadow service: last-known state of every device accessible even when offline
  6. Write unit, integration, and load tests — no service reaches staging without test coverage
  7. Own service reliability: SLO definitions, alerting runbooks, on-call incident response

Cloud Infrastructure (Interim)

  1. Provision and manage all AWS environments (dev, staging, production) using Terraform — no click-ops
  2. Configure AWS IoT Core: MQTT endpoint, topic namespace, rules engine, certificate management
  3. Set up CI/CD pipelines via GitHub Actions for all backend services
  4. Configure CloudWatch monitoring, log aggregation, and automated health alerts
  5. Manage IAM for all team members — least-privilege access, no shared credentials
  6. Hand off infrastructure fully documented when a DevOps engineer joins in Phase 2

Requirements

  1. 7–12 years software or systems engineering; minimum 4 years specifically building IoT platform backends or connected product infrastructure
  2. Expert-level, hands-on experience with AWS IoT Core or Azure IoT Hub — production deployments, not tutorials ⚑ NON-NEGOTIABLE
  3. Expert MQTT knowledge: v3.1 and v5.0, topic hierarchy design, QoS levels, retained messages, Last Will & Testament, broker sizing and clustering ⚑ NON-NEGOTIABLE
  4. Proficiency in Python and Node.js/TypeScript for production backend services — Go is a strong advantage
  5. Hands-on experience with a time-series database: InfluxDB, TimescaleDB, or AWS Timestream
  6. Terraform or AWS CloudFormation — you provision cloud infrastructure programmatically, not through the console
  7. Multi-tenant SaaS backend architecture: data isolation patterns, tenant-scoped access control, shared infrastructure design
  8. Security fundamentals applied in practice: TLS/mTLS, X.509 certificates, OAuth 2.0, JWT, secrets management (Vault or AWS Secrets Manager)
  9. Message broker or streaming experience: Kafka, RabbitMQ, AWS Kinesis, or AWS IoT Rules Engine
  10. Proven ability to work autonomously at a senior level — makes decisions, documents rationale, flags risks without needing to be prompted ⚑ REMOTE DISCIPLINE

Nice to Have

  1. Industrial protocol knowledge: Modbus TCP/RTU, OPC-UA, BACnet — even as a consumer or integrator
  2. EMQX, HiveMQ, or VerneMQ broker deployment and production operation
  3. Edge computing runtimes: AWS Greengrass v2, Azure IoT Edge, or Balena
  4. Digital twin frameworks: AWS IoT TwinMaker, Azure Digital Twins
  5. Container orchestration: Kubernetes, ECS, or equivalent for future Phase 2 migration
  6. Open-source IoT contributions or published technical writing on platform architecture

Skills at a Glance

Architecture: IoT platform end-to-end design · Multi-tenant SaaS patterns · Device lifecycle management · Protocol abstraction · Rule engine design · Horizontal scaling strategy

Backend: Python / Node.js / TypeScript / Go · REST + GraphQL API design · WebSocket / SSE real-time delivery · MQTT broker configuration · Time-series DB (InfluxDB / Timestream) · PostgreSQL or equivalent RDBMS

Cloud & DevOps: AWS IoT Core / Azure IoT Hub · Terraform / CloudFormation · GitHub Actions CI/CD · Docker containers · CloudWatch monitoring · IAM and security policy management

Security: TLS / mTLS configuration · X.509 certificate management · OAuth 2.0 / JWT implementation · Secrets management · Device authentication at scale
