We are looking for a senior developer who can take ownership of iOS development, deliver reliable software, and help our team become more effective at building applications with AI.

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Senior iOS App Developer with an excellent background in native iOS development using Swift and SwiftUI, together with practical experience integrating Kotlin Multiplatform into iOS applications.

This is a hands-on engineering role. You will develop and improve our iOS application, integrate shared application logic, solve complex technical problems, and establish effective workflows for AI-assisted and agentic development.

Experience with GPS, Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), Ultra-Wideband (UWB), or related location and proximity technologies would be particularly valuable.

You will also share your knowledge with our internal team, including mentoring a junior team member who is learning to build mobile applications through AI-assisted development, often referred to as “vibe coding.”

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, maintain, and improve our native iOS application using Swift and SwiftUI.
  • Integrate Kotlin Multiplatform modules into the iOS application and collaborate on shared business logic.
  • Implement platform-specific functionality while maintaining consistent behavior across iOS and Android.
  • Implement and troubleshoot location and proximity features involving GPS, BLE, UWB, and related device capabilities.
  • Address practical iOS challenges such as permissions, application lifecycle, background execution, battery consumption, and device compatibility.
  • Use AI coding assistants and coding agents extensively to implement features, investigate defects, refactor code, and support testing.
  • Set up and improve agentic development workflows, including task decomposition, project context, automated checks, and review processes.
  • Review and validate AI-generated code, taking responsibility for its correctness, maintainability, security, and performance.
  • Test relevant functionality on real devices and investigate issues that automated tests alone may not reveal.
  • Mentor our junior team member through practical demonstrations, pair programming, and clear explanations.
  • Support application signing, release preparation, and distribution through TestFlight and the App Store.
  • Document important technical decisions and share reusable knowledge with the internal team.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated senior-level experience delivering and maintaining production iOS applications.
  • Excellent practical knowledge of Swift, SwiftUI, and the iOS development ecosystem.
  • Practical experience with Kotlin Multiplatform and its integration into native iOS applications.
  • Solid understanding of application architecture, asynchronous programming, lifecycle management, and state management.
  • Strong debugging skills across application code, shared modules, APIs, and device behavior.
  • Substantial hands-on experience using AI coding tools to deliver working software.
  • A strong interest in agentic coding and the ability to establish effective development workflows around coding agents.
  • The ability to assess AI-generated solutions critically and explain technical decisions.
  • Willingness and ability to teach less experienced team members patiently and clearly.
  • The ability to work independently, communicate progress clearly, and take ownership of results in a remote team.
  • Interest in a long-term, full-time position and availability to start promptly after an agreement is reached.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • GPS positioning, location accuracy, geofencing, and sensor data.
  • BLE discovery, advertising, connections, and proximity detection.
  • UWB ranging, distance measurement, direction estimation, and hardware compatibility.
  • NFC and other device-to-device interactions.
  • Interoperability between Swift and Kotlin Multiplatform, including asynchronous operations and error handling.
  • Building automated development and testing workflows that combine human oversight with coding agents.

What We Offer

  • A fully remote, full-time role with a long-term perspective.
  • Compensation based on your experience, expertise, and responsibilities.
  • Ownership of meaningful iOS development work.
  • The opportunity to shape how our team uses AI and coding agents.
  • Close collaboration with an internal team that wants to learn from your experience.

Remote Working Arrangement

Our remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots of the screen. This monitoring is part of the working arrangement and will be explained during the recruitment process.

Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup.

How to Apply

Please submit your CV and a short overview of relevant projects.

Include:

  • Your role in developing and releasing iOS applications.

  • Any practical experience with GPS, BLE, UWB, or similar technologies.

jobs.title: VP of Product / Chief Product Officer
jobs.excerpt: Maisha Meds is hiring!  We're looking for a product leader to own our platform end to end and define what it becomes over the next three years.
jobs.description:
Maisha Meds is hiring! We're looking for a product leader to own our platform end to end and define what it becomes over the next three years.

About Maisha Meds

Maisha Meds is an organization dedicated to improving health care in Africa through best-in-class technology.

Founded in 2017, Maisha Meds has created the largest digital network of private pharmacies and clinics across Kenya, Tanzania, Uganda, and Nigeria through our mobile software. Our platform helps these providers improve their business by making sales, managing inventory, and tracking patients. It also reimburses them for providing high-quality care for malaria, eyeglasses, and HIV care at discounted costs.

Maisha Meds supports more than 35 million patient visits every year and has provided more than 2 million quality-assured reimbursements to date. We harness data from our network to reveal health and market trends, which allows us to design better solutions that work for the people we serve. We have worked with leading academic institutions such as UC Berkeley and KEMRI to evaluate the effectiveness of our programs, and we continue to demonstrate 4-7x improvement in quality and effective health care through randomized trials and ongoing program data.

We recently demonstrated the sustainability of our model through a flagship initiative with the Lagos State Government, which adopted our platform for malaria and fever care via a World Bank loan and subsequently through direct state budgetary support.

About the role

Maisha Meds runs three products that work as one system: the business software that 6,000 pharmacies and clinics use every day; the payments and audit platform that reimburses those providers for quality-assured care and gives payors the verification they need; and a real-time, geotagged dispensing dataset that is one of the largest longitudinal records of private-sector primary care in Africa, built across four countries.

This role owns that system end to end. The provider experience, the reimbursement workflows, the data products our payors depend on, and the AI layer that cuts across all of it. You will define what the platform becomes over the next three years, be accountable for growth and for health outcomes, and lead an interdisciplinary team spanning product, design, engineering, clinical, and country program functions.

Two things make this different from most product leadership roles. First, our funding is increasingly tied to verified outcomes rather than activity, so measurement is not a reporting function here. It is the product. Second, we have the dataset, the provider relationships, and the operational load that make AI worth doing for real rather than as a pilot, and nobody has yet set that agenda.

The role is remote-first (though with a preference for aligned time zones), with travel across our markets for product research and to work with our team. Compensation is commensurate with experience.

What you will do

Platform vision and roadmap. Set a product vision across provider software, reimbursement, and data, and turn it into a roadmap with real prioritization behind it. Make the trade-offs between bold bets and quick wins explicit, decide what we build versus buy, and hold the organization to OKRs rather than activity reports.

AI-led product experience. Reason through where AI owns a task, where it assists a provider or an operator, and where a clinician has to stay in the loop. Build an eval-led practice so we improve accuracy and engagement with evidence rather than intuition. The near-term surface area is concrete: forecasting and stockout prevention from our dispensing data, anomaly detection in claims and audit, decision support at the point of dispensing, low-bandwidth conversational interfaces for providers and patients, and aggressive automation of the internal operations that currently cap how fast we can grow.

Metrics and experimentation. Define what good looks like before we build, then be rigorous about measuring it. Own the metric tree that runs from provider activation, engagement, and retention through claim quality and payment integrity to patient outcomes and cost per DALY averted. Build the instrumentation and reconciliation that make those numbers trustworthy to a payor, not just to us. Run staged rollouts, holdouts, and quasi-experimental designs so we are learning continuously between formal trials.

Growth and operating model. Own acquisition, activation, and retention across the network, with a thorough understanding of LTV and CAC rather than top-of-funnel alone. Shape how the platform is positioned, priced, and deployed with government health systems, private partners, and payors.

Management and execution. Deliver yourself while managing and mentoring a team of product managers and designers and leading several scrum teams across geographies. Build a culture that is ambitious, data-driven, customer-centric, and focused on outcomes. Keep raising the team's ability to execute.

Partnership and advocacy. Represent the product with ministries of health, funders, leadership, and country teams. Lead steering committees, translate complex technical work clearly for every one of those audiences, and unlock the partnerships that drive growth.

Who we're looking for

A builder. You have taken at least one product from concept to production to scale in a resource-constrained environment, and you owned its outcomes. You do not need scaffolding to get started.

Depth in AI product work. 8+ years of product experience, with a meaningful share of that on AI-powered products and managing people. Hands-on fluency with LLMs: prompt design, retrieval architectures, eval pipelines, agent tooling, and the cost, latency, and quality trade-offs that decide whether a feature survives contact with a pharmacy in a low-connectivity setting.

Quantitative instinct. You are genuinely data fluent. You cut the data yourself, you can tell a weak metric from a real one, and you have built an experimentation practice rather than inherited one.

First-principles thinking about service design. You prototype quickly, sketch flows, write the copy, and make your vision concrete rather than describing it.

Credibility across clinical and technical teams. You can earn trust with both and translate between them without losing either.

Context. Deep experience with building products that users love, including customer needs, market opportunity, and reporting and regulatory requirements across multiple countries. Experience in healthcare, clinical tools, or another high-stakes domain is a strong plus. Prior experience with third-party technology and product partnerships helps.

Mindsets.

  • A team player who loves working collaboratively
  • A sense of optimism, flexibility, and adaptability to any situation
  • An ability to thrive in ambiguity through resilience and tenacity
  • A growth mindset and real enthusiasm for learning, feedback, and continuous improvement
  • A blend of passion, humility, patience, and a good sense of humor
  • A tendency to roll up your sleeves to move projects forward

Why you should join us

  • On a roll: We are doubling year over year with new funding partnerships that are boosting expansion in multiple countries.
  • Great team: Founded, managed, and backed by successful veterans of Stanford School of Medicine, Google, KPMG, M-KOPA, IQVIA, and CNN. We have technologists, clinicians, and economists working side by side to solve difficult problems.
  • Great funders: We are backed by the Gates Foundation, CIFF, Livelihoods Impact Fund, Novartis, the Nigerian Government, and many others. This is catalytic funding to fundamentally change the way health outcomes are funded in the private sector throughout Sub-Saharan Africa.
  • A rare dataset: Real-time, geotagged dispensing data across our markets, with the provider relationships to act on what it tells us.
  • Huge market: We are disrupting a massive, growing $50+B market for healthcare payments, with a focus on paying for health outcomes so that patients get the best quality care.
  • Impact: We have cultivated a fun and exciting start-up culture that empowers the team to make a huge difference.

jobs.description:
Location: Remote
Job Type: Full-Time | Independent Contractor
Work Schedule: Monday–Friday | 8:30 AM – 6:00 PM EST (1-hour lunch)
Compensation: USD $1,000/month during the 3-month trial period, increasing to USD $1,500/month upon successful completion of the trial. This role also offers quarterly performance bonus opportunities based on team and individual goals.

About the Role

At Fiesta Health, we believe every family deserves an incredible first experience from the moment they reach out for help. As our Client Onboarding Specialist, you'll be the friendly, dependable voice families hear from the moment they're referred to us through the moment they're enrolled and receiving services. You'll guide them step by step — answering questions, gathering information, coordinating appointments, and clearing away any obstacles — so that starting care feels simple instead of stressful. This is a phone-first role: you'll spend the majority of your day on calls with families, building trust and momentum at every stage of their journey. You'll also help us build the systems, checklists, and playbooks that make onboarding faster and easier as our team grows.


What You'll Do:
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for families from the moment a referral is received, guiding them by phone through every step of the onboarding journey.
  • Conduct proactive outreach and follow-up calls to collect the information and documentation needed to move each family's case forward (contact details, insurance information, required forms and records).
  • Help families understand and complete insurance verification, authorization, and documentation requirements, keeping them informed and reassured at every step.
  • Schedule and confirm appointments, send timely reminders, and reschedule as needed so families never fall through the cracks.
  • Identify and resolve barriers that could delay a family from starting services — such as insurance/payor transitions, transportation challenges, or missing paperwork — using creativity and sound judgment to find solutions.
  • Keep accurate, up-to-date records of every family interaction in company systems.
  • Help build and document repeatable outreach and onboarding processes, and contribute to training and growing the onboarding team over time.
What We're Looking For:
  • Fluent in English and Spanish (written and verbal) — required.
  • Experience in a phone-based outreach, intake, scheduling, or client/patient onboarding role, ideally within healthcare or a service-based industry.
  • Comfortable spending the majority of the workday on the phone with clients or families.
  • A natural problem-solver with strong judgment and the ability to think creatively to remove obstacles.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with a warm, empathetic, family-first approach.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage a high volume of outreach and follow-ups at once.
  • Familiarity with health insurance or authorization processes is a plus.
  • Reliable high-speed internet and a quiet, professional home office setup.


Compensation and Benefits:
  • USD $1,000/month during the 3-month trial period, increasing to USD $1,500/month upon successful completion.
  • Performance bonus eligibility, paid quarterly, based on team and individual goals.
  • 10 days of paid time off (PTO).
Growth Opportunities:
This role is expected to grow. As you help build scalable onboarding systems, you'll have the opportunity to help hire, train, and lead a small onboarding team over time.

At Fiesta Health, we believe that a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace is essential to our mission of delivering compassionate, high-quality care. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic.

We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills—because the more inclusive we are, the better we can serve our community.

jobs.description:
We're looking for a Travel Concierge who is passionate about crafting seamless travel experiences and delivering high-quality client service. You will be the trusted expert behind every journey, using AI-powered tools to research and recommend hotels, coordinating logistics across platforms, and communicating directly with travelers via WhatsApp to make every trip feel effortless and personal.

This role is for someone who loves travel, writes with warmth and clarity, thinks fast when plans change, and takes pride in the kind of attention to detail that makes clients feel like VIPs from the first message through check-in.

Why You'll Want to Join

  • You will be paid in USD (bi-monthly: every 15th and 30th)
  • Paid Time Off in accordance with company policy
  • Observance of Holidays per company guidelines
  • 100% remote setup so you can work wherever you're most productive
  • This role offers two shift options: 12 AM to 8 AM Monday through Friday or 8 AM to 4 PM Wednesday through Sunday
  • Work in the luxury travel and hospitality space with access to premium brands and destinations
  • Use cutting-edge AI tools to enhance research and elevate the client experience

What You'll Work On

Client Engagement and Support

  • Chat with travelers via WhatsApp to understand their preferences and deliver personalized recommendations
  • Respond quickly and thoughtfully to incoming inquiries with initial responses landing within 10 to 20 minutes during your shift
  • Handle special requests and ensure smooth communication between clients and hotels or vendors
  • Maintain a calm, professional, and reassuring tone even when plans change at the last minute

Research and Booking

  • Research and recommend hotels, restaurants, and attractions using AI tools and reliable online sources
  • Verify every detail including location, timing, currency, and amenities before confirming bookings
  • Coordinate hotel reservations, car rentals, and travel logistics across multiple booking platforms

Content and Destination Curation

  • Write and curate destination guides and travel recommendations that blend editorial polish with practical, on-the-ground insight
  • Collaborate with the marketing team to highlight exceptional hotels and destinations for social content
  • Stay current on travel trends, new openings, and hidden gems worth knowing about

Problem-Solving and Adaptability

  • Think fast and find creative solutions when plans shift due to flight delays, cancellations, or unexpected changes
  • Communicate clearly and calmly under pressure to maintain client confidence and satisfaction

What You Bring

  • Empathetic and client-obsessed with a genuine drive to make every traveler feel like a VIP
  • Detail-oriented and reliable with the ability to catch mistakes before they become problems
  • Exceptional written English with clarity, warmth, and professionalism in every message
  • A self-starter who learns, explores, and improves processes without being asked
  • Tech-savvy and comfortable using Slack, WhatsApp, Google Sheets and Docs, and booking platforms
  • Fast but thoughtful with the ability to balance responsiveness and quality under pressure
  • Experience with Expedia Tapp or Fora is strongly preferred for this role
  • Available to work one of the two offered shifts consistently

Nice to Have

  • Background in hospitality, travel, or concierge services
  • Experience with AI tools such as ChatGPT or travel research assistants
  • Familiarity with airlines, loyalty programs, and travel booking systems
  • International travel experience or strong knowledge of major global destinations
  • Negotiation skills to advocate for clients with vendors and hotels

How to Apply

Please include:

  1. Your updated resume highlighting any customer service or travel-related experience
  2. A short Loom video (1 to 2 minutes) introducing yourself, sharing why you are passionate about travel and client service, and confirming which shift you are available for
  3. A short writing sample such as an email, WhatsApp message, or short paragraph showing your conversational tone

Only candidates who submit a Loom video will be moved to the next step of the hiring process.

If you love connecting with people, solving travel challenges, and creating experiences that feel effortless for the traveler, this role gives you the platform and the tools to do that every single day.

Application Process Overview

Our comprehensive selection process ensures we find the right fit for both you and our clients:

  1. Initial Application - Submit your application and complete our prequalifying questions
  2. Video Introduction - Record an video introduction to showcase your communication skills and work experience
  3. Role-Specific Assessment - Complete a homework assignment tailored to the position (if applicable)
  4. Recruitment Interview - Initial screening with our talent team
  5. Executive Interview - Meet with senior leadership to discuss role alignment
  6. Client Interview - Final interview with the client team you'd be supporting
  7. Background & Reference Check - Professional reference verification
  8. Job Offer - Successful candidates receive a formal offer to join the team

Each stage is designed to evaluate your fit for the role while giving you insights into our company culture and expectations.

We'll keep you informed throughout the process and provide feedback at each step.

jobs.excerpt: Warp: We're Building the Platform for Agentic Development Warp began with the vision of reimagining one of the fundamental dev tools, the terminal, to make it more usable and powerful for all developers.
jobs.description:
Warp: We're Building the Platform for Agentic Development

Warp began with the vision of reimagining one of the fundamental dev tools, the terminal, to make it more usable and powerful for all developers. As AI has advanced, Warp has evolved beyond its terminal roots into a full agentic development environment: a workbench for dispatching agents to code, deploy, and debug production software.

Today, we have three products. Warp is the agentic development environment born out of the terminal, built on an orchestration platform for running hundreds of cloud agents in parallel. And Warp Factories is our newest product: infrastructure for engineering teams to build and run their own cloud software factories, where fleets of agents triage, spec, implement, review, and verify code across a company's entire SDLC. Together, these products are creating the scaffolding for developers to build their own workflows for working with agents.

In Warp, you can seamlessly switch between running commands, launching agents, and iterating on code with agents, eliminating the need to jump between a terminal and an IDE. It all works with our built in SOTA agent or top agents like Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, and OpenCode. On the orchestration side, you can build custom agents that are triggered programmatically, tracked centrally, and shared across full teams to run agents across organizations without compromising security or reliability. Continue a cloud agent run locally in Warp or on the web with one click. And with Warp Factories, teams can go a step further and set up entire automated workflows around their SDLC, retaining full control over their data, models, and compute along the way.

With over 1 million active developers at companies including Docker, Ramp, and Peloton, and over half of the Fortune 500, and revenue that grew over 44x last year, Warp is one of the fastest growing startups in the AI development space.

Our mission has remained the same even as AI has advanced: to empower developers to ship better software more quickly, freeing them to focus on the creative and rewarding aspects of their work. If you want to help define what development looks like in the agentic era at a company where your work reaches hundreds of thousands of engineers every day, we'd love to have you. For more information on our team and culture, we highly recommend reading our' How We Work' guide.

Why this role?

Warp is hiring a Sales Engineer to help engineering organizations evaluate, adopt, and expand Factories. You’ll join our growing team of sales engineers, and be one of our primary technical leads in our enterprise deals. You’ll work alongside our account executives and sales leadership, and partner closely with engineering, and growth.

You’ll show technical buyers what an AISDLC looks like in their environment and help them prove it’s worth it. Factories is defining a category that’s still being invented, and buyers are asking new questions: What’s our automation rate? What’s the ROI on agents? What does a merged PR cost? You’ll help shape how the industry answers them. You’ll also help build the technical sales playbook for how Warp sells Factories.

Your work will fall into three broad areas:

Technical Sales

  • Run technical discovery, demos, and deep-dives with engineering leaders, platform teams, and individual developers
  • Work through security reviews, compliance questionnaires, and architecture questions to unblock Factories in enterprise environments
  • Build and refine the technical sales playbook, including demo environments, POC frameworks, and reusable collateral

Proof of Value

  • Scope and lead POCs and pilots that show measurable impact in a customer’s own codebase and workflows
  • Help customers configure Factories for their environment, including agent workflows, model and harness choices, integrations, and self-hosted or bring-your-own LLM setups
  • Define success criteria with customers and build the business case: automation rate, SDLC velocity, cost-to-quality tradeoffs, and time saved
  • Handle technical implementation and onboarding to get teams to a technical win quickly

Customer Insight

  • Be the voice of the customer for product and engineering, surfacing patterns from enterprise evaluations that shape the roadmap

About you:

  • 6+ years in a sales engineering, solutions engineering, or technical customer-facing role
  • Experience selling and implementing technical SaaS, ideally developer tools, DevOps, infrastructure, or AI products
  • A background in software engineering: you can read a codebase, debug an integration, and go deep on technical challenges
  • Hands-on with AI coding agents and LLMs, with an informed view on where agents work well today and where they don’t
  • Experience leading POCs and getting through enterprise security and compliance reviews
  • Able to explain complex technical concepts to engineers, engineering leaders, and non-technical stakeholders
  • Highly organized and able to run multiple technical evaluations at once
  • Comfortable building process at an early-stage startup where the playbook is still being written
  • You’ve integrated AI into your daily workflows; at Warp we lean heavily on agents to accelerate and automate our work

Bonus:

  • Experience bringing a new product category to market
  • Experience selling into platform engineering or developer productivity teams
  • Experience building agentic workflows that automate processes within a large enterprise environment

At Warp, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. So if you’re excited about this role, but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in this job description—we encourage you to apply anyways! We are a community of curious learners, and most of us are learning some skills for the first time (like our engineers learning to program Warp in Rust). You might be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Salary Transparency

Total compensation at Warp consists of two parts: 1) a competitive base salary, and most importantly, 2) meaningful equity.

When we find the right person, we try to put our best foot forward with an offer that excites you. We consider what you’d like to be paid, the skills and level of experience you bring, what similar jobs pay, and make sure there’s equal pay for equal work among those you’ll be working with. The budgeted base compensation amount for this role is targeted at: $170,000 - $220,000.

In addition to salary, all employees receive further compensation in the form of equity in the company. This is a meaningful stock option grant with a four-year vesting period and one-year cliff. Your equity is where most of the significant upside potential is. Comparing startup equity is always a bit tricky, so we’re happy to walk you through different valuation scenarios at the offer stage in order to help paint a clearer picture of the upside.

Final total compensation is determined by multiple factors including your experience and expertise and may vary from the amounts listed above.

What We Offer

  • Competitive Salary & Meaningful Equity—we will stretch to get the right talent on board
  • Full Medical, Dental, and Vision Benefits for employees (80% coverage for dependents)
  • Flexible remote-first culture, with optional office spaces in NYC and SF for folks who want to work together IRL
  • Pre-tax FSA Health Savings Plan
  • Pre-tax Commuter Benefit
  • 20-days of Paid Time Off
  • Unlimited Sick Time Off
  • 12 US Holidays
  • 16 weeks of paid Parental Leave for both birthing and non-birthing parents
  • Twice-a-year company retreats
  • Monthly gym and internet stipend
  • Guideline 401(k)
  • Complimentary OneMedical membership

Individuals seeking employment at Warp are considered without regards to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, or sexual orientation.

About Warp

We are a company run by product-first builders, building a core product for all developers. We are committed to understanding our users deeply. We will ultimately build the best product and business if that team includes developers and designers from a wide range of backgrounds. The early team comes from Google, Dropbox, Gem, LinkedIn, and Facebook. We are looking for passionate individuals to join us and help bring Warp to the world.

We value honesty, humility, and pragmatism, and our core product principle is focusing on the user. If you’re interested in learning more about our company values and the culture of our engineering team, please take a look at our internal 'How We Work' guide.

We’re very fortunate to be backed by a great group of venture capital firms. In August 2023, we announced a $50M Series B funding round ($73M total raised), led by Sequoia Capital. Our other investors include Google Ventures, Neo, and Box Group. We are also backed by a network of passionate angels, including Dylan Field (Co-Founder and CEO, Figma), Elad Gil (early investor in Airbnb, Pinterest, Stripe, and Square), Jeff Weiner (Executive Chairman and Ex-CEO, LinkedIn), Marc Benioff (Founder and CEO, Salesforce), and Sam Altman (Co-Founder & CEO, OpenAI).

jobs.description:
Description

Sr. UX DELIVERABLES

General

There are four (4) distinct delivery phases in which user experience designers (task based I&IT consultants) produce deliverables following Ontario Digital Service Design playbook, which outlines the standard process for user experience design.

Delivery Phase 1) Discovery:

Before building a solution, a project team needs to find out whether users need it and whether other solutions exist. The UX Designers responsibilities during this phase are to build an understanding of the problem space/statement, the long and short-term business goals, and the user and business needs.

Deliverables:

  1. Facilitate the Kick-off meeting with the project team to produce such outputs as:
  • Business Model Canvas
  • 5 Whys
  • User Personas
  • Stakeholder Mapping
  • Strategy Map
  • Short- and Long-Term Goals
  • Fears and Challenges
  • Problem Statement
  1. Facilitate user research activities to produce such outputs as:
  • User interview topic Maps, a summary of interrelated topics for the user interview
  • User Interview Scripts to plan and guide user discussion
  • User Interview Synthesis (collection, aggregation and analysis) of written observations recorded during each interview
  • User research findings report
  1. Inception (Science Fair Day):
  • Showcases the work and key findings from this stage to stakeholders outside of the core project team
  • Aligns entire team (business, technical) on what the next steps will be
  • Planning activities for next phase (Alpha)
  1. Other deliverables typically delivered in this phase include:
  • User Storyboard to communicate a story through images displayed in a sequence of panels that chronologically maps the storys main events.
  • Technical Service Blueprint, a diagram that displays the entire process of service delivery including support systems by listing all the activities that happen at each stage, performed by the different roles involved
  • Defined business Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Delivery Phase 2) Alpha:

Alpha is about testing hypotheses and experimentation. The purpose of Alpha is to determine how to meet the user needs that were identified in discovery. This phase is an opportunity to quickly test different approaches with users before building a service.

Deliverables:

  1. Optionally conduct Google Ventures five (5) Day Design Sprint (or variation). This sprint is a five (5) day process for answering critical business questions through design, prototyping, and testing ideas with customers
  2. Produce clickable prototypes of multiple possible solutions
  3. Validate "clickable prototypes with users through usability testing sessions and produce research findings report
  4. Iterate (improve) on clickable prototypes with insights garnered from research findings report
  5. Identify and document existing processes or policies that will need to change to support the new product or service
  6. Produce a business proposal to justify funding for the next phase (Beta)
  7. Define a clear vision for the solution that will be built in Beta
  8. Create a plan and prioritized list of features to be completed in the Beta phase
  9. Define user solution, and delivery of KPIs

Delivery Phase 3) Beta:

The goal of Beta is to build a real service that works well for a larger group of people. The prototypes that were developed and tested during Alpha are used to build a Minimum Viable Product (MVP) for deployment in a live, user-facing environment. Executed within the context of Scrum methodology, the UX Designer performs the following Agile ceremonies: Stand-up meetings, Sprint Planning, Backlog grooming, Reporting, Acceptance, and Retrospective.

The designers are at the spearhead of this methodology, creating and validating user stories for the developers (typical) one iteration ahead.

Deliverables:

  1. User story creation and validation:
    1. Participates in deciding which priority to tackle
    2. Sketching workshop to create visual representation of ideas or user flows
    3. Create designs
    4. Enhancements made to designs
    5. User Interviews (for validation)
    6. Synthesising individual and overall interview findings
    7. Enhancements to designs made from synthesis
    8. Get product owner sign off and input story into backlog for future iteration planning
    9. Rinse and repeat for each feature, function within a given iteration
  2. Conduct accessibility compliance testing of the solution within each iteration.
  3. Conduct regular usability testing sessions on the MVP built as part of the Beta phase.

Delivery Phase 4) Live:

Live begins when the service has reached a point of maturity and all of the main features in the backlog have been built. While most people understand the purpose of live, its not always given the attention and resources it deserves.

Continuous improvement is one of the core principles of service design and thats what live is all about. The goal is to continuously monitor, research, test and iterate for as long as the service is active.

Deliverables:

  1. Continue to facilitate user research activities to produce such outputs as:
  • User interview topic maps, a summary of interrelated topics for the user interview
  • User interview scripts to plan and guide user discussion
  • User interview synthesis (collection, aggregation and analysis) of written observations recorded during each interview
  • User research findings report
  1. Conduct regular accessibility compliance testing of the live build as improvements are released.
  2. Conduct regular usability testing sessions on the live build.
  3. Analyze usage analytics and user behaviour patterns to track and measure key performance indicators.

SkillsExperience and Skill Set Requirements

Sr. User Experience Designer Evaluation Criteria

User Experience Design 40%

· Extensive experience in using UX design best practices to design solutions, and a deep understanding of mobile-first and responsive design.

· Ability to iterate your designs and solutions efficiently and intelligently.

· 3+ years of relevant experience in participating in complex projects (products) of different sizes, ensuring alignment to plans, best practices and incorporating user-centred design processes and agile (scrum) methodologies.

· Degree or diploma in graphic design; degree or certification in usability, human-computer interaction, and technical writing a plus

· Experience in facilitate User Research and Usability testing. Accessibility compliance testing is a plus.

· Experience in facilitate User Research and Usability testing activities to produce such outputs as:

o User Interview Topic Maps

o User Interview Scripts

o User Interview Synthesis (collection, aggregation and analysis) of written observations recorded during each interview

o User Research Findings Report

Relationship Management - 20%

· Demonstrated experience in communication and mediation skills with business teams and core team members to ensure Client projects (products) are progressing according to schedule

· Experience with strategies and actions to overcome resistance to change and capitalize on forces in support of change during all stages of projects Discovery, Alpha, Beta, Live or similar delivery methodologies

· Ability to deliver on a (project) product with a balanced team (product owner, user experience designers, developers) by participating in Agile (SCRUM) delivery methodologies

Technical Skills - 30%

· Expertise in UX software such as JustInMind, InVision, Sketch, Adobe Creative Cloud, Axure, Figma, and Zeplin. HTML5, CSS3, and JS skills (React, Angular, NodeJS), are a plus.

Soft skills - 10%

· Ability to clearly and effectively communicate design processes, ideas, and solutions to teams and clients.

· Be excited about collaborating and communicating closely with teams and other stakeholders via a distributed model to regularly deliver design solutions for approval.

· Strong interpersonal and negotiation skills

· Strong presentation, verbal and written communication skills

Must Haves

Extensive experience in using UX design best practices to design solutions and a deep understanding of mobile-first and responsive design.

Description

We're looking for a Marketing Design Team Lead who is equal parts creative leader, marketer, and AI geek, someone who knows how to achieve business goals through visuals that actually sell.

You will take a team of 3 AI-driven Creative Designers and scale it to 6. The team produces static ad creatives, photorealistic AI visuals for performance campaigns across paid media channels, and source assets for our video production pipeline.

  • Work tightly with Creative Producers, Marketers, Media Buyers, and Video Editors: align on strategy, negotiate deadlines, solve bottlenecks.

Requirements

Your must-haves

Hands-on with modern AI image platforms (Figma Weave, Higgsfield, Magnific, Runway, or similar), using them for creating photorealistic visuals. Able to choose the right tool for each task, as well as to catch and fix artifacts.

Nice to have

Description

CapsLock is a global IT marketing company that pioneers unique, scalable customer acquisition solutions for B2C clients. We solve complex sales challenges across a wide range of industries, primarily for large North American partners. By integrating our expertise in Digital Marketing, IT, Design, AI-driven analytics, proprietary MarTech, and sales consulting, we deliver powerful, data-informed customer acquisition solutions.

At CapsLock, people, technology, and forward-thinking innovation lie at the heart of everything we do. Our diverse, global team, fluent in over 10 languages, thrives on open collaboration and the exchange of new ideas, pushing boundaries to ensure our clients' success.

Role overview

We're looking for a Marketing Design Team Lead who is equal parts creative leader, marketer, and AI geek, someone who knows how to achieve business goals through visuals that actually sell.

You will take a team of 3 AI-driven Creative Designers and scale it to 6. The team produces static ad creatives, photorealistic AI visuals for performance campaigns across paid media channels, and source assets for our video production pipeline.

Your job is to build the company's visual creative engine. Whatever the starting point- a brief, a hypothesis, a raw idea - it leaves the team as a creative that performs.

You'll work closely with Creative Producers, Marketers, Copywriters, Media Buyers, and the Video Editing team, and partner with our Generative AI Pipeline Engineer on tooling and workflows.

What you will work on

  • Lead, mentor, and scale a team of 3 to 6 AI-driven Creative Designers - grow people, not just output;
  • Own the production flow: task distribution, capacity planning, and strict QC - production-grade, not demo-grade;
  • Drive creative direction: concepts, hooks, and visual angles that stop the scroll and convert;
  • Generate ideas yourself and push the team beyond safe iterations - informed by visual trends and competitor creatives;
  • Own the creative testing loop: build a database of winners, analyze failures, turn performance data into next iterations;
  • Track new AI models and tools; be the company's go-to expert on what's creatively possible with AI, staying hands-on in the tools;
  • Run regular R&D and build prompt and style libraries that keep quality consistent as the team grows;
  • Stay hands-on: jump into the tools (Figma, Adobe Suite, AI platforms) when needed to unblock the team, take on the most complex creatives, or test new approaches;
  • Partner with the Generative AI Pipeline Engineer to turn the team's creative needs into pipelines, presets, and automation;
  • Work tightly with Creative Producers, Marketers, Media Buyers, and Video Editors: align on strategy, negotiate deadlines, solve bottlenecks.

Requirements

Your must-haves

You don't need to meet every single requirement. If you're excellent in most of these areas and can show shipped work, we'd love to hear from you.

  • 5+ years of Leadership Experience: You have successfully managed creative/design teams in digital marketing. (This is not a role for a senior designer looking for their first management gig);
  • Mature Leader & Problem Solver: You build clear processes, guide your team, gracefully resolve conflicts, remain highly proactive, and stay completely open to new ideas and approaches;
  • Strong Project Manager: You drive every project cleanly to the finish line. You guarantee top-tier quality, maintain absolute order, and hit strict deadlines without excuses;
  • Strong Visual Craft: composition, lighting, color, typography, anatomy. You can articulate exactly why a creative works or doesn't;
  • Design Toolstack: proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite; comfortable connecting AI outputs with traditional design pipelines;
  • AI Geek: far beyond basic prompting. You track every new model release and can't wait to test how it could level up ad creatives. Hands-on with modern AI image platforms (Figma Weave, Higgsfield, Magnific, Runway, or similar), using them for creating photorealistic visuals. Able to choose the right tool for each task, as well as to catch and fix artifacts.
  • Performance Marketing DNA: solid understanding of static ad creatives (Google, Meta, and other paid channels). You know what stops the scroll, what makes a visual sell, and how creative decisions move CTR, CPA, and conversion rate;
  • Fluency in English - both spoken and written.

Nice to have

  • A strong portfolio showcasing performance marketing creatives and AI-generated photorealistic work - ideally with examples shipped under your leadership and the results they drove;
  • Experience with creatives for high-CPA verticals (home improvement, insurance, health, legal, finance, or similar);
  • Experience creating visuals for North American audiences - you know what looks native to a US consumer;
  • Understanding of how static visuals feed video production pipelines.

What we offer

  • Remote Work - we offer a truly and fully remote environment. You choose where you are the most productive and comfortable to have an impact.
  • Paid vacations - generous paid vacation policy to ensure you have time to recharge.
  • Unlimited Sick Days - we understand that being only human means getting sick or feeling under the weather from time to time, so we guarantee you time off as long as you need to recover and get back on your feet.
  • Ongoing Learning - people at CapsLock are deeply inquisitive and eager to learn new knowledge and skills, that's why we support and create learning opportunities like the Free Books program, workshops, conferences, and more.
  • Home Office - we will cover the equipment and furniture expenses to make sure you have the best work-from-home experience.
  • Physical Well-Being - we will cover costs of your medical insurance. Additionally we offer an allowance for a flexible fitness program.

Reports to: VP of Finance Operations

Location: US - Remote

About BibliU

BibliU is an award-winning, technology-led B2B company transforming the $65bn educational content industry. With a 90% CAGR the past 5 years, we are just getting started. We've cracked the code on Day 1 access to affordable digital course materials for students, while delivering comprehensive campus store solutions that foster human relationships and increase our stickiness in the world of AI.

The result? Measurable impact: 10% higher student retention, 1-point GPA increases, and partnerships with 170 universities serving 600,000 students each year.

We've fundamentally changed how universities procure, distribute, and manage learning content. We partner with 4,000+ publishers, including Pearson, Oxford University Press, and Wiley to deliver content to universities, and provide rich engagement data and interactive tools like quizzes that help students actually learn.

Here's what makes our story compelling:

Founded in late 2015 as an Oxford University spin-out, we've grown explosively with 90% CAGR over the last five years, including 65% in FY25, reaching $100m in annual revenue. Our Series B raised $23m, led by Nesta Impact Investments (with Guinness Asset Management, Stonehage Fleming, and Oxford Sciences Enterprises). In late 2023, we acquired Texas Book Company (now 'BibliU Campus') to become the only fully vertically integrated player in the market, driving US organic growth which now represents 90% of our business.

We're hungry for more. We're actively building our M&A pipeline as we compete head-to-head against legacy bricks-and-mortar providers to improve the faculty and student experience while boosting the financial sustainability of universities.

Our culture is collaborative, high-growth, and agile. You’ll join an experienced and motivated executive team with backgrounds from Instructure (Canvas) and other successful edtech companies with exit experience. We operate as a distributed team across the UK and US, with offices in London.

Position Overview

This role gives you the opportunity to work with a global, cross-functional team as a core member of our growing company. We are looking for a driven Commercial Partnerships Lead who will report into the VP of Digital Operations whilst building and managing key supplier relationships. This role is essential to achieving our continued international growth and you will drive BibliU's growth initiatives by collaborating and strategising in conjunction with our suppliers, in order to ensure that the BibliU platform can best serve our University customers.

What you will be doing:

  • Data analysis on internal/external reporting
  • Internal process/system improvement related projects, working directly with our product and implementation teams
  • Account management of BibliU’s commercial publisher partners
  • Build relationships, communicate efficiently, and strategise with commercial partners in order to enable BibliU’s strategic direction
  • Pitch new business models and revenue streams to commercial partners in order to sign commercial agreements
  • Negotiate with commercial partners to secure pricing and terms that maximise our margins
  • Enable business development by signing distribution agreements with new commercial partners to help us achieve 100% booklist coverage across all partner universities
  • Understand and articulate value propositions of BibliU's platform and services to commercial partners, including platform demonstrations and feature Q&A sessions
  • Handle our repository of commercial partners’ contracts and consulting internal and external stakeholders
  • Analyse content usage and sales trends from platform data in order to present valuable insights and strategic recommendations to top commercial partners
  • Liaise cross-functionally with various departments at BibliU, including Sales, Customer Success and Product teams, to ensure the needs of all external stakeholders (both commercial partners and universities) are being met both timely and efficiently
  • Represent BibliU in global industry conferences as required (London & Frankfurt)
  • Deliver operational needs to commercial publisher partners, such as weekly/monthly reporting covering adoption and commercials

What we are looking for:

  • Excellent commercial acumen and relationship building skills
  • 4+ years experience in consulting and/or a growing tech company
  • Presentation and sales skills, able to articulate a value proposition to senior stakeholders and negotiate commercial terms
  • Extremely organised with strong attention to detail
  • Effective communicator, able to work with a remote team
  • Self-motivated and able to prioritise workload and manage time effectively
  • Know-how and confidence to speak with external stakeholders, including senior publishing executives (C-Suite etc)
  • Experience with Google Sheets, CRM databases such as Salesforce, and project management software such as ClickUp

Benefits

Our benefits are all aimed at supporting a healthy work-life balance and cultivating a company culture where you can bring your whole, human self to work.

Here's what we offer:

  • 🌴 35 holiday per year - yep, that’s not a typo! (in addition to public holidays)
  • 🎂 Your birthday off
  • 🌱 12 scheduled company wellness Fridays off per year (in addition to your vacation entitlement)
  • 🩺 Medical, vision & dental insurance (BibliU contributing 70% of all monthly premiums)
  • 📄 401k plan (Company Match: 100% of the first 3%; 50% of the next 2%)
  • ❤️ Enhanced maternity & paternity allowance
  • 💸 Flexible Spending Account
  • ⏰ Flexible working hours - we’re a remote team spread across the US and UK
  • 💻 Work-from-home allowance to help you set up your dream WFH station

We strongly encourage candidates of all different backgrounds, experiences and identities to apply. Each new hire is an opportunity for us to bring in a different perspective and BibliU is committed to building an inclusive and supportive workplace where everyone can do rewarding work.

About Fiesta Health

Fiesta Health is a rapidly growing ABA provider serving children with autism throughout Georgia. As we continue to expand, we are seeking an experienced Revenue Cycle Manager to oversee all aspects of billing, claim submission, payment posting, denials and appeals, accounts receivable, and revenue cycle systems.

This is not an entry-level billing position. We are looking for someone with extensive experience managing the full revenue cycle for ABA or behavioral health organizations with Medicaid and commercial insurance companies in the United States.

The ideal candidate is fluent in ABA CPT codes and payer-specific billing rules, has personally worked denials and appeals through to overturned decisions, and is comfortable communicating directly with insurance companies to make sure every claim is paid accurately and on time.

Position Overview

The Revenue Cycle Manager is responsible for managing the complete revenue cycle, from the moment a session is documented through final payment and account resolution.

This includes:

  • Coding and charge review

  • Pre-billing claim review

  • Claim submission

  • Clearinghouse management

  • Payment posting

  • Cash reconciliation

  • Denials management and appeals

  • Accounts receivable follow-up

  • Underpayment review

  • Patient statements and family billing support

  • Revenue cycle reporting

Channel Account Manager - Northeast U.S. & Eastern Canada

Job Summary:

Department: Channel Sales / Partner Ecosystem

Reports To: VP of Channels

Location: Boston, MA or New York, NY (remote, field-based)

Travel: ~50% across the territory

Alkira is the leader in AI-Native Network Infrastructure-as-a-Service (NIaaS). Founded in 2018 by Amir and Atif Khan — the team behind Viptela and the founding of the SD-WAN market — Alkira unifies any environment, site, or user through an enterprise network built entirely in the cloud, managed with the same controls, policies, and security systems network teams already know, and augmented by AI. There is no hardware to deploy, no software to download, and no new architecture to learn. Alkira is trusted by Fortune 100 enterprises, leading system integrators, and global managed service providers, and is part of Lumen Technologies.

Alkira's partner ecosystem is growing fast: over 150 partners now drive more than 40% of total company revenue, and the 1,000th partner was recently enabled. In March 2026, Alkira launched Connect, its next-generation partner program built around a “Partner Profit Stack” of tiered margins, rebates, MDF, and velocity incentives — giving VAR’s, GSIs, MSPs, cloud service providers, and security/AI-focused firms a repeatable engine to attach high-value services to every deal. Alkira has also expanded successfully into Canada, making the Northeast U.S. and Eastern Canada a natural, connected territory for a single owner.

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly motivated Channel Account Manager based in Boston or New York to own and grow Alkira's partner ecosystem across the Northeast U.S. and Eastern Canada (including markets such as Toronto, Ottawa, and Montreal). This role is responsible for recruiting, enabling, and driving revenue through the full range of partner types in the territory — VARs, GSIs, MSPs, TSDs/master agents, and cloud service providers — and for building the cross-border relationships needed to grow Alkira's presence on both sides of the border. The ideal candidate has established relationships with enterprise-focused partners in the Northeast corridor and is comfortable navigating the added complexity of a cross-border, dual-currency territory.

Key Responsibilities

Territory Partner Development

  • Recruit, onboard, and manage strategic channel partners across the Northeast U.S. and Eastern Canada, including VARs, GSIs, MSPs, TSDs/master agents, and cloud service providers.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for territory partners, building relationships from executive sponsors down to field sales and technical teams.
  • Build and execute a coverage plan spanning key Northeast metros (Boston, New York, and the broader corridor) and Eastern Canadian markets (e.g., Toronto, Ottawa, Montreal), prioritizing investment where partner and customer demand is strongest.

Sales Growth & Pipeline Management

  • Drive pipeline and revenue growth through joint account planning, demand generation, and co-selling with territory partners.
  • Leverage Alkira Connect's Partner Profit Stack — tiered margins, rebates, MDF, and velocity incentives — to accelerate partner-sourced pipeline and time-to-first-deal.
  • Maintain accurate partner pipeline and forecast reporting in Alkira's CRM/PRM, providing visibility to channel and regional sales leadership.

Partner Enablement

  • Educate and certify partners on Alkira's NIaaS platform, ensuring their sales and technical teams can confidently position, sell, and deliver Connect Services Attach Plays (network modernization assessments, segmentation/compliance design, migration and cutover sprints).
  • Execute Alkira's partner program initiatives, incentives, and joint marketing campaigns across the territory.
  • Run and support partner trainings, roadshows, and events in both the Northeast U.S. and Eastern Canada.

Collaboration & Market Expansion

  • Work closely with Alkira's direct sales, marketing, and sales engineering teams to align on territory channel initiatives and joint opportunities.
  • Identify new partner opportunities across target verticals in the Northeast U.S. and Eastern Canada to broaden Alkira's footprint.
  • Represent Alkira at partner events, industry conferences, and customer-facing engagements throughout the territory, including travel into Canada as needed.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in channel sales, partner account management, or alliances — preferably in networking, cloud, or SaaS.
  • Established relationships with VARs, GSIs, MSPs, TSDs/master agents, or cloud service providers in the Northeast U.S.; experience with Canadian partners or cross-border sales is a strong plus.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise IT infrastructure, cloud networking, and partner go-to-market motions.
  • Demonstrated success driving revenue through indirect sales and partner-led opportunities.
  • Proven ability to develop joint business plans, manage partner programs, and execute go-to-market strategies across a multi-market territory.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills.
  • Highly self-motivated with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth startup environment.
  • Based in or near Boston or New York City, with a valid passport and the ability to travel approximately 50% of the time, including regularly into Eastern Canada.

Why Join Alkira

  • Own a high-density, high-opportunity territory spanning two of the U.S.'s top enterprise markets plus Alkira's growing Canadian footprint.
  • Launch with the backing of Alkira Connect, a partner program built to help partners grow their own services revenue alongside Alkira's.
  • Work alongside a world-class team of networking industry veterans and innovators.
  • The salary range for this position is $225,000 - $260,000. Your actual base salary and level will be determined on a case by case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge, skills, experience, education and location.

Life at Alkira is human and connected, even in a fast moving, AI‑focused organization. We set clear expectations and trust people to meet them. With real support and shared accountability, teams collaborate better, move faster, and deliver meaningful outcomes.

The Strategic Account Management organization is a highly skilled forward-thinking sales team serving our largest and most complex customers, while also managing our highest valued vaccine contracts. The customers we call on primarily include Health Systems, IHNs, Medical Groups, PBGs, FQHCs and state Awardees.


We are an innovative global healthcare company that helps the world stay ahead of infectious diseases by delivering more than 500 million vaccine doses a year. Across different countries, our talented teams are exploring new technologies to protect people and promote healthy communities. We chase the miracles of science every single day, pursuing progress to make a real impact on millions of patients around the world.


Join the team protecting half a billion lives every year with next-gen science, mRNA innovation, and AI driven breakthroughs. In Vaccines, you’ll help advance prevention on a global scale - and shape the future of immunization.


About Sanofi

We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives.


Main Responsibilities


  • Assume the leadership role within assigned accounts, providing overall account leadership to cross-functional internal and external team members as needed. In this capacity, the SAM will assume responsibility for assigned strategic customers and manage each as a business partnership on behalf of Sanofi. Additionally, the SAM will bear full responsibility for building a strategic account plan for assigned accounts, as well as organizing and deploying the appropriate resources within Sanofi to drive value co-creation with customers and meet/exceed Sanofi’s revenue targets.

The SAM will develop a deep understanding of the customer’s business which includes their pressures and drivers, priorities, as well as their related challenges and opportunities. They will maintain working knowledge of the customer’s business model, strategic goals and objectives, and their position within the healthcare environment including value-based health care, their competitors, and financial levers.
  • Identify and qualify high value opportunities within their accounts by working directly with the customer to develop and drive growth strategies, team-to-team alignment, and executive relationships together with internal cross-functional team members. Accordingly, the SAM will conduct business coaching and strategy session with their account teams to facilitate the co-creation of customer value and ensure ongoing internal alignment and account growth. The SAM will function as the central focal point for communications regarding account planning, strategy, collaboration, resource allocation and customer engagement.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Strong data analytics
  • Experience working in Market Access, Pricing, Contracting or Finance
  • Proficient with MS Office and customer management databases

Travel:


  • Ability to travel up to 75% of the time to customers, conventions, training, and other internal meetings.


Why Choose Us?


  • Work at the forefront of AI-driven research, smart manufacturing, and groundbreaking mRNA platforms that are redefining the future of immunology.
  • Help protect half a billion people every year, contributing to one of the largest global vaccination efforts in healthcare.
  • Develop your career with access to mentoring, international mobility programs, and opportunities to grow across four continents.

How will you make an impact?

  • We are seeking a highly skilled, technically authoritative and customer-facing Sr. Principal Hyperscale Rack Engineer within the Intelligent Infrastructure Segment to lead the architecture, integration, and strategic direction of advanced air and liquid-cooled server and network rack solutions for large-scale hyperscale deployments.

  • This role will serve as the senior technical authority responsible for translating customer requirements into scalable, manufacturable, and commercially viable rack systems.

  • As the Sr. Principal Hyperscale Rack Engineer, youwill operate at the intersection of engineering, customer engagement, and program execution – driving end-to-end rack architecture across mechanical, power, thermal, electrical, and software domains.

  • Success in this role requires deep technical expertise, strong commercial acumen, and the ability to lead complex programs while influencing both internal and external stakeholders.

What will you do?

  • Serve as the lead architect and development manager for complex rack-level solutions, owning system-level design decisions across mechanical, electrical, power, thermal, networking, and software integration domains.

  • Lead customer-facing technical engagements from RFI/RFQ all the way to first hardware delivery, including design reviews, trade-off discussions, and executive-level conversations.

  • Translate ambiguous or evolving customer requirements into clear program frameworks, ensuring alignment between customer expectations and engineering execution.

  • Demonstrate strong commercial awareness by effectively managing customer expectations, pushing back when requirements introduce risk or inefficiency, and confidently addressing challenging technical and cost-related questions.

  • Drive cross-functional alignment across all departments (executives, engineering, supply chain, manufacturing, and program) to ensure cohesive solution development with emphasis on Bill of Materials (BOM) management and scheduling.

  • Own rack-level architecture including power distribution design, thermal strategies (air and liquid cooling), cable routing, serviceability, and manufacturability.

  • Provide deep technical guidance on rack infrastructure including PDUs, busbars, liquid cooling systems (CDUs, manifolds, QDs), airflow design, and high-density compute integration.

  • Oversee architecture decisions impacting performance, cost, scalability, and deployment efficiency.

  • Drive program execution from concept through production, ensuring schedules are clearly defined, tracked, and met.

  • Apply strong program management discipline: define milestones, identify risks early, escalate issues proactively, and hold cross-functional teams accountable to commitments.

  • Drive readiness support calls internally from initial NPI scoping to prototyping to mass production, ensuring all systems are operable together from a power, thermal, and software standpoint.

  • Partner with customers and internal stakeholders to continuously refine designs based on deployment feedback and operational learnings.

  • Collaborate with compliance and certification teams to ensure mechanical designs meet global regulatory requirements (e.g., UL, CE, ISTA, ASTM).

  • Mentor and guide engineers across disciplines, establishing best practices in rack system architecture and integration.

  • Understanding of rack installation constraints, maintenance access, and serviceability in rack mechanical infrastructure.

  • Conduct root cause analysis and corrective actions for mechanical failures or field issues.

  • May perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related field is required

  • Minimum of 10 years’ experience in engineering, systems integration, or data center hardware design.

  • Minimum of 3 years’ rack-level (L11) solution design and integration experience.

  • Minimum of 3 years’ switch/server (L10) experience, including compute, storage, or networking hardware integration.

  • Proven ability to drive the development and execution of complex rack solutions for hyperscale or large-scale data center environments, managing 12-18 month lifecycles and portfolios valued at hundreds of millions of dollars.

  • Familiarity with industry standards (EIA, ORV3, OCP) and global power architectures.

  • Demonstrated experience working directly with customers in technical and commercially sensitive environments.

  • Strong background in program execution, including schedule ownership, risk management, and cross-functional leadership.

  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills – a must.

  • Strong understanding of mechanical systems, integration strategies, and program management.

  • Hands-on experience with prototype fabrication and testing (mechanical S&V, software burn-in and test validation).

Directs the Revenue Enablement function for the organization. Owns the strategy, roadmap, and execution of enablement programs for Go to Market (GTM) teams. Provides guidance to Revenue Enablement leaders and their direct reports, and ensures work is distributed across the team in a manner that optimizes throughput and builds skills and capabilities. Works cross functionally to provide the Sales, Customer Success, and other customer facing teams the right content, training, and mentorship needed to hone their skillsets and effectively engage their buyers and customers. Quarterbacks the Onboarding & New Hire Training Program to drive quicker and more consistent ramp times, runs point on sales readiness programs, and leads the use of AI to scale enablement delivery.

Key Responsibilities

  • Leads, guides, evaluates and monitors deliverables of the Revenue Enablement team. Manages performance including hiring, coaching, performance reviews, and professional development planning for direct reports. Ensures clarity around priorities, motivates and empowers department leaders to manage day-to-day execution of team operations, and removes obstacles to improve team productivity and effectiveness. Encourages leadership development and growth and implements professional development plans for high-potential employees.
  • Works with Sr. Leadership to identify and execute engagement, recognition, promotion, and retention strategies focused on making sure the organization has the right talent to drive enablement strategy and initiatives forward.
  • Owns and architects the vision, roadmap, and priorities for sales communications and enablement, and assumes accountability for evolving the roadmap based on business results and organizational input.
  • Collaborates with subject matter experts from product management and other teams to create high-quality enablement content, including role specific training materials and processes, playbooks, sales guides, demo scripts, certifications, and solution presentations.
  • Assumes responsibility of foundational and continuous learning programs for customer facing teams, including but not limited to training content creation, scheduling and coordination, creation and deployment or delivery of on-demand courseware, and instructor-led sales and field training.
  • Works with product management, marketing, and other stakeholders to gather feedback, incorporate product updates, and ensure that enablement materials are up to date and aligned with the latest product offerings.
  • Establishes key performance indicators (KPIs) that tie enablement programs to revenue outcomes such as win rate, sales-cycle length, ramp-to-quota time, and quota attainment. Generates reports to track progress, identifies areas for improvement, and communicates success to stakeholders.
  • Stays abreast of industry trends, competitive landscape, and customer challenges. Incorporates knowledge into enablement programs to help position OEC’s solutions as industry-leading and differentiated.
  • Assumes ownership for implementing and maintaining sales productivity tools including Seismic and Outreach, builds self-paced training content, and leads the evaluation and adoption of AI-driven tools and workflows. Recommends and leads process improvement initiatives.
  • Recruits, hires and onboards new department leaders and staff.
  • Participates in developing the annual budget. Identifies, manages and allocates company resources (budget and staffing) to ensure business goals can be accomplished, while ensuring fiscal responsibility.
  • Leads the implementation of standardized sales methodologies across customer-facing teams and drives their ongoing adoption, embedding them into training, coaching, and content.

Education

A bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university is required, with a focus in Training, Sales, or related discipline. In the absence of a degree, equivalent work experience will be considered as a substitute for the degree.

Experience

At least 10 years of experience in revenue/sales/GTM enablement or revenue operations, with a background in executing sales trainings such as teaching selling skills, sales coaching, and/or roleplaying, plus demonstrated experience leveraging AI tools and workflows for improving enablement efficiency and reporting, a verifiable track record of connecting enablement programs to measurable revenue outcomes, hands on experience implementing and driving adoption of a structured sales methodology, and at least 5 years of prior management experience directly managing a high-performing team and providing performance management and coaching to direct and indirect reports.

Must also be able to demonstrate the following knowledge, skills and abilities:

  • Proficiency with Seismic, a Sales Enablement platform
  • Experience training and coaching GTM teams on MEDDIC, Sandler, and Challenger sales methodologies
  • Ability to lead diverse teams and create an engaging and positive culture that motivates and empowers others to do great work.
  • Driven proactive operator who can effectively and independently set direction, build agendas, anticipate business needs, and move initiatives forward.
  • Comfortable operating in a complex, matrixed, and fast-changing work environment with competing priorities and incomplete information.
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to translate the company's vision and defining objectives into impactful goals and expectations for the team.
  • Excellent audience-tailored communication skills and can flex messaging and format for executives, frontline sellers, and cross-functional partners, with a clear call to action.
  • Sound business judgement and strong critical thinking skills.
  • Flexible and adaptable approach to work and can effectively support department leaders and their teams through change management and with adjusting to shifts in priorities as the needs of the business change.

Travel

  • Occasional travel for this position may be required according to business needs but is anticipated to be less than 15% of work responsibility.
