Itero Group is a Women-Owned Small Business focused on simplifying complex transformations. We empower clients in the private and government sectors to become more optimized, digitally enabled, and data-driven organizations through our comprehensive business consulting and innovative delivery solutions.

Itero Group's dedicated team members are experienced thought leaders, tenacious workers, and creative thinkers. We hire people who are passionate about being catalysts for change - in our company, for our clients, throughout our career- and we empower people to express their ideas, create better practices, innovate better products, and become better professionals.

We have been named a Great Place to Work for six years, and offer a competitive salary and benefits package.

Itero Group is seeking an experienced, hands-on Scrum Master II to support a software development team within a large-scale federal healthcare program. The ideal candidate will bring a practical understanding of Agile methodologies, strong facilitation and delivery coordination skills, and the ability to support a technical team operating within established sprint cycles and quarterly release schedules.

This role requires someone who understands how to apply Agile principles to drive results rather than simply following processes. The Scrum Master will work closely with developers, business analysts, technical leadership, and the Product Owner to remove impediments, maintain delivery momentum, and promote continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities

  • Facilitate Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and backlog refinement.

  • Support a cross-functional software development team operating in three-week sprints with quarterly release commitments.

  • Identify and remove impediments, manage dependencies, and help ensure sprint goals and delivery milestones are achieved.

  • Partner with the Product Owner, technical lead, developers, and business analysts to coordinate priorities, activities, and deliverables.

  • Track sprint progress, risks, dependencies, and team performance using Jira dashboards, metrics, and reporting tools.

  • Coordinate system demonstrations, including preparation, stakeholder communication, and execution.

  • Analyze Agile metrics and identify opportunities to improve team productivity, accountability, and delivery performance.

  • Support project coordination, status reporting, and administrative activities to maintain visibility into team progress.

  • Apply Agile and Scaled Agile practices within a structured delivery environment, balancing flexibility with established release requirements.

  • Collaborate with other Scrum Masters and PMO leadership to establish consistent Agile practices, reporting standards, and delivery processes.

  • Promote team collaboration, ownership, continuous improvement, and effective communication across technical and business stakeholders.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated experience serving as a Scrum Master supporting software development teams in an Agile environment.

  • Strong working knowledge of Scrum, Agile methodologies, and Scaled Agile concepts.

  • Experience supporting teams operating within fixed release schedules, enterprise delivery environments, or hybrid Agile frameworks.

  • Proven ability to facilitate Agile ceremonies, remove obstacles, and support successful sprint execution.

  • Hands-on experience with Jira, including sprint tracking, backlog management, dashboards, metrics, and reporting.

  • Experience analyzing team performance metrics, identifying delivery risks, and communicating progress to stakeholders.

  • Strong organizational, facilitation, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications.

  • Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and collaborate effectively with technical and business teams.

  • Practical, results-oriented approach to Agile delivery with the ability to adapt processes to meet team and program needs.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting federal government or healthcare technology programs.

  • Familiarity with CMS, Medicare, healthcare claims processing, or medical policy systems.

  • Experience supporting mainframe, legacy application development, or enterprise modernization initiatives.

  • Exposure to batch processing systems and complex enterprise application environments.

  • Experience working within a Project Management Office (PMO) or supporting Agile process standardization across multiple teams.

  • Background in project coordination, delivery reporting, or traditional project management activities.

Technical Environment

The Scrum Master will support a software development team responsible for enterprise applications and legacy systems within a federal healthcare environment. The team operates in three-week sprint cycles with established quarterly releases.

While deep technical development or mainframe expertise is not required, candidates should be comfortable collaborating with technical teams, understanding development activities at a high level, identifying dependencies, and coordinating delivery timelines.

Agile certifications are not required. Relevant hands-on experience, sound judgment, adaptability, and demonstrated success supporting software delivery are the primary considerations.

About Itero Group

Itero Group is a women-owned small business focused on delivering innovative technology solutions and consulting services to commercial and government clients. We are committed to providing exceptional service, fostering collaboration, and helping our clients achieve meaningful business outcomes.

Itero Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace and providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants.

If you are looking for a role where you will lead with integrity, create and innovate, inspire excellence, be a respected member of the team, drive results, and have fun, we look forward to connecting with you!

Benefits at Itero Group

jobs.description:
Product Manager, Industrial Solutions

Job Term: Full-Time

The Opportunity

Picarro is looking for a product-minded builder to join our Industrial Solutions team as a Product Manager. You will define what gets built, why it matters, and how it works. You will own outcomes, not just a backlog.

You will own features end-to-end and shape the roadmap within Picarro’s fastest-growing verticals: continuous fenceline monitoring for chemical manufacturing compliance and industrial workplace monitoring for occupational safety. Both are grounded in the Cavity Ring-Down Spectroscopy (CRDS) measurement science that makes Picarro instruments the gold standard in precision gas analysis.

You will work across the full product lifecycle: customer discovery, requirements, prototyping, launch, and iteration. The products you ship will directly help companies meet complex environmental and safety obligations. That is the mission.

Responsibilities

Product Strategy & Roadmap

Set priorities and shape the Industrial Solutions roadmap, balancing near-term customer needs and compliance deadlines with longer-term platform investments. Own features end-to-end, from concept to launch to continuous improvement, and be accountable for the results.

Prototyping & Requirements

Translate customer insights and market needs into crisp, actionable requirements: MRDs, PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria. Build low- and high-fidelity prototypes to test ideas early, gather feedback, and de-risk development before engineering investment scales up.

Customer & Market Discovery

Conduct structured customer interviews, synthesize field data, and maintain a current view of EPA rulemaking, OSHA requirements, and emerging monitoring technologies. Use what you learn to make confident prioritization decisions, even with incomplete information.

Cross-Functional Execution

Serve as the product owner in Agile sprint cycles (planning, backlog grooming, story review, and retrospectives). Partner closely with R&D, engineering, data science, QA, and field teams. Make the tradeoff calls, remove blockers, and keep delivery on track and on spec.

Go-To-Market & Commercial Enablement

Own product positioning, sales enablement materials, and competitive intelligence for your features. Partner with marketing and sales on launch planning and support pre-sales technical discussions with key accounts.

Performance & Iteration

Define success metrics before you build. Track performance post-launch, report results to leadership, and drive a continuous loop of feedback, data, and iteration.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Environmental Science, Chemistry, Physics, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
  • 3–5 years of product management or equivalent experience with direct product ownership responsibilities.
  • Demonstrated ability to write sharp requirements and prototype ideas. You close the gap between discovery and delivery.
  • AI-forward mindset with hands-on experience applying AI tools, LLMs, or automation to real product problems.
  • Experience working within Agile/scrum development as a product owner.
  • Proficiency with Jira, Confluence, Figma, or similar product and design tools.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; comfortable presenting to technical and non-technical audiences alike, and able to influence cross-functional teams without direct authority.
  • Willingness to travel approximately 20% for customer visits, conferences, and industry events.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Proven track record of building and shipping products or features independently, including personal projects, open-source contributions, or internal tools that went beyond your core job responsibilities.
  • Familiarity with EPA continuous fenceline monitoring requirements (such as the HON Rule) or comparable environmental/occupational safety regulatory frameworks.
  • Background in environmental science, chemistry, chemical engineering, or industrial operations, or knowledge of methane leak detection, emissions monitoring, air quality, or precision gas measurement.
  • Experience with cloud-based SaaS or data analytics products for industrial or environmental applications.
  • Proficiency with product analytics tools (Pendo, Amplitude, PostHog, or similar).
  • Prior experience in a startup or high-growth technology environment.

The base salary range for this full-time position is $120K to $140K. Our total compensation packages include base salary, bonus eligibility, and equity. Your base salary range and title will be determined based on the location, experience, qualification, skills, knowledge, level, and pay of employees in similar positions.

We offer a comprehensive benefit package including:

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance
  • Flexible Spending Account (FSA) and Health Savings Account (HSA) plans
  • Life, Short-Term Disability, and Long-Term Disability Insurance
  • Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays
  • Employee Referral Program
  • 401K
  • Social events (summer picnic, holiday party, team lunches, etc.)
  • On-site Health & Wellness programs (fitness challenges, outdoor bootcamp, flu-shots, etc.)

About Picarro:

We are the world's leader in timely, trusted, and actionable data using enhanced optical spectroscopy. Our solutions are used in a wide variety of applications, including natural gas leak detection, ethylene oxide emissions monitoring, semiconductor fabrication, pharmaceutical, petrochemical, atmospheric science, air quality, greenhouse gas measurements, food safety, hydrology, ecology, and more. Our software and hardware are designed and manufactured in Santa Clara, California and are used in over 90 countries worldwide based on over 65 patents related to cavity ring-down spectroscopy (CRDS) technology and are unparalleled in their precision, ease of use, and reliability.

jobs.description:
About Discovered Labs

Discovered Labs is an SEO/AEO agency built by a Stanford rocket scientist turned AI researcher (Ben Moore) and demand gen marketer with experience scaling B2B SaaS companies to 8-figures in ARR (Liam Dunne).

We're a team of ML engineers, data scientists and senior marketers trusted by fast-growing B2B SaaS companies including Instantly, Granola and Composio to help generate leads and customers through Google and AI assistants like ChatGPT.

We do this through a mixture of content marketing, technical optimisations and off-site brand amplification (PR, backlinks, Reddit marketing).

View recent case studies at

High-level overview of our approach:

  • AI-powered operations: Our ML team builds internal tools that remove repetitive work and give marketers more time for judgement and execution.

  • Senior judgement: Experienced marketers set the strategy and quality bar; automation supports the work rather than replacing it.

  • Full-stack execution: We work across content, technical SEO/AEO and off-site amplification to give clients better outcomes.

Note: If you want to stand out, please include a Loom video showing a tool, system or deliverable you've produced and are proud of. We'd love to see it!

This role

We’re hiring for a SEO/AEO Lead. You’ll manage our team of analysts and strategists, constantly raise the bar across client work and collaborate closely with product and engineering to turn client and market insights into better tools and workflows for the team.

You’ll be accountable for client health, making sure the department’s quarterly net revenue retention (NRR) goal is hit and coaching the team to become best-in-class marketers who are progressing in their careers.

This is not a typical management role where your value is measured by team meetings. It will be operationally intense: high context, high communication and the application of unreasonably high standards across everything we do for clients.

It is fully remote, ideally within +/-4 hours of GMT, though we can be flexible for the right person.

What you'll do

  • Improve the delivery methodology. Identify better ways for us to find, diagnose and act on SEO/AEO performance opportunities that help clients win. Turn successful changes into playbooks and workflows that don’t rely on heroics.

  • Set and maintain delivery standards. Improve how we structure deliverables, run QA, communicate with clients and collaborate as a team so clients receive a world-class experience and we maintain a culture of excellence.

  • Coach and train the team weekly. Use structured work, call and communication reviews to give feedback, practise improvements and check that subsequent client work meets the standard.

  • Manage performance and development. Run structured fortnightly 1:1s, quarterly reviews, and maintain individual development plans so team members are progressing in their careers and feel incentivised.

  • Own NRR and client health. Report on retention, expansion and account health; spot risks early and work with strategists on save plans for red accounts.

  • Build the talent bench and hire well. Build a pipeline of capable analysts and strategists for future capacity needs. Run structured assessments and interviews to evaluate ability and help close candidates.

  • Build effective onboarding. Build and improve an onboarding curriculum so analysts and strategists reach our delivery standards faster.

  • Sponsor product and workflow improvements. Work with product and engineering to build new tools and workflows that make your team more effective and gives clients unfair advantages.

The ideal person for this role

  • You’ve led teams before. You know how to run performance reviews, handle hard conversations and get the most out of those who work with you.

  • You can challenge a search strategy. You can judge whether a content plan targets the right clusters, a technical recommendation deserves priority or an AEO experiment will deliver the right commercial outcomes.

  • You operate with radical candour. You proactively provide feedback and are comfortable having difficult conversations without being an asshole. People know where they stand with you.

  • You are detail-oriented. You spot details that others miss and you unapologetically hold yourself and everyone around you to a high standard.

  • You can diagnose the real problem. If a strategy is underperforming, you are able to quickly identify the issues and resolve it using data.

  • You develop judgement in others. You can explain why a plan or deliverable falls short, give useful feedback and help the person produce better work next time.

  • You think in systems. Disconnected work drives you crazy. You connect work into clear frameworks, shared definitions and standards.

Requirements

  • Experience formally managing SEOs with evidence of improved performance, candid feedback and difficult people decisions.

  • Strong practical SEO judgement across content, technical and off-page work.

  • Evidence that your SEO decisions improved client business outcomes.

  • Evidence of prioritising across client accounts or equivalent stakeholder portfolios when performance, retention risk and delivery capacity compete.

  • Ability to define requirements and acceptance criteria for delivery improvements, and validate solutions with product or engineering.

  • Excellent written and verbal English and availability for a working day that overlaps meaningfully with GMT.

This role is not for you if…

  • You’re not exceptional at SEO. We believe great leaders must first be great operators.

  • You’d rather operate in the shadows. This is a high-visibility role interacting with clients every day and collaborating with the team.

  • You aren’t comfortable with data. We’re a deeply technical team who prefers data over opinions.

  • You’d rather sit at 50,000 feet in diagrams and planning docs. You’ll be expected to also be in the weeds pushing work forward.

Culture fit

You'll thrive here if:

  • You like small teams, direct feedback and a high degree of autonomy.

  • You’re comfortable challenging others’ thinking and also having yourself challenged.

  • You are comfortable making a recommendation and explaining the data and rationale behind it.

You won't thrive here if:

  • You need heavy management or wait for perfect instructions.

  • You rely on “that’s how it’s always been done” to defend an approach.

  • You leave concerns unspoken because the conversation might be uncomfortable.

  • You intend to view Discovered Labs as another client amongst other projects and clients.

What's in it for you

  • Compensation: $50K to $85K USD, DOE

  • Fully remote: work from where you do your best work, with meaningful overlap with GMT.

  • Progression: A clear path towards head of client delivery or associate director.

  • Flexibility: You can have flexible working hours with the expectation of 40 hours of meaningful work per week.

  • Real autonomy: you will have a voice, be trusted to do your work and make improvements to our systems.

  • A small, senior team: work directly with experienced operators, with direct feedback and quick decisions.

  • Annual company off-site: We get together once a year at a nice destination to relax, reset and plan.

Interview Process:

  • Async assessment (15 minutes)

  • 30 minute call with founder

  • 90 minute deep-dive into career history and work

  • 3 hour paid assessment

  • Reference checks with former peers and managers.

To apply:

Please complete the short form on the platform where you see this job ad. Be specific as possible when answering questions - we love detail.

Please do not use sloppy AI to auto-apply for this role. It’s obvious and will result in us not progressing with your application for this role and future roles.

jobs.title: Subject-Matter Experts - AI Benchmark Question Writers & Reviewers
jobs.excerpt: 1-StopAsia is building a native-language benchmark that tests how well today's leading AI models reason in Asian and European languages.
jobs.description:
1-StopAsia is building a native-language benchmark that tests how well today's leading AI models reason in Asian and European languages. We are looking for native-speaking academics and professionals to write expert-level exam questions that the best AI models cannot answer correctly, and to review questions written by others. Your work will show AI developers where their models still fall short in your language, culture and field.

Languages and domains we are hiring for

Language / Domains

  • Thai - Law
  • Filipino (Tagalog) - Literature (Poetry / Classics)
  • Vietnamese - International Relations and Political Science; Philosophy (including non-Western); Psychology; Religion and Religious Studies
  • Korean - Economics (Finance / Business / Trade); History; International Relations and Political Science; Law
  • Standard Russian - Several humanities and social-science domains – tell us your field

You may apply for more than one domain if you have the expertise.

What you will do

As a Question Writer:

  • Write original, exam-style questions in your native language in your domain.
  • Write both short-form questions (multiple choice or one exact answer) and long-form questions (one connected reasoning task, graded against a rubric).
  • Test each question on 5 AI models (GPT, Gemini, Claude Opus, Kimi, Muse Spark) using free accounts; we tell you which versions to use.
  • A question is accepted when at least 3 of the 5 models answer it wrongly.
  • Also write at least 5 "non-challenge" questions per domain that the models do answer correctly.
  • For every question, provide the correct answer, the reasoning that leads to it, why the question is hard, and what the models got wrong, all translated into English.
  • Record everything in our structured Google Sheets template.

As a Reviewer:

  • Check each accepted question against five criteria: well formed, unambiguous, genuinely multi-step, correct answer, and an explanation that traces the reasoning.
  • Comment on anything that fails and approve or return the question.

What makes a good question

  • It needs several connected reasoning steps, not a single fact lookup or several unrelated questions bundled together.
  • Every requirement (format, method, length) and all needed context are stated in the question itself; if it refers to a text, the text is included.
  • It has one well-defined correct answer, which you have solved yourself exactly as written.
  • It draws on knowledge rooted in sources, institutions and traditions of your language, not on translated textbook material.

Requirements

  • Native speaker of Thai, Filipino, Vietnamese, Korean or Russian.
  • University degree in one of the listed domains (Master's or PhD preferred), and/or professional, teaching or research experience in it.
  • Strong written English, enough to translate your questions, answers and explanations accurately.
  • Comfortable working with AI chat tools and Google Sheets.
  • Precise, patient and able to work independently to a deadline.

Nice to have: exam or test-writing experience; university teaching; expertise in more than one domain; prior work in AI training data, evaluation or annotation.

Scope and timing

  • Per domain: 20 accepted questions (10 short-form, 10 long-form), plus at least 5 non-challenge questions.
  • One expert may cover one or several domains.
  • Start as soon as possible after onboarding; all work completed by 2 November 2026.
  • Fully remote, flexible hours.

Benefits

  • Question Writers are paid in USD per accepted question, with a higher rate for long-form questions. Questions that do not meet the acceptance threshold are not paid; please take this into account.
  • Reviewers are paid per reviewed question or hourly.
  • Rates are agreed individually; tell us your expected rate in your application.

Application questions

  1. What is your native language?
  2. Which domain(s) can you write or review expert-level questions in?
  3. What is your highest degree, and in which field?
  4. How many years of professional, teaching or research experience do you have in that domain?
  5. Would you like to work as a Question Writer, a Reviewer, or both?
  6. Do you understand that writers are paid only for accepted questions (at least 3 of 5 AI models fail)? (Yes / No)
  7. Your expected rate in USD per accepted short-form and long-form question (reviewers: per question or per hour).
  8. How many accepted questions could you realistically deliver per week until 2 November 2026?
  9. Have you done AI training, evaluation or annotation work before? If yes, briefly describe it.
  10. Write one sample question in your domain (in your language, with an English translation and the correct answer) that you believe needs several reasoning steps.

To apply, submit your CV and answer the questions above instead of sending cover letter.

jobs.description:
TSPi is seeking a Data Engineer 4 to support the federal government. This position will provide technical leadership for the data pipelines, interfaces, and cloud services that collect, transform, validate, and deliver vessel and enforcement-related information to operational applications and reporting tools.

The successful candidate will serve as a senior member of an established Agile delivery team and work with federal product owners, architects, application developers, data engineers, testers, and regional stakeholders. The role requires deep hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform, BigQuery, SQL, APIs, pipeline architecture, and production operations. The engineer will own technically complex integrations, guide design decisions, mentor team members, and improve the reliability, observability, security, maintainability, and cost efficiency of the broader data ecosystem.

Responsibilities

Data Architecture and Integration Leadership

  • Contribute to the design, modernization, and support of production data pipelines that ingest, transform, validate, and publish vessel, permit, trip, declaration, landing, and enforcement-related data.
  • Define scalable integration patterns for batch, scheduled, event-driven, streaming, and API-based workloads based on operational and mission requirements.
  • Translate business and technical needs into source-to-target mappings, canonical models, schema strategies, transformation logic, reference-data rules, and data-quality controls.
  • Design and optimize complex SQL and data-processing logic for ingestion, reconciliation, analytics, reporting, and application support.
  • Establish approaches for data lineage, versioning, backward compatibility, and controlled schema evolution across interconnected systems.
  • Lead technical reviews, set engineering standards, and guide source-code, configuration, testing, and release practices through Git or GitHub workflows.

Google Cloud Platform Engineering

  • Architect and implement secure, resilient data workloads using BigQuery and other Google Cloud Platform services.
  • Guide the design of cloud storage, orchestration, service identities, secrets, configuration, networking, and environment-specific deployment settings.
  • Improve continuous integration and delivery pipelines and establish consistent, automated deployments across development, test, staging, and production environments.
  • Evaluate architectural tradeoffs and improve performance, scalability, cost efficiency, recoverability, and operational visibility.
  • Apply federal security requirements, least-privilege access, encryption, auditability, and secure service-to-service communication practices.

Operations Technical Leadership and Collaboration

  • Define monitoring and service-level indicators for pipeline health, processing volume, latency, failures, data quality, and downstream impact.
  • Lead the diagnosis and resolution of complex issues involving source data, database connections, APIs, credentials, transformation logic, schedules, dependencies, and cloud services.
  • Establish standards for alerting, structured logging, retry handling, failure recovery, reprocessing, reconciliation, and operational readiness.
  • Coordinate releases, production validation, incident response, root-cause analysis, corrective actions, and communication with technical and program stakeholders.
  • Own and review architecture diagrams, interface documentation, data dictionaries, decision records, runbooks, deployment procedures, and known-issue records.
  • Mentor engineers, facilitate technical design discussions, estimate complex work, identify delivery risks, and contribute to backlog refinement, sprint planning, demonstrations, and retrospectives.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Minimum 9 years of professional experience in data engineering, systems integration, software engineering, or a related role, including responsibility for complex production systems.
  • Advanced experience designing, building, and supporting data pipelines in Google Cloud Platform or a comparable cloud environment.
  • Advanced SQL skills and demonstrated experience designing solutions with BigQuery, relational databases, or cloud data warehouses.
  • Strong proficiency with Python, Java, or another language used for production data-processing and integration services.
  • Demonstrated experience designing REST API integrations, data contracts, schema-evolution strategies, mappings, transformations, and reconciliation processes.
  • Experience leading production troubleshooting, incident response, root-cause analysis, and resolution of complex data-quality or integration issues.
  • Experience establishing Git or GitHub workflows, code-review standards, automated testing, continuous integration, and deployment pipelines.
  • Ability to assess an existing architecture and codebase, identify technical risk, and assume ownership of mission-critical services with limited oversight.
  • Strong technical leadership, documentation, communication, mentoring, and cross-functional collaboration skills in an Agile environment.
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, data engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Skills and Experience

  • Deep experience with BigQuery, Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, Pub Sub, Cloud Storage, Dataflow, Composer, or related Google Cloud services.
  • Experience developing enterprise data architecture, reusable integration frameworks, data governance practices, or platform modernization roadmaps.
  • Experience with fisheries, vessel monitoring, maritime, geospatial, regulatory, or enforcement data, including permit, trip, logbook, declaration, landing, or reference-data sources.
  • Experience with Docker, infrastructure as code, automated data-quality testing, orchestration, and cloud observability tools.
  • Experience defining operational metrics, service-level objectives, health dashboards, and alerts for business-critical data pipelines.
  • Experience supporting federal information systems and leading technical work within federal security, accessibility, change-control, and release-management requirements.

Additional Information

Successful candidates must be able to pass a government background investigation and satisfy public trust requirements. US Citizenship or US Green Card is required.

jobs.excerpt: Meet ApertureAt Aperture, we create value and drive growth by delivering exceptional product consultancy and advertising services to our global partners.
jobs.description:
Meet Aperture

At Aperture, we create value and drive growth by delivering exceptional product consultancy and advertising services to our global partners. Through data-driven strategies, we harness our expertise in performance marketing, creative strategy, and product optimisation to achieve outstanding results.

Founded in 2022 by industry leader Hannah Parvaz, we’ve quickly made waves. Already recognised as Business Consultant of the Year and named 2024’s Most Innovative Growth Agency, our trajectory is nothing short of extraordinary.

Now, as we prepare to scale new heights, we’re building a dream team to fuel our ambitions. This is your chance to join us and be part of our incredible growth story. Are you ready to make an impact?

Our Culture:

  • Growth mindset. We're hungry to learn and improve.
  • Take full responsibility for every outcome—no excuses.
  • Obsess over results. We're here to make a measurable impact.
  • We’re data-obsessed. We let numbers, not opinions, guide our decisions.
  • Client success is our success. Period.
  • No ego. The best idea wins, regardless of who it comes from.
  • Radical candour. We give and receive honest feedback to fuel growth.
  • No job is too small. We support each other and JDFI.

Work from anywhere

Embrace our remote-first culture that prioritises impact over location. Work from wherever you're most productive, while enjoying meaningful connections with the team in London from time to time.

We bring everyone together for inspiring sessions and great conversations over amazing food and events—because the best ideas often start with "what if?". You must be able to work in a UK timezone.

Role overview

We’re hiring a Creative Assistant to support our creative team and help raise the quality, speed, and clarity of our creative output as Aperture scales.

This role is ideal for someone who:

  • is obsessed with TikTok, Instagram Reels, and internet culture
  • has strong instincts for hooks, words, and framing
  • enjoys turning messy inputs into clear briefs and hypotheses
  • wants to get better at creative by doing, analysing, and iterating

You’ll work closely with our Creative Manager and the wider creative and performance teams to help shape briefs, write hypotheses, analyse what’s working, and support creative experimentation across client accounts.

You don’t need prior agency experience — but you do need curiosity, taste, and proof that you care deeply about getting better.

Key responsibilities

Creative research, libraries, and systems

  • Build and maintain banks of hooks, angles, scripts, and creative references.
  • Collect, tag, and organise high-performing ads, videos, and formats from TikTok, Instagram Reels, and other relevant platforms.
  • Keep swipe files and inspiration libraries up to date so the team can move fast without starting from scratch.
  • Turn raw inspiration into structured, usable inputs (clear hooks, angles, formats, and hypotheses).

Briefs, hypotheses, and creative thinking

  • Help write and structure creative briefs for ads and content.
  • Turn insights and performance signals into clear creative hypotheses.
  • Support the team in articulating the hook, angle, and emotional or functional driver behind each concept.
  • Ensure briefs are focused, clear, and actionable.

Creative analysis and iteration

  • Review creative performance alongside the performance team.
  • Look at key signals (CTR, hook rate, hold rate, conversions) and help identify patterns.
  • Feed learnings back into the next round of briefs and ideas.

Execution and support

  • Support creative production by helping organise assets, scripts, captions, and references.
  • Assist with copywriting tasks where needed (hooks, captions, scripts, variations).
  • Help keep creative systems, folders, and documentation clean and usable.

Requirements

Experience

This role does not require prior agency or paid media experience.

We care far more about taste, curiosity, and learning speed than job titles. You might have:

  • made your own TikToks, Reels, memes, or other content
  • written scripts, captions, threads, or hooks
  • run a personal or niche account
  • built swipe files or analysed ads obsessively
  • worked on creative side projects alongside studies or another job

Proof that you actively engage with content and try to understand why it works matters most.

Skills and mindset

  • You’re good with words and enjoy writing or refining language.
  • You have strong creative instincts but are open to being wrong and learning fast.
  • You’re comfortable looking at numbers and using them to inform creative decisions.
  • You’re highly curious and pay attention to internet culture, trends, and formats.
  • You care deeply about quality and iteration, not just ideas.
  • You communicate clearly and aren’t afraid to share a point of view.
  • You’re obsessed with getting better, not just being “creative”.

This is an entry-level creative role with real responsibility. You’ll be trusted early, supported closely, and expected to bring energy, ideas, and care to the work.

What you’ll learn in this role

  • How high-performing ad creatives are briefed, tested, and iterated.
  • How creative and performance teams work together.
  • How to turn insights into repeatable creative systems.
  • How to develop taste, judgement, and confidence over time.

Strong performers in this role often progress into Creative Manager or Creative Designer paths.

Why this role matters

Creative is the biggest lever in performance marketing.

This role helps:

  • Improve the quality of creative thinking upstream.
  • Turn performance data into better briefs.
  • Increase creative velocity without sacrificing clarity.
  • Support our Creative Manager and the wider team as output scales.

You’ll play a key role in making Aperture’s creative work sharper, faster, and more effective.

Before you apply

We read every single application.

We’re looking for people who are curious, thoughtful, and genuinely interested in creative work, not just people who like the idea of it.

Specific examples, references, or explanations of how you think about content go a long way. We can tell when applications are generic or surface-level.

This leader will connect commercial, operational and financial data; frame the critical trade-offs; and translate insight into measurable actions that improve contribution margin, EBITDA, cash flow, working capital and asset utilization. This role will also help shape Spartech’s next chapter of operational and commercial growth by providing the financial insight, scenario rigor and investment discipline needed to scale capabilities, expand attractive markets and convert strategic opportunities into sustainable enterprise value.

The successful candidate will be equally comfortable building a rigorous model, challenging assumptions with senior leaders, improving a recurring process, and coaching a team. The role requires manufacturing fluency, executive presence, strong systems and analytics capability, and a bias for practical action.

THE MANDATE: Create one trusted performance view, strengthen forecasting and SIOP, make strategic choices decision-ready, and reinvest time saved through automation into further margin improvement and business partnering.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

Enterprise Planning, Forecasting & Performance Management

  • Lead the annual budget, long-range planning, rolling forecast and monthly outlook processes, including clear calendars, ownership, assumptions, scenario ranges and executive-level outputs.
  • Own consolidated P&L forecasting and performance reporting, with disciplined analysis of revenue, volume, mix, contribution margin, operating expenses, EBITDA, cash flow and working capital.
  • Drive high-quality variance and root-cause analysis that goes beyond surface-level P&L and balance-sheet impacts to uncover hidden-factory and companywide costs, working-capital requirements and the full cash-to-serve economics of customer, product and service decisions; quantify the financial impact, identify leading indicators and establish accountable corrective actions.
  • Establish and maintain enterprise KPIs, scorecards and bridges that connect operational drivers to financial outcomes and track progress against commitments.

SIOP, Commercial Finance & Business Partnership

  • Provide financial leadership to the SIOP process, ensuring demand, production, inventory and financial views reconcile to a credible, actionable enterprise plan.
  • Partner with Sales & Marketing and R&D on customer volume and margin forecasts, pipeline conversion, wins and losses, pricing, refinement of product and customer profitability costing, and commercial resource allocation.
  • In collaboration with Product Management, Commercial, Technology and other functions, serve as a thought and validation leader in quantifying and communicating the differentiated value proposition of Spartech products and services in the marketplace, supporting value-based pricing and decision-making beyond a cost-plus approach.
  • Partner with Operations, Supply Chain and Manufacturing Finance to connect forecast changes to production, inventory positioning, uptime, yield, scrap, material usage, capacity and asset-utilization decisions.
  • Frame and quantify trade-offs involving service, delivery, quality, expedite cost, inventory, contribution margin and cash flow so leaders can act quickly and transparently.

Strategic Finance & Enterprise Value Creation

  • Lead financial modeling, scenario analysis and sensitivity analysis for growth initiatives, turnaround plans, footprint and portfolio decisions, productivity programs, restructuring actions and other enterprise priorities. Partner with other groups and functions as appropriate regarding underlying inputs, assumptions, underlying
  • Develop fact-based paths to break-even and sustainable profitability for underperforming products, facilities or business areas, and monitor execution against the approved plan.
  • Assess capital expenditures and new product development opportunities through standardized business cases, ROI, cash payback, risk analysis and post-investment performance reviews.
  • Support mergers, acquisitions and divestitures as applicable, including valuation, financial due diligence, synergy assessment, integration planning and performance tracking.
  • Partner with the CFO and leadership team on ad hoc analyses, board and shareholder questions, financing-related materials and other high-priority strategic projects.

Reporting, Analytics & Technology Enablement

  • Own and continuously improve executive, board, lender and management reporting packages, ensuring consistent definitions, clear visual communication, concise commentary and decision-focused insights.
  • Build a modern, scalable analytics foundation and trusted source of financial and operating data across ERP, profitability, commercial and operational data sets, working in direct partnership with Operational Analytics Leader to improve data fidelity, analytical depth and product-level visibility into net-cash-to-EBITDA conversion.
  • Lead development and adoption of standardized dashboards and reporting tools, including executive P&L, daily sales, profitability, SIOP, plant KPIs and controllable-spend reporting.
  • Automate recurring reporting and analysis, strengthen controls and data governance, reduce manual reconciliation and enable appropriate self-service analytics.
  • Develop strong working knowledge of SAP / ERP and related data flows, including product costing, COPA and the connection from transactional data to profitability and management reporting.

Leadership, Talent & Cross-Functional Influence

  • Lead, develop and retain a high-performing FP&A team with clear accountabilities, development plans, cross-training and succession coverage for critical capabilities.
  • Create a culture of intellectual curiosity, ownership, constructive challenge, speed, accuracy and continuous improvement.
  • Build trusted partnerships across Commercial, Operations, Supply Chain, Accounting, IT, Human Resources and other functions, influencing outcomes without relying on formal authority.
  • Communicate complex analyses in a concise, practical manner tailored to executives, finance professionals and non-financial leaders.
  • Promote financial and data literacy through coaching, knowledge sharing and practical training in analytics, modeling and decision support.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance or Accounting, Economics or a related field.
  • 10-15 years of total Finance or Accounting experience with at least 7-10 years of progressive FP&A, strategic finance, business finance or related experience, including meaningful leadership experience.
  • Experience in a multi-site manufacturing, industrial or similarly complex operating environment.
  • Demonstrated ownership of budgeting, forecasting, consolidated performance reporting, financial modeling and analytics-based decision support.
  • Advanced Excel and financial-modeling capability, with experience working in large-scale ERP and business-intelligence environments.
  • Strong knowledge of financial statements, management reporting, cash flow, working capital and core accounting concepts.
  • Proven ability to influence senior leaders, challenge assumptions constructively and convert analysis into action.
  • Clear, concise written and verbal communication skills, with the executive presence to present to leadership and governance stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • MBA, CPA, CMA or other relevant advanced degree or certification.
  • Experience with SAP, COPA, Power BI, data lakes or comparable analytics and profitability platforms.
  • Private equity-backed company experience, including board, lender or sponsor reporting, is a strong plus but is not required.
  • Experience supporting SIOP, capital allocation, product and customer profitability, turnaround initiatives,

Leadership Profile

  • Enterprise thinker - Connects commercial, operational and financial drivers and optimizes for total-company value.
  • Hands-on strategist - Moves comfortably between executive-level framing and detailed model, data and process work.
  • Talent multiplier - Develops people, raises standards, shares knowledge and reduces key-person dependency.
  • Builder and improver - Creates scalable processes and tools while maintaining continuity and meeting deadlines.
  • Constructive challenger - Tests assumptions, raises risks early and proposes practical alternatives.

Measures of Success

  • The team has clear development plans, strong coverage of critical capabilities and reduced single points of failure.

Work Environment & Expectations

You’ll also be the person on our team who can tell the difference between a candidate who knows billing and one who only knows the vocabulary.

Sourcing & Pipeline Building

Matching & Hiring Support

  • Learn each partner practice’s billing setup, payer mix, and systems so candidates fit the actual role
  • Present top candidates to our team with a short summary of strengths and risks
  • Coordinate interviews, follow-ups, and next steps between candidates, our team, and partner practices
  • Support offer, onboarding handoff, and replacement searches when a placement needs to be refilled

Process & Quality

  • Help improve our billing assessments, scenarios, and scoring standards based on what you see in the field
  • Share hiring trends with leadership: where candidates are strong, where they fall short, and what that means for sourcing
  • Keep candidate communication professional, timely, and respectful from first contact to final decision
  • Protect candidate and partner information and follow HIPAA and confidentiality standards at all times

Requirements

Required

  • Strong working knowledge of payer requirements, EOB interpretation, reimbursement rules, and common denial reasons
  • Ability to explain billing workflows clearly and judge whether a candidate’s answers hold up
  • Comfort running live screening calls and asking follow-up questions that test real experience
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • Strong organization and follow-through across many candidates and open roles at once

  • Reliable home office setup with a stable internet connection and a quiet, professional workspace

Preferred

  • Familiarity with therapy EMR and billing platforms such as WebPT, Prompt, Raintree, or similar
  • Experience with Medicare, Medicaid, workers’ compensation, and out-of-network billing
  • Experience training, auditing, or leading other billers
  • Comfort with applicant tracking systems, Google Workspace, and cloud-based communication tools

WHAT WE LOOK FOR

  • Billing judgment: you can hear a candidate describe a denial and know right away if they’ve worked one
  • Ownership: you treat every open role like a practice is waiting on it, because one is
  • Honesty: you’ll tell us when a candidate isn’t ready, even when the pipeline is thin
  • Empathy: you remember what it’s like to be on the other side of the interview and treat candidates with respect
  • Reliability: our team and our partners count on your updates. You show up, follow through, and communicate clearly.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary commensurate with experience
  • A full-time remote role on Rockstar’s internal team, not a client placement
  • Opportunities for professional development and long-term career growth
  • Work within a collaborative, supportive team that values your billing expertise
  • Make a meaningful impact by placing the people who keep therapy practices paid and patients cared for

We know the job search process can feel uncertain and want to be respectful of your time and interest. All candidates who apply online will receive application status updates via email. Thank you for considering M-Files as your next career opportunity.

Who we are:

M-Files is redefining how work gets done. Our context-first document management system offers purpose-built business use cases—spanning universal and industry-specific workflows—to enable secure collaboration, automate processes, and ensure governance.

Unlike traditional systems, M-Files organizes content around the context of your business, connecting documents to related people, projects, and transactions. With our unique metadata-driven architecture, organizations can model content in line with their business processes, unify information across silos, and apply AI at scale. The result is greater productivity, reduced risk, and smarter, faster decisions for over 6,000 customers in 100+ countries.

At M-Files, our Guiding Principles unite us across diverse cultures and personalities:

  1. Make It Happen – We set bold goals, take ownership, learn from mistakes, and relentlessly pursue results.
  2. Help Others – We lead with kindness, assume good intentions, hold one another accountable, and celebrate wins together.
  3. Love Customers – We put customers and partners at the heart of everything, delivering value with respect, fairness, and speed.

To learn more about us we encourage you to visit M-Files Careers | Open Jobs, Culture & Benefits

Learn more about what earned us the Working at M-Files Inc. | Great Place To Work®

Role description

As a Solution Architect, you are a key part of the Consulting Services team and will play a critical role in driving our success. You are the customer's first and most trusted technical voice: you will lead discovery, uncover what customers truly need, and turn those needs into clear requirements and sound M-Files solution designs. You will serve as Subject Matter and Solution Expert in M-Files software and Systems Integration, and as the Design and Technical Lead on key customer engagements, working closely with the customer and project team. Your day-to-day work consists of running requirements workshops and stakeholder interviews, analyzing business processes and content, documenting and validating requirements, designing solutions that satisfy them, and defining the integrations with 3rd party applications and external data sources each implementation needs. As M-Files transforms how it works with AI, you will use Claude daily to accelerate discovery, analysis, and documentation, and you will help customers identify where automation and AI agents can deliver measurable value from their M-Files environment.

Responsibilities

Discovery and Analysis

  • Lead customer discovery: facilitate requirements workshops, stakeholder interviews, and process walkthroughs to understand business goals, current-state processes, pain points, content types, and success criteria.
  • Help customers identify and clarify their needs: separate stated wants from underlying needs, ask probing questions, and surface unstated requirements, assumptions, constraints, and risks early.
  • Assess the customer's existing environment, including IT infrastructure, authentication and security models, data sources, and 3rd party systems, to identify and validate M-Files integration points.
  • Document requirements clearly and traceably (business requirements, current and future-state process maps, solution descriptions, UML diagrams), and validate them with business and technical stakeholders.
  • Prioritize requirements with the customer, define acceptance criteria up front, and manage scope changes with Project Management.
  • Use Claude daily to prepare for discovery sessions, synthesize notes and transcripts, draft requirement and design documentation, and identify gaps or conflicts, always applying your own judgment and review before anything reaches a customer.
  • Identify where automation and AI agents can add value in the customer's workflows, and advise on governance, supervision, and data access considerations.

Solution Design and Delivery

  • Serve as Subject Matter and Solution Expert in M-Files software and Systems Integration.
  • Translate business requirements into a technical solution design to be implemented by the project consultants, serving as the technical design leader on multiple projects.
  • Provide best-practice recommendations on design and customer solution sets.
  • Coordinate with the consultants on the technical aspects of deployments, and work closely with M-Files Project Management on timelines, task planning, and delivery.
  • Support all aspects of the deployment lifecycle, including solution design, development, deployment, migration, QA, UAT, and other consulting engagements.
  • Oversee delivery validation against the agreed requirements and acceptance criteria, testing with real customer data where possible and reporting results candidly, so deployments meet and exceed customer expectations for quality and reliability.
  • Produce technical documentation and handoff materials, and train customer technical staff where the engagement calls for it.

Product and R&D Partnership

  • Recognize when a customer requirement goes beyond standard product capability or what can reasonably be built on the M-Files extensibility layer (vault applications, scripts, and APIs), and scope that gap clearly for R&D and Product Management rather than forcing a workaround.
  • Coordinate change requests and product updates required for customer success with R&D and Product Management.
  • Feed recurring requirements patterns observed across customers back to Product Management as structured input.

Team and Practice Contribution

  • Mentor and lead more junior members of the consulting unit.
  • Build and share reusable discovery templates, requirements checklists, solution patterns, and Claude prompts and workflows that raise the quality and speed of the whole team.
  • Support pre-sales scoping and technical feasibility conversations as needed, and identify and escalate additional service and expansion opportunities that surface during engagements.
  • Coordinate scope boundaries with Implementation, Managed, and Expert Services on accounts where more than one team is active.

Requirements

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5 to 8 years of corporate services consulting experience, from a management consulting firm, boutique consulting firm, or a software firm with a services practice.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field; Master's degree in a relevant field preferred but not required.
  • Proven requirements gathering experience in a customer-facing consulting environment: facilitating workshops and interviews, eliciting and clarifying needs, and translating them into documented requirements and solution designs.
  • Hands-on experience using Claude (for example Claude.ai, Claude Cowork, or Claude Code) in your daily work, such as research, analysis, drafting, and summarization, with the judgment to verify AI output and protect customer data.
  • Working knowledge of AI agent and automation concepts as applied to enterprise data, including governance, supervision, and responsible use.
  • Experience working with document/content management systems.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with a proven ability to explain ideas to both business and technical audiences.
  • Strong leadership and interpersonal skills, with the ability to listen to customers and translate their needs into specific actions and solutions.
  • Experience creating technical documentation (solution descriptions, requirements documents, UML diagrams, etc.).
  • Knowledge of solution architecture and cross-application communication and integration methodologies.
  • Experience in all lifecycle phases of enterprise IT solutions (specification, planning, design, development, delivery, rollout, training, and operations), including managing project timelines and scope.
  • Ability to drive projects to completion and manage obstacles; excellent organizational skills and experience supporting multiple concurrent customer engagements.
  • Solution-driven approach with strong problem-solving skills; self-confident and able to engage and manage customer engagements effectively.
  • Highly motivated self-starter with a strong desire to learn new methods and technologies, able to thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
  • Willingness to travel (up to 25%).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience using Claude Projects, skills, connectors, or MCP integrations to build repeatable workflows for consulting or delivery work.
  • Experience with M-Files or a comparable enterprise content management platform, including building on its extensibility layer (vault applications, scripting, APIs).

About Buzz Solutions

Buzz Solutions builds PowerAI, a computer vision platform that finds hardware defects in utility transmission and distribution infrastructure and delivers those findings straight into the systems where utilities actually make asset decisions. Our customers include Dominion, AEP, NYPA, and Ameren. We integrate today with Esri's ArcGIS and IBM Maximo, and we work alongside capture partners such as Skydio.

We are a team of roughly 60 people scaling across sales, engineering, customer success, and operations. Every hire we make now shapes the company we become, and this role will be instrumentally involved in the processes we create and the functions we set up to position the company for scale.

The role

Own the operational backbone of how Buzz hires, onboards, and keeps its people engaged. That means running the hiring lifecycle end to end (scheduling, scorecards, offers, and onboarding), owning our applicant tracking system, keeping employee records clean and compliant, and bringing our culture and values to life for a distributed team.

This is deliberately a hybrid charter. It requires someone who can coordinate a five-interview loop across three time zones in the morning, walk a new hire through benefits enrollment in the afternoon, and catch an outdated employee record before it becomes a compliance problem the following week. Candidates who are strong at recruiting coordination but also interested in people operations will do well here.

Responsibilities

  • The hiring lifecycle
    • You own every candidate's path from first scheduled interview through their first day. That includes coordinating interviews across departments and time zones, managing candidate communication at every stage, preparing offers, and keeping a clear, steady line of communication between hiring managers and candidates. When a loop stalls, you are the person who notices and moves it.
  • Greenhouse, our applicant tracking system
    • You own Greenhouse, not just the data entry. Every candidate sits in the right stage, every scorecard is completed on time, and every report is current enough that leadership can trust it without double-checking. You hold hiring managers to the process, kindly and persistently.
  • Candidate experience and sourcing
    • Every candidate should leave the process with a positive view of Buzz. You will also support sourcing for open roles across the organization, building pipeline alongside hiring managers rather than waiting for applicants to arrive.
  • Onboarding and the employee lifecycle
    • A signed offer is not a successful hire. You'll run onboarding so that new team members arrive prepared and productive: welcome communications and schedules, walking them through our employee handbook, benefits enrollment, and policies, and making sure nothing falls through the gap between offer and day one.
  • HR compliance and employee records
    • You maintain accurate employee records, proactively identify outdated or missing information, and flag compliance risks to the People Operations team before they become problems. You'll support documentation and audits as they arise.
  • Culture, engagement, and recognition
    • You bring the Buzz Solutions culture and values to life, including coordinating employee engagement activities and events, helping run employee recognition programs, and constantly looking for ways to bring a distributed team together.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in human resources, business administration, or related field.
  • 3+ years of experience in recruiting coordination, people operations, or similar role, ideally a high-growth company where process was still being built
  • Owned an applicant tracking system, not just used one, including stages, scorecards, reporting, and hygiene.
  • Exceptional organization. You can run many hiring loops in parallel without dropping a candidate or a hiring manager.
  • Clear, warm, professional communication with candidates, new hires, and senior leaders alike.
  • Discretion with confidential information, including compensation, offers, and employee records.

Benefits: Health, Dental &Vision insurance, 401k Contributions, Unlimited Paid Time Off, STD/LTD,

jobs.excerpt: Graphite Financial is a growing boutique finance, accounting, tax, and strategy firm (www.
jobs.description:
Graphite Financial is a growing boutique finance, accounting, tax, and strategy firm (www.graphitefinancial.com) built to help startup and high-growth companies scale efficiently and sustainably. Graphite Financial is redefining the “finance department” for early-stage companies and VC-backed startups. We deliver high-caliber accounting and finance leadership and support to entrepreneurs and management teams building scalable, high-growth companies. Our clients are actively managing cash burn, measuring performance, reporting to investors, making capital allocation decisions, and preparing for fundraising. All of that takes expertise and time that founders don’t have and can’t afford to hire for. Graphite bridges the gap with flexible, fixed-fee support packages that provide fractional leadership and operational support from CFOs, Controllers, FP&A Managers, and Tax leaders.

ROLE PURPOSE

Own the client relationship and full accounting delivery for an assigned portfolio of consumer packaged goods (CPG) companies — from early-stage emerging brands to scaling, VC-backed operations. The Client Lead, Accounting — CPG is the primary point of accountability for quality, timeliness, client satisfaction, and team execution across every engagement they manage.

CPG companies present a distinct and demanding set of accounting challenges: complex cost structures, multi-channel revenue streams, trade spend management, inventory valuation, and margin pressure that requires precision at every level of the P&L. Founders and management teams in this space are moving fast, often undercapitalized, and counting on Graphite to give them a clear financial picture so they can make the right calls.

WHAT IT TAKES TO SUCCEED HERE

This is a fully remote, client-facing role. You are the face of Graphite to your CPG clients. Your accounting expertise, industry fluency, and professional presence determine whether clients trust you — and whether they stay. The following qualities are what separate a good Client Lead from a great one in this industry.

  • CPG Industry Fluency: You speak the language of CPG without having to look it up. Trade promotions, slotting fees, deductions management, landed cost, shrinkage, distributor margin — these are part of your daily vocabulary. Clients should feel immediately that you understand their business, not just their books.
  • Client Relationship Ownership: You are not just delivering accounting work — you are managing a relationship with a founder or management team that is betting on Graphite. Every interaction reflects your professionalism, judgment, and commitment to their success.
  • Proactive Communication: CPG clients face cash crunches, seasonal swings, and retailer demands that move fast. You do not wait for them to ask. You surface issues, flag trends, and manage expectations before problems become surprises.
  • Executive Presence: Your deliverables, emails, and meeting conduct are indistinguishable from what a seasoned in-house Controller at a CPG brand would produce. Investors and board members will read your work. It needs to be that good.
  • Responsiveness: In a remote model, your availability and responsiveness are primary signals of service quality. CPG clients move fast and their questions are often urgent. Show up for them.
  • Judgment Under Ambiguity: Early-stage CPG companies operate with incomplete data, informal processes, and constant change. You make sound accounting decisions in that environment, apply the right guidance, and know when to escalate.
  • Accountability: You own your portfolio — client outcomes, deliverable quality, team execution, and relationships. Success and failure both start with you.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

Client Ownership & Delivery

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for an assigned portfolio of CPG clients, owning each relationship from onboarding through ongoing monthly delivery
  • Oversee the full monthly close cycle for every client in the portfolio — reviewing and approving Associate and Senior Associate work before any final delivery
  • Prepare and deliver financial statements, board reporting packages, and management-level commentary that is accurate, clear, and relevant to how CPG brands are actually managed and evaluated
  • Proactively surface observations on margin trends, cost structure, trade spend efficiency, and working capital to help clients make better decisions — not just report on what happened

CPG-Specific Accounting

  • Manage and reconcile trade promotion accruals, deductions, and promotional liabilities with precision — this is often where CPG financials break down and where Graphite must be a source of strength
  • Own inventory accounting across multiple channels and fulfillment models, including landed cost calculation, obsolescence reserves, and inventory reconciliation across 3PL and warehouse partners
  • Apply appropriate COGS structure and gross-to-net revenue accounting for multi-channel CPG businesses selling through DTC, Amazon, retail, and distributor networks
  • Manage co-packer, contract manufacturer, and supplier accruals with accuracy and appropriate documentation
  • Support clients through slotting fee accounting, new retail placement costs, and retailer compliance charge classification
  • Ensure revenue recognition is applied correctly across channel types, promotional periods, and return and deduction activity

Technical Accounting

  • Identify and resolve complex accounting matters including equity and SAFE transactions, deferred revenue, intercompany activity, and other issues common to VC-backed early-stage companies
  • Apply accounting policy correctly and consistently across all engagements; surface policy gaps or ambiguities to Team Leads for resolution
  • Ensure all client financial records are accurate, well-documented, and audit-ready at all times — CPG clients approaching Series A or B will face investor scrutiny, and the books need to be clean

Team Direction

  • Direct the day-to-day accounting work of Associates and Senior Associates across all CPG client engagements in the portfolio
  • Review deliverables thoroughly before client delivery and provide direct, actionable feedback that builds CPG accounting competency across the team
  • Manage close timelines and escalate capacity, quality, or coverage issues to Team Leads promptly — not after the fact

Onboarding & Client Development

  • Lead onboarding of new CPG clients, including chart of accounts design tailored to CPG P&L structures, systems setup, historical data migration, and process documentation
  • Identify opportunities within the client portfolio to deepen Graphite’s service — particularly as clients grow, add channels, or approach fundraising milestones — and communicate those opportunities to Team Leads

SCOPE & DECISION RIGHTS

  • Owns all day-to-day accounting decisions within the assigned CPG client portfolio
  • Directs the work of Associates and Senior Associates on client engagements
  • Escalates technical policy questions, complex transactions, and high-risk client issues to Team Leads
  • Does not set firm-wide accounting standards or make unilateral changes to service scope

CLIENT INTERACTION

  • Primary point of contact for all assigned clients — this is a relationship role as much as a technical one
  • Owns all client communication on accounting matters, including day-to-day questions, close status updates, deliverable delivery, and escalation management
  • Translates complex financial and accounting information into clear, plain-language communication for CPG founders and operators who are experts in their products — not their balance sheets
  • Participates in client calls, board meeting preparation, investor reporting discussions, and lender or retailer financial reviews as needed
  • Engages with CPG-specific stakeholders — including operations leads, supply chain partners, and sales teams — to gather the information needed to produce accurate financial reporting

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting required; CPA strongly preferred
  • 4–7 years of accounting experience with direct ownership of month-end close; public accounting (Senior Associate or Manager level) or outsourced accounting experience strongly preferred
  • Demonstrated, hands-on experience with CPG accounting — this is a non-negotiable requirement. We are looking for candidates who have owned the books for a CPG brand, not candidates who have worked adjacent to one
  • Deep familiarity with trade promotion accounting, deductions management, landed cost and inventory valuation, gross-to-net revenue, and COGS structure in a multi-channel CPG context
  • Experience working with CPG brands that sell through retail, DTC, Amazon, and distributor channels, and the accounting complexity that comes with each
  • Familiarity with common CPG technology and operational platforms including NetSuite, QuickBooks Online, Cin7, Inventory Planner, Shopify, and 3PL management systems
  • Strong working command of GAAP with hands-on experience applying it in startup or growth-stage CPG company contexts
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple client relationships simultaneously and deliver consistently on deadlines
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to translate financial information clearly for founders and non-finance operators
  • Experience with VC-backed company structures, SAFE and convertible note accounting, and investor reporting is a strong plus

MEASURES OF SUCCESS

  • Client satisfaction, trust, and retention across the assigned CPG portfolio
  • Timeliness and accuracy of month-end close and financial reporting for every client
  • Quality and depth of CPG-specific financial insight delivered to clients — not just accurate numbers, but numbers that help clients run their business
  • Accuracy and completeness of trade promotion, inventory, and COGS accounting across the portfolio
  • Effectiveness in directing and developing Associates and Senior Associates on CPG-specific accounting challenges
  • Ability to identify, resolve, or escalate issues before they become client-facing problems — especially during high-stakes moments like fundraising, retail launches, or audits

Comprehensive Benefits & Perks:

  • Health & Wellness: Competitive Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage. 100% of the employee's health insurance premium is covered by the company.
  • Financial Security: Company-paid Short-Term and Long-Term Disability insurance.
  • Work/Life Balance To Include: Generous Unlimited Paid Time Off (PTO), 11 Paid Company Holidays, and comprehensive Paid Parental Leave.
  • Remote Work Setup: Fully remote position with company-provided technology equipment and a $250 technology stipend to support your ideal home office setup.
  • 401k: With a company match
