jobs.description:
We’re Hiring: Sales Development Representative (SDR)

Location: UK or Singapore

Department: Marketing

Reporting to: Revenue Growth & Outbound Operations Manager

Contract Type: Permanent, Full time

About AsiaVerify

AsiaVerify is the corporate verification and risk intelligence layer for organisations operating across Asia, helping them verify businesses, understand ownership, assess risk and monitor changes with confidence.

Through direct access to authoritative registry data and local intelligence across APAC, AsiaVerify delivers trusted company, ownership and risk insights across the full customer lifecycle: verify, understand, assess, onboard and monitor.

Built for Asia and trusted by global organisations, our solutions support onboarding, compliance, third-party risk, due diligence and ongoing monitoring in some of the world's most complex markets.

About the Role

The Sales Development Representative (SDR) owns cold outbound through to qualified SQL handoff and is responsible for generating qualified appointments for the Sales team through focused outbound calling. The role is measured on booking a minimum of 4 qualified appointments per week, with at least 40% of those accepted as SQLs by Sales.

This is a phone-first role. The SDR makes high-volume outbound calls to compliance, risk and onboarding leaders at payment providers, corporate entities and data resellers operating across Asia, uncovering their company verification, KYB, due diligence and third-party risk needs and booking qualified prospects in with the Sales team.

The SDR works within the outbound operating model set by the Revenue Growth & Outbound Operations Manager, executing call activity against agreed ICPs, target accounts, campaigns and trigger-led plays, and maintaining accurate activity records in HubSpot.

The role contributes directly to AsiaVerify's FY26 growth objectives by building a predictable source of outbound-sourced pipeline.

Key Responsibilities

  • Outbound Calling
    Make high-volume outbound calls to targeted individuals and organisations to explore their requirements for AsiaVerify products and services. Handle gatekeepers and objections confidently, and follow up persistently across calls, voicemail and email until a clear outcome is reached.
  • Prospect Qualification
    Ask questions to understand each prospect's requirements and qualify them against agreed criteria (need, authority, timing and budget) before booking an appointment. Answer first-line questions about AsiaVerify, our registry coverage and our use cases, and communicate the AsiaVerify proposition clearly by phone and email.
  • Appointment Setting & Handoff
    Book qualified appointments for the Sales team. Use the calendar to invite attendees, monitor acceptances and confirm attendance. Provide the Sales team with a clear briefing on each prospect so appointments progress with clear ownership and consistent follow-up.
  • Account Research & Call Preparation
    Research organisations and contacts before each call to personalise outreach. Build a working knowledge of target industries, buyer roles and the regulatory drivers behind KYB and due-diligence requirements.
  • Campaign & Trigger-Led Outreach
    Execute calling campaigns aligned to AsiaVerify's ICP-driven campaign calendar, ABM target accounts and trigger-led plays such as regulatory change, market events and customer signals. Communicate regularly with other team members on campaigns and daily workflow.
  • CRM & Activity Management
    Update HubSpot with accurate information on all prospects and organisations. Log every call, outcome, note and next step against the relevant record on the same day, use HubSpot email templates and sequences to support calling activity, and keep lead status and lifecycle stage up to date in line with the agreed handoff process.
  • Daily Planning & Reporting
    Manage your own day and prioritise daily call lists and work plans to hit activity and appointment targets. Report all results, positive and negative, to your Line Manager, and go the extra mile to hit appointment targets and support other team members.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Primary Metrics:

  • Qualified appointments booked for the Sales team (minimum 4 per week).
  • Strong appointment-to-opportunity conversion rate.
  • Outbound-sourced opportunities.
  • Sales acceptance rate of booked appointments.
  • Daily call activity (100 - 150).
  • HubSpot data quality and same-day activity logging.
  • Reschedule rate does not exceed 30%

Supporting Metrics:

  • Connect rate and conversations held.
  • Appointment show rate.
  • Sequence and follow-up performance.
  • Target-account coverage.
  • Contribution to campaign and trigger-led plays.

Requirements

  • Excellent verbal communication skills and a confident, professional phone manner.
  • Builds rapport easily over the phone, with strong listening and questioning skills.
  • A natural passion for sales, a competitive streak and a drive to achieve sales targets.
  • Strong interpersonal and customer service skills.
  • Ability to manage own time and prioritise tasks effectively in a fast-paced, remote environment.
  • IT literate, able to use email, internet, Microsoft Word and Excel to an intermediate level.
  • Previous outbound calling, telemarketing or SDR experience, ideally in B2B SaaS, is an advantage.
  • Experience using HubSpot or a similar CRM platform is an advantage.
  • Experience within SaaS, RegTech, FinTech, compliance, KYB, KYC, AML or third-party risk industries is advantageous.

Expected Behaviour & Attitudes

  • Self-driven, independent and detail-oriented, with a practical can-do attitude.
  • Resilient and persistent, able to work under pressure and stay positive in the face of rejection.
  • A willingness to take responsibility and accountability.
  • Enthusiasm for learning and openness to coaching and feedback.
  • Collaborative team spirit.
  • Demonstrates a strong service mindset when communicating with prospects, clients and internal stakeholders.
  • Disciplined in daily planning and CRM accuracy.
  • Proactive and comfortable working in a fast-growing, commercially focused environment.
  • Positive, pragmatic and solutions-focused mindset.

jobs.title: Senior Analyst – Intelligence & Advisory
jobs.excerpt: AHEAD builds platforms for digital business.  By weaving together advances in cloud infrastructure, automation and analytics, and software delivery, we help enterprises deliver on the promise of digital transformation.
jobs.description:
AHEAD builds platforms for digital business. By weaving together advances in cloud infrastructure, automation and analytics, and software delivery, we help enterprises deliver on the promise of digital transformation.
At AHEAD, we prioritize creating a culture of belonging, where all perspectives and voices are represented, valued, respected, and heard. We create spaces to empower everyone to speak up, make change, and drive the culture at AHEAD.
We are an equal opportunity employer, and do not discriminate based on an individual's race, national origin, color, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, marital status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law, whether actual or perceived.
We embrace all candidates that will contribute to the diversification and enrichment of ideas and perspectives at AHEAD.

As a Senior Analyst – Intelligence & Advisory, you will work alongside AHEAD’s consultants and practice teams at the intersection of technology, AI and business - turning ambiguous business questions from consulting teams into structured, hypothesis-led research and clear, actionable recommendations. You will independently own deliverables end-to-end, act as a credible thought partner to onsite consulting and pursuit teams and help raise the quality bar by guiding junior analysts. Your work will directly shape how AHEAD’s consulting teams understand markets, position against competitors, plan for accounts, and win complex enterprise technology deals — and how sharply those insights are communicated to CXO audiences.

You will scope and prioritize requests, clarify objectives, and select the right insights on clients, markets, offerings and competition to address them. You will conduct data-driven analyses and turn the results into accurate, client-ready documents, models and charts, and join team problem-solving discussions so that recommendations are actionable and strategically relevant. Beyond individual requests, you will help build and maintain AHEAD’s knowledge assets, databases and proposal and use-case material, using scripts and automation to prepare and validate data, while continuing to grow with the industry.

Being part of this exciting team, you will get long term opportunities to lead client discussions with global IT leaders, identify and creatively solve complex problems using both qualitative and quantitative research methods. You will design and build written research, graphics, and tools/frameworks to support clients in critical processes and help organizations transform the way they operate.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

    Problem Solving & Advisory Support

  • Translate pursuit, account and client questions into structured problem statements, hypotheses, issue trees and research plans; clarify scope, success criteria and timelines with stakeholders up front.
  • Apply consulting frameworks and structured thinking (e.g., MECE issue trees, hypothesis-driven analysis, value-chain and maturity assessments, 2x2 prioritization) to break down complex problems, test hypotheses and arrive at defensible answers.
  • Exercise sound judgement when data is incomplete — triangulate across sources, state assumptions, size the opportunity and flag confidence levels — and always answer the “so what” with a recommendation, not just data.
  • Apply sound judgement to prioritize what matters: separate signal from noise, assess the reliability of sources and data, challenge assumptions, and clearly call out risks, trade-offs and confidence levels in every recommendation.
  • Advisory Engagements: Support pursuit and advisory engagements by delivering market insights, competitive benchmarking and strategic guidance that shape deal strategy and client conversations.

    • Research Delivery & Insights

  • Own end-to-end delivery of assigned items from AHEAD's research product stack — Market Size & Outlook, Industry/Technology POVs, Account Intelligence Packs, Competitive Profiles & Battlecards, Buying Behaviour Analysis, market trend summaries/briefs, Capability Heatmaps, Benchmark Reports and other custom research products where required
  • Synthesize intelligence from primary research and secondary sources — tier-1 analyst platforms (e.g., Gartner, Everest Group, Forrester, Nelson Hall, IDC, Avasant), business databases (e.g., Hoovers, AlphaSense ,ZoomInfo) and proprietary sources — into crisp, executive-ready insight narratives.
  • Track competitor strategies, partnerships, offerings and deal signals, and translate them into actionable pursuit positioning.
  • Analyze market dynamics across AHEAD-relevant technology areas—including Applications, cloud and infrastructure, application modernization, data and AI, cybersecurity, digital workplace, platform engineering, automation, and emerging technologies—to assess business needs and technology linkages.
  • Build account-level intelligence to support strategic account planning, C-suite engagement and opportunity identification.
  • Know how in helping service providers make informed pricing and solutioning decisions — e.g., peer price benchmarking, delivery-improvement and competitive analysis to improve win-rates (Good to have or is a plus)
  • Validate sources for currency, credibility and relevance; maintain high standards of accuracy and referencing across all deliverables.

    • Reporting, Dashboards & AI-Enabled Research

  • Design, build and maintain interactive dashboards and reports in Power BI and lightweight HTML dashboards (e.g., competitor trackers, account, and market views, CoE performance reporting) that let stakeholders self-serve insights.
  • Clean, model and visualize data from multiple sources (Excel, databases, analyst-platform exports); ensure accuracy, clear metric definitions and version control.
  • Use AI tools and agents to automate and accelerate research workflows — source scanning, competitor monitoring, summarization and first-draft creation — with human validation of every output.
  • Verify AI-generated content for accuracy, bias and source traceability; build reusable prompts and agent workflows and share good practices with the team.

    • Storytelling & Visual Communication

  • Convert research findings into answer-first storylines, proposal narratives and CXO-level communications that persuade rather than merely present.
  • Build polished, consulting-grade decks and data visualizations using AHEAD’s brand-compliant templates; partner with visual communication specialists for high-impact pursuit and proposal material.
  • Present findings and recommendations to senior internal stakeholders and handle questions and pushback with confidence.

    • Stakeholder Partnership

  • Act as a day-to-day research partner with consulting, sales, practice and deal teams to translate business needs into hypothesis-led research and concise, insight-rich narratives aligned with AHEAD’s solutions.
  • Manage multiple concurrent requests, balancing standard reports with bespoke, high-urgency support while keeping quality and timelines on track.
  • Anticipate intelligence needs across the pursuit lifecycle-from opportunity identification and qualification to proposal development and win/loss review — and incorporate stakeholder feedback into future work.
  • Collaborate with subject-matter experts across AHEAD’s practices to understand intelligence requirements and deliver research aligned to account goals.
  • Present findings through concise, insight-rich narratives that connect business strategy with AHEAD solutions.

    • Team Contribution, Tools & Continuous Improvement

  • Contribute to reusable assets — research templates, source libraries, capability heatmaps, frameworks and maturity models — that extend research output into AHEAD IP.
  • Help shape the CoE’s research agenda — identify priority topics, data gaps and new content ideas based on industry and stakeholder needs — and recommend process and tooling improvements to Intelligence & Advisory stakeholders
  • Track and report on your own delivery metrics — turnaround time, quality and stakeholder satisfaction — and contribute to win/loss learnings on research-supported pursuits.
  • Mentor, guide and review the work of junior analysts; share domain knowledge, research methods and quality standards to raise the team’s overall capability.

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

  • Experience: 5–8 years of progressive experience in research, market/competitive intelligence, deal advisory and strategy/management consulting – in large leading IT services /Consulting firms OR leading research & advisory firm (Candidates from BPO industry /BPO Services companies need not apply)
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree is a must; and/or master’s degree in management from a reputed institution is preferred.
  • Domain Expertise – Technology and Vertical Domain (atleast one domain) : Good understanding of the IT services and enterprise technology landscape — Enterprise Applications, cloud, infrastructure, digital transformation, data & AI, GenAI, cybersecurity coupled with one or two domains (Verticals)
  • Exceptional Problem Solving & Structured Thinking: Proven ability to break down ambiguous, open-ended questions into structured problems, form and test hypotheses, perform root-cause analysis and reach clear conclusions with minimal supervision.
  • Consulting Skills: Consulting-style approach to scoping, framing and answering stakeholder questions — including storyline development, “so what” thinking, handling feedback and pushback, and making recommendations rather than simply reporting data.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (e.g. Word, Excel and PowerPoint); software tools working knowledge (e.g. Alteryx, Tableau, Power BI, Knime, Qualtrics etc ) is a plus
  • AI & Agents: Hands-on experience using generative AI tools and AI agents in research or analysis workflows (prompting, automation, validation of outputs), with a responsible-use mindset and enthusiasm for adopting new ways of working.
  • Judgment & Analytical Skills: Strong ability to analyze market trends, vendor strategies and enterprise needs, combining qualitative and quantitative inputs (market sizing, benchmarking, comparative analysis) into actionable insights; sound judgement in prioritizing, weighing evidence, evaluating source credibility and making a call when data is imperfect.
  • Reporting & Dashboarding: Working proficiency in Power BI (data modelling, DAX/Power Query basics) and advanced Excel; ability to build clear, interactive dashboards, including HTML-based dashboards, that turn data into decision-ready views.
  • Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication; able to produce executive summaries, research notes and presentations that are clear, concise and ready for senior audiences.
  • Presentation Skills: Strong working proficiency in PowerPoint — able to turn analysis into polished, consulting-grade slides, charts and visual narratives.
  • Research Proficiency: Hands-on experience with secondary research using tier-1 analyst platforms and business intelligence databases, across areas such as competitive intelligence, account intelligence, market sizing, market trend synthesis, technology benchmarking and converting research evidence into structured findings is preferred.
  • Curiosity & Ownership: Intellectual curiosity, comfort with ambiguity and the drive to push beyond surface-level data to uncover insight that changes how decisions are made.
  • Organizational Rigour: Ability to manage multiple concurrent deliverables with competing priorities and tight timelines while maintaining quality.
  • Collaboration: Collaborative, consultative mindset; builds trusted relationships with global, cross-functional teams.
  • Exposure to RFP support, proposal intelligence or pursuit enablement within a consulting or technology firm.

Why AHEAD:

Through our daily work and internal groups like Moving Women AHEAD and RISE AHEAD, we value and benefit from diversity of people, ideas, experience, and everything in between.
We fuel growth by stacking our office with top-notch technologies in a multi-million-dollar lab, by encouraging cross department training and development, sponsoring certifications and credentials for continued learning.

Comprehensive health insurance coverage for employees, with options to extend coverage to dependents
Paid time off and company holidays, along with additional leave benefits as per policy
Flexible work arrangements, supporting work-life balance
Learning and development opportunities to support continuous growth and upskilling
Employee wellness initiatives and programs focused on physical and mental well-being
Retirement and statutory benefits in line with India regulations
Inclusive and people-first culture, with a strong focus on collaboration and ownership

  • Ensure reliability of a real-time product: monitor releases with Crashlytics and analytics pipelines, investigate call-quality and stability issues, and drive performance optimization.

jobs.title: Incubated Founder
jobs.excerpt: Advancements in AI bring both opportunities and serious risks.
jobs.description:
Advancements in AI bring both opportunities and serious risks. Atlas Computing takes on society-scale AI risks that no existing institution is built to address — we design the intervention, validate it with domain experts and funders, then recruit and empower the specialist who will own it.

You can think of us as:

  • A tiger team that identifies, scopes, and launches interventions that aren't a good fit for existing organizations
  • A design studio developing and staffing product requirements docs for coordination and market failures
  • A think tank combined with whatever their analog of "tech transfer" would be.

Some of the most important problems in catastrophic AI risk need owners: leaders who identify an overlooked, high-impact, and tractable problem; develop effective interventions; and ultimately take personal responsibility for bringing those interventions into the world.

That’s why Atlas Computing is launching a selective program for people with deep domain expertise and the drive to address the most important risks facing society from growing AI capabilities. Founders will take one problem from a rough direction to a fundable plan: sharpening a concrete intervention, pressure-testing it against the field, building the relationships and founding team to execute it, and leaving with a grant proposal and the backing to pursue it.

Our job is to lower the barriers to entry — both the cost of leaving your current career path and the risk that a good idea never gets off the ground — and to meaningfully raise the odds that the effort you launch succeeds.

Founders will have between six months and two years to research a problem and develop a pitch, but we hold that loosely — a Founder is done when their effort is ready to stand on its own, not when a calendar says so. The goal is for Founders to develop an ambitious plan as quickly as possible (early graduations welcome), complete with conditionally committed users/stakeholders, an excellent founding team, expert advisors, and organizational plans like milestones — completion consists of pitching funders like Coefficient Giving and launching with an initial grant of around $10 million.

Cohort 1: Securing AI Infrastructure

    While future cohorts will tackle other neglected topics in navigating transformative AI, the first cohort focuses on securing AI infrastructure. This includes keeping the frontier AI systems out of the hands of actors who would steal, poison, or misuse them.

    The more powerful AI gets, the more critical it is to have strong guardrails, authorization systems, and safety mechanisms around it. However, most people working on catastrophic AI risk don’t have the necessary infosecurity experience to address these problems.

    We expect transformative AI will need to be secured against threat actors like nation-states, terrorists, insider threats, and even misaligned AIs themselves — actors who may have enormous resources, intentions to harm large numbers of people, or significant legitimate access. These may be the hardest, highest-stakes security problems you ever work on, and you'll be one of a very small pool of people qualified to work on them.

    Examples of problems we're looking for owners on include:

  • Securing AI from exfiltration: protecting model weights and algorithms from theft.
  • Securing AI integrity: protecting models from tampering via data poisoning or other attacks.
  • Enabling verification of AI datacenter properties: demonstrations that would allow verifiable attestations that a data center is being used for inference or alignment research, rather than training.
  • Adjacent problems in AI infrastructure security (e.g., disconnected model safety, secure compute verification, protocols for using compromised AI, detecting and responding to rogue deployments) may also be in scope where they bear on keeping frontier models secure.

    • You can read a series of one-pagers about these problems here.

Success in the first 6 months looks like

    By the end of the program, a successful Founder has:

  • Sharpened a rough direction into a concrete intervention, with attestations from domain experts that it's plausible and from decision-makers that it would change their behavior;
  • Built the relationships and founding team needed to execute it; and
  • Produced a grant proposal in partnership with an interested donor we’ll introduce. Joining the incubator does not guarantee funding for your project, but the goal of the program is to develop plans funders are excited to scale. If there's not a mutually satisfactory project to scale up, we'll support you in finding your next role.

    • Outcomes we'd be excited about:

  • You become the founder and/or directly responsible individual (DRI) of an object-level intervention.
  • You become a grantmaker or “general manager” of grantmakers directing serious capital across this field
  • You become the advisor, mentor, and recruiter for the next wave of AI risk founders in this field.

    • We're not looking to maximize follow-on funding — we're looking for people the field builds around.

Founders and Field Strategists

    Atlas is also hiring Field Strategists, and we're running both searches at once, with separate applications. The two roles are complementary.

  • Field Strategists map a field’s incentives and bottlenecks, identify points of leverage, and de-risk high-impact interventions across an ecosystem. Their goal is to scope promising solutions clearly enough to pitch them, identify and recruit the right founders to own them, and support the handoff from strategy to execution. The field strategist holds an ongoing position at Atlas, building the skills and praxis for this approach for multiple efforts simultaneously and in series.
  • Founders take a single object-level project and iterate a rough idea into a fundable, executable plan. Founders will learn and practice field strategy for one specific problem, which will become a project they will remain responsible for and transition out of Atlas.

    • Upon joining Atlas, you're not locked in: a Founder who realizes their strength is ecosystem strategy can switch tracks, and vice versa.

You may be a fit for this role if you have…

  • You have one of the following backgrounds, or similar:
  • Experience working on cybersecurity in a national security context (especially building SL5 facilities, intelligence, or offensive security).
  • Experience in ML security research (tamper resistance, backdoors, password locking).
  • Experience in a relevant industry context — e.g., at a frontier AI lab, or in security at a hyperscaler, hardware company, or government contractor.
  • Exceptional capability in a relevant area — e.g., academic security research, security entrepreneurship, developing security standards, or AI hardware or firmware.
  • You break down ambiguous problems into clear next steps, and don't get overwhelmed when you lack guidance.
  • You can clearly articulate your plans, verbally and in writing, to coordinate and motivate others.

We also expect everyone to have…

  • A practice of reviewing the state-of-the-art after having an idea, coupled with an urge to prototype, test, and iterate.
  • Experience coordinating and aligning stakeholders to work toward a common goal.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Comfort with uncertainty and interest in shaping our culture, as we're still a very small organization.
  • A strong compulsion to do something about AI risk — you understand what it would mean to be responsible for mitigating a particular risk from AI, and you want it anyway (because no one else is).
  • The ability and inclination to do this work (to some extent) without Atlas, but you believe the program’s network, expertise, and institutional support would substantially decrease the difficulty, increase your odds of success, and or scale your enjoyment while doing it.

Bonus points if you...

  • Have a habit of doing non-technical coordination work despite a technical background.
  • Have thought deeply about existential risk and made contributions to reducing it.
  • Have led or started an organization, or managed people.
  • Have already worked on related AI security problems, and have ideas you're ready to pursue.
  • Have deep networks in cybersecurity or the AI safety community.
  • Are great at getting people to tell you things they probably shouldn't have, getting into conversations with incredibly busy people, or coming up with creative ideas to align incentives.
  • Have work authorization in the US.

We're probably not the right fit if you…

  • Already have the answer to the problem you want to solve, and want funding more than a thought partner.
  • Want a stable, well-scoped role with a clear roadmap handed to you.
  • Are drawn to AI risk in the abstract but don't want to own a single specific, concrete problem. (If you'd be happy owning an area, Field Strategist might be right for you...)

jobs.excerpt: Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets.
jobs.description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring multiple positions from early-career engineers to experienced architects focused on the different dimensions of dependable software: cybersecurity, quality, and safety.

What does it take to bring the world’s open source software into mission-critical systems? At Canonical, we are driving the engineering discipline needed to build secure, reliable, and high-quality products that our automotive and industrial partners can depend on. Ubuntu is already the world’s most widely used Linux distribution in general; we want to make it the world’s best choice for the automotive and industrial sectors too.

We operate at the boundary between upstream open source innovation and the industrial regulatory realities. Our engineers define the concepts, architectures, processes, verification strategies, and certification artifacts to transform a general-purpose platform into a dependable, certifiable foundation for automotive and industrial compute. This is systems-level engineering at scale, requiring precision, rigor, and a deep understanding of how complex software behaves in constrained, regulated environments.

We are looking for engineers and architects who combine an open source hacker and builder mindset with respect for rigorous, standards-driven engineering. You will work across Canonical engineering teams and with leading industrial partners, helping to build this capability from the ground up and shaping how open source enters the most demanding technical domains.

Location: This is a remote role based in the EMEA region.

The role entails

  • Translate automotive and industrial cybersecurity, quality and safety standards into actionable engineering requirements and perform gap analyses against current capabilities.
  • Drive the creation of structured engineering artifacts, including requirements, traceability models, risk analysis, test strategies, and certification documentation.
  • Collaborate with Canonical engineering teams to align development practices with industrial compliance needs.
  • Design, implement, and execute verification and validation activities required to qualify Ubuntu and other components for regulated environments.
  • Develop and improve automation and tooling to scale traceability, testing, compliance evidence generation, and reporting.
  • Engage with industrial partners to understand their expectations, align external expectations and internal capabilities, and support audits and technical reviews.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of Canonical’s internal processes and standards capability as the team scales.

What we are looking for in you

  • Strong software engineering foundation with experience in developing complex systems on Linux.
  • Professional experience with C, C++, and Python in production environments.
  • Demonstrated experience working within automotive, industrial, or other regulated environments governed by safety, cybersecurity, or quality standards (such as ISO 26262, ISO/SAE 21434, IEC 61508, IEC 62443, SOTIF, or (A)SPICE), and applying them in practice.
  • Experience in system or software architecture, implementation, or verification and validation of complex embedded systems.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to produce precise technical documentation.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively in a distributed team and engage with industrial partners.

Additional experience that is valuable

  • Contributions to open source projects, particularly in the area of Software Defined Vehicles.
  • Knowledge of Debian packaging.
  • Experience with Rust or safety-critical software development.

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal-opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products.Whatever your identity we will give your application fair consideration.

jobs.title: Field Strategist
jobs.excerpt: Advancements in AI bring both opportunities and serious risks.
jobs.description:
Advancements in AI bring both opportunities and serious risks. Atlas Computing takes on society-scale AI risks that no existing institution is built to address — we design the intervention, validate it with domain experts and funders, then recruit and empower the specialist who will own it.

You can think of us as:

  • A tiger team that identifies, scopes, and launches interventions that aren't a good fit for existing organizations
  • A design studio developing and staffing product requirements docs for coordination and market failures
  • A think tank combined with whatever their analog of "tech transfer" would be.

We start from the opportunity or risk, map the context in which the need for interventions arise. Then we sketch possible interventions, iteratively working with experts to ensure feasibility and potential stakeholders to establish sufficiency to have the desired impact. Finally, we will make it as easy as possible for a career professional to take ownership over each interventions (we believe most of these efforts don't require risk-seeking young generalists courted by traditional VCs, but rather are best addressed by career professionals who have spent the last decade or more executing on very similar work.

Atlas Computing is looking to hire a cohort of Field Strategists to scope multiple potential interventions simultaneously and hand them all off.

While this is a separate role from our Founders (who will scope intervention they would like to lead themselves), we expect the Field Strategists will work closely in collaboration with our cohort of Founders.

While Atlas interested in many aspects of AI Resilience, we expect this first cohort will likely focus on some combination of cybersecurity, datacenter security, and epistemic security; we will prioritize candidates with relevant experience.

Success in the first 6 months looks like

  • The hire has created two or more clear write-ups describing:
  • Why advances in AI capabilities pose a specific risk to society
  • What a proposed intervention would look like.
  • Who are the best people in the world to advise and steer the intervention
  • (and their attestation that this solution is plausible).
  • What decision-makers would change their behavior because of this intervention
  • (and their attestation that this intervention plan is sufficient).
  • Who would likely fund it
  • (and what their decision criteria would be).
  • What skills and experience the founder needs (and where are we likely to find that person)
  • The hire has worked with a recruiter to pitch potential founders for that organization and has introduced one to potential funders.
  • A more junior hire would:
  • focus on 1-2 organizations at a time.
  • benefit from checking in with Atlas leadership multiple times per week.
  • A more senior hire would:
  • develop 3-5 organizations simultaneously and on ~3-5 month timescales.
  • benefit from the freedom of little oversight.
  • be "fire and forget", sharing weekly updates as needed to highlight potential opportunities.
  • (perhaps) provide mentorship to junior hires.

    • Note that we expect this first cohort to focus primarily on starting new efforts in the United States that could scale globally, rather than creating efforts starting outside the US, but this is not a hard constraint.

You may be a fit for this role if you have…

  • expertise in navigating and/or modifying complex systems (natural or human-made),
  • This could look like complex systems research in academia, policy research at a think tank, market research in a product role, or analyst research in the intelligence community.
  • generalist: able to quickly understand nuances in a variety of topics, including ML architecture, export control laws, and ideological differences within the AI community.
  • meaningful experience in at least one of these areas:
  • Cybersecurity - Technical:
  • Software security, vulnerability analysis (or related).
  • Hardware security or hardware supply chain security (or related).
  • Identity & authentication systems (or related).
  • Privacy engineering or privacy threat modeling (or related).
  • Cybersecurity - Strategic:
  • Cybersecurity strategy, Red Team, or threat intelligence (or related).
  • Cyber-defense coordination or policy (e.g., IC, CISA).
  • Risk analysis in highly complex environments.
  • Epistemic Security - Technical:
  • Media forensics, deepfake detection, or content provenance (or related).
  • Platform trust & safety, content moderation systems, or recommender integrity (or related).
  • Computational propaganda analysis or bot/network detection (or related).
  • Epistemic Security - Strategic:
  • Information operations analysis or counter-influence strategy (e.g., IC, think tank, or allied government).
  • Election security, democratic resilience, or civic information integrity (or related).
  • Institutional epistemic governance or public trust measurement (or related).
  • Cross-cutting
  • Strategic technological or product planning.
  • Working in an "ARPA" entity.
  • Technology roadmapping or multi-year strategic planning.
  • a strong ability to interview experts and synthesize across domains.
  • comfort forming and revising hypotheses quickly.
  • strong creative problem-solving skills, love finding pareto improvements to the obvious options.
  • a capability to reason about AI trajectory, safety, and future-state technologies.

We also expect everyone to have…

  • a practice of reviewing the state-of-the-art after having an idea, coupled with an urge to prototype, test, and iterate.
  • a founder mindset, with a high degree of ownership over outcomes (not process) and the ability to personally make and externally drive progress with little oversight.
  • experience coordinating and aligning stakeholders to work toward a common goal.
  • strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • comfort with uncertainty and interest in shaping our culture, as we’re still a very small organization.

Bonus points if you...

  • strongly hold a conviction that AI is going to reshape the face of civilization fairly soon, and you want to join a hard-working team focused on making that go as well as possible.
  • have deep networks in cybersecurity, biosecurity, or epistemic security
  • have a background in product or taking things from zero to one: organizational formation, paired with domain depth.
  • have experience acting as a COO-type integrator across complex, multi-expert efforts
  • thrive in a high-trust, low-structure environment.
  • love talking to people across multiple domains about concrete actions that can address important problems.
  • know how to solve problems with money, but also know how to operate on a tight budget.
  • seriously considered starting your own company, but the opportunity or push hasn’t come up yet.
  • find yourself always recommending books, models, and frameworks.
  • are deeply committed to improving the human condition with technology…
  • and understanding how different people might differently define “improving”, “human”, “condition”, and “technology” in that sentence.
  • have work authorization to work in the US (and ideally also would be eligible to hold a US security clearance)

jobs.description:
L'équipe Sales s'agrandit !

AssessFirst, en quelques mots 👇

Nous sommes une HR Tech en forte croissance, avec une mission claire : révolutionner le recrutement à l’échelle mondiale.
Plutôt que de se baser sur le CV, nous aidons les entreprises à prédire la performance et l’épanouissement des talents grâce à l’analyse de leur personnalité, de leurs motivations et de leur capacité à apprendre.
Aujourd’hui, nous sommes plus de 110 collaborateurs et accompagnons 3 500+ clients dans plus de 40 pays, pour recruter et faire évoluer leurs équipes de manière plus inclusive et plus efficace.
Notre culture ? Ambition, impact et liberté.
Tu veux contribuer à transformer le futur du travail ? On veut te rencontrer.

Ta mission :

Identifier, engager et qualifier les décideurs RH les plus pertinents afin de générer des opportunités commerciales à fort potentiel pour AssessFirst.
Grâce à une approche consultative et orientée données, tu aides tes interlocuteurs à prendre conscience de leurs enjeux RH et leur montres comment AssessFirst peut les aider à révéler le potentiel humain au sein de leur organisation.

Ce que tu feras au quotidien :

  • Construire et piloter ta stratégie de prospection sur le BeLux & la Suisse en priorisant les comptes et segments à plus fort potentiel.

  • Identifier et engager des décideurs RH grâce à une approche multicanale : téléphone, email, LinkedIn, événements, inbound…

  • Comprendre les enjeux business et RH de tes interlocuteurs pour faire émerger des opportunités à forte valeur ajoutée.

  • Qualifier rigoureusement les opportunités et assurer une passation fluide aux Account Executives et aux Account Managers

  • Exploiter les données CRM, signaux de marché, outils de ciblage et d’automatisation pour maximiser ton impact.

  • Tester et améliorer en continu les messages, séquences et stratégies d’approche adaptés à ton marché.

  • Partager tes apprentissages terrain pour contribuer à construire et faire évoluer notre Go-To-Market sur la zone.

  • Participer à la visibilité d’AssessFirst à travers des campagnes, événements et initiatives locales.

Tes objectifs :

✅ Générer un pipeline qualifié et à fort potentiel de conversion sur le BeLux & la Suisse.
✅ Développer notre présence auprès de comptes stratégiques et de décideurs RH.
✅ Identifier les approches et segments permettant d’accélérer notre développement sur ces marchés.
✅ Assurer un suivi rigoureux des opportunités et alimenter le CRM avec des données fiables et exploitables.

Pour réussir dans ce rôle :

Tu sais ouvrir un marché : tu es autonome pour analyser ton territoire, prioriser tes comptes et construire ton plan d’attaque.

Tu es orienté résultats : tu sais concentrer ton énergie sur les actions qui créent réellement du pipeline.

Tu es stratégiquement "paresseux·se" : tu automatises les tâches à faible valeur ajoutée pour consacrer ton temps aux conversations qui comptent.

Tu es à l’aise avec la donnée : tu l’utilises pour prioriser, personnaliser tes approches et améliorer tes performances.

Tu es curieux·se et proactif·ve : tu testes, apprends et ajustes rapidement ton approche en fonction du marché.

Tu es un joueur collectif : tu travailles étroitement avec les équipes Sales, Marketing et Revenue Operations pour faire progresser l’ensemble du moteur commercial.

Ta future équipe

Tu feras partie de la team BDR, composée de 12 personnes.

Tu travailleras également très étroitement avec l'équipe Account Executive et Account Manager !

Expérience souhaitée

🏃 Tu as au moins 3 ans d’expérience en prospection / Business Development B2B, idéalement dans un environnement SaaS ou Tech.

💻 Tu es très à l’aise avec les outils digitaux, notamment les outils d’IA

🔥 Tu sais engager tes interlocuteurs avec des approches pertinentes, personnalisées et accrocheuses.

🏆 Tu as une vraie culture de la performance, le goût du challenge et l’envie d’ouvrir de nouveaux marchés.

🌍 La maîtrise de l’anglais est indispensable.

Qu'est ce que tu obtiendras ?

Fourchette salariale :Package 70K (45K fixe) -variable déplafonné

Autonomie & flexibilité :tu t’organises librement selon les priorités et les projets du moment.

Full remote :travaille d’où tu veux en Europe ! 🌍

Vie d’équipe :une culture forte et quatre séminaires par an pour se retrouver.

Notre processus de recrutement:

  1. Notre annonce te parle

  2. Tu remplis nos questionnaires en postulant (tu recevras un lien par email)

  3. L'équipe Talent te contacte

  4. 4 entretiens maximum : Ton futur N+1, un cas pratique, un échange avec Quentin (CRO) et David notre CEO !

  5. Bienvenue dans l'équipe, tu fais désormais partie de l'équipe !

jobs.excerpt: The Red Hat Technical Account Management team is looking for a Technical Account Manager to join us in Germany.
jobs.description:
The Red Hat Technical Account Management team is looking for a Technical Account Manager to join us in Germany.

In this role, you will provide personalized, attentive support and mentorship to a small set of enterprise customers. Your goal will be to build high-value relationships as you understand their IT infrastructures, internal processes, and business needs, creating long-lasting loyalty to Red Hat. You will ensure that our customers have access to solutions that will enable their technical environments to run efficiently.

You will forge relationships with your customers, develop a deep technical understanding of their Red Hat implementation, share technical best practices and act as point of contact for any major incidents, managing the customer’s expectations and communications through resolution of such incidents.

As a Technical Account Manager, you will work closely with internal teams such as Support Delivery, Engineering, and Product Management. Depending on your customers’ environments and needs, you will help them collaborate with other vendors and advocate on their behalf. In this role, you will have the opportunity to shape the future of our technology alongside subject-matter experts and developers in the open-source community.

What you will do:

  • Become a Red Hat technical ambassador, working closely with a small number of customers using Red Hat OpenShift and develop relationships with key business and IT stakeholders and become an expert on a customer’s implementation by understanding their top business goals and priorities.

  • Deliver key portfolio updates and assist customers with upgrades of our offerings; advise customers on technology changes, mitigation strategies, and potential disruptions to their service

  • Conduct technical investigations of customer issues to find root causes and solutions on your own or through collaboration with fellow Red Hatters and customer teams

  • Provide advice and guidance to customers about their current and future use of Red Hat’s offerings

  • Perform technical reviews and share knowledge to proactively identify and prevent issues

  • Manage customer use cases and maintain clear and concise case and customer documentation

  • Create customer engagement plans and keep the documentation on the customer's environment updated

  • Handle customer escalations with Red Hat and customer teams

  • Engage with Red Hat’s engineering teams to help develop solutions, based on customer engagements as well as personal experience, that will guide product adoption

  • Engage with Red Hat’s field teams, customers, and partners to ensure a positive cloud technology experience and a successful outcome resulting in long-term enterprise success

  • Establish and maintain parity with Red Hat cloud technologies strategy

  • Analyse and present periodic reviews of operational performance to customer leadership

  • Deliver presentations to customer associates

  • Communicate how specific Red Hat cloud solutions and our cloud roadmap align to customer use cases

  • Travel, as necessary, to visit customers or attend internal events

  • Collaborate with third-party hardware and software vendors

What you will bring:

  • Experience in a support, development, engineering, or quality assurance organisation

  • Expertise with enterprise cloud solutions like Platform-as-a-Service (OpenShift by Red Hat), containers, Kubernetes, cloud management (Red Hat CloudForms), and IT automation (Ansible Automation Platform by Red Hat)

  • Ability to manage and grow existing enterprise customer relationships by delivering proactive, relationship-based support

  • Outstanding verbal and written communication skills; ability to convey complex information to customers clearly and concisely

  • Competent comprehension of enterprise architecture and strategic business drivers

  • Ability to manage multiple issues and projects with an eye for detail

  • Direct experience with a variety of hardware vendors

  • Experience with presentation delivery

  • Fluent verbal and written communication skills in German

The following are considered a plus:

  • Experience in system management, cloud or server virtualization

  • Bachelor's degree in a technology-related discipline, preferably computer science or engineering

  • Red Hat Certified Engineer (RHCE)

  • Prior experience in a technical leadership or mentorship role

About Red Hat

Red Hat is the world’s leading provider of enterpriseopen source software solutions, using a community-powered approach to deliver high-performing Linux, cloud, container, and Kubernetes technologies. Spread across 40+ countries, our associates work flexibly across work environments, from in-office, to office-flex, to fully remote, depending on the requirements of their role. Red Hatters are encouraged to bring their best ideas, no matter their title or tenure. We're a leader in open source because of our open and inclusive environment. We hire creative, passionate people ready to contribute their ideas, help solve complex problems, and make an impact.

Inclusion at Red Hat
Red Hat’s culture is built on the open source principles of transparency, collaboration, and inclusion, where the best ideas can come from anywhere and anyone. When this is realized, it empowers people from different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences to come together to share ideas, challenge the status quo, and drive innovation. Our aspiration is that everyone experiences this culture with equal opportunity and access, and that all voices are not only heard but also celebrated. We hope you will join our celebration, and we welcome and encourage applicants from all the beautiful dimensions that compose our global village.

Equal Opportunity Policy (EEO)
Red Hat is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We review applications for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, veteran status, genetic information, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, or any other basis prohibited by law.


Red Hat does not seek or accept unsolicited resumes or CVs from recruitment agencies. We are not responsible for, and will not pay, any fees, commissions, or any other payment related to unsolicited resumes or CVs except as required in a written contract between Red Hat and the recruitment agency or party requesting payment of a fee.


Red Hat supports individuals with disabilities and provides reasonable accommodations to job applicants. If you need assistance completing our online job application, email . General inquiries, such as those regarding the status of a job application, will not receive a reply.

At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence.

As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. The Team

Upstart’s Servicing team supports borrowers after loan origination and works to improve outcomes for investors and borrowers. The team is building data-informed approaches across areas such as collections, loan assistance, payment experiences, and borrower communications, with meaningful opportunity to apply machine learning to problems that have often been addressed manually.

As a Senior Applied Scientist on the Servicing team, you will build predictive and causal models and translate their outputs into decisions that improve how loans are serviced. You’ll partner with Product, Engineering, and Servicing and Collections Operations to evaluate interventions and shape data-informed approaches to payment plans, loan modifications, communications, and autopay.

How you’ll make an impact

  • Develop and evaluate machine-learning models that predict borrower repayment behavior and other servicing outcomes.
  • Apply causal inference and experimentation to measure the impact of servicing interventions, including loan modifications and payment assistance.
  • Translate model predictions and treatment-effect estimates into practical decision algorithms and actions.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering on payment experiences, autopay, and borrower communications, and with Servicing and Collections Operations on collections strategy and agent-performance insights.
  • Identify and develop machine-learning opportunities in servicing areas that have historically relied on manual optimization.
  • Explain analytical choices, tradeoffs, and findings to technical and non-technical partners to inform high-stakes operational and product decisions.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Graduate degree in mathematics, applied mathematics, statistics, physics, econometrics, operations research, computer science, or a related quantitative field.
  • Experience applying causal inference methods and experimentation to real-world decisions in an applied science or data science context.
  • Applied statistics, probability, and experimental-design expertise used to build or evaluate models or interventions.
  • Production-quality coding experience in Python, including data manipulation and algorithm implementation.
  • 3+ years of experience conducting machine-learning, statistical-modeling, or applied quantitative research in an academic or industry setting.

Preferred Qualifications

  • PhD in a quantitative field.
  • Experience with payment products or payment experiences, such as autopay, recurring payments, or payment plans.
  • Experience with causal machine-learning methods or treatment-effect modeling.
  • Experience with supervised learning, model evaluation, and feature engineering, especially with large or complex datasets.
  • Experience taking work from exploratory analysis and experimentation through production model development while maintaining analytical rigor and model reliability.
  • Ability to translate broad servicing or business problems into structured research questions and communicate complex findings as actionable recommendations.

Position location

This role is available in the following locations: Remote — United States.

Travel requirements

As a digital first company, the majority of your work can be accomplished remotely. The majority of our employees can live and work anywhere in the U.S or Canada (outside of Quebec) but are expected to spend high quality time in-person collaborating via regular onsites and in-person meetings. The onsite cadence varies depending on the team and role; most teams meet once or twice per quarter for 2-4 consecutive days at a time.

In addition, Upstart provides employees with target bonuses, equity compensation, and generous benefits packages (including medical, dental, vision, and 401k).

Fresh Prints is an NYC-based custom apparel company experiencing rapid year-over-year growth. You’ll join a team that helps drive our business growth by building and scaling a reliable supplier ecosystem and ensuring operational excellence across our supply chain.

We’re looking for a detail-oriented, technically strong Sewing Pattern Maker to support the development and production of garments across our supplier network. In this role, you’ll be responsible for translating garment designs, technical specifications, measurements, and approved samples into accurate, production-ready sewing patterns.

You’ll directly report to our Sourcing Manager and work closely with our internal Design and Ops teams, as well as overseas garment manufacturers, to ensure patterns meet fit, construction, measurement, grading, and production requirements. You’ll also help troubleshoot pattern and construction issues during sampling and production, ensuring garments can be manufactured accurately and consistently at scale.

You’ll grow as Fresh Prints grows. You’ll get the support, ownership, and development opportunities needed to learn quickly, grow professionally, and make a meaningful impact.

Responsibilities

  • Develop accurate, production-ready sewing patterns based on technical specifications, measurements, design references, technical drawings, and approved samples.
  • Create and maintain pattern grading across required size ranges, ensuring consistent and proportional fit.
  • Review samples and fitting results and make pattern adjustments to address fit, measurement, and construction issues.
  • Apply knowledge of different fabric types, including woven, knit, stretch, lace, and elastic materials, to ensure patterns are suitable for the intended fabric and construction.
  • Collaborate with internal teams and manufacturers to troubleshoot pattern, fit, sewing, and construction issues during sampling and production.
  • Interpret technical packs, measurement specifications, construction details, sketches, and approved samples and translate them into production-ready patterns.
  • Maintain accurate pattern files, revisions, measurements, and technical documentation, ensuring manufacturers are always working with the correct versions.
  • Prepare and share digital pattern files and relevant technical information with manufacturing partners for production.
  • Communicate asynchronously with overseas manufacturers to clarify pattern and construction requirements and resolve production issues.
  • Identify opportunities to improve pattern development, sampling, and production processes.
  • The unknown - we're always looking for new ways to improve, and we want you to take ownership of projects you believe can create value.

Technical Skills

  • Ideally 3+ years of experience in garment pattern making, preferably within an apparel manufacturing environment.
  • Strong knowledge of garment construction, fitting, measurements, grading, and pattern development.
  • Experience creating production-ready patterns for sewn garments.
  • Proficiency in CAD pattern-making software such as Gerber AccuMark, Lectra, Optitex, or similar systems.
  • Experience with digital pattern grading and pattern modification.
  • Strong understanding of different fabric types and how fabric characteristics affect pattern development, fit, and construction.
  • Ability to interpret technical packs, measurement specifications, construction details, sketches, and approved samples.
  • Experience with apparel sampling and fitting is strongly preferred.
  • Experience with women streetwear apparel is a strong advantage.
  • Familiarity with 3D apparel software such as CLO3D or Browzwear is a plus.
  • Comfortable working with digital files and maintaining organized pattern documentation.

Essential Requirements

  • Strong understanding of garment construction and the ability to identify and resolve pattern-related production issues.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy in measurements and pattern development.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple pattern development projects simultaneously.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with manufacturers and internal stakeholders in a remote environment.
  • Self-motivated and comfortable working with limited supervision.
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to manage revisions, deadlines, and multiple garment styles.
  • Reliable internet connection and a suitable work-from-home setup.
  • Willingness to work remotely with teams and manufacturers across different time zones.

jobs.excerpt: Location: 100% Remote Employment: Full-time, long-term position Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement Salary: Based on experience, technical expertise, and level of responsibility About UsWe are developing a mobile application that combines real-world interactions with location and proximity technologies.
jobs.description:
Location: 100% Remote
Employment: Full-time, long-term position
Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement
Salary: Based on experience, technical expertise, and level of responsibility

About Us

We are developing a mobile application that combines real-world interactions with location and proximity technologies. Our team uses AI coding tools and autonomous coding agents to accelerate development, improve our engineering workflows, and build practical knowledge across the team.

We are looking for a senior developer who can take ownership of mobile development, deliver reliable software, and help our team become more effective at building applications with AI.

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Senior Mobile App Developer with strong Kotlin Multiplatform expertise and an excellent background in native Android development with Kotlin.

This is a hands-on engineering role. You will develop and improve our application, solve complex technical problems, and establish effective workflows for AI-assisted and agentic development. Experience with GPS, Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), Ultra-Wideband (UWB), or related location and proximity technologies would be particularly valuable.

You will also share your knowledge with our internal team, including mentoring a junior team member who is learning to build Android applications through AI-assisted development, often referred to as “vibe coding.”

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, maintain, and improve our Android application using Kotlin and Kotlin Multiplatform.
  • Design shared application logic and integrate it with platform-specific functionality.
  • Implement and troubleshoot location and proximity features involving GPS, BLE, UWB, and related device capabilities.
  • Address practical mobile challenges such as permissions, background execution, battery consumption, connectivity, and differences between devices.
  • Use AI coding assistants and coding agents extensively to implement features, investigate defects, refactor code, and support testing.
  • Set up and improve agentic development workflows, including task decomposition, project context, automated checks, and review processes.
  • Review and validate AI-generated code, taking responsibility for its correctness, maintainability, security, and performance.
  • Test relevant functionality on real devices and resolve problems that automated tests alone may not reveal.
  • Mentor our junior team member through practical demonstrations, pair programming, and understandable explanations.
  • Document important technical decisions and share reusable knowledge with the internal team.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated senior-level experience delivering and maintaining production Android applications with Kotlin.
  • Strong practical experience with Kotlin Multiplatform, including shared code, platform-specific integrations, and the boundaries between them.
  • Solid understanding of Android architecture, Jetpack Compose, coroutines, Flow, application lifecycle, and state management.
  • Strong debugging skills and the ability to investigate problems across application code, APIs, and device behavior.
  • Substantial hands-on experience using AI coding tools to deliver working software.
  • A strong interest in agentic coding and the ability to establish effective development workflows around coding agents.
  • The ability to assess AI-generated solutions critically and explain why an implementation is appropriate.
  • Willingness and ability to teach less experienced team members patiently and clearly.
  • The ability to work independently, communicate progress clearly, and take ownership of results in a remote team.
  • Interest in a long-term, full-time position and availability to start promptly after an agreement is reached.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • GPS positioning, location accuracy, sensor data, and proximity detection.
  • BLE discovery, advertising, connections, and signal-strength limitations.
  • UWB ranging, distance measurement, direction estimation, and hardware compatibility.
  • NFC and other device-to-device interactions.
  • Building automated development and testing workflows that combine human oversight with coding agents.

What We Offer

  • A fully remote, full-time role with a long-term perspective.
  • Compensation based on your experience, expertise, and responsibilities.
  • Ownership of meaningful mobile development work.
  • The opportunity to shape how our team uses AI and coding agents.
  • Close collaboration with an internal team that wants to learn from your experience.

Remote Working Arrangement

Our remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots of the screen. This monitoring is part of the working arrangement and will be explained during the recruitment process.

Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup.

How to Apply

Please submit your CV and a short overview of relevant projects.

Include:

  • Your role in developing Android applications and Kotlin Multiplatform solutions.
  • Any practical experience with GPS, BLE, UWB, or similar technologies.
  • The AI coding tools and agentic workflows you use, with an example of how they helped you deliver a working application or feature.
  • Your experience mentoring junior developers or colleagues learning AI-assisted development.
  • Your earliest start date and salary expectations.

Public portfolio or GitHub links are welcome where available.

Overview

Experian's Fraud Analytics & Commercialization operates across four main functions. These include client engagement analytics, scalable and custom analytics for financial institutions, fraud analytics consulting, and solution integrity and enablement for production-ready platforms.

We're looking for a motivated Data Scientist to help build fraud detection models and features that identify high-risk activity while minimizing friction for legitimate customers. Core skills for this role include an eagerness to collaborate, and empathy. You will will dig into surprising signals in the data and to learn how that insight becomes a deployed model.

You will help investigate the latest fraud patterns, build features, and train and evaluate machine learning models. You will work with senior data scientists and engineers starting with problem definition through feature engineering, experimentation, and deployment. You will be a developing programmer, ready to translate theoretical principles into production-ready solutions.

We continue to sharpen through research and the engineering that turns those findings into tools and systems built for commercialization.

This is a remote role and you will report into the Sr. Manager of Fraud Analytics.

What you'll do

  • Investigate large datasets, including exploratory analysis and fraud label development, to identify latest fraud patterns, attack methods, and behavioral signals.
  • Translate ambiguous fraud and risk problems into clear hypotheses, analytical plans, model requirements, and measurable success criteria.
  • Develop machine learning models for fraud detection across account opening, account takeover, and identity risk.
  • Evaluate models using metrics like ROC/AUC/KS/Gini, precision/recall, fraud capture rate, false-positive rate, customer friction, and fraud losses prevented.
  • Develop and validate predictive features using identity, transactional, consumer credit history, device, behavioral, temporal, velocity, network, and third-party data.
  • Write clean, efficient, well-tested Python and PySpark code, and collaborate with teams to bring models and features into batch, retro, or real-time decisioning environments.
  • Monitor feature quality, model performance, population changes, and fraud-pattern drift
  • Design and present analyses for model behavior, tradeoffs, risks, and recommendations
  • Follow appropriate standards for data privacy, model documentation, explainability, validation, and governance.

Qualifications

  • At least 3 years of experience in data science, machine learning, statistical modeling, or a related quantitative field
  • Bachelor's or advanced degree in computer science, statistics, engineering, data science, or another quantitative discipline
  • Direct experience developing fraud-detection, identity-risk, credit-risk, financial-crime, or other adversarial risk models.
  • Demonstrated experience creating meaningful fraud features
  • Proficiency in Python and PySpark, with experience writing modular and tested code for large datasets and distributed or cloud data systems.
  • Experience using common data science and machine-learning tools such as pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, XGBoost, TensorFlow, or comparable technologies.
  • Knowledge of supervised learning, model evaluation, feature selection, statistical inference, experimentation, and model calibration.
  • Experience navigating challenges common to fraud modeling, including class imbalance, delayed or incomplete labels, changing attack patterns, and model drift.
  • Experience moving models beyond experimentation and into production, either directly or in close partnership with engineering teams.

Benefits/Perks:

  • Great compensation package and bonus plan
  • Core benefits including medical, dental, vision, and matching 401K
  • Flexible work environment, ability to work remote, hybrid or in-office
  • Flexible time off including volunteer time off, vacation, sick and 12-paid holidays
