jobs.description:
Afresh, the AI platform for grocery, began by tackling the most complex problem in the industry: fresh, and has evolved into the core AI platform for grocers.

By leveraging proprietary AI designed for high-volatility environments, we empower partners like Albertsons, Meijer, and Wakefern to drive smarter decisions across their entire enterprise.

Following record-breaking 70% revenue growth in 2025, we have scaled to 6 enterprise-grade solutions, with solutions live in over 10% of the U.S. grocery market. Our platform now orchestrates billions of decisions from the store floor to the distribution center and prevented over 200 million pounds of food waste last year alone.

If you're looking for a role where your work directly translates into massive scale and social good, and you want to be part of the team that defines how the world eats, there is no better time to join us.

Afresh, the AI platform for grocery, began by tackling the most complex problem in the industry: fresh, and has evolved into the core AI platform for grocers.

By leveraging proprietary AI designed for high-volatility environments, we empower partners like Albertsons, Meijer, and Wakefern to drive smarter decisions across their entire enterprise.

Following record-breaking 70% revenue growth in 2025, we have scaled to 6 enterprise-grade solutions, with solutions live in over 10% of the U.S. grocery market. Our platform now orchestrates billions of decisions from the store floor to the distribution center and prevented over 200 million pounds of food waste last year alone.

If you're looking for a role where your work directly translates into massive scale and social good, and you want to be part of the team that defines how the world eats, there is no better time to join us.

About the Role

As a Principal Support Engineer at Afresh, you are the person who understands how our platform actually behaves for our grocery partners. You have deep technical support, solutions, or data engineering experience, you communicate with equal clarity to a store director and a staff engineer, and you are excited to reduce fresh food waste in the grocery industry.

Support Engineering is the complex technical investigation arm of our Support organization — the last stop for internal escalations to resolve customer-facing problems across all Afresh products. You will own the complex escalations that others cannot resolve and then work upstream to eliminate or minimize future recurrence; quantifying impact, building tooling and agentic AI workflows to deflect future volume, and then proactively driving the cross-functional efforts to eliminate the root cause.

This is a senior individual contributor role, and the scope of this role is deliberately broad. You will be handed goals rather than tasks and you are expected to quickly and autonomously develop deep expertise across our products and the complex data relationships behind them. You will own and lead initiatives from end to end, building influence and alignment with other teams to achieve your goals.

What You’ll Do

A typical week might involve building an agentic AI support workflow in Stylo, shipping a Claude skill that lets Tier 1 Support resolve issues with a new product feature, coordinating a team-wide investigation of data issues across 200 products, and then presenting the root cause analysis and measured impact of that investigation to Product and Data Engineering leadership. Specifically, you will:

  • Own our most complex escalations end to end — data mapping defects, recommendation and forecast anomalies, and integration or data-feed failures
  • Identify and lead large initiatives that deliver critical impact against department-level OKRs, such as raising our ticket deflection rate, reducing average handle time, or reducing escalations to cross-functional teams. You will work autonomously — scoping the work yourself, defining what success looks like, and communicating progress and blockers without being asked
  • Define and report the numbers that prove impact: baseline before you build, quantify after, and publish on a regular cadence in channels where the appropriate teams and leaders can see it
  • Build the tooling that removes the work — SQL and Python, Databricks and Looker dashboards and notebooks, Stylo workflows, Claude and Cowork skills, and lightweight automations that take manual effort off Tier 1 Support and Operations
  • Drive cross-functional change with teams that don't report to you, partnering with Solutions Engineering, Data Engineering, Product Engineering, and Operations to fix the systems generating ticket volume — securing shared ownership, holding regular communication cadence, and raising flags visibly when progress stalls
  • Multiply the team rather than absorb its hardest work: mentor Tier 1 and Tier 2 engineers, lead training, and write the playbooks and source-of-truth documentation that let others resolve what only you can resolve today
  • Be visible outside Support — present in Tech Demos, post data-driven updates in company-wide channels, join account reviews, and represent Support in cross-functional forums
  • Master partner-specific behavior across our retailers and their banners, and serve as the escalation point when a judgment call needs to reach Product, Engineering, or the customer directly

What Will Make You a Great Fit

The following represent attributes our ideal candidate possesses. We encourage all highly-qualified candidates to apply, even if they do not fulfill all the listed criteria.

  • 5+ years in technical support engineering, solutions engineering, data engineering, or a comparable role where you personally owned root-cause analysis on production data
  • Advanced SQL. You reason comfortably about joins across large, imperfect datasets, and you validate findings against the authoritative source rather than the most convenient table
  • Demonstrated ability to own complex cross-functional initiatives end to end and land them — including the uncomfortable parts: securing commitments from other teams, absorbing friction, and driving to a decision
  • A measurement instinct. You define success numerically before you start, and you speak to results rather than activity
  • Proficiency building with AI tools such as Claude or other agentic platforms, paired with sound judgment about where automation can be trusted and where it cannot
  • Scripting ability in Python or similar to automate investigation and data work
  • Clear, calm written communication, and the instinct to teach rather than correct when helping less experienced teammates
  • Comfort with ambiguity and a bias toward shipping an imperfect, iterative solution over waiting for a complete one
  • Self-direction. You source your own answers, set your own milestones, and do not need oversight to make progress

Nice to Have

  • Grocery, retail, or supply chain domain knowledge — hands-on familiarity with ordering, replenishment, assortment, or fresh department operations is a significant advantage
  • Experience with Databricks, Zendesk, Stylo, or workflow automation platforms
  • Experience supporting ML-driven products, and the ability to distinguish whether an anomaly originates in data inputs, model behavior, or application logic
  • A track record of mentoring engineers and raising the technical bar of a team

Salary Range in U.S.: $130k to $195k + meaningful early stage equity & benefits

Why You’ll Love Working at Afresh
At Afresh, our mission to eliminate food waste starts with investing in our people. We provide a comprehensive support system designed to help you do your best work while maintaining a healthy, balanced life.
  • Comprehensive Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your family, with the majority of premiums covered by Afresh. We also provide dedicated mental health support and counseling services.
  • Invested in Your Future: Competitive base salary, meaningful equity (U.S. employees), and a 401(k) program with a generous company match.
  • Flexible & Modern Workspace: Whether you work from home or a local office, we support your setup with a home office stipend and "Coworking Wallets" for flexible workspace access.
  • Growth-Obsessed Culture: We believe in continuous learning. Every employee receives an annual professional development budget to master new skills and grow their career at Afresh.
  • Holistic Monthly Stipends: Beyond your paycheck, we provide monthly stipends for "Betterment" (wellness/lifestyle) and telecommunications to ensure you have what you need to thrive.
  • Time to Recharge: Flexible paid time off to take the time you need to recharge.
*Full-time U.S. employees are eligible for these benefits

About Afresh

Founded in 2017, Afresh is using AI to tackle the #1 solution to curb climate change: reducing food waste. By building AI specifically for the intricacies of grocery—from the fresh perimeter to the center store—we help grocers minimize waste and maximize sales.

Afresh sits at an incredible intersection of positive social impact, rocket ship financial growth, and cutting-edge technology. Our best-in-class AI research has been published in top journals, including ICML, and our investors include Al Gore’s Just Climate, former Whole Foods Market CEO Walter Robb, and Eric Schmidt's Innovation Endeavors.

Grocery is the past, present, and future of our food system – the waste we create today will impact our planet for years to come. Join us as we continue to build a vibrant, diverse, and inclusive team that embodies our company’s values of proactivity, kindness, candor, and humility.

Afresh provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, marital status, pregnancy or related condition, or any other basis protected by law.

General Description:


Reporting to a Director, GVAP Hematology, the person in this role drives the global value, access, pricing, and reimbursement launch-readiness for an assigned asset — initially in one or more of its early indications, and later potential future pipeline indications — across geographies. The Associate Director translates pivotal evidence and the competitive landscape into a differentiated global access and pricing tactics as well as country-ready toolkits that enable local affiliates to secure timely reimbursement and optimal patient access at launch and across the lifecycle. S/he/they will maintain coordination with other BeOne Hematology portfolio leads whose assets share the same or similar indications and will collaborate closely with global cross-functional teams incl. HEOR, Medical, commercial, clinical development and regulatory as well as seek input and alignment with affiliate teams to develop strategy and access toolkits to optimize the assets reimbursement and pricing potential.

Key Responsibilities:

Support Market Access and Value Strategy Development:

  • Develop and help lead the global market access and reimbursement strategy across lead and potential future pipeline indication, aligned to pivotal evidence and relevant comparators.
  • Support development of inputs (GVAP perspective) that inform asset lifecycle planning, indication sequencing, and evidence prioritization to maximize long-term access, reimbursement, and portfolio value; provide input to governance and oversight bodies as delegated.
  • Translate regional and affiliate payer insights into actionable recommendations for clinical development, evidence generation, pricing, access strategy, and commercialization planning.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to integrate access and payer requirements into the development process — influencing trial design, endpoints, and evidence generation to meet payer needs.

Access Toolkits & Payer Materials

  • Build country-ready access toolkits in close partnership with HEOR — global value dossiers, budget-impact and cost-effectiveness frameworks, and payer communication materials aligned to pivotal evidence and comparators.

Launch & Access Readiness (project execution):

  • Support EU Joint Clinical Assessment (JCA) strategy and dossier development in close collaboration with HEOR, GVAP JCA coordinators, and the wider cross-functional team.
  • Track access milestones, evidence needs, and deliverables against the launch plan; flag risks and dependencies to the Director.

Cross-functional & Affiliate Support

  • Serve as a day-to-day point of contact for regional and affiliate teams on access and pricing deliverables — fulfilling requests, sharing materials, and training teams on the toolkits.
  • Coordinate and align deliverables across Pricing, HEOR, Medical Affairs, Regulatory, Commercial, and Clinical Development.
  • Feed affiliate and payer insights back to the Director to inform strategy and evidence decisions

Market Insights

  • Monitor the competitive, pricing, HTA, and policy landscape (including BTK-class dynamics and EU HTA / JCA developments), translating changes into actionable updates to strategy and toolkits.

Education Required:

  • Undergraduate science degree required.
  • Post-graduate science degrees (PhD, PharmD, MD) and/ or MBA preferred.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in life sciences, health economics, pharmacy, health policy, business, or a related field; advanced degree (MSc, MPH, PharmD, PhD, or MBA) strongly preferred with 8+ years of biopharmaceutical experience, with a substantial portion in global / region / country value, access, pricing, and reimbursement roles.
  • Demonstrated expertise in HTA processes and payer systems across key markets (e.g., G-BA / IQWiG, NICE, HAS) and the US payer environment (IRA / MFN awareness a plus).
  • Experience building global value dossiers, HTA / EU HTA JCA submission content, and payer value evidence in partnership with HEOR.

- Ability to manage and prioritize multiple projects/tasks simultaneously.

- Knowledge of Duke University policies and procedures relating to grant and contracts activity

jobs.title: RQ09199 - UX Designer - Senior
jobs.excerpt: There are four (4) distinct delivery phases in which user experience designers (task based I&IT consultants) produce deliverables following Ontario Digital Service Design playbook, which outlines the standard process for user experience design.
jobs.description:
There are four (4) distinct delivery phases in which user experience designers (task based I&IT consultants) produce deliverables following Ontario Digital Service Design playbook, which outlines the standard process for user experience design.

Delivery Phase 1) Discovery:

Before building a solution, a project team needs to find out whether users need it and whether other solutions exist. The UX Designers responsibilities during this phase are to build an understanding of the problem space/statement, the long and short-term business goals, and the user and business needs.

Deliverables:

  1. Facilitate the Kick-off meeting with the project team to produce such outputs as:
  • Business Model Canvas
  • 5 Whys
  • User Personas
  • Stakeholder Mapping
  • Strategy Map
  • Short- and Long-Term Goals
  • Fears and Challenges
  • Problem Statement
  1. Facilitate user research activities to produce such outputs as:
  • User interview topic Maps, a summary of interrelated topics for the user interview
  • User Interview Scripts to plan and guide user discussion
  • User Interview Synthesis (collection, aggregation and analysis) of written observations recorded during each interview
  • User research findings report
  1. Inception (Science Fair Day):
  • Showcases the work and key findings from this stage to stakeholders outside of the core project team
  • Aligns entire team (business, technical) on what the next steps will be
  • Planning activities for next phase (Alpha)
  1. Other deliverables typically delivered in this phase include:
  • User Storyboard to communicate a story through images displayed in a sequence of panels that chronologically maps the storys main events.
  • Technical Service Blueprint, a diagram that displays the entire process of service delivery including support systems by listing all the activities that happen at each stage, performed by the different roles involved
  • Defined business Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Delivery Phase 2) Alpha:

Alpha is about testing hypotheses and experimentation. The purpose of Alpha is to determine how to meet the user needs that were identified in discovery. This phase is an opportunity to quickly test different approaches with users before building a service.

Deliverables:

  1. Optionally conduct Google Ventures five (5) Day Design Sprint (or variation). This sprint is a five (5) day process for answering critical business questions through design, prototyping, and testing ideas with customers
  2. Produce clickable prototypes of multiple possible solutions
  3. Validate "clickable prototypes with users through usability testing sessions and produce research findings report
  4. Iterate (improve) on clickable prototypes with insights garnered from research findings report
  5. Identify and document existing processes or policies that will need to change to support the new product or service
  6. Produce a business proposal to justify funding for the next phase (Beta)
  7. Define a clear vision for the solution that will be built in Beta
  8. Create a plan and prioritized list of features to be completed in the Beta phase
  9. Define user solution, and delivery of KPIs

Delivery Phase 3) Beta:

The goal of Beta is to build a real service that works well for a larger group of people. The prototypes that were developed and tested during Alpha are used to build a Minimum Viable Product (MVP) for deployment in a live, user-facing environment. Executed within the context of Scrum methodology, the UX Designer performs the following Agile ceremonies: Stand-up meetings, Sprint Planning, Backlog grooming, Reporting, Acceptance, and Retrospective.

The designers are at the spearhead of this methodology, creating and validating user stories for the developers (typical) one iteration ahead.

Deliverables:

  1. User story creation and validation:
    1. Participates in deciding which priority to tackle
    2. Sketching workshop to create visual representation of ideas or user flows
    3. Create designs
    4. Enhancements made to designs
    5. User Interviews (for validation)
    6. Synthesising individual and overall interview findings
    7. Enhancements to designs made from synthesis
    8. Get product owner sign off and input story into backlog for future iteration planning
    9. Rinse and repeat for each feature, function within a given iteration
  2. Conduct accessibility compliance testing of the solution within each iteration.
  3. Conduct regular usability testing sessions on the MVP built as part of the Beta phase.

Delivery Phase 4) Live:

Live begins when the service has reached a point of maturity and all of the main features in the backlog have been built. While most people understand the purpose of live, its not always given the attention and resources it deserves.

Continuous improvement is one of the core principles of service design and thats what live is all about. The goal is to continuously monitor, research, test and iterate for as long as the service is active.

Deliverables:

  1. Continue to facilitate user research activities to produce such outputs as:
  • User interview topic maps, a summary of interrelated topics for the user interview
  • User interview scripts to plan and guide user discussion
  • User interview synthesis (collection, aggregation and analysis) of written observations recorded during each interview
  • User research findings report
  1. Conduct regular accessibility compliance testing of the live build as improvements are released.
  2. Conduct regular usability testing sessions on the live build.
  3. Analyze usage analytics and user behaviour patterns to track and measure key performance indicators.

User Experience Design 40%

· Extensive experience in using UX design best practices to design solutions, and a deep understanding of mobile-first and responsive design.

· Ability to iterate your designs and solutions efficiently and intelligently.

· 3+ years of relevant experience in participating in complex projects (products) of different sizes, ensuring alignment to plans, best practices and incorporating user-centred design processes and agile (scrum) methodologies.

· Degree or diploma in graphic design; degree or certification in usability, human-computer interaction, and technical writing a plus

· Experience in facilitate User Research and Usability testing. Accessibility compliance testing is a plus.

· Experience in facilitate User Research and Usability testing activities to produce such outputs as:

o User Interview Topic Maps

o User Interview Scripts

o User Interview Synthesis (collection, aggregation and analysis) of written observations recorded during each interview

o User Research Findings Report

Relationship Management - 20%

· Demonstrated experience in communication and mediation skills with business teams and core team members to ensure Client projects (products) are progressing according to schedule

· Experience with strategies and actions to overcome resistance to change and capitalize on forces in support of change during all stages of projects Discovery, Alpha, Beta, Live or similar delivery methodologies

· Ability to deliver on a (project) product with a balanced team (product owner, user experience designers, developers) by participating in Agile (SCRUM) delivery methodologies

Technical Skills - 30%

· Expertise in UX software such as JustInMind, InVision, Sketch, Adobe Creative Cloud, Axure, Figma, and Zeplin. HTML5, CSS3, and JS skills (React, Angular, NodeJS), are a plus.

Soft skills - 10%

· Ability to clearly and effectively communicate design processes, ideas, and solutions to teams and clients.

· Be excited about collaborating and communicating closely with teams and other stakeholders via a distributed model to regularly deliver design solutions for approval.

· Strong interpersonal and negotiation skills

· Strong presentation, verbal and written communication skills

· Excellent analytical, problem-solving and decision-making skills

Must haves:

Extensive experience in using UX design best practices to design solutions, and a deep understanding of mobile-first and responsive design.

3+ years of relevant experience in participating in complex projects (products) of different sizes, ensuring alignment to plans, best practices and incorporating user-centred design processes and agile (scrum) methodologies

You'll work across Synera's product, from our web-based execution platform to the low-code desktop editor and customer portal, helping bring these pieces together into one cohesive and awesome experience. Along the way, you'll have room to experiment: trying out new approaches, bringing AI into your own workflow, and pushing for better ways of building rather than just the familiar ones.

That means shaping the way users interact with complex engineering automations, and making it feel simple, fast, and even fun. We're looking for someone who’s excited to own features end-to-end, explore new technologies, and help connect the dots between our different products.

If you enjoy working in a collaborative environment where ideas (and pizza 🍕) are always shared, you’ll feel right at home with us.

👉 What a week at Synera could look like:

  • Monday: You kick off the week by syncing with fellow devs across teams: sharing breakthroughs, tackling tough bugs, or dropping a hot tip about that obscure TypeScript feature you mastered recently.

  • Tuesday: Time to dive into a new technical challenge: you and your team huddle up for a design session to figure out how to make a complex feature feel like magic for the user.

  • Thursday: It’s demo day! You show off what the team’s built during the sprint, watching features come together and getting high-fives (virtual or real) from across the company.

  • Friday: You sit in on a customer call with our success team and get real insights into what’s working, and what’s not. That afternoon, during your bi-weekly Friday project time, you spin up a quick prototype that just might solve their problem.

  • You start to support other developers by completing reviews.

  • You take on stories of increasing complexity with increasing independence.

  • You add and adjust skills of our software factory.

This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports, reporting to the Service Engineering Lead, Enterprise Intelligence. It operates within DeepHealth’s Forward Deployment Engineering (FDE) function, whose purpose is to help customers adopt DeepHealth products correctly. The role sits at the intersection of the Technical Delivery Manager (TDM), Product, Service and Solution Delivery teams to ensure smooth customer adoption. It transitions best practices to the Service and Solution Delivery teams and plans upcoming product changes with them to ensure commercial readiness.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end technical solution design of the Diagnostic Suite for assigned customers, combining core PACS, Viewer, Reporting, integrations and AI into one clinical workflow.

  • Lead suite-level technical discovery with customers and implementation teams, and produce the solution design and configuration plan used for implementation.

  • Lead the product-area FDEs (Reporting Pro, Viewer, HL7 Integration) and own OS/Core PACS configuration directly, to deliver a consistent customer solution.

  • Partner with the assigned implementation counterpart for this workstream to adopt learnings and best practices into customer configuration and implementations; train and coach implementation teams on suite-level configuration standards; maintain reference architectures and deployment playbooks.

  • Serve as customer-facing technical lead during go-lives, hypercare and escalations that span multiple components.

  • Provide technical support to the implementation teams for cross-component issues in assigned accounts, including root cause analysis and resolution with engineering (approximately 20–30% of time).

  • Convert recurring customer needs into standardized workflows and product requirements, distinguishing product gaps from configuration or training issues.

  • Own the AI adoption strategy across the DxS suite: define requirements, expected customer impact and success criteria, and feed them back to Product and Engineering.

  • Support customer adoption of AI-enabled workflows across the suite as they are released, coordinating rollout, site readiness and customer adoption with the Technical Delivery Manager and Product Manager.

  • Own escalation of engineering issues for assigned accounts: triage, document reproducible defects, track status with engineering and close the loop with customers.

  • Support site reliability (SRE) for assigned accounts: monitor service health with observability tools, participate in incident response and drive reliability improvements with engineering.

PLEASE NOTE: This is not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities and requirements of the position described above. Other functions may be assigned and management retains the right to add or change duties at any time.

  • Experience: 5+ years in a customer-facing technical role across multiple enterprise imaging components (PACS, viewer, reporting, RIS), such as solutions engineer, technical consultant or senior implementation engineer (required).

  • In-depth knowledge of DICOM and HL7 v2, and how they connect across the radiology order-to-report workflow (required).

  • Hands-on configuration of PACS and diagnostic viewers, and experience integrating radiology reporting systems such as PowerScribe (required).

  • Strong understanding of end-to-end radiology clinical workflow, including RIS, worklists, reading, reporting and results distribution (required).

  • Working knowledge of cloud-hosted applications (GCP, AWS or Azure), networking, storage and SSO/authentication (required).

  • Demonstrated ability to communicate technical decisions to radiologists, IT leaders and executives, including in escalated situations (required).

  • Imaging informatics or clinical credential such as CIIP, PARCA or ARRT(R) (preferred).

  • Experience deploying or supporting clinical AI applications in radiology (preferred).

  • Experience in a regulated medical device environment (FDA 21 CFR 820, ISO 13485, IEC 62304) and with ITIL practices (preferred).

  • Microsoft Office experience required.

Our platform sits between our customers and dozens of third-party accounting and ERP systems. That makes reliability part of our product. When a call is slow or fails, our customers need to know why, and so do we. You’ll be the senior engineer who owns how our platform runs in production, and you’ll keep building the product alongside the team. Metrics, logs, traces and alerts, across our services and the third-party APIs we call. Raise the bar on security and reliability

Backend Software Developer – Maatwerk Software met Impact

Wij weten dat wat op het eerste gezicht eenvoudig lijkt, vaak complexer is dan men denkt. En wij begrijpen dat technologie geen barrière mag zijn, maar juist de verbinding naar een bestendige maatschappij.

Bij Dawn Technology bouwen we niet zomaar digitale oplossingen. We ontwikkelen hoogwaardige maatwerk software die het leven van mensen verrijkt. Binnen onze Smart Devices afdeling bouwen we apps die impact maken. Van media apps voor bedrijven als Pathé en de NPO met miljoenen gebruikers, tot de app van het KNMI waarmee we belangrijke weerswaarschuwingen zoals code rood meldingen afgeven. We maken geen compromissen op kwaliteit en zoeken altijd naar de best mogelijke oplossing, tot in de kleinste details.

Om onze groeiambities te realiseren zoeken we een Backend Software Developer. Iemand die energie krijgt van het ontwikkelen van sterke backend-omgevingen, het schrijven van strakke code en het operationeel krijgen én houden van de onderliggende cloud-infrastructuur voor applicaties met miljoenen gebruikers.

Jouw rol

Als Backend Software Developer ben je een onmisbare schakel in de backend-trajecten van onze applicaties. Je bouwt de schaalbare, onzichtbare motor achter hoogwaardige innovaties en zorgt dat onze infrastructuur robuust staat. Je bent analytisch sterk en je krijgt er energie van om technische requirements te vertalen naar logische cloud-infrastructuren die je vervolgens zélf bouwt. Je werkt nauw samen met onze multidisciplinaire ontwikkelteams en zorgt dat de code soepel draait. Geen haastwerk, maar engineering met diepgang en visie.

Wat je zal gaan doen:

  • Ontwikkelen en operationeel maken van serverless backends en event-driven API's met TypeScript (AWS Lambda / Serverless Functions).

  • Effectief asynchroon samenwerken, documenteren en code opleveren binnen een distributed, remote-first team.

Requirements

Wie ben jij?

We zoeken een developer met een HBO werk- en denkniveau die al de nodige stappen heeft gezet in het bouwen van cloud-native applicaties. Je hebt sterke ervaring met de TypeScript/Node.js stack en modern software-development zoals Agile/Scrum, CI/CD en Infrastructure as Code kent voor jou geen geheimen.

Je bent niet alleen een developer, maar je kunt ook écht zelf cloudomgevingen operationeel krijgen en beheren met tools als AWSCDK, Terraform of CloudFormation. Algemene cloud kennis is een vereiste; specifieke ervaring met AWS of Scaleway is een pre. Je geniet van technische puzzels, levert graag goed geteste code op en voelt je thuis in een Node.js backend. Verder ben je woonachtig in Nederland.

Wat bieden wij jou?

  • De Organisatie: Snelgroeiende, vooruitstrevende organisatie met sterke visie en focus op maatschappelijk relevante software.

Over Dawn Technology

We bouwen niet voor de massa, maar voor betekenis. Onze klanten komen uit sectoren die er écht toe doen – van zorg en educatie tot duurzaamheid en publieke dienstverlening. We verstoppen complexiteit achter eenvoud en bouwen software die logisch voelt. En precies dát maakt ons werk elke dag boeiend.

Samen met een groep van bijna 250 digitale specialisten delen we kennis, zoeken we de nieuwste technologieën op en versterken we elkaar. Benieuwd om te horen hoe het is om bij Dawn Technology te werken? Luister dan eens naar deze podcast.

Spreekt deze rol je aan? Laat je gegevens dan achter via de sollicitatieknop. Ook als je twijfelt of je volledig aansluit nodigen we je uit om te solliciteren. Nog vragen naar aanleiding van deze vacature? Neem dan gerust contact op met Dennis Timmerman (Corporate Recruiter) via 0638675360.

Have a great day. Dawn Technology.

Senior Software Engineer - Integrations

About the job

HeroDevs is hiring a Senior Software Engineer for our Evergreen team. HeroDevs keeps critical open-source software secure long after it reaches end of life. The Evergreen team owns EOLDS, our end-of-life dataset, which internal teams and integration partners rely on to understand which open-source software has reached end of life, the risk that carries, and how to remediate it. We also build the systems that turn that data into packages our partners can consume, and we need those systems to produce packages at scale when a partner needs them.

Position Summary

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to help take EOLDS to its next stage. You'll help build the pipelines that let us generate and publish large numbers of packages for partners on demand. This is a high-ownership role. You'll make design decisions, set patterns for the team, and work closely with partner-facing teams to understand what partners need from the data.

Responsibilities

  • Improve EOLDS data quality through validation, deduplication, provenance tracking, and automated checks that catch regressions before they reach partners
  • Investigate and document how our current risk heuristics work, including their inputs, assumptions, and edge cases
  • Design and build a multi-model risk scoring framework that supports different risk profiles for remediation, including CVE-centric models alongside our existing heuristics
  • Build weighted, configurable scoring so risk profiles can be tuned per partner or use case, with clear explanations of how a score was produced
  • Integrate EOLDS with Kafka and our data lake, including event schemas, producers and consumers, backfills, and consistency between systems
  • Build automated pipelines that can generate, version, and publish large numbers of packages for partners on demand, reliably and reproducibly

  • Write services and tooling in TypeScript/Node.js, with automated testing and CI/CD
  • Review code and designs, mentor other engineers, and help raise the team's engineering bar
  • Write clear documentation for the dataset, scoring models, and pipelines you build
  • Work to automate package requests from our partners

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with significant time spent building data-intensive systems or data pipelines in production
  • Proficiency in TypeScript/JavaScript (Node.js)
  • Experience with event streaming platforms such as Kafka, and with data lakes or data warehouses

  • Experience with Argo UI

jobs.title: Principal Platform Engineer (m/w/d)
jobs.excerpt: Shopware ist ein führendes E-Commerce-System, das es Unternehmen weltweit ermöglicht, im digitalen Handel schnell und effizient zu skalieren.
jobs.description:
Shopware ist ein führendes E-Commerce-System, das es Unternehmen weltweit ermöglicht, im digitalen Handel schnell und effizient zu skalieren. Als zukunftsweisende Open-Source-Lösung wird Shopware bereits von einigen der größten europäischen Marken, Einzelhändlern und Herstellern im B2C- und B2B-Bereich eingesetzt.

Wir suchen eine:n Principal Platform Engineer (m/w/d) für den Aufbau und Betrieb unserer Data Platform – der Infrastruktur für Datenaufnahme, Speicherung und Laufzeitumgebungen, auf der alle Datenpipelines bei Shopware laufen. Du verantwortest ihre Architektur und Zuverlässigkeit: von der CDC-Datenaufnahme über einen dreistufigen Data Lake bis hin zur Orchestrierungsplattform.

Deine Arbeit ermöglicht es den Service-Teams und dem Management, unsere Kund:innen und Produkte besser zu verstehen. Zugleich schaffst du die technische Grundlage, um Anforderungen an Data Governance und Compliance tatsächlich durchzusetzen.

Du arbeitest eng mit Data & AI zusammen, die auf der von dir betriebenen Plattform Datenpipelines entwickelt. Im Service Enablement Team sorgst du dafür, dass für die Data Platform dieselben Golden Paths und Qualitätsstandards gelten wie für die übrige Service Platform. Die Position ist eine erfahrene Fachlaufbahn ohne Personalverantwortung. Wichtig ist, dass du gern mit vielen Stakeholdern, Kolleg:innen und Partnern zusammenarbeitest.

Requirements

  • Datenaufnahme: CDC-Ingestion über DMS/Lambda in den Raw-Bereich von S3 sowie Verantwortung für Raw-Schema und Datenverträge. Derzeit umfasst die Plattform 13 Domänen und rund 180 Schemata über drei Ebenen hinweg. 11 CDC-Quellen laufen bereits produktiv, weitere kommen hinzu.

  • Speicherung und Orchestrierung: Verantwortung für die mit Terraform bereitgestellte Orchestrierungsplattform auf Basis von Step Functions, EventBridge und Glue über alle drei Lake-Ebenen (Raw, Curated und Aggregated) sowie für die zugehörigen CDC-Terraform-Module.

  • Datenkatalog-Infrastruktur: Betrieb und Bereitstellung von OpenMetadata. Dazu gehören die Katalog-Infrastruktur und die Trennung zwischen Betrieb und Nutzung wie bei den Lake-Ebenen. Data & AI ergänzt darauf aufbauend Datensatzbeschreibungen, Glossar und Stewardship-Inhalte.

  • Tooling-Infrastruktur: Bereitstellung und Betrieb von Superset, dem Werkzeug der Teams für Datenabfragen und Visualisierungen.

  • Abgrenzung der Pipelines: klare Codegrenzen, ein Merge-blockierender Vertragscheck und eine eindeutige Regel für die Weiterleitung von Vorfällen: Bei Infrastrukturproblemen wirst du benachrichtigt oder alarmiert, nicht bei Fehlern in der Pipeline-Logik.

  • Zuverlässigkeit: Aufbau von Observability und operativer Exzellenz für die Data Platform, unter anderem mit Datadog, Incident Response sowie SLOs und SLIs. Du übernimmst den On-Call-Dienst; die Vergütung dafür entspricht vom ersten Tag an der Regelung anderer Teams.

  • Governance- und Compliance-Mechanismen: Die Richtlinien selbst – etwa Klassifizierungsstandards, Aufbewahrungsregeln und der Umgang mit DSGVO- und Datenschutzanfragen – werden außerhalb von SET und Data & AI durch Legal/Compliance oder eine datenschutznahe Funktion verantwortet. Du legst diese Richtlinien nicht fest, sondern implementierst die dafür erforderliche Architektur: Aufbewahrungsfristen, Zugriffskontrollen, Klassifizierungsmetadaten und die Weiterleitung von Löschanfragen.

  • Plattformübergreifende Konsistenz: Zusammenarbeit mit dem Principal Platform Engineer für Infrastruktur, damit die Data Platform dieselbe Self-Service-Philosophie und denselben Reifegrad wie die übrige Plattform erreicht.

Das bringst du mit:

  • Fundierte praktische AWS-Erfahrung mit Glue, Athena, Step Functions, EventBridge, Lake Formation und S3 sowie umfassende Terraform-Erfahrung beim Erstellen und Weiterentwickeln gemeinsam genutzter Module.

  • Praxiserfahrung mit CDC-Pipelines und einer Iceberg-basierten Lakehouse-Architektur mit den Ebenen Raw, Curated und Aggregated. Dieses Format ist heute produktiv im Einsatz.

  • Vertrautheit mit Kafka-basiertem Event-Streaming (MSK, Glue Schema Registry) für Ereignisse auf Anwendungsebene, die neben CDC-Daten in der Plattform landen.

  • Sicherheit im Betrieb einer Plattform, auf die andere Teams angewiesen sind: Erfahrung mit Incident Response und SLOs sowie das Urteilsvermögen, individuelle Anforderungen in den Backlog aufzunehmen, statt sie ad hoc umzusetzen.

  • Starke teamübergreifende Kommunikation: Du arbeitest direkt mit Data & AI daran, die Grenzen zwischen Infrastruktur und Pipeline-Logik klar zu halten, und stimmst dich mit dem Principal Platform Engineer für Infrastruktur zu übergreifenden Standards ab. Keine der beiden Beziehungen ist eine Berichtslinie.

  • Ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis dafür, was eine datengetriebene Kultur nachhaltig verankert: Führungskräfte, die anhand von Kennzahlen handeln, organisationsweite Datenkompetenz, eine für alle Zielgruppen zugängliche Infrastruktur und Daten als gemeinschaftliche Ressource.

  • Du kommunizierst sicher gegenüber der Führungsebene und sprichst Zielkonflikte und Risiken proaktiv an, statt darauf zu warten, danach gefragt zu werden.

  • Du kommunizierst schriftlich klar und direkt und kannst technische Positionen gegenüber Engineering-Kolleg:innen ebenso wie gegenüber nichttechnischen Stakeholdern vertreten und begründen.

Nice to have:

  • Vertrautheit mit dbt (dbt-athena) oder Spark/pySpark – genug, um konstruktiv darüber zu sprechen, wo die Grenze zwischen Infrastruktur und Pipeline-Logik künftig verlaufen sollte.

  • Erfahrung beim Aufbau eines On-Call-Dienstes für ein Team, das bisher noch keinen hatte.

  • Erfahrung in der direkten Zusammenarbeit mit Legal- und Compliance-Stakeholdern: Anforderungen an Aufbewahrungsfristen oder Datenklassifizierung in konkrete Infrastrukturentscheidungen übersetzen – und nicht nur wissen, dass es solche Anforderungen gibt.

Das bieten wir dir:

  • Unternehmenskultur: Offene Kultur, flache Hierarchien, Eigeninitiative wird gefördert.

  • Arbeitsverträge: Unbefristete Anstellungen bieten langfristige Sicherheit.

  • Flexibilität: Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Optionen für mobiles Arbeiten und Full-Remote-Verträge.

  • Ausstattung: Freie Wahl der Arbeits-Hardware.

  • Onboarding: Gut strukturiertes Onboarding mit Unterstützung durch einen persönlichen "Buddy".

  • Arbeitsumfeld: Inspirierendes Umfeld mit engagierten Kollegen und einer dynamischen Gemeinschaft.

  • Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten: Vielfältige Chancen für persönliches Wachstum und Entwicklung.

  • Zusatzleistungen: Attraktive Benefits wie betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Gesundheitsprogramme und regelmäßige Teamevents.

... und vieles mehr!

Einen detaillierten Einblick bekommst du auf unserer Karriereseite.

Deine Ansprechperson für diese Stelle ist Yanina Schröer und steht dir bei Fragen gerne zur Verfügung!

Der Schutz deiner persönlichen Daten hat für uns oberste Priorität. Unsere Bewerberinformationen findest du hier.
